desc_en: For as long as I can remember, I invariably preferred the open road to working with dusty ledgers or moving promissory notes from one pile to another. And it definitely felt more engaging to listen to caravaneers' tales about distant travels instead of bickering with them, haggling for better prices.##A firstborn son of a wealthy spice merchant, I never had a say in choosing my fate. My late father, the Host rest his soul, harbored deep animosity towards any kind of knowledge that he couldn't turn into profit - I was taught how to count almost before I learned how to write. He even hired a traveling elven monk to teach me the dialects of Jacinth, so that he could spare expenses on translators in the future...##Over the years, me and my tutor became good friends. Not only I got a decent grasp on the elven language but also learned the basics of the martial art practiced by most of the Jacinth Kingdoms' monastic communities.##To my then surprise, its focus wasn't on wrestling and fist fighting but rather a rich variety of kicks.##( . . . )##After my father's death from a sudden disease, I had no more reason to linger. I sold my share of the family business to my brother for a hefty sum, used that money to gather a caravan, and, after bidding farewell to my family and friends, embarked for the Jacinth Kingdoms...
desc_zh: 我从能记事开始，就喜欢出门旅行，不喜欢翻弄落了灰的账簿，也不喜欢倒腾期票之类的东西，每次听到有人讲商队周游异国他乡的经历，就特别兴奋；每次跟人讨价还价，就头疼得要命。##父亲生前是香料富商，没给我多少选择人生的机会，在他看来，任何知识和信息，不能转化成利润，就没有价值。我还不会写字的时候，他就已经教会我数数了，还请了个精灵族的云游僧，教我红锆各地的方言，希望以后能省去聘用翻译的开销。##我和精灵族的老师渐渐成了挚友，不仅掌握了精灵族的语言，还学了红锆武僧最常练习的基本功法。##我学了这些基础，才知道功夫的重点在于腿脚功夫，而非摔角和手上的技巧。##（……）##父亲突然病逝，我没必要再留家里了，就把我那一部分家业卖给哥哥，然后花了一大笔钱组了商队，告别亲朋好友，启程前往红锆列国……

extra.en: "Journey to the East, Tome One"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Athletics abilities:~/~##~lg~Mighty Kick~/~#~lg~Leg Sweep~/~#~y~Disengage~/~#~y~Not This Time~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《东游记》（卷一）##~gr~可以学习若干“肢体活动”能力：~/~##~lg~猛踹~/~#~lg~扫腿~/~#~y~脱身~/~#~y~命不该绝~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。

extra.en: The first part of the memoir written by an heir of the now impoverished trade house. The lengthy musings about the author's place in the world are lined with meticulous descriptions of martial arts exotic to Aldor.
extra.zh: 这是某本回忆录的第一章，作者是某个没落商业家族的继承者，他用了大量笔墨思考自己在这个世界的位置，时不时也会细腻描述奥尔多很难见到的武术招式。
作者：弗雷德里希·菲尔

desc_en: ...We set up our camp next to a wilting palm grove on the edge of a giant open sky bazaar. Silk, ivory, and figs were laid out on display next to silver ingots and rolls of woolen cloth brought there from Aldor.##As I wandered through the stalls, admiring the wealth of imagery captured in numerous exquisite jade figurines, I couldn't get rid of a nagging thought. The next day I was supposed to head back to Aldor, even though I hadn't yet experienced even the tiniest fragment of what I'd heard about the Jacinth Kingdoms.##My melancholy was interrupted by music. The sounds of flute and drums produced such a catchy tune that my legs carried me towards its source on their own volition. A crowd of bystanders had already gathered in a small clearing next to a carpet merchant's tent. I pushed through them to get a better look - at first, I almost mistook the performance for a vicious brawl.#Two elves, stripped to the waist, their shaved heads betraying them as monks, were exchanging a flurry of strikes, kicks, and leg sweeps. Bare feet kicked up dust, every move and strike was so swift and powerful, it felt like a small miracle that the elves hadn't knocked each other down yet. The spectacle was truly breathtaking: when it looked like either of them fell behind and was about to take a hit, they would deftly dodge or parry it.##There were a few more monks sitting on the ground nearby, a part of the same community. They played the drums, steadily raising the tempo, making the fight resemble an exotic dance.##Finally, the music came to a stop. The fighters bowed to each other to the sound of lazy applause. The crowd began to disperse. A novice monk walked between the rows of onlookers with a clay bowl - some people tossed copper coins in it before leaving. It only took me a couple of solid gold crowns to strike up a conversation...
desc_zh: ……我们在一小片干萎的椰枣树林旁落了脚，扎了营。穿过树林，就是一个巨大的露天巴扎，里面随处可见丝绸、象牙和无花果，有些摊子还摆出了奥尔多产的银锭和羊毛布。##我在商铺之间信步闲逛，把玩着一座座精美的玉雕，脑子里始终有个念头挥之不去。我第二天就要回奥尔多了，从前听闻的红锆列国却还丝毫尚未领略。##远处的乐声将我从惆怅之中唤醒，笛声轻快，鼓点紧密，双腿不由自主地走到了一座卖织毯的帐篷旁边，不大的空地里里外外早已围满了看客。我钻进人群，找到一个合适的位置，起初以为是两个精灵族发生了肢体冲突，而后发现原来是一场表演。#两人上身赤裸，头剃得光亮，想必都是僧人。这边一拳，那边一脚，有来有回，看得人眼花缭乱。一记又一记飞踢，一次又一次扫腿，打得现场沙土飞扬。每一个动作都迅捷有力，然而两个精灵都没有被对方击倒。这边眼看落了下风，那边马上就要挨打，他们都能巧妙闪开，或者化解了对方的攻击。##旁边地上还坐着几位僧人，似乎与打斗的两者同属一个寺院。他们吹着笛子，打着鼓，节奏越来越快，现场的武打也随着变成了异域舞蹈。##音乐最后停了下来，场上的两位僧人对鞠一躬，人群懒散地喝了几声彩，鼓了几下掌，便开始散去。一个幼僧捧着一只陶碗，在看客中间钻来钻去，时不时会听到铜币落碗的“当啷”声音。我只出了几枚足金的钱币，便跟他们搭上了话……

extra.en: The second part of the memoir by Fridrich Fyr is composed of disconnected travel logs of limited practical value. On the bright side, it also contains a bunch of helpful, detailed instructions for a dozen hand-to-hand moves.
extra.zh: 弗雷德里希·菲尔回忆录的第二章，内容是断续不连贯的游记，没有太多价值。不过这一部分详细记述了一些打斗招式，十分有益。

desc_en: ...I decided to join the pilgrims on their journey to the mountains of Sundanar. By the time the purse I brought with me ran out of gold, I had already managed to become close friends with the monks, earning their trust and a place in their community. I spent a few years with them, making pilgrimages across half the Jacinth Kingdoms.##And yet, even at the edge of the world, my fate still caught up with me. I received troubling news from Aldor about my family - our trade empire was falling apart. I had to make a choice once more...##( . . . )##In a truly inexplicable manner, my dear brother managed to make an enemy out of each and every one of our suppliers. He barely paid any attention to the business, instead wasting our fortune on studying questionable occult practices. Needless to say, he didn't have a drop of magic talent in him. Or any business sense, for what it's worth...##To get us out of the debt, I had to sell off the pitiful remnants of our former wealth. Only a few things remained: the family house and our only profitable manufacture, a small printing shop near Maen.##( . . . )##After everything was taken care of, I began languishing. I yearned for the Jacinth Kingdoms, but I couldn't abandon my family in circumstances this dire. At the same time, ever since my return to Aldor, I had a growing desire to tell the entire world about my adventures in the East. And even though I had lots of stories to choose from, I was particularly interested in telling about the exciting lives of Sundanarian monks, their strength of spirit, their grueling training, and the amazing martial arts they practice...
desc_zh: ……我决定跟着他们去松达纳的山区朝圣。钱袋慢慢空了，但我赢得了这些僧人的信任，融入了他们的队伍，与他们成为了关系亲密的朋友。几年之间，我与他们一道朝圣，走遍了半数红锆列国。##我就算到了天涯海角，依然无法摆脱命运的纠缠。奥尔多传来了家里的噩耗，家族的商贸帝国行将崩塌，我又一次走到了人生的岔路口……##（……）##哥哥把我们的供应商全都得罪了，具体情况我全然不知。他一心挥霍家产，研习玄学的邪门歪道，几乎荒废了所有家业。他根本没有修习魔法的天赋，当然也不是经商的料子……##我为了还清家里的外债，卖了所剩无几的家产，最后只留下了家里的房子和曼恩旁边的一座小印厂——这已是我们唯一一间不亏钱的厂子。##（……）##一切安顿好之后，我就消沉了下去。我想回到红锆列国，可是家里这种情况，实在不忍心撒手而去。我自从回到奥尔多，就特别想把自己在东方的冒险经历告诉整个世界，这种念头一天强过一天。我有太多的故事想讲，不过最想讲的还是松达纳僧人的生活，讲他们非凡的精神力量、艰苦的修炼还有令人惊叹的武术……

extra.en: The third part of the memoir extensively denounces extravagant spending habits and the study of forbidden magic. Other than that, there's quite a few tidbits about the training regimen of Sundanarian warrior monks.
extra.zh: 回忆录的第三章，大量篇幅均在抨击铺张挥霍和禁魔研究，还有相当数量的片段谈及了松达纳僧人的修行方法。

desc_en: ...It only took me a week to learn meditation, a common exercise practiced among the people of Sundanar and Bhadjarath. Don't let its seemingly straightforward nature trick you - noticeable results only come with experience.##Unfortunately, I never had the patience for hours-long training sessions, a vital prerequisite for reaching true mastery. Each person has to decide for themselves how much effort they are willing to put into untapping their full potential. I personally found the prospect of sacrificing a few years of my life too bothersome.##Health is strengthened by tempering, tendons - by running, and muscles - by lifting weights. These exercises unquestionably prepare a warrior for hardships. However, they, as all things corporeal, have their limit. The final obstacle, which prevents the full extent of inner power from manifesting itself, lies within our mind. Once this limit is broken, the warrior is no longer a slave to their body, instead putting it at the service of pure Willpower.##To walk off paralyzing pain, to break shackles of fear, to find strength where there was none, to understand your place on the battlefield with crystal clarity - it's all just a tiny fraction of what can be achieved if you train your mind alongside your muscles.
desc_zh: 松达纳和跋嘉罗提的人经常冥思，我只用了一周就学会了反观自己内心。这种修行看似简单，实际并非如此，只有长期积累经验，才能产生显著的效果。##冥思要想真正达到一定的境界，每次都需要花费数个小时，可惜我没有这样的定力。冥思可以令人释放自身潜能，只是任何人都需要自行决定愿意为之付出多少精力。对于我而言，牺牲数年生命修习冥思太过夸张。##淬炼有益健康，跑步强筋健骨，负重增强肌肉。这些锻炼，毫无疑问，能让战士更加坚韧，更能克服种种苦难，只是拘泥于肉体，因而都有一定的局限。要想突破这最后一道障碍，要想完全释放内在的力量，就必须从心念入手。战士一旦冲破了这道障碍，就可以通过纯粹的意志运用躯壳，无须再受躯壳奴役。##视剧痛如无物，破恐畏之心魔，生强力于非时，瞭战局若指掌——假使你能同时驾驭心念和躯体，这些就易如反掌了。

desc_en: There's truly no one more foolhardy than a landless knight! I had plenty of opportunities to prove this during my long and not particularly pious life.##When I was barely twenty, my father unexpectedly passed away. As his youngest son, I was left with nothing. Too wayward to serve under another lord and too hot-headed to become a priest or a templar, I ended up spending my days carousing. That's how I met Sir Dennor, a bastard son of a certain nobleman, whose name I'd rather not mention out of prudence.##We became fast friends. One day, we were having a drink together. I finally decided to ask why he carried a commoner's axe instead of a noble sword, a weapon that befits a man of his high birth. He laughed at the question and told me that he actually grew so skillful with it that he could easily take on any pompous fencer who would dare challenge him. I found the claim unlikely, but before we could begin the argument in earnest, the tavern's door swung open, and a band of angry-looking armed fellows barged in. Their leader, standing a good six and a half feet tall, eyed the quiet tavern hall with a ferocious expression, as if searching for someone. When his gaze settled on Sir Dennor, he smirked victoriously, dropped a few profanities, and drew his sword.##Sir Dennor reacted immediately, I suppose he anticipated this predicament. He grabbed the axe lying nearby and charged at the sneering leader... The uninvited guest attempted to deflect the strike, but it was all for nothing - Sir Dennor nimbly evaded the leader's swing, pushed him off balance, and cleaved his skull in two with a single deft blow. For a split moment there was ringing silence - the dead man's followers were trying to make sense of what had just transpired. But eventually they gathered their wits, yelled out in fury, and ran towards us. I cursed under my breath, flipped the table to hold off their advance, and rushed to help Dennor - the time had come to prove my friendship...
desc_zh: 骑士没有领地，活得比谁都潇洒……我这一辈子活了挺长时间，而且也不是那么虔诚，算是亲身体悟了这个道理。刚二十岁没几天，父亲就突然走了，我排行老末，所以遗产没我的份。##我为人张狂，伺候不了别的领主，行事又浮躁冲动，当不了祭司和圣堂武士，最后成了个酗酒度日的酒鬼，也就是因为喝酒，才认识了丹诺爵士——他是某位领主的私生儿子，领主的名字我就不透露了。##我后来和丹诺成了莫逆之交，有一回趁着酒兴，终于问了他为什么身上别了把平民的斧子。在我看来，他这种出身的人，更应当用高贵的刀剑。爵士听了我这个问题，哈哈大笑，说自己从小到大都是用斧子，已经用得炉火纯青。不论哪个剑手，只要敢找他麻烦，他几下就给砍翻。我觉得他是吹牛，还没来得及跟他争论，酒馆的门就“嘭”得一下开了。一帮人怒气冲冲撞了进来，手上拿着刀剑，身上穿着盔甲。打头那人约莫一丈高，目露凶光，把安安静静的酒馆扫视了一圈，看着是在找人，眼睛最后停在了丹诺爵士身上。他得意洋洋地笑了几下，爆了几句不敬神的粗口，就拔出了剑。##丹诺爵士反应迅速，他想必是已经料到了这个情况，提起一旁的斧子，直向那带头人冲了过去……这位不速之客见势急忙出剑，却让爵士灵巧躲开，反被撞了个趔趄，脑子一下就成了两半。酒馆一时间鸦雀无声，似乎还回荡着斧刃劈开颅骨的声音。过了许久，那人的手下才缓过神来，抽出兵器，怒吼而来。我暗暗骂了一句，掀翻了桌子，挡了几个喽啰，赶忙冲到丹诺旁边相助，这个时候爵士就能看出我跟他的交情怎么样了……

desc_en: Entry seventeen: regarding the fearsome warriors known as berserkers.##Dwarves are simple, gruff, and somewhat savage people. Aldorians, at least the knightly estate, abide by combat etiquette, yet to dwarves the very idea appears preposterous and meaningless. They aren't above using the dirtiest of tricks if it ensures their victory in battle. Berserkers, also known as berserks, are the embodiment of this sentiment. They are the most reckless and ferocious dwarves out there, inspiring fear even among their own brethren.##Clad only in bear pelts, berserkers don't feel shame, pain, or cold. They prefer to fight with two axes, wielding them with surprising dexterity. Some of them treat their weapons as some kind of deities, offering them prayers and reveling in all sorts of idolatry.##Before combat, berserkers consume a special brew that lets them enter a state of destructive fury. Its recipe is strictly guarded, but I can say with certainty that it includes henbane flowers and some strange mushrooms. This drink is extremely toxic to most humans and dwarves, leaving them writhing in agony, but berserkers are always happy to take a sip. When one of them consumes the potion, it's a truly terrifying sight: bloodshot eyes dart all over the place, searching for victims, the entire body shudders with tremors, and foam drips down the disheveled beard. The only thing you can do upon encountering a raging berserker is to keep your distance: imbued with inhuman strength and leaving a trail of carnage in their wake, they will not stop until every opponent is dead on the ground.##Now I finally understand why the Border Guard avoids engaging groups of Fjall raiders until they know for sure whether there are berserkers among their ranks...
desc_zh: 第十七：关于令人胆寒的狂战士。##矮人这个民族粗鄙、野蛮。奥尔多人，或者说起码骑士阶级战斗都会遵守一定的礼节，而对于矮人而言，战斗遵守礼节这种习惯本身似乎就有悖常理、毫无意义。只要能够制胜，再卑劣的手段他们也用得出来，狂战士（又被人称为“狂战”）就是这种观念的最佳体现。这些矮人较其同类更加粗暴和凶残，即便是矮人，见了他们也畏惧三分。##狂战士的身上只披熊皮，不知羞耻、疼痛和寒冷，喜用双斧，而且用得飒飒生风，有一些甚至将自己的双斧视为神明，会向兵器祷告，将它们当作偶像崇拜。##狂战士因为战斗之前通常会喝特制的汤剂，所以可以大杀四方。这种汤剂的配方严格保密，但是原料一定包含天仙子的花和某些菌类。对于多数人类和矮人而言，这种汤剂毒性极强，喝了只会痛苦不堪，然而狂战士通常不会拒绝。这些战士饮下这种汤剂之后，形状着实令人胆寒——两眼充血，目光四处扫射，寻找目标，身体不停抽动，凌乱的胡须不断有白沫滴下。要是遇到了这样一个狂战，唯一能做的就是不要靠近。这些狂战士此时力量异于常人，走到哪里，杀到哪里，对手一刻不死，他们便一刻不会罢休。##我现在终于明白戍边的卫队为什么只要不知道弗约匪帮有没有狂战士，就不会轻易和他们开打了……

extra.en: The author of this book, an Aldorian traveler, had a chance to spend three long winter months in the mountains of Fjall. During his stay in that unwelcoming land, he was dutifully writing down all manner of observations, which he intended to share with his venerated readers.
extra.zh: 这本书的作者是奥尔多的一位旅行家，曾在弗约的山区渡过了三个漫长的冬天。他那段时间尽管在那片环境恶劣的土地备受煎熬，依然记录下了很多东西，只为日后讲给诸位尊敬的读者。

desc_en: "A song about the Headsman of Brynn"##A story of a headsman#Who had a house in Brynn.#Fat bellied, petty villain#He swung his axe with glee.###And then one day a pauper came#To hint at shoddy grind:#"There's no sharpness to the blade#With only strength behind!"##The headsman knelt before the block:#"I'll prove it's sharpened right!#How dare you over here walk#And say it's just my might?"###The pauper chopped at villain's neck#The bloodied edge was true.#It hardly was the grandest hack,#But through the spine it blew.###"Now would you look at that,#The fellow wasn't just strong.#His axe is nothing to scoff at,#He sure proved me wrong!"
desc_zh: 《布林刽子手之歌》##从前有个刽子手#家住在布林#肥头大耳，老地痞#爱砍别人头##有天来了一农夫#说他斧子钝#“只是你的力气大#不然根本不行”##刽子手趴上了砍头台#“竟然说我斧子钝#你胆子可不小#有本事过来试一试#看它钝不钝”##农夫砍在了脖子上#斧刃血淋淋#力气用得倒不大#剁开了骨和肉##“哎哟我天，真可以#这家伙没说谎#他这斧子可真快#除恶又惩凶！”

desc_en: Hundreds of years ago, this boar-shaped piece was carried at the head of countless battle-hardened phalanxes.
desc_zh: 这种锤杖顶部形似野猪，古代通常会有士兵手持这种兵器走在久经沙场的军队方阵头部。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 长杖

desc_en: An intricately embroidered cape cut from strange azure fabric. By the looks of its ornamented gold fibula, it was brought to Aldor from the Jacinth Kingdoms.
desc_zh: 斗篷纹绣精细，用的是某种天蓝色的布料。从金质环扣上的图案来看，应该是从红锆列国带到奥尔多的。

desc_en: Grants the following effect for ~y~360~/~ turns:##Restoration replenishes ~lg~twice~/~ as much Energy per tick
desc_zh: 可以产生以下效果，持续~y~360~/~个回合：##精力自动恢复每次恢复的精力数量~lg~翻倍~/~

extra.en: Glows faintly in the dark - it's said azurecaps do so by capturing and retaining moonlight.
extra.zh: 荧蓝菇在暗处会发出隐约可见的微光，有人说这种蘑菇能吸收月光。

desc_zh: 可以令所选身体部位停止~r~出血~/~。

extra.en: Might keep you from bleeding out.
extra.zh: 或许可以防止失血致死。

desc_zh: 交给派发契据的人，可以获得额外的~y~报酬~/~。

extra.en: A vivid testament to the ruthlessness of Fjall customs.
extra.zh: 生动展现了弗约风俗的凶残。

desc_zh: 大篷车旗帜

desc_en: Few eat barberries for their taste - they're mostly consumed to treat a variety of ailments.
desc_zh: 一般只有得病了或者不舒服的时候才吃刺檗，没什么人会无缘无故吃这个东西。

desc_en: Few eat barberries for their taste - they're mostly consumed to treat a variety of ailments.
desc_zh: 一般只有得病了或者不舒服的时候才吃刺檗，没什么人会无缘无故吃这个东西。

desc_en: Barbutes offer a great balance between protection and unobtrusiveness, which makes them well-suited for archers and light infantry.
desc_zh: 巴布特盔在防护和自如行动中间达到了绝佳的平衡，非常适合弓箭手和轻步兵配戴。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 头盔

desc_en: For the longest time, Aldorian nobles had been rather dismissive towards axes. Their perspective took a turn when the late King Etbert introduced a fashion for richly decorated axes, turning them into a symbol of power.
desc_zh: 过去，人们始终认为斧子是农民用的兵器。先王埃特伯特将纹饰丰富的斧子用作权力的象征之后，人们很快便摒弃了这种观念。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手斧

desc_en: The Council's nobles expected a swift and decisive victory - and miscalculated. As a result, baronial weaponry is now being passed down from one new owner to the next.
desc_zh: 王廷的贵族当初以为可以旗开得胜、马到成功，结果失算了。于是，男爵的兵器便开始了频频辗转易主的生活。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手锤棒

desc_en: Baselards are so popular among both the nobility and townsmen that they are often viewed as an accessory rather than an actual weapon.
desc_zh: 很多贵族和普通的城里人身上都会带着一把巴塞拉德，不过很多只是把它当做装饰，而非防身的兵器。

stats.type_text: 普通 匕首

desc_en: Once native to Aldor's shadowy groves, this ancient bat species now survives only in the depths of caves.
desc_zh: 这种蝙蝠已经出现很久，源自奥尔多影影绰绰的林间，如今只出没于洞穴深处。

extra.zh: 可以剖解。

desc_en: Once native to Aldor's shadowy groves, this ancient bat species now survives only in the depths of caves.
desc_zh: 这种蝙蝠已经出现很久，源自奥尔多影影绰绰的林间，如今只出没于洞穴深处。

extra.zh: 可以剖解。

desc_en: A simple butcher's cleaver, crudely refashioned into a sword-like shape by an unknown craftsman.
desc_zh: 普普通通的砍刀，不知道被哪个工匠改成了剑的式样。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: A stable stance during spellcasting matters just as much as the precision of gestures - and quality boots provide welcome support.
desc_zh: 施展法咒的时候，脚下稳不稳和手上动作准不准一样重要，所以质量上乘的靴子能帮上不少忙。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: Battlemages aren't averse to risks. Many of them willingly forgo proper head protection to stay unhindered while casting complex spells.
desc_zh: 战地法师置生死于度外，许多人为了畅快施放复杂的咒法，甘愿头部不加防护。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: Everything about it speaks of practicality and ease of wear: thick fabric, muted colors, simple - albeit golden - fastenings...
desc_zh: 这个斗篷各处做工都透着实用：布料厚实，颜色克制，搭扣样式朴素——虽然是金的……

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 斗篷

desc_en: Its inner layer is embroidered with protective spells.
desc_zh: 兜帽内里绣了一些防护法咒。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: Much lighter than a common gambeson and much sturdier than a mantle, this chestpiece combines the best of both worlds.
desc_zh: 这件防具论轻便，远胜过普通的软铠；论结实，又甚优于普通的法袍，兼具二者之长。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Well-trained and experienced mages are a force to be reckoned with, which makes them a prime target on the battlefield. Unsurprisingly, they're always on a lookout for quality armor that doesn't compromise the freedom of movement.
desc_zh: 修习有素的法师积累了丰富的经验之后，绝对不可小觑，战场上常常是敌人重点关注的目标。正是因为这个，他们经常寻觅优质防具，希望自身的行动不会受到防具影响。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 手套

desc_en: Battle-proven mages are always in demand and, consequently, are wealthy enough to afford custom-tailored, hard-wearing mantles.
desc_zh: 久经沙场的法师从来不用担心无事可做，所以收入也是相当丰厚，有余钱订做经磨耐穿的袍子。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Every so often, there's simply no time for casting spells, and fighting up close becomes the only option.
desc_zh: 有些时候根本没有时间施法，近身打斗就成了唯一选择。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: A rare remedy that brings back youthful vigor and replenishes stamina.
desc_zh: 这种东西可以入药，不过稀罕且昂贵。许多人认为坚持使用熊脂可以保持年轻，恢复体力。

desc_en: Lends itself to a higher grip whenever the enemy gets too close for a full swing.
desc_zh: 如果敌人近在眼前，不宜大开大合，这种斧头也可以握着靠上的位置使用。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: In the eyes of the Fjall dwarves, the sling is a far more honorable weapon than the bow - so much so that even battle-hardened veterans readily wield it in combat.
desc_zh: 在弗约矮人眼中，投石索远比弓更拿得出手，连久经沙场的老兵也一点都不避讳这种兵器。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: Additional resolution options will be added in future updates.
desc_zh: 其他的分辨率未来将会支持。

extra.zh: 独眼龙魏格玛
属性
拿走

desc_en: Filling and mellow in flavor, beets are a staple of peasant cooking.
desc_zh: 甜菜头有营养，甘甜可口，很多农家菜都得放这样东西。

desc_en: Filling and mellow in flavor, beets are a staple of peasant cooking.
desc_zh: 甜菜头有营养，甘甜可口，很多农家菜都得放这样东西。

desc_en: Named after forge bellows, this helmet's visor has numerous perforations, allowing for less restricted breathing and improved air flow.
desc_zh: 这种头盔的面甲因为形似风箱而得名。面甲镂有孔洞，所以头盔内部呼吸和通风都更方便。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 头盔

desc_en: Rather than relying on your arm strength alone, the belt hook also allows to engage back muscles when drawing the string, which makes reloading this crossbow noticeably less tiring.
desc_zh: 这把弩装了腰钩，装填更加方便，引弦的时候可以更好地调用背部肌肉。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: Fjall berserkers draw strength not only from the Ancestors' protection but also from the spirit of their guardian beast.
desc_zh: 弗约狂战士的力量不仅来自先祖的庇护，也来自他们守护兽的魂灵。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: Its previous owner could equally likely be an orc or a dwarf.
desc_zh: 先前的主人可能是个奥克，也可能是个矮人。

desc_en: Local herbalists regard bilberries as a trusted remedy for stomachaches.
desc_zh: 奥尔多的药师坚信黑果越橘有治疗腹痛的功效。

desc_en: Local herbalists regard bilberries as a trusted remedy for stomachaches.
desc_zh: 奥尔多的药师坚信黑果越橘有治疗腹痛的功效。

desc_en: Bills of exchange were invented by the bankers of the Bronze Isles. This convenient trading tool proved so popular among Brynn merchants that they brought it with them to the Continent.
desc_zh: 汇票由青铜群岛的钱庄发明，使用便利，深受布林的商人青睐，所以被他们带上了大陆。

extra.en: Can be used as payment when trading with denizens of ~bl~Brynn~/~.##Bills of exchange won't be accepted in other settlements and cities.
extra.zh: ~bl~布林~/~城内与城民交易商品时可以使用。##其他城镇、乡村不接受汇票。

desc_en: Long before the unification of Aldor, such clasps were already used to fasten the burial clothes of anyone wealthy enough to afford them.
desc_zh: 奥尔多统一之前，这种夹扣就已经出现很久了，富有家庭会用这个东西固定逝者下葬时所穿的衣物。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Early Hieronites made frequent use of the imagery of a lone bird to depict the soul's pursuit of the Host's grace.
desc_zh: 圣门的早期成员经常利用孤鸟的形象描绘灵魂追逐圣主的恩惠。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: It's believed that these figurines come to life in the afterworld, guiding the souls of the dead with their radiance.
desc_zh: 人们认为这种物件到了生后世界就会活过来，利用光辉为亡者的魂灵引路。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: For a time, the court was swept up in an extravagant fashion for ancient Ald customs, such as drinking from bison horns. It didn't take long for everyone to return to far more convenient cups, though.
desc_zh: 王室之前热衷豪掷千金，企图恢复古代奥尔多人的风土习俗，彼时若能用牛角饮酒，往往说明饮者身份不凡。这股风潮没有持续很久，人们最后还是选择了熟悉且更加便利的酒杯。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: It's almost asking to be put to work.
desc_zh: 恨不得能张嘴叫你开工。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Whether they're making armor, blades, or horseshoes, no smith would consider reaching for tongs or hammer before putting on a good pair of mittens.
desc_zh: 但凡是铁匠，不论是锻打盔甲、刀剑还是马掌，拿钳子锤子之前都会先戴上结实耐用的手套。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 手套

desc_en: What need is there for a helmet, when in an honest duel no blade could hope to reach your head?
desc_zh: 光明正大的决斗没有刀剑会砍到头上，还需要戴什么头盔？

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: With a proper polish, they could easily pass for a mirror.
desc_zh: 两只靴子如果好好擦一擦，能亮得像镜子一样。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: Lightweight, resilient, and cut for mobility - despite the many metal plates sewn into the lining.
desc_zh: 轻便，结实，而且虽然内里缝了不少铁板，但剪裁丝毫不影响活动。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Expert fencers can afford to skimp on heavy hand protection, trusting in their ability to parry every blow.
desc_zh: 剑术精湛的人可以依靠自身能力招架对手的每一次击打，不需要专门选择厚重的护具保护双手。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 手套

desc_en: Blademasters are paid double wages to fight on the frontline - and they don't need to be asked twice to demonstrate why this expense is well-founded.
desc_zh: 剑客在前线作战，报酬是其他人的两倍。你要是问为什么他们就翻倍？剑客往往当时就能让你明白翻倍的原因。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 双手刀剑

desc_en: A gift from the Duke of the Bronze Isles to the Archtheurgist of the High Hieron, who blessed it to eternally sate the thirst of those in need. Miraculously, the water inside never runs out.
desc_zh: 青铜狮形水壶，工艺精美，不知出自青铜群岛哪位精工巧匠之手，传入奥尔多之后，至高圣会大圣宗本尊亲自为其开了光。自此之后，壶中每逢水竭，便会奇迹一般地水满盈壶，永续不断，因而成了缺水之人恒久的取水之源。

extra.en: Can be activated once per day. Sates ~lg~50%~/~ Thirst, replenishes ~lg~25%~/~ Max Health, and improves Condition of each body part by ~lg~15%~/~.
extra.zh: 每天可以使用一次，令口渴缓解~lg~一半~/~，恢复生命上限~lg~25%~/~的生命，身体各个部位情况好转~lg~15%~/~。

desc_en: An old-fashioned crossbow, restored with care, if somewhat hastily. The opening words of a common Hieronite prayer are carved into its stock.
desc_zh: 这把老式的弩年头久远，虽然打理得仓促，也能看出其中的爱惜。弩身刻了圣会某段祷文开头的几个字词。

desc_en: Can be delivered to the contract giver for an additional ~y~reward~/~.
desc_zh: 交给派发契据的人，可以获得额外的~y~报酬~/~。

extra.en: Continues to ooze otherworldly, spectral chill.
extra.zh: 依然散发着不属于这个世界的幽幽寒意。

desc_en: unholy blood
desc_zh: 邪血

desc_en: Sweet, with a touch of pleasant sourness. Simply delicious.
desc_zh: 酸酸甜甜，爽口美味。

desc_en: Sweet, with a touch of pleasant sourness. Simply delicious.
desc_zh: 酸酸甜甜，爽口美味。

desc_en: May be quite dangerous when angered.
desc_zh: 激怒之后，十分危险。

desc_en: This homemade shield is just a few rough planks cobbled together. Still better than nothing.
desc_zh: 几块木板凑在一起，就是一块盾牌。虽然简陋，总比什么都没有好。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 盾牌

desc_en: A weapon of choice among the corsairs of the Bronze archipelago, utterly indispensable during boardings.
desc_zh: 青铜群岛的雇佣海盗喜欢用这种兵器，劫船的时候必不可少。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: Bodkin arrows are designed to penetrate light armor, but they lack raw stopping power.
desc_zh: 锥头弓箭专门用于穿透轻甲，不过杀伤力较弱。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: Bodkin bolts are designed to penetrate light armor, but they lack raw stopping power.
desc_zh: 锥头弩箭专门用于穿透轻甲，不过杀伤力较弱。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: Also known as buckbean, this plant can easily be found around swamps. It stimulates appetite and is often used in various tonics.
desc_zh: 这种植物多见于沼泽周围，可以开胃，也常用于配制奎宁水。

desc_en: As gamblers like to say, always keep an ace up your sleeve and a dagger down your boot.
desc_zh: 赌场里的人经常说：“袖子里要藏一张王牌，靴子里得藏一把匕首。”

stats.type_text: 普通 匕首

desc_en: Won't even interest a dog.
desc_zh: 狗都不会多看一眼。

desc_en: Won't even interest a dog.
desc_zh: 狗都不会多看一眼。

desc_en: While in the Inventory, grants bonuses that can be added through the crafting menu with ~w~rare hunting trophies~/~. The bonuses are empowered by killing respective animals and are refreshed by using more ~w~trophies~/~ of the required type.##The charm can grant up to ~w~3~/~ different bonuses simultaneously. Upon reaching the limit, a new bonus will replace the oldest one.
desc_zh: ~w~稀罕的猎获~/~与骨器放入制作界面，可以赋予骨器相应的增益。骨器在行囊里时，增益生效。击杀相应的动物可以增强增益的效果，再次献祭相应的~w~猎获~/~可以令增强的增益生效。##骨器同时最多可以赋予~w~3~/~种增益。如果增益数量已满，继续增添增益会顶掉旧的增益。

extra.en: Norrheim hunters believe that the spirit of a slain animal can be compelled to offer aid through a special incantation - though its exact words are known only to a few.
extra.zh: 假如诺尔海姆的猎手所言不虚，那么动物杀死之后，可以念诵某个特别的咒语，令其亡魂从旁助你，不过咒语具体的内容鲜为人知。

desc_en: While in the Inventory, killing an enemy reduces Sanity by ~r~6~/~, with ~y~33%~/~ chance activates ~lg~Unholy Blessing~/~ for ~y~9~/~ turns, and grants the following effect for ~y~9~/~ turns:##~lg~+9%~/~ Life Drain#~lg~-9%~/~ Damage Taken#~lg~+9%~/~ Experience Gain
desc_zh: 行囊如果放了这件东西，击杀敌人会令你~y~9~/~回合之内神智减~r~6~/~、生命吸取~lg~+9%~/~、所受伤害~lg~-9%~/~、经验收益~lg~+9%~/~、并有~y~33%~/~的几率触发~y~9~/~回合的~lg~邪术庇佑~/~。

extra.en: A necromantic artifact created by Axonian mages and later rediscovered by Venemist. Picking it up instantly fills your mind with faint, lingering whispers in a long-dead language...
extra.zh: 这是古亚克逊法师创造的死灵法器，最近被韦尼米斯特发现。你只是把它捡了起来，脑中就立刻隐约响起了某种灭绝已久的语言，沉吟低语久久回荡不绝……

desc_en: 3rd of Reaping##All brothers toiled well today. Let's hope that the coming harvest will recompense us for our hard work just as it did last year. Another few bountiful seasons, and we might save up enough gold to renovate the cloisters. Patience and diligence are truly the greatest virtues.##5th of Reaping##This night Brother Albert went down with a sudden fever. The heat from his body is so severe, one can burn a hand on him. I have no idea how he managed to catch a cold like this... Perhaps he worked in the rain? I left a couple brothers by Albert's side and sent to Mannshire for a healer. Herbal poultices and earnest prayers should be more than enough to cure this ailment.##6th of Reaping##Since last night, Brother Albert hasn't been able to recognize any of us. He keeps on babbling some nonsense, but no one can make sense of it... The healer stayed by his bedside till morning, tried all his potions - it was all for naught. Before he headed back home, we had to pay him regardless. If Albert doesn't get better soon by himself, it will be his funeral we'll have to pay for...##6th of Reaping, evening##Brother Irve is sick as well. It's not a cold...
desc_zh: 刈月初三##大伙今天都累得不轻，希望这回收成能跟去年一样好，也不枉我们一年辛苦。再有几季好收成，应该就有钱修缮院里的回廊了。人还是要沉得住气、吃苦耐劳才行啊！##刈月五日##艾尔伯特修士今天突然病倒了，高烧不退，整个人烫得碰都不能碰，也不知道一场感冒怎么会成这样……估计是淋雨着了凉？我让几个修士守他床边，还叫了人去曼郡找治疗师来给他看看。用些草药，再祈祷几次，应该就能好了。##刈月六日##艾尔伯特昨天晚上开始就不认识人了，净说胡话，谁都听不懂他说的什么……治疗师在床边忙活了整整一夜，能用的药全都用了一遍，什么用都没有。折腾了一夜也没治出名堂，照样出了钱才把他打发走。要是艾尔伯特这两天还不见好的话，估计就要掏钱给他下葬了……##刈月六日夜##伊尔弗修士也病倒了，看样子这病不是感冒那么简单……

extra.zh: 破旧的大部头，装订被啃得不像样子，书页潮湿、泛黄。
作者：维迪安院长

desc_zh: 刈月初三##大伙今天都累得不轻，希望这回收成能跟去年一样好，也不枉我们一年辛苦。再有几季好收成，应该就有钱修缮院里的回廊了。人还是要沉得住气、吃苦耐劳才行啊！##刈月五日##艾尔伯特修士今天突然病倒了，高烧不退，整个人烫得碰都不能碰，也不知道一场感冒怎么会成这样……估计是淋雨着了凉？我让几个修士守他床边，还叫了人去曼郡找治疗师来给他看看。用些草药，再祈祷几次，应该就能好了。##刈月六日##艾尔伯特昨天晚上开始就不认识人了，净说胡话，谁都听不懂他说的什么……治疗师在床边忙活了整整一夜，能用的药全都用了一遍，什么用都没有。折腾了一夜也没治出名堂，照样出了钱才把他打发走。要是艾尔伯特这两天还不见好的话，估计就要掏钱给他下葬了……##刈月六日夜##伊尔弗修士也病倒了，看样子这病不是感冒那么简单……

desc_en: Few corners of Aldor are as perilous as the Northern Borderlands, where the reach of raiders and monsters from Fjall is held in check only by the preparedness of the local garrisons, whose gear could inspire envy in even some noble lords.
desc_zh: 奥尔多境内，北疆是数一数二危险的地方。弗约的强盗和怪物能侵犯王国多少领土，完全取决于当地戍边卫兵的战斗实力，所以他们装备好到连有些贵族老爷都眼红。

desc_en: After the Maafs conquered Jarimad, the nomad chieftains presented their bozdogans to the conquerors - who, unexpectedly, took quite a liking to the weapon.
desc_zh: 玛弗征服亚里迈德之后，收到了各部酋长献上的波兹多安，没想到游牧民族的这种兵器居然令他们爱不释手。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Has a remarkable tendency to tie itself in impossible knots.
desc_zh: 这根腰带经常缠出令人匪夷所思的死结。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: A brandistock is a fairly uncommon weapon which is sometimes issued to sergeants of the Road Guard.
desc_zh: 三尖枪非常少见，有些巡路铁卫的军官会配备这种兵器。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: Expensive, but not without its benefits. Royal physicians have been using brandy for years to "treat" monarchs' coughs and headaches - there haven't been many complaints so far.
desc_zh: 这东西不便宜，不过用处也很多。此前多年以来，王家治疗师都是用白兰地“治”国王、君主的咳嗽和头疼，也没多少人抱怨疗效不好。

extra.zh: 可以导致中度~r~醉酒~/~。

desc_en: Expensive, but not without its benefits. Royal physicians have been using brandy for years to "treat" monarchs' coughs and headaches - there haven't been many complaints so far.
desc_zh: 这东西不便宜，不过用处也很多。此前多年以来，王家治疗师都是用白兰地“治”国王、君主的咳嗽和头疼，也没多少人抱怨疗效不好。

extra.zh: 可以导致中度~r~醉酒~/~。

desc_en: A typical coming-of-age gift for a merchant's son.
desc_zh: 如果家里是做生意的，不少男孩到了成人的年纪，都会收到这样一份成年礼。

desc_en: Brass has been around for centuries - the technique used to make this ring is rooted in the Firn metal-working tradition.
desc_zh: 弗恩几百年前就开始接触黄铜，这枚戒指的制作工艺就源自弗恩的冶金传统。

desc_en: A handy tool for sealing personal letters and business papers.
desc_zh: 个人信件和商函盖章的时候，用这个非常方便。

desc_en: A hefty loaf of rustic bread. Somewhat chewy.
desc_zh: 一大块面包，乡下烤法，有点粘牙。

desc_en: A hefty loaf of rustic bread. Somewhat chewy.
desc_zh: 一大块面包，乡下烤法，有点粘牙。

desc_en: These swords are forged by the dozen in underground smithies, far from prying eyes and unwanted questions.
desc_zh: 这种剑产自不见人的兵械工场，避开耳目，也省了很多没必要的询问，每次一造就是几十把。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: Offers a bit of respite from the scorching midday sun.
desc_zh: 能够稍微遮挡正午炙热的阳光。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: It's best to keep your distance when someone is swinging this axe around - it chops limbs and heads with equal ease.
desc_zh: 如果对方手里拿着这么一把斧子，最好和他保持距离。否则的话，掉脑袋和断手断脚都是一眨眼的事情。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: Arrows like these often get stuck deep in the flesh, causing massive bleeding. However, they are rather heavy, cumbersome, and of limited use against armor.
desc_zh: 这种箭镞通常能深嵌皮肉之中，导致伤者大量失血。不过，这类箭镞很沉、笨重，而且破坏防具的效果很差。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: Bolts like these often get stuck deep in the flesh, causing massive bleeding. However, they are rather heavy, cumbersome, and of limited use against armor.
desc_zh: 这种箭镞通常会深嵌皮肉之中，造成伤者大量失血。不过，这类箭镞很沉、笨重，而且破坏防具的效果很差。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: For a noblewoman, it's a boring ring with a cheap gem. For a poor commoner's daughter - an incredible luxury and her greatest treasure.
desc_zh: 只有一颗廉价宝石，贵族女辈肯定看不上这种戒指，但对穷苦家庭的女人而言，没有什么东西比它还要金贵。

stats.type_text: 普通 通用型 戒指

desc_en: In olden times, Alds had a tradition of burying horses alongside their deceased owners. Those who weren't affluent enough to buy a mount in life had to settle for a miniature replica.
desc_zh: 很久以前，奥尔多人有用马陪葬的传统，身家不怎么富裕，买不起马的话，就只能用小型的塑像代替。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Hieronite funerary rites prescribe burying the deceased alongside a few jugs of water or wine.
desc_zh: 按照圣会仪礼，圣门之徒下葬，身旁必须摆几壶水或者葡萄酒。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Your main ally in the never-ending struggle for tidiness and order.
desc_zh: 打扫、整理是无休止的斗争，这个是你的重要战友。

desc_en: Among the brotherhoods created after the dissolution of the Triune Hand Order, the Brotherhood of Ouroboros is the most secretive and mysterious one. Its symbol has a plethora of interpretations: the most popular one is a righteous death followed by a rebirth.
desc_zh: 三手会解散之后出现了诸多兄弟会，其中数衔尾蛇兄弟会最为神秘。这个组织的标志存在多种解读，最常见的一种认为表示人若死得其所，就能重生。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 中 盾牌

desc_en: The Brotherhood of the Asp's knights are best known for abandoning Aldor to settle in the mountains of Ahjat. According to legends, their hidden citadel stands as a sanctuary of learning at the crossroads of religion, magic, and alchemy - concealed from prying eyes and protected by the Sultan himself.
desc_zh: 地虺兄弟会的骑士之所以为世人所知，最主要是他们放弃奥尔多，住到了艾哈雅特的山里。传闻这些骑士的大本营位置隐蔽，与世隔绝，受到苏丹庇护，他们在那里同时研习宗教、魔法和炼金术这三门学问。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 腰带

desc_en: Can be used to start a campfire on an empty adjacent tile.#Campfires allow to cook food and reduce the duration of  ~r~"Wetness"~/~ affecting your character.
desc_zh: 能在邻近的空格生起营火。#营火可以做菜，还能缩短角色自身~r~潮湿~/~的存续时间。

extra.en: There are enough sticks here to sustain a fire for a long while.
extra.zh: 这些树枝够烧一阵子的。

desc_en: Can be used to start a campfire on an empty adjacent tile.#Campfires allow to cook food and reduce the duration of  ~r~"Wetness"~/~ affecting your character.
desc_zh: 能在邻近的空格生起营火。#营火可以做菜，还能缩短角色自身~r~潮湿~/~的存续时间。

extra.en: There are enough sticks here to sustain a fire for a long while.
extra.zh: 这些树枝够烧一阵子的。

desc_en: The Falcon Company is one of the most infamous detachments of the Magistrate's army. Their crossbows were fashioned by master craftsmen of Brynn in the likeness of elven bolt throwers.
desc_zh: 猛隼佣兵团是城联军里赫赫有名的队伍。他们的弩由布林技艺精湛的弩匠制作，仿效了精灵族的大弩。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: A weapon of rank, proudly carried by captains of the Brynn garrison. The way they strut about with these axes on their belts is a sight to behold.
desc_zh: 这种兵器只有布林戍军的长官才能佩戴，只要看到有人走路大摇大摆，腰上别着这么一把斧子，肯定就是戍军长官。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: These shields are employed by famous Crossbow Brigades, the elite units of the Brynn garrison.
desc_zh: 布林戍军的精英部队——-声名赫赫的弩兵旅用的就是这种盾牌。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 盾牌

desc_en: A line of soldiers bristling with such polehammers is a force that can threaten even the heavy cavalry. Especially the heavy cavalry.
desc_zh: 如果有士兵握着这种长柄锤站成一列，就算是重型骑兵见了也不能轻视，不仅不能轻视，还应该打起一万分精神谨慎应对。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: The design has unmistakably Brynnian roots, blending a multi-pronged hammerhead with a sharp spike, typical of the South.
desc_zh: 这个战锤的形制显然继承了布林的样式，锤头分三叉，顶部锥形，是南方典型的设计。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Can be used to haul some cool well water on a hot day.
desc_zh: 天热的时候，什么都不如一桶凉爽的井水。

desc_en: Can be used to haul some cool well water on a hot day.
desc_zh: 天热的时候，什么都不如一桶凉爽的井水。

extra.zh: 里边盛了水。

desc_en: Any duelist worth their salt must possess three things: a buckler, a trusty blade, and a carefully rehearsed Brynn accent.
desc_zh: 正儿八经的对决手有三样东西绝对不能少——小圆盾、多年随身的兵器和精心学习的布林腔。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 盾牌

desc_en: Allows you to open doors in the Order's Prison.
desc_zh: 可以打开教会监狱的牢门。

extra.en: Shaking it produces a pleasant jingling sound.
extra.zh: 摇几下会发出清脆悦耳的声响。

desc_en: Buntings have a distinct preference for building their nests near cultivated fields.
desc_zh: 黄鹀喜欢把巢筑在耕地附近。

extra.zh: 羽毛可以拔掉。
黄鹀

desc_en: Buntings have a distinct preference for building their nests near cultivated fields.
desc_zh: 黄鹀喜欢把巢筑在耕地附近。

extra.zh: 羽毛可以拔掉。
黄鹀

desc_en: This weed grows along roads and fences. Its roots are valued for their numerous medicinal properties.
desc_zh: 长于路边或篱笆旁，据说根部有多种功用。

desc_en: Can be used to store items, with dedicated compartments for crowbars and lockpicks.##Must be equipped before use.
desc_zh: 可以收纳物品，有专门放撬棍和开锁工具的地方。##装备之后才能使用。

extra.en: Draws sidelong glances from nearby guards, but that's the price of being well-prepared for the job.
extra.zh: 容易引起卫兵注意，不过干这个就少不了这样家伙事。

desc_en: A herb used to staunch fresh wounds and keep infection at bay.
desc_zh: 这种植物既能给伤口止血，还能防止创口感染。

desc_en: When added to a dish during cooking, grants it an ~y~additional effect~/~:##~lg~+25%~/~ Hunger Resistance#~lg~+1%~/~ Diet Morale
desc_zh: 做菜时加入，可以令餐食~y~额外~/~获得一个效果：##饥饿抗性~lg~+25%~/~#饮食斗志~lg~+1%~/~

extra.en: As the saying goes, butter makes everything better. Can add it to pretty much anything.
extra.zh: 老话说得好，“黄油再加也不嫌多”，基本上什么东西都能加黄油。

desc_zh: 色彩斑斓，轻翼翩跹，令人不禁想到人生易逝。

desc_en: Cabbage makes up nearly half the diet of an average peasant: it's eaten raw, boiled, stewed, pickled...
desc_zh: 平常农家每日三餐有一半都离不开这种卷心菜，能生吃，白水煮了能吃，能炖菜，也能腌……

desc_en: Has ~w~90%~/~ Armor Penetration and ~lg~+100%~/~ Bodypart Damage.##~w~100%~/~ chance to cause ~w~Confusion~/~ for ~w~4-6~/~ turns#~w~100%~/~ chance to ~w~Immobilize~/~ for ~w~2~/~ turns#~w~100%~/~ chance to ~w~Stagger~/~ for ~w~2~/~ turns##Move Resistance is ~r~50%~/~ less effective against caltrops.
desc_zh: 无视~w~90%~/~的护甲，肢体伤害~lg~+100%~/~。##有~w~100%~/~的几率造成~w~4-6~/~回合的~w~混乱~/~#有~w~100%~/~的几率造成~w~2~/~回合的~w~移动受限~/~#有~w~100%~/~几率造成~w~2~/~回合的~w~失衡~/~####踩到铁蒺藜时，位移抗性的效果减弱~r~50%~/~。

extra.en: During the siege of Brynn, Magistrate mercenaries used these to greet Council soldiers: a carpet of caltrops blocking a narrow street can easily hold off an enemy advance, be it cavalry or light infantry.
extra.zh: 王廷围攻布林的时候，城联的雇佣兵经常用这个招呼王廷的兵。狭街窄巷只要撒上铁蒺藜，别管骑兵还是轻步兵，都能轻松挡住。

desc_en: So withered that it's almost impossible to think of any good use for it.
desc_zh: 都干成这样了，实在想不到还能有什么用处？

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: Can be ignited when equipped or fastened to the belt.##~ly~Illuminates~/~ the surroundings within ~w~9~/~ tiles.#Remaining within a lit area removes the penalties of darkness.##Can be refilled with candles.
desc_zh: 拿在手上或挂在腰带上时可以点燃。##能够~ly~照亮~/~周围~w~9~/~个方格。#如果站在照亮的区域，视野范围不会受黑暗影响。##更换蜡烛可以续用。

extra.en: Darkness shrinks back and retreats as the candlelight at your belt flickers to life.
extra.zh: 腰上提灯的烛光摇曳，黑暗见状便退开了。

desc_en: Refills the candle lantern by ~lg~20%~/~.
desc_zh: 可以让蜡烛提灯照明时间恢复~lg~20%~/~。

extra.zh: 这根蜡烛烧不了多长时间了。

desc_en: A reinforced variant of a barbute, preferred by those who don't find scars attractive.
desc_zh: 这种巴布特盔经过了加固，不喜欢伤口的人颇为青睐这种头盔。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 头盔

desc_en: A dozing sentry will snap to attention at the sound of their heavy tread.
desc_zh: 打瞌睡的哨兵听到这种靴子的脚步声，会“噌”得一下醒过来。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 靴子

desc_en: Fashioned to keep the wearer in one piece, letting them live through scrapes they have no business surviving.
desc_zh: 这种防具的形制主要是为了安全，即便是九死一生的险境也能捡回一条性命。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 铠甲

desc_en: It's not unusual for leaders of the most celebrated mercenary warbands to amass fortunes that eclipse those of many aristocrats. Naturally, much of it is spent on acquiring the best equipment available.
desc_zh: 如果雇佣兵团声名显赫，那么团长有时候家产甚至可以超过许多贵族。这种时候，他们自然会把很多财产用来购置最上等的装备。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 铠甲

desc_en: Anyone who lives long enough to earn the rank of captain knows full well how to avoid putting themselves into unnecessary danger - sometimes you just don't need more than a gambeson.
desc_zh: 不论是谁，但凡活得够长，混到了长官的位置，都知道怎么能避免不必要的危险。有时候不需要别的，一件夹棉软铠就行。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Built for the battlefield, and equally useful for loudly slamming a fist on the war table when the campaign isn't going to plan.
desc_zh: 设计的初衷只考虑了战场，但战况不顺利的时候，也适合“哐哐”砸沙盘。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 手套

desc_en: For a mercenary warband's captain, a greatsword isn't just a weapon but a proof of their rank and combat experience. And if they need to spend some extra gold to make it stand out, then so be it.
desc_zh: 对于雇佣兵团的团长而言，大剑不仅仅是兵器，也体现了他们的级别和作战经验。有的人还喜欢多花几个钱给自己的宝剑修饰一番。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: It strikes a perfect balance between aesthetics, battlefield performance, and comfort of use - such swords are often carried by captains of the most renowned mercenary companies.
desc_zh: 这种兵器看着好看、用着舒服，杀敌效果也不差，颇受各大佣兵团的长官青睐。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: A captain's poleaxe stands out even at a distance - a rallying point, and a reassuring sign that the company is still in the fight.
desc_zh: 长官的长柄斧即便离得远了，也分外醒目，这是大家的集结点，也是振奋人心的标志，说明兵团还在奋战。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: Will hold a scabbard, a supply pouch, a key to the war chest, a map case, a list of passwords - and whatever else the situation demands.
desc_zh: 什么都能挂，剑鞘、补给口袋、钱柜钥匙、地图卷筒、记下来的口令，还有各种乱七八糟的东西。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: In the hands of mercenary captains, warhammers are mainly treated as a symbol of command. Nevertheless, this doesn't prevent them from being highly effective tools of war.
desc_zh: 战锤到了雇佣兵团的长官手上，主要作为发号施令的象征，不过这个用途丝毫不影响克敌的效果。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Adds a flagpole to the Camp, allowing to raise found ~w~banners~/~ to receive various bonuses.
desc_zh: 营地添置一根旗杆，可以升起途中获得的~w~旗帜~/~，从而获得各种增益。

extra.en: A symbol of fellowship and hope.
extra.zh: 这个东西象征了同伴的感情，也是希望的标志。

desc_en: An ordinary hammer that can also be used to pull out bent or errant nails.
desc_zh: 普普通通的锤子，也能拔钉歪钉偏的钉子。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: An excellent garnish... once you wash the dirt off.

desc_en: Any weapon has a potential to be transformed into an object of art. It's the age of redundancy after all.
desc_zh: 任何兵器都可以变成艺术品，毕竟眼下是一个浮华的时代。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: Similar figurines can be found in any peasant home. The rough workmanship leaves plenty of room for interpretation: some would say it is the Host, others a local saint...
desc_zh: 这种小木雕随便哪个农户家都能见到。工艺粗糙，便也留下了很多解读的空间，有的说这是圣主，有说是本地的圣徒……

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: It's amazing how much a plain gold ring can transform in the hands of a skilled craftsman.
desc_zh: 简简单单的金戒指，到了能工巧匠手里，竟然能变成这样，真是不可思议。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 戒指

desc_en: It was most likely crafted for a wealthy Royal Ranger, who had been granted a fief for his loyal service.
desc_zh: 很有可能是某位有钱的王苑守卫因功受了封，才打了这么一把好弓。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: Such necklaces are an essential attribute of prosperous city aristocrats, who never miss a chance to put their wealth on display.
desc_zh: 城里的名门贵族不会放过任何炫耀家产的机会，这种项链他们家家必有。

stats.type_text: 普通 攻击型 项链

desc_en: You never know what you might find in a church casket: could be a scrap of old parchment, could be the finger of a long-dead saint.
desc_zh: 你永远不知道教堂的匣子里边会有什么，可能是老羊皮纸的碎块，也可能是早年某个圣徒的一截手指。

extra.en: Can be used to store items.##Might interest some merchants.
extra.zh: 可以收纳物品。##这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: The Castelliers were the Bronzian branch of the Order of the Triune Hand, famed for their relentless fight against piracy and the construction of impregnable fortresses, from which they took their name.
desc_zh: 卡斯泰列是三手会布朗齐亚的分会，素以抵御海寇、修筑堡垒闻名，因而得此名（意“垒砌城堡的人”）。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 长杆刃器

desc_en: A little bit rusty, but it should still fit.
desc_zh: 有点锈了，应该还能用。

extra.en: Allows you to open a cell door.
extra.zh: 可以打开一道牢门。

desc_en: The use of incense plays a special role in Hieronite practices, albeit not nearly as crucial as in elven rituals.
desc_zh: 对于圣会的礼拜仪式而言，香炉的意义特殊，只是不像在精灵族仪式中那么不可或缺。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Judging by the engraving, it once belonged to Sir der Ulne, a famous glutton and a drunkard. A dozen years ago, during one of his feasts, Sir der Ulne met a heroic death in a prolonged battle with a whole roast hog.
desc_zh: 从上面的铭文来看，这件胸甲原本属于大名鼎鼎的酒鬼饕客德·伍恩爵士。十几年前，德·伍恩爵士英勇赴宴，与一头烤全猪鏖战几百回合，最后壮烈牺牲。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 铠甲

desc_en: A true piece of art - many weapon connoisseurs would pay through the nose to acquire it for their collection.
desc_zh: 名副其实的艺术品，很多兵器鉴赏家就算花天价，也愿意把这件匕首纳为自己的藏品。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 匕首

desc_en: The famed Brynnian weaponsmith, Etien Morel, crafted many masterpieces in his lifetime, and this elaborate halberd is one of them. Tragically, his life was cut short when he perished during the siege of Brynn, burning alive along with his workshop.
desc_zh: 布林的传奇铁匠艾蒂安·莫雷尔一生锻铸杰作无数，这一柄精美的戟斧便是其中之一。可惜他在布林受围之时，困于自己的工坊，被活活烧死。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 长杆刃器

desc_en: The gilded ornaments seem to be the craftsman's attempt at adapting the traditional Radiant Wars motifs to fit the shape of a modern helmet.
desc_zh: 头盔上有些镀金的修饰，看起来是工匠为了适应现代头盔的形制，改变了光辉战争的传统图纹。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 头盔

desc_en: Small, light, and, quite importantly, cheap - a helmet worn by many guards and militia.
desc_zh: 这种头盔整体较小，轻便，而且造价低廉——这一点非常重要，是卫兵和民兵的不二之选。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 头盔

desc_en: Judging by the eye-catching band and the pair of metal discs added for extra protection, this helmet likely belonged to a merchant's son during his service in the town militia.
desc_zh: 头盔边沿和两侧的金属圆盘非常醒目，主要用于提供额外的防护，以前应该是谁家做生意的小孩在镇上民兵队参军时戴的。

desc_en: A chain is a weapon of street and tavern fights, hardly suitable for real combat.
desc_zh: 酒馆、街头械斗常见的家伙事，不过不适合真正的战斗使用。

extra.zh: 工具

desc_en: If you don't have a waist to speak of, it's not wise to wear this belt over a civil garment - the links have a notable tendency to pinch and chafe.
desc_zh: 你要是没有腰，建议穿常服的时候不要系这个东西——这些链子又紧又磨肚皮。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: A roll of fine woolen fabric - the kind Yostwayne was once famous for.
desc_zh: 一卷上好的羊毛料子，约斯特文的羊毛布料之前远近闻名。

desc_en: There's enough material to mend a large tear or two.
desc_zh: 这么一块布，补一两个大窟窿没有问题。

extra.zh: 可以令任意布防具恢复~lg~4~/~点耐久。

name_en: Codex of the Triune Hand Order
desc_en: This hefty tome is written in the Order's notorious code, which no one has yet managed to crack. It's rumored that this book was blessed by all three Hands of the Host, and that it contains the full history of the Order and every mystery of creation they were privy to...
desc_zh: 这本大部头采用三手会闻名遐迩的暗语写就，会外迄今尚未有人破解这套暗语。这本章程传言受了圣主三只圣手庇佑，而且详细记述了圣会的全部历史以及他们所掌握的有关创世造物的所有秘密……

extra.en: While in the Inventory, killing an ~r~Undead~/~ or ~r~Proselyte~/~ enemy has ~y~25%~/~ chance to grant ~lg~Blessing~/~ for ~y~100~/~ turns.
extra.zh: 行囊如果放了这件东西，击杀~r~不死生灵~/~或~r~变节信徒~/~有~y~25%~/~的几率立刻获得存续~y~100~/~回合的~lg~庇佑~/~。

desc_en: An ancient, preferably Axonian coin with a hole drilled in it is a common charm for better luck.
desc_zh: 很多人都喜欢给古钱币——最好是亚克逊的钱币——中间钻个孔，戴在身上招好运。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 项链

desc_en: There's no end to peasant women's household chores, yet they still find time to look after themselves.
desc_zh: 尽管农家生活贫乏，农妇也会想尽办法收拾好自己的头发。

desc_en: Swords are prohibitively expensive for most commoners, while axes and clubs can't be comfortably tucked into a belt. What else is left to an honest peasant?
desc_zh: 多数平民百姓不得佩剑，一旦发现，罚金数额高昂，而斧头棍棒又不方便别在腰间。除了这个，老实本分的农民还能带什么呢？

stats.type_text: 普通 匕首

desc_en: Helmets of this shape have been in use for centuries, commonly worn by those who can't afford anything better.
desc_zh: 这种外形的头盔已经用了几百年，现在只有戴不起好头盔的人才戴这种东西。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 头盔

desc_en: Dried-up and shriveled, as if it had no desire to hear its owner's unholy schemes.
desc_zh: 干巴巴，白得瘆人。

extra.en: Can be delivered to the contract giver for an additional ~y~reward~/~.
extra.zh: 交给派发契据的人，可以获得额外的~y~报酬~/~。

desc_en: Doesn't seem like simple roasting will cut it here...
desc_zh: 看样子简简单单烤一下应该还是不行……

stats.type_text: 普通 防御型 项链

desc_en: Refined copper finds ample use in many areas: household goods, modest jewelry, smelting alloys...
desc_zh: 铜矿石精炼之后，用处很多，例如家庭器具、朴素的首饰、合金冶炼……

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: The cheapest jewelry money can buy. It's said that wearing copper is beneficial to one's constitution.
desc_zh: 最廉价的首饰，他们说戴铜东西这个对身体好。

stats.type_text: 普通 通用型 戒指

desc_en: A solid choice when fighting on foot. This particular shield bears the colors of the Royal Council.
desc_zh: 非常适合徒步作战。这一块盾牌刷了王廷的盾徽。

desc_en: It's hard to imagine a more wasteful and extravagant way to belt one's clothes.
desc_zh: 腰带的作用只是束腰，很难想象还能有怎样更加铺张浪费的腰带。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: Stylish, light, durable, and unbelievably comfortable, a dream come true for most mages.
desc_zh: 轻便，耐穿，款式入时，而且舒服得令人难以置信，法师的梦之靴。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: Court mages have a very particular taste in clothes. Their goal is to dazzle and leave an impression, so they gravitate towards the craziest styles and colors.
desc_zh: 家内法师对于衣装的要求非常特别——希望身上的衣服能让人目眩神迷，给人留下深刻的印象，所以他们通常偏好极其夸张、反常的款式和色彩。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 斗篷

desc_en: Just a few years worth of village taxes is all it costs for a lord to adorn his court mage with one of these diadems.
desc_zh: 领主只需要拿出领内乡村二三年的农税，就足够给自己豢养的法师做一件这样的头冠了。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: Gems and noble metals are treasured for their ability to resonate with magic. What at first may appear as a display of unrestrained opulence can in fact be a tool of the trade.
desc_zh: 宝石与贵重金属能与魔法产生共振，因此而为法师所爱。有些东西看似只为炫耀身家，实际是有真正的用处。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 手套

desc_en: Mages who find themself a part of a noble court are a subject of envy. The life they lead is comfy, lucrative, and devoid of any real dangers - that is until their master decides to participate in a military campaign...
desc_zh: 法师若能得到领主供养，成为家内法师，就会成为他人艳羡的对象。他们衣食无忧，收入丰厚，而且没有性命之忧。不过，倘若主人某日决定率军参战……

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: This enchanted staff's headpiece was designed for conducting all types of magic.
desc_zh: 这根法杖顶部附了法力，可以传导各类魔法。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: Allows ~lg~"Crafting"~/~ to create ~y~advanced~/~ items without a workbench.
desc_zh: 有了这个，没有工作台也可以~lg~制作~/~~y~进阶~/~物品。

extra.en: All the essentials for working with wood and metal in the field.
extra.zh: 野外打木器、做五金离不开这些工具。

desc_en: A cranequin is a cunning mechanism which made crossbows even more deadly than they had already been. At least a dozen engineers and master craftsmen from all over Aldor compete for the title of its original inventor.
desc_zh: 齿轮弩的机械十分巧妙，因而杀伤力相对其他弩更高。奥尔多各地至少有十几位工程师和工匠大师将发明这种弩的功劳归在了自己头上。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: One careless twist of the knife, and a prized apothecary ingredient is reduced to useless sludge.
desc_zh: 蜘蛛眼球能提取出来一种东西，调配某些药物必不可少。这种器官采集难度很高，一不小心就会碰破。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Stars and celestial bodies are held in superstitious reverence in Ahjat, as their positions in the sky govern the outcome of rituals performed by Hazzun oracles.
desc_zh: 艾哈雅特对于星辰和其他天体存在近乎迷信的崇拜，因为各类天体的位置直接左右哈尊先知祈神仪式的结果。

stats.type_text: 普通 防御型 项链

desc_en: A tribute to the principle that offense is the finest form of defense.
desc_zh: 完美阐释了“出色的进攻就是最好的防御”。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: ( . . . )##Lady Avinna (frightened):#Ah, couldn't we do without a fight!##Sir Urgen (indolently):#This insult can only be washed off with blood. What's said is said. Things done cannot be reversed. Our argument will be resolved with a duel.##Lady Avinna:#But perhaps...##Sir Urgen:#No, no, and no! I demand this duel and I won't settle for less.##Unfred the Rogue (humbly):#Very well, so be it.##Act two##Scene one##(The duel commences. Sir Urgen is armed with a sword and buckler. Unfred is armed with a sword and dagger. Opponents come to blows and exchange a few attacks. Unfred skillfully dodges charging Sir Urgen)##Sir Urgen (out of breath):#Curses, you are a stronger opponent than I thought!##Unfred the Rogue (boastfully):#It is what it is. You, however, lack finesse.##Sir Urgen:#I'm a noble knight, not some cut-throat!##Unfred the Rogue:#Then where is your armor?##Sir Urgen:#The Codex demands...##(Unfred disarms Sir Urgen with a sudden lunge)##Unfred the Rogue (mockingly):#The Codex? First time I hear about such a thing. And what does it demand?##Sir Urgen:#How?! It can't be! Well then, the victory is yours. And now...##Unfred the Rogue (interrupts him):#And now, my friend, you are done for.##(Unfred stabs helpless Sir Urgen with the dagger. The nobleman crumples to the floor, choking on his own blood)##Sir Urgen:#Why?.. You blackguard... But the Codex...##Unfred (casually wipes blood off his dagger):#Your Codex should be the last of your worries.##( . . . )
desc_zh: （ . . . ）##亚维纳夫人（惊慌失措）：#啊，非打不可吗？！##厄金爵士（咄咄逼人）：#此等耻辱，只有鲜血方可洗刷。君子一言，驷马难追。事已至此，木已成舟。此事当一战而决。##亚维纳夫人：#不然这样……##厄金爵士：#不行！我要与此人对决，绝不退让。##无赖文弗雷德（谦卑）：#一言为定。##第二幕##第一场##（对决。厄金爵士一手长剑，一手圆盾；文弗雷德一手长剑，一手匕首。两人你来我往，打了几个回合。文弗雷德身手敏捷，躲开了厄金爵士的冲撞）##厄金爵士（气喘吁吁）：#该死，没想到你还挺难对付！##无赖文弗雷德（得意洋洋）：#现在想到了吧？你的动作破绽太多。##厄金爵士：#我是堂堂骑士，不是亡命之徒！##无赖文弗雷德：#既然是骑士，怎么没穿盔甲？##厄金骑士：#《武律》有言……##（无赖文弗雷德突然一个箭步上前，挑掉了厄金爵士的长剑）##无赖文弗雷德（讥讽）：#什么《武律》？没听说过，有什么令？##厄金爵士：#岂有此理！你胜之不武。既然如此……##无赖文弗雷德（打断了他）：#既然如此，朋友，拿命来吧。##（文弗雷德一刀插进了厄金爵士的胸口，骑士应声倒地，鲜血汩汩冒出）##厄金爵士：#卑鄙小人……凭什么？《武律》……##文弗雷德（随手擦了擦匕首上的血）：#什么《武律》不《武律》的。##（ . . . ）

desc_en: ( . . . )##"Listen to me, boy,#Didn't Baron di Felin#Promise to arrive#Here in person?"#Marquis di Roden asked,#His nose twitching in suspicion.##"Ah, Your Excellency,#Please forgive me, but#The Baron is indisposed",#The servant replied#And bowed at his waist.##"As an apology he sends#A bag of fine wheat#From his own supplies,#A gift to Your Excellency."##He pointed at#The burlap sack#Filled to the brim#As claimed.#Marquis di Roden#Wheezed with laughter:##"What's this?#I gut his granaries#And butcher his servants,#And yet instead of#Meeting me#Face to face#On the fields of glory,#He sends his scrawny varlet#To buy me off?#Could it be#That rumors of his#Bravery and honor#Are nothing but a myth#And tall tales?"##"Once again, I beg forgiveness",#The servant's face turned crimson,#"I wouldn't dare#To speak for the baron.#Please, have a look#At the gift!#We reaped a bountiful harvest.#The golden seeds#Are asking to be ground".##Marquis di Roden#Leaned closer#To get a better look#At the precious offer,#When suddenly#Baron di Felin#Pounced at him#From around the corner.#A flash of dagger steel,#The Marquis' blood dripped on the grain...#A worthy gift!##"And may no one,#You hear me?#No one! No one#May dare to claim#That I,#Baron di Felin,#Didn't come in person.#As for my servant,#The lie was his,#And only his alone."##( . . . )
desc_zh: （ . . . ）##洛登侯爵满面疑，#高声问那男仆人：#“小伙，我来问问你，#菲林男爵不是说#他本人今日来？”##“大人，您且听我言。#男爵虽然如此说，#谁知今日抱了恙，#不能亲自拜见还望您海涵。”#男仆深深鞠一躬，#险些头顶碰脚尖。##“男爵自知礼数有亏欠，#特意献上上等好麦一箩筐，#还望大人您笑纳。”##仆人所言毫不虚，#金黄麦粒满到筐边沿。#洛登侯爵哈哈笑，#前仰后合不能停：##“他这是什么意思？#我宰了他粮食官，#屠了他手下人，#不来与我较高下，#倒派了个麻杆下人#想把我来收买？#听闻菲林大男爵#威武又磊落，#莫非都是花花故事，#好听不能信？”##“还望大人能海涵”#仆人脸通红：#“小的只是贱下人，#岂敢替男爵说话。#还是请您来看这筐麦！#我们今年收成好，#麦粒黄澄澄，#只等您收下。”##洛登侯爵上前去，#刚要细端详。#菲林男爵突现身，#猛扑向洛登，#只见刀光“噌”一闪，#侯爵血洒麦箩筐……#真是好惊喜！##“谁都不许，#我告诉你，#谁都不能！#都不能信口雌黄，#我不敢较高下？！#至于仆人撒谎篇，#那是他的事，#全与我无关。”##（ . . . ）

desc_en: ... I'm obviously aware of the existence of dwarven berserkers, elven dervishes, and the Bronze Isles' duelists who prefer fighting with two blades instead of one - I even had the pleasure of meeting one of the latter personally. Alas, my memory isn't what it used to be, so I can't recall the name of that noble warrior. An old friend of my late tutor, he left the Bronze Isles just before they cut all ties with the outside world.##After losing his homeland, he decided to make a living by teaching swordsmanship to youngsters - I was lucky to take a couple lessons from him back in the day. He preferred to teach a bunch of students at the same time, sparring with five or six opponents simultaneously. It goes without saying, he never failed to give us a thrashing - it felt as if his blades had a mind of their own, striking in every direction at once.##But what did it cost him? Years upon years of grueling practice, starting from early childhood and throughout his entire life, day after day... For this very reason I don't take dual wielding seriously. Even to an experienced fencer a buckler is a hundredfold more useful than a second blade. Unless you actually know what you're doing, dual wielding will only result in your quick demise...
desc_zh: ……我当然知道矮人的狂战士、精灵的苦行修士和青铜群岛的对决手战斗的时候都爱一手一件兵器，还曾有幸亲眼见到过这么一位，只是现在记性差了，想不起来这位战士姓甚名谁了。他来自青铜群岛，与我过世的老师交情颇深。他刚来到奥尔多没有多久，青铜群岛便与外界断绝了联系。##他再也无法回到故土，因而决定以教授少年剑法为生，我当时特别幸运，跟着他上了几节课。这位战士喜欢几个学生一起授课，所以经常同时招架五六个对手。即便如此，我们依然力不能敌，经常被他一顿好打。他手里的剑就像长了眼一样，迅如闪电。##可是，他的剑法达到这样的境界，付出了怎样的努力？他幼年便开始苦练，日复一日，年复一年，直至成年，依旧还在修习……正是这个原因，我认为兵器双持不值得学习。就算是身经百战的剑士，副手拿拳盾也要比再拿一件兵器好过一百倍。假若不得要领，兵器双持只会让你死得更快……

extra.zh: 《剑击之术：几点理论思考和实用建议》##~gr~可以学习若干兵器双持能力：~/~##~lg~暴风疾雨~/~#~lg~挡避~/~#~y~双持训练~/~#~y~视死如归~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。

extra.en: Myrwan vir Debur's essays are valued for their thoroughness and comprehensiveness - after all, he is still the greatest fencer in Aldor, even if his years are starting to catch up with him.
extra.zh: 米尔万·佛·德布的论著论述全面，鞭辟入里，毕竟是奥尔多顶尖的剑士，不过他的水平现在也渐渐受到了年岁的影响。
作者：米尔万·佛·德布

desc_en: ... I'm obviously aware of the existence of dwarven berserkers, elven dervishes, and the Bronze Isles' duelists who prefer fighting with two blades instead of one - I even had the pleasure of meeting one of the latter personally. Alas, my memory isn't what it used to be, so I can't recall the name of that noble warrior. An old friend of my late tutor, he left the Bronze Isles just before they cut all ties with the outside world.##After losing his homeland, he decided to make a living by teaching swordsmanship to youngsters - I was lucky to take a couple lessons from him back in the day. He preferred to teach a bunch of students at the same time, sparring with five or six opponents simultaneously. It goes without saying, he never failed to give us a thrashing - it felt as if his blades had a mind of their own, striking in every direction at once.##But what did it cost him? Years upon years of grueling practice, starting from early childhood and throughout his entire life, day after day... For this very reason I don't take dual wielding seriously. Even to an experienced fencer a buckler is a hundredfold more useful than a second blade. Unless you actually know what you're doing, dual wielding will only result in your quick demise...

desc_en: The seal on the pommel leaves no room for interpretation: this exotic dagger used to belong to Orro Denye, the one and only Duke of Bronza.
desc_zh: 柄上的家徽非常清楚，这把异域匕首的主人不是别人，正是布朗萨公爵奥洛·登耶。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 匕首

desc_en: Single combat with two-handed swords is a form of art, where your reflexes and precision matter just as much as brute strength.
desc_zh: 双手剑的单人对战堪称艺术，不仅需要单纯的膂力，也考验你的反应和精准。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: A little something to complete the image of a daring fighter and a relentless heartbreaker.
desc_zh: 对决手要想塑造无畏斗士的形象，要想俘获一颗又一颗芳心，就不能没有这一条腰带。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: In addition to the fighting skill, duelists also continuously sharpen their fashion sense.
desc_zh: 对决手不仅要具备一定的格斗能力，也要不断提升自己的衣着水平。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: An effective safeguard against treacherous thrusts and jabs at vital areas.
desc_zh: 可以有效保护要害部位，抵挡刁钻的阴招。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 铠甲

desc_en: Some duelists become so apt at wielding a dagger that even sword strikes are no challenge for them to parry and counter.
desc_zh: 有些对决手匕首使得炉火纯青，连刀剑都能轻松挡下。

stats.type_text: 普通 匕首

desc_en: A fair number of duelists prefer wearing all black when showing up for a fight. Why? Blood is harder to spot on dark fabric.
desc_zh: 有的人参加对决喜欢从头到脚一身黑。为什么？因为黑的料子沾了血不容易看见。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Career duelists in particular are fond of this style of gloves - they look especially dashing wrapped around a sword hilt.
desc_zh: 职业对决手尤其偏爱这种手套，因为戴上握着剑柄的时候，样式尤其好看。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 手套

desc_en: If there's anything that dwarves appreciate more than booze and looting, it's a good axe.
desc_zh: 矮人第一爱喝酒，第二爱趁火打劫，第三爱的就是上好的斧子。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: A customary headwear of Fjall seidrs, practitioners of the bizarre mix of Axonian magic and local pagan rituals.
desc_zh: 弗约的赛德修炼、运用亚克逊魔法，只是会与当地的多神教习俗结合，这种头环是他们的传统头饰。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: Dwarves have a preference for round shields - they are suitable for tight formations as well as one-on-one combat.
desc_zh: 这种圆盾矮人经常用，既适合密集人群作战，也适合单打独斗。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 盾牌

desc_en: Dwarves have a preference for round shields - they are suitable for tight formations as well as one-on-one combat.
desc_zh: 这种圆盾矮人经常用，既适合密集人群作战，也适合单打独斗。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 盾牌

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 盾牌

desc_en: The headpiece in the form of a sea leviathan is carved with such attention to detail that it looks like it could start spewing flames at any moment.
desc_zh: 手杖顶端形似海底巨兽，雕刻十分精致，似乎随时都会喷出火焰。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: When the Aldorian army was routed by the Nistrian cavalry at the battle of Thorny Hill, the Eeders militia took the humiliating defeat to heart and started attaching special anti-cavalry hooks to their axes.
desc_zh: 荆棘山一役，尼斯特拉骑兵大破奥尔多军，伊德斯的民兵由此吸取教训，给他们的斧子加上了专门对付骑兵的勾刃。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: The production process for these famous longbows isn't exactly common knowledge - the denizens of Eeders tend to keep to themselves.
desc_zh: 伊德斯长弓远近有名，不过伊德斯人寡言少语，所以这种长弓的制作工艺并非人人皆知。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: One reason why village tykes enjoy climbing trees.
desc_zh: 从前有道敕令要求鸡蛋必须打小头，不过这个规定早就没几个人记得了。

desc_zh: 从前有道敕令要求鸡蛋必须打小头，不过这个规定早就没几个人记得了。

desc_en: Novice electromancers often complain about being constantly distracted by the constant electric crackling produced by these cowls. They quickly grow accustomed to it though.
desc_zh: 初级电术法师刚戴这种兜帽的时候，经常说总会因为听到劈里啪啦的电流音分心，不过穿得久了，很快就能习惯。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: Barely touching the material sends a sharp, tingling sensation up one's arm. That is unless you're an electromancer.
desc_zh: 随便碰一下袍子的面料，手臂就会电得发麻。不过，如果你是电术法师，就完全不会有异常的感觉了。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: The Pyromancy Circle used to spread malicious rumors that the death of Frid Konnoken, the founder of the Electromancy Circle, was caused by him foolishly allowing a similar staff to come in contact with a street puddle.
desc_zh: 炎术法会过去曾有居心不良之人散布谣言，谎称电术法会的建会会长弗利得·孔诺肯死因实系其误令同类长杖接触了路面的水洼。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: In Jacinth Kingdoms, felt boots are sported by people from all walks of life, be it Ohirian nomads, maafs of Ahjat, or ghazi of Jibey.
desc_zh: 红锆列国无论贵贱贫富，不论是奥息尔游牧民、艾哈雅特的玛弗还是吉贝的加齐，都会穿毡靴。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: Hideously sour but very healthy. The nobles cringe but keep eating them.
desc_zh: 酸得要命，但有益于健康。贵族就算酸得浑身哆嗦，也还是要吃。

desc_en: Hideously sour but very healthy. The nobles cringe but keep eating them.
desc_zh: 酸得要命，但有益于健康。贵族就算酸得浑身哆嗦，也还是要吃。

desc_en: Elven flails serve mostly a ceremonial purpose, carried only by the most skillful of warriors to flaunt their status. No money is spared to make these weapons look the part.
desc_zh: 精灵连枷一般用作礼兵器，只有武艺高强的战士才能持有，以此彰显他们的身份地位，因此主人时常会斥重金装点这种连枷。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: There is a faint flowery scent coming from the cloth. It reminds you of places you've never had a chance to travel to.
desc_zh: 衣服上有淡淡的花香，好像来自你从未去过的地方。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Although Eraffa is the dominant faith in the Jacinth Kingdoms, the influence of sun worship remains evident even after many centuries. Various solar motifs frequently appear in elven-made trinkets and adornments - this belt's buckle is as fine an example as any.
desc_zh: 虽然叶拉法现在是红锆列国的主流信仰，但太阳崇拜即便已消失了几百年，其影响依然清晰可见。精灵制作的饰品和珠宝时常出现太阳的各种图案，这条腰带的卡扣就是一个很好的例子。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: Sipahi are the heavy cavalry that forms the core of the Ahjat Empire's army, a cornerstone of its many victories. Unsurprisingly, their gear is crafted only by the best armorsmiths on the personal orders of Ahjat emirs.
desc_zh: 西帕希重骑兵是艾哈雅特帝国陆军的核心，为多次战役的胜利奠定了坚实的基础。他们的铠甲均由艾哈雅特手艺上乘的盔匠锻造，由埃米尔亲自督造，这也自然也在情理之中了。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 铠甲

desc_en: This sparkling wine is produced in the Jacinth Kingdoms from frozen grapes according to a secret recipe. Local nobles are willing to sell their souls for just a single sip.
desc_zh: 这种起泡酒产自红锆列国，采用鲜冻葡萄酿成，配方保密。当地贵族如果能够抿上一口，就算出卖自己的灵魂也没问题。

extra.zh: 可以导致轻度~r~醉酒~/~。

desc_en: Longaxes are exotic to elven lands - the peoples of Jacinth who use them can be counted on the fingers of one hand.
desc_zh: 对于精灵而言，长斧是舶来品，红锆列国用这种兵器的人屈指可数。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: Some of the local aristocrats favor eastern sabers over traditional Aldorian swords - despite any weird looks they get from their subjects.
desc_zh: 本地有的贵族不喜欢奥尔多的刀剑，反倒偏爱这种马刀，尽管常常因此而遭到子民侧目，他们依然我行我素。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: Elves call this hammer shape a "bull horn" for the distinctive spike on its back end.
desc_zh: 因为这个锤子尾部形似牛角，所以精灵又称之“牛角锤”。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: Perfect for displaying one's fashion sense during a drinking night.
desc_zh: 晚上的酒场上系上这个，最能展现自己的时尚品味。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: A rare gemstone worthy of kings - any jeweler would be glad to have it.
desc_zh: 这种宝石非常稀罕，献给国王都没问题，是所有首饰匠人梦寐以求的石材。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: The apparent unity of Jibey, Ahjat, and other realms of Jacinth is merely a mirage. In reality, each is a patchwork of diverse tribes, khanates, and emirates, with every local "monarch" wielding almost absolute power over their people.
desc_zh: 吉贝、艾哈雅特与红锆的其他各国看似统一，实则只是假象。每个国家都是各种部族、汗国、埃米尔国拼凑而成，各自的“君主”掌握绝对的统治权力。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: The resource spent on using abilities and performing some other actions, such as swimming.
desc_zh: 你有这么多精力可以运用能力和进行游泳等其他行动。

extra.zh: 活力

desc_en: English
desc_zh: 中文

desc_en: It would be a mistake to perceive the gilding as a mere decoration. To a battlemage, gold rims and edges can actually be of great practical use.
desc_zh: 如果以为胫甲镀金只是为了装饰，就大错特错了。对于战地法师而言，这些金边其实用处很大。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 中 靴子

desc_en: Despite the strict isolation, some goods still get smuggled from the Bronze Isles to Aldor. A lot of the time the contraband includes various swords: if anything, the islanders have had a lot of practice crafting weaponry.
desc_zh: 青铜群岛虽与外界隔绝，有一些商货依然走私到了奥尔多，通常都会有各种刀剑。不得不说，青铜群岛的人锻造兵器确实很有一手。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 双手刀剑

desc_en: The sun-worshiping cult of the Everflaming was outlawed by the grandfather of the current Amir of Jibey. Only a few isolated communes now remain of what was once a popular faith, having fled persecution to the distant fringes of the empire.
desc_zh: 崇拜太阳的永焰教曾经风靡一时，只是很早之前就被吉贝阿米尔的祖父归为了不法之教，如今仅存若干公社，为了躲避迫害，逃到了帝国的边陲，彼此没有联系。

stats.type_text: 普通 攻击型 项链

desc_en: Judging by the lingering aroma, this elven-made casket was used for storing spices.
desc_zh: 这只匣子用的是精灵族的工艺，至今仍有淡香残留，想必原本是存放香料的器物。

extra.en: Can be used to store items.##Might interest some merchants.
extra.zh: 可以收纳物品。##这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: A longaxe is a highly unusual choice for a ceremonial weapon. And by the looks of the decorations, the original owner shelled out a pretty sum for it.
desc_zh: 很少会有人拿长斧当礼兵器，从表面的修饰来看，斧子最早的主人在这件兵器上砸了不少钱。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 双手斧

desc_en: Don't let the glint of gold mislead you: despite its elegant ornaments, this polemace shatters skulls and bones just as efficiently as its plain counterparts.
desc_zh: 这件钉头锤鎏金修饰丰富，不过切勿因此低估了兵器的实战性能——它断骨碎颅的本事丝毫不比普通的长柄钉头锤差。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 双手锤棒

desc_en: From a certain distance, the masterfully cut ruby can easily be mistaken for a drop of fresh blood.
desc_zh: 红宝石如果切割精妙，离远了看，很容易被人看成一滴鲜血。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 戒指

desc_en: A tabar is a symbol of maafs, the warrior estate which holds the most power in the Ahjat Empire. Even the nobility require a special permission to arm themselves with one.
desc_zh: 艾哈雅特帝国的大权掌握在武士阶级玛弗手中，而塔巴正是玛弗的象征。即便是上流贵族，未经许可，也不得携带塔巴。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手斧

desc_en: The handle makes this sword's origins crystal clear - Brynn weaponsmiths have a soft spot for elegant and somewhat ostentatious detailing.
desc_zh: 这种大剑看到剑柄就知道产地是哪儿了——布林的兵匠非常热衷雅致而又张扬的纹饰。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 双手刀剑

desc_en: There was a time in Aldor when hunting birds became an item of prestige. A lord without a personal falconeer would feel inadequate even in front of his own court.
desc_zh: 奥尔多的名门望族有一段时间非常流行隼猎，领主如果手下没有驯隼的师傅，连站在自己的仆从面前都会少几分底气。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 手套

desc_en: A pair of expertly-crafted boots that will add a spring to your step while promenading the streets.
desc_zh: 穿着这双工艺精湛的靴子，大摇大摆走在街上，你会感觉自己的脚步更加轻盈。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: A time-honored charm meant to bring luck during a hunt.
desc_zh: 自古以来，人们都相信戴上这种护符打猎，一定可以满载而归。

stats.type_text: 普通 攻击型 项链

desc_en: The multiple attempts to marry Hieronite teachings with elven rituals produced a number of prominent Aldorian saints capable of glimpsing into the future - nevertheless, most of the clergy rejected this path, branding it as a perversion of the church traditions.
desc_zh: 奥尔多的圣会多次尝试将圣门教义与精灵仪礼结合，造就了若干声名显赫的先知圣徒。可是大多数祭司将这种方式斥为颠覆教会传统，不愿采用。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 长杖

desc_en: ...The most distinctive tradition of the ancient Nistrian cult of the Mother-Mountain is their worship to giant boulders. Finely chiseled, they're placed in circles all over Nistra, forming a large number of majestic structures. Sometimes these boulders are also covered in strange writings, top to bottom. Rain and wind rendered most of it utterly indecipherable, but some parts remained perfectly intact. I try my best to record every surviving symbol I encounter, but alas, I still can't crack this ancient alphabet. I can only hope that if not me, then at least my descendants will be able to solve this mystery...##( . . . )##Well then, looks like there was no reason to lose heart after all. Spending a couple more weeks of my precious time on that risky search for Fodah's tomb returned my investment a hundredfold, rewarding me for all the misery and hardships I've suffered over the years. When I saw that the epitaph was doubled in ancient Aldorian, I couldn't believe my eyes... This means that with only a bit of effort I can finally cross-reference and decipher some of the words.##( . . . )##Yes! At last! After months of diligent work I, Joran of Brynn, have solved the secret of the ancient Nistrian alphabet. A large portion of my records seems to describe some rather fascinating magic rituals and practices that are only briefly mentioned in ancient chronicles... Once I get home, taking a trip to Maen is the first order of business. I'm certain these findings will greatly interest the Academy...
desc_zh: ……崇拜巨石是尼斯特拉古代“山母”教最具特点的一项传统。尼斯特拉至今仍然保留着大量恢弘的圆形石阵——-巨石雕凿成石碑，摆成一个又一个圆圈。有些巨石表面刻了文字，经年累月的风吹雨打之后，大部分已经无法辨认，而部分文字则保留得极为完好。我现在每看到一段这样的文字，就会把它们记录下来，只可惜到现在也没破译这种古老的文字，只能寄希望于我的后人了……##（ . . . ）##哈哈，看样子是我太容易灰心丧气了。我花了几周宝贵的时间，冒着生命危险去了一趟佛达的陵墓，回来的时候获益百倍，期间那些罪也算没白受。我看到那些文字标注了古奥尔多文的时候，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛……这样一来，我只需要花一点点工夫，就能交叉比对、破译一部分石碑文字了。##（ . . . ）##工夫不负有心人！我，布林的约兰，辛苦了几个月，终于破解了古尼斯特拉文的奥秘。之前记录的文字，大部分似乎都在描述某种相当神奇的魔法仪式和咒法。这类仪式和咒法之前只有一两卷编年史料简要提及……等我到了家，第一件事就是去曼恩，我这些发现，学院的人肯定很有兴趣了解……

extra.en: "Travel Notes on My Journey to Biest"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Geomancy abilities:~/~##~lg~Runic Boulder~/~#~lg~Stone Armor~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《比耶斯特游记》##~gr~可以学习若干地术能力：~/~##~lg~符文巨石~/~#~lg~石甲~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。

extra.en: A rather chaotic journal by a professor of linguistics who taught in Brynn a century ago. Perhaps the most fascinating read in the entire grammar curriculum at Brynn University.
extra.zh: 这本一百年前的日志记录潦草，作者是布林大学的语言学教授，可能是布林大学语法课程最有意思的阅读材料。
作者：布林人约兰

desc_en: Lesson one, titled "Stone Spikes and Everything You Need to Know About Them"##Greetings! I'd like to sincerely congratulate you: if you're reading these words then chances are high you weren't kicked out during your first year in the Academy. With this in mind, there's little need for any introductions.##This lesson will teach you about the second most important spell of the earth magic - stone spikes. Some fools might scoff at this suggestion, too eager to jump straight to boulder tosses and explosions, but as any diligent student may already know, a timely cast of this spell can isolate a dangerous opponent, change the flow of an entire battle, and even save your life...##( . . . )##At this point we can safely conclude that stone spikes are utterly indispensable to a geomancer and must be mastered right after you learn how to raise runic boulders. In fact, let's start with just that: summon a boulder and attempt to resonate with it, unleashing the energy trapped within the stone...
desc_zh: 第一课，“石刺详解”##你好！我真心恭喜你：你既然正在看这本书，就说明已经顺利完成了学院第一学年的功课，我也就不用浪费口舌介绍入门概念了。##这节课将讲解大地魔法第二重要的法咒“石刺”。某些蠢货可能会直奔投石和爆炸，不屑于修习这项法咒，而勤奋好学的学生都知道，石刺如果催动时机得当，可以限制危险敌人的行动，改变战局，甚至可以保命……##（ . . . ）##……可以说地系法师绝对不能不会石刺，所以你们学会召唤符文巨石之后，就应该开始修习石刺。我们就从这里开始——唤出一块符文巨石，然后看看能不能与之产生共振，放出困在巨石内部的能量……

extra.en: Magister Buras, a prominent geomancer, is best known for the approachability of his explanations - a rare quality for an Academy lector.
extra.zh: 布勒斯法师是著名的地系法师，也是学院的讲师，讲课深入浅出。这一点对于学院的讲师而言颇为难得，他也因此而为人所知。
作者：布勒斯法师

desc_en: In the meantime, a few dozen people separated from the main army and headed straight towards the walls, unfazed by the threat of the formidable Aldwynn archers who had already slain a significant number of Nistrians. Clad only in robes, they looked like an easy prey to the besieged. Eager to avenge their fallen comrades, they rained arrows upon the impudent Nistrians, but to the defenders' shock and dismay, their weapons left nary a mark. The arrows simply bounced off their enemies' bodies, even though it was clear as day that they wore no armor.##( . . . )##It was deep in the night when the chanting had finally ceased. The Aldwynn garrison, which by that time had realized the futility of their attempts to stop the ritual, was silently awaiting the worst. The faint light of the hundreds of runic boulders dispersed the darkness, as if the stars themselves descended from the skies to litter the ground below.##( . . . )##And then the once impregnable walls shuddered, massive towers collapsed upon themselves, and chaos engulfed the city. Age-old buildings crumbled to dust, crushing hundreds and thousands of people underneath. Huge fires burst out, and there was no place to run, no escaping death. Some townsfolk fled to the temple, placing their lives in the hands of the Host, only to be buried by the falling roof. When the earthquake finally came to a halt and the Nistrians entered the city, there was no one to stand in their way. Such was the disastrous fall of the city of Aldwynn...
desc_zh: 城墙上箭如雨下，数不胜数的尼斯特拉人纷纷倒下。就在这时，大军之中分出一队人马，直奔城墙。这队人马身着长袍，却完全无惧奥尔德文弓手的箭雨。尽管这群尼斯特拉人没有穿着铠甲，可是奥尔德文的弓箭未能伤到他们分毫，守城将士见到此状，大惊失色。##（ . . . ）##夜深时分，吟诵终于停了，奥尔德文驻军也意识到这场仪式自己已无法阻止，只能静静坐以待毙。成百上千块符文巨石发出微弱的光，驱散了夜晚的黑暗，仿佛天上的群星撒在了地上。##（ . . . ）##坚不可摧的城墙开始颤抖，高高耸立的塔楼轰然坍塌，混乱霎时间吞没了整座城市。年代久远的建筑土崩瓦解，埋葬了数千条生命。地下涌出熊熊烈火，奥尔德文人根本无处可逃。有些人冲进了神庙，希望圣主能够拯救他们，最后也压在了废墟之下。地震完全停止之后，尼斯特拉人进了城，此时已经没有人可以抵抗，奥尔德文城就这样陷落了……

extra.en: "A Selection of Excerpts From the Great Chronicles of Aldwynn"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Geomancy abilities:~/~##~lg~Earthquake~/~#~lg~Petrification~/~#~y~Rune of Binding~/~#~y~Rune of Unity~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《奥尔德文城志选集》##~gr~可以学习若干地术能力：~/~##~lg~地动山摇~/~#~lg~石化~/~#~y~共难符文~/~#~y~合一符文~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。

extra.en: An excerpt from the Aldwynn chronicles telling about a Nistrian siege that happened a century and a half ago. It's one of the first detailed mentions of geomancy in Aldorian records.
extra.zh: 奥尔德文城志节选，记述了尼斯特拉人一个半世纪之前的一次攻城。这是奥尔多历史上首篇描述地系法术的文献记载。
作者：佚名

desc_en: For quite a while, it was considered impossible to imbue stone with any magical properties, as it was deemed too inert for such subtle and complex manipulations. But now, thanks to professor Joran of Brynn University, we finally understand that this assertion was far from the truth.##So what exactly allows us to combine these two elements that were previously thought to be incompatible? The answer comes from history, namely the arid plateaus of Nistra. Runes - they are the link between a mage's will and stone, the instrument to achieve the impossible. Geomancy yielded to us ever so slowly, like an ore vein under a miner's pick, but our efforts bore fruit - earth mages are now well-respected, and everyone knows how dangerous they can be.##( . . . )##The most destructive weapon in a geomancer's arsenal is, of course, an overcharged runic boulder. It only takes one word to unleash the power trapped within to a devastating effect. There are even stories about great geomancers of old who could destroy entire armies with a single cast of this powerful spell, although I'm sure it's just an exaggeration. Still, some sources offer a different perspective - for instance, there is a historical account of a renowned Aldwynn chronicler...
desc_zh: 长久以来，主流思想认为石头属性过于木讷，无法赋予魔法属性，也无法参与复杂的咒法。不过，布林大学约兰教授的研究结果表明，事实与主流观念相去甚远。##我们原本以为石头与魔法互不相容，那么是什么推翻了这一理论呢？这要从悠远的古代和干旱的尼斯特拉高地说起。问题的关键在于符文，因为符文可以联通石头和法师的意念，令人完成不可完成之物。地系咒法的研究进展十分缓慢，就像矿工用锄头采挖矿石一样。不过，我们的努力终究没有白费——地系法师现在得到了人们的尊重，大家也知道了他们的威力。##充能之后的符文巨石是地系法师破坏力最大的武器，法师只需念出一句法咒，即可催动符石，造成颇大的破坏。历史上有些伟大的地系法师，相传只用一句法咒，便可令敌人全军覆没。这些说法肯定含有夸张的成分，不过某些史料提供了不同的视角——奥尔德文就有一位知名历史学家称……
