extra.en: A life's work of some small-time historian - an ambitious attempt at gathering all available information about the Geomancy Circle's origins.
extra.zh: 作者是一位没有名气的历史学者，这是他的毕生之作——他希望汇集当时所有相关资料，追溯地术法会的起源。

extra.en: Written by Wynur Eshvan the Elder
extra.zh: 作者：瓦依努·伊什万村长

desc_en: Ghazi are warriors of the Jacinth Kingdoms who voluntarily joined the holy war against King Etbert's invasion. Naturally, their ranks included many highborn elves...
desc_zh: 红锆列国当时有一批战士主动投身圣战，对抗埃特伯特国王的侵略，他们叫作“加齐”，其中自然不乏出身高贵的精灵……

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手锤棒

desc_en: It keeps beating long after being extracted. Some scholars are fond of the idea that this mysterious phenomenon can be a key to solving the mysteries of life and death...
desc_zh: 离体很久之后还会持续搏动，部分学者认为这个神秘现象一旦探明，就能破解生与死的奥秘了……

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: A successful attempt at making an axe look luxurious without sacrificing its battle performance.
desc_zh: 这把手斧形制十分豪华，但战斗能力也丝毫没有牺牲。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手斧

desc_en: A belt made of durable, high-quality leather in accordance with the latest Brynn fashion trends. Its buckle proudly displays some nobleman's monogram.
desc_zh: 这腰带用的是上好的皮革，是布林近来最时兴的样式。腰带扣上大大地雕了一幅花押字，代表的不知道是哪个贵族。

desc_en: Hardly the most elegant piece of jewelry - the craftsman was clearly more interested in the practical applications of gold than its aesthetics.
desc_zh: 这件首饰的造型显然算不上十分讲究，相较外观，工匠显然更看重金子的实用。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: No need to spend countless crowns to convince the onlookers of your great wealth: an elegant gilded dagger on your hip will speak for itself.
desc_zh: 如果想让旁人知道你富得流油，不需要挥金如土，只要腰上插一把漂亮的镀金匕首，就不言自明了。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 匕首

desc_en: Trimmed with velvet and tastefully accented with gold - the sort of gauntlets worn while signing declarations of war and accepting surrenders.
desc_zh: 天鹅绒滚边，镀金的点缀也很有品味，这种手甲适合戴着签开战宣言和受降书。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 手套

desc_en: A distinguished staff for a distinguished mage: with gilding this lavish, there is plenty of precious metal for magic to course through.
desc_zh: 长杖金光煌煌，配声名赫赫的法师。镀金用料豪气，魔力定能大显身手。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: An elven plant with a tart taste and fragrant aroma. Reputedly, it helps with hangovers and other similar ailments.
desc_zh: 这种植物多见精灵族种植，气味清香，入口辛辣，据说可以缓解宿醉以及其他……不适。

extra.zh: 可以帮你更快恢复~lg~清醒~/~。

desc_en: Even though it bears a resemblance to a spear, thrusting with a glaive is not very effective - it's basically a broad sword attached to a shaft.
desc_zh: 长柄刀虽然与长枪颇为相似，但是突刺的效果并不怎么样，毕竟这种兵器本质上就是长杆头部接了一个宽刀片。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: The inhabitants of Fjall are singularly talented at preparing decent meals even from seemingly inedible ingredients.
desc_zh: 弗约的矮人就是有这样的天赋，再难吃的东西到了他们手上，也能做出像样的菜肴。

desc_zh: 弗约的矮人就是有这样的天赋，再难吃的东西到了他们手上，也能做出像样的菜肴。

desc_en: The smell may be questionable, but the taste is perfectly fine.
desc_zh: 闻着难闻，吃着好吃。

desc_en: The smell may be questionable, but the taste is perfectly fine.
desc_zh: 闻着难闻，吃着好吃。

desc_en: As far as peasants are concerned, goblin shamans use these staves to send murrain upon their cattle.
desc_zh: 农民认为哥布林萨满会用这种长杖把瘟疫引到牛身上。

desc_en: This curved blade is covered in layers of dirt, rust, and caked blood.
desc_zh: 这把弯剑沾了厚厚的泥土、锈迹和血迹。

desc_en: To the knightly estate's great displeasure, this modest peasant weapon is perfectly capable of slipping through gaps in even the heaviest armor.
desc_zh: 这种农家兵器虽然简陋，但是完全可以插进板甲的缝隙，颇令骑士阶层深恶痛绝。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: The fastest way to find common ground in Aldor - though the age of full-weight gold coinage has long since passed.
desc_zh: 有了这个，很快就能在奥尔多跟别人找到共同话题，只可惜现在满大街都是低金甚至无金的金币，而且这也不是最近才出现的现象。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Aquamarine favors the bold and the courageous: reputedly, it brings good luck in risky endeavors.
desc_zh: 海蓝宝石眷顾勇敢无畏之人，这种宝石能令人在险境之中获得好运。

desc_en: A fragment of gold trim ruthlessly scraped from a piece of ornamented armor.
desc_zh: 有的防具有金饰，硬刮下来就会成这样。

desc_en: Some Aldorian nobles are so desperate to put their wealth on display that it's hard to see what they wear under all the jewelry and ornaments.
desc_zh: 奥尔多有些贵族特别喜欢展示自己身家，浑身上下挂满了首饰珠宝，把衣裳盖得严严实实。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_zh: 奢华早已不再，失去了存在的意义。

desc_zh: 奢华早已不再，失去了存在的意义。

desc_en: Cast from the finest gold - an echo of Aldor's age of splendor.
desc_zh: 上等的金子打造，产于奥尔多的辉煌年代。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Cast from the finest gold - an echo of Aldor's age of splendor.
desc_zh: 上等的金子打造，产于奥尔多的辉煌年代。

extra.zh: 里边盛了水。

desc_en: Diamonds this monstrous can usually only be found in royal crowns.
desc_zh: 这种尺寸的钻石一般只有王冠上才能见到。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 戒指

desc_en: Apart from the Academy Circles' archmages, there aren't that many people who have the crowns for this kind of jewelry.
desc_zh: 除了学院法会的大法师之外，没有多少人买得起这种首饰。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 项链

desc_en: Their owner is long dead. Everything is fleeting... except gold.
desc_zh: 首饰的主人早已离世，世事无常，只有黄金恒存。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: The opulence of richly decorated ritual items is a time-tested means of inspiring divine awe in parishioners.
desc_zh: 仪式礼器之所以装饰繁复，是为了令教众产生敬圣之心。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Gold is an excellent magical conduit. Maybe that's where its value comes from?
desc_zh: 黄金传导魔能的效果非常好，大家都喜欢金子是不是就因为这个？

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 戒指

desc_en: Signet rings like this one are beloved by bigwigs of the Grand Magistrate.
desc_zh: 戴印章戒指的一般都是城市联盟的重要人物。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 戒指

desc_en: Set with a masterfully cut sapphire. The dream of every sorcerer.
desc_zh: 嵌了一颗切割精细的蓝宝石，所有魔法师都梦寐以求能有一枚这样的戒指。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 戒指

desc_en: Niran of Maen spent many years of his life collecting and restoring the scattered knowledge about the magical properties displayed by various gems. His efforts were instrumental to making sapphire what it is today, a stone strongly associated with the practitioners of magic.
desc_zh: 曼恩的尼兰费尽多年心血，为了寻找有关各类宝石魔法性质的记载，四处奔波。海蓝宝石能有今天的地位，他功不可没，否则魔法人士也不会如此青睐这种石头。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 项链

desc_en: A plain medallion without much flair - its value comes exclusively from the material.
desc_zh: 普普通通的一块金牌，没有多少花里胡哨，价值完全来自材质本身。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 项链

desc_en: Contains more gold than some of the newly minted coins.
desc_zh: 这个东西含金量比最近铸造的金币高。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: It's tart enough to sour one's mood.
desc_zh: 特别酸，酸到能影响人的心情。

desc_en: It's tart enough to sour one's mood.
desc_zh: 特别酸，酸到能影响人的心情。

desc_en: The Grandmaster was the highest rank in the now-disbanded Order of the Triune Hand, yet their flails of office bore almost no adornments, honoring the vow of austerity.
desc_zh: 三手会还在的时候，会长是会内职位最高的人。尽管如此，会长的专用连枷外观几乎没有任何修饰，反映了他们禁断物欲的追求。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Sweet and slightly tart.
desc_zh: 甜中带一点涩。

desc_en: Sweet and slightly tart.
desc_zh: 甜中带一点涩。

desc_en: A solid choice when fighting on foot. This particular shield bears the colors of the Gray Army.
desc_zh: 非常适合徒步作战。这一块盾牌刷了灰色军团的盾徽。

desc_en: Brynn boys rarely miss an opportunity to go diving for crabs - not only is it great fun, but it also offers a chance to earn some coin.
desc_zh: 布林的半大小子只要有机会下水逮螃蟹，没有几个会不愿意去。他们捉螃蟹不光是玩耍，也是想换几个钱花。

extra.zh: 可以拆开。

desc_en: A portion of juicy cabbage leaves tossed with slices of tangy onion and some other greens.
desc_zh: 卷心菜留下有汁水的叶子，加上辣口的洋葱丝，再跟别的绿叶菜搅拌混合。

desc_en: Technically not a sword but a very large knife - though who besides weapon collectors would lose sleep over such a distinction?
desc_zh: 形制上来说，其实是一把大刀，不过除了兵器收藏家，又有谁会在意这种差异？

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: A thin porridge of questionable origin. Stuffing one's stomach with it is barely enough to dull the hunger.
desc_zh: 兑了水的粥，不知道哪儿来的，也就能管个水饱，勉强不用挨饿。

desc_en: A thin porridge of questionable origin. Stuffing one's stomach with it is barely enough to dull the hunger.
desc_zh: 兑了水的粥，不知道哪儿来的，也就能管个水饱，勉强不用挨饿。

desc_en: The beak-like visor of this sallet keeps the wearer's face safe from most dangers. In general, such helmets are worn by warriors of noble blood.
desc_zh: 这种轻盔前端面甲形似鸟喙，穿戴者面部可以免受很多攻击的伤害。这种形制的头盔很受贵族战士喜爱。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 头盔

desc_en: Commonly issued to guards of higher rank.
desc_zh: 一般是发给军衔比较高的卫兵。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: A perfect example of a weapon's effectiveness relying entirely on the user's skill: this bow is pretty much useless in the hands of a novice archer.
desc_zh: 这种弓充分证明了兵器好用与否完全取决于个人的能力——这弓要是给了修习弓法不久的人，就几乎是件废品。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: Village guards are usually recruited from peasantry, where most are already familiar with a bow. As for town guards, it takes much less effort to arm them with crossbows than teach them archery from scratch.
desc_zh: 村里的卫兵多数出身农家，入伍之前就已经熟悉弓箭。城里的守卫就不是这么回事了，与其从零教他们习弓练箭，不如直接配弩。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: These halberds are typically forged from poor steel: city guards don't see a lot of action.
desc_zh: 城里的守卫一般不用大动干戈，所以这类戟用的都不是好钢。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: When King Etbert ascended the throne, Aldor was drowning in crime and infighting. His swift success in regaining control over the brigand-infested roads can mostly be attributed to the creation of guard units that answered directly to him rather than local lords.
desc_zh: 埃特伯特国王登基之初，奥尔多派系林立，不法之徒猖獗。他当初之所以能够迅速铲除官道的匪患，还是因为创建了不从领主而唯王命是从的卫兵队伍。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 头盔

desc_en: These swords were intended for King Etbert's bodyguards. After the monarch's death, at least several of them ended up stolen from the royal arsenal.
desc_zh: 这些兵器很久之前属于埃特伯特国王的护卫，国王驾崩之后，原本存放在王家军械库，后来有几把不翼而飞。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手刀剑

desc_en: Not too long before his demise, King Etbert ordered to form a unit of crossbow-wielding guardsmen. The most skilled Aldwynn bowyers were tasked with providing the weaponry, but they'd managed to produce only a few dozen crossbows before the monarch's death.
desc_zh: 埃特伯特国王驾崩之前没有多久，下令组建了一支弩兵卫队，并命多位手艺无与伦比的奥尔德文工匠为卫队打造兵器。直到国王离世，工匠也才造出了几十把弩。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: The cuffs are embossed with King Etbert's crest, leaving no question about the original owner's allegiance.
desc_zh: 腕部压了埃特伯特国王的纹章，全然彰显了手套原主人效忠的是哪一方。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 中 手套

desc_en: After the Royal Guard was disbanded, many former guardsmen decided to try their luck as mercenaries. Rather predictably, they took all their equipment with them, these shields included.
desc_zh: 王家卫队解散之后，许多守卫改行当了雇佣兵，只是没有抛弃自己从前的装备，依然带在身上，这些盾牌便是其中之一。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 盾牌

desc_en: Making these swords is a routine job for the Guild's smiths - day after day, night after night...
desc_zh: 新会的铁匠打这种剑跟家常便饭一样，从早打到晚，从晚打到早……

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: It's said that Aldorian smiths got the idea of forging such a peculiarly shaped weapon from the inhabitants of the Bronze Isles.
desc_zh: 奥尔多的铁匠之所以造出了这种形状的东西，据说是参考了青铜群岛的兵器。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: Big appetite, big liver.
desc_zh: 胃口大，肝也大。

desc_en: Big appetite, big liver.
desc_zh: 胃口大，肝也大。

desc_en: Gulon hunting has long been a beloved pastime of the Sentian aristocracy. At first, it was just the thrill of danger that drew them in - but then their cooks figured out which parts of the beast could be turned into a delicacy...
desc_zh: 捕取谷隆常年都是森提亚贵族热衷的娱乐方式。虽然他们起初只是其中无比的惊险刺激，但是后来贵族的厨子也发现了这种动物的哪些部位可以做成美食……

desc_en: Gulon hunting has long been a beloved pastime of the Sentian aristocracy. At first, it was just the thrill of danger that drew them in - but then their cooks figured out which parts of the beast could be turned into a delicacy...
desc_zh: 捕取谷隆常年都是森提亚贵族热衷的娱乐方式。虽然他们起初只是其中无比的惊险刺激，但是后来贵族的厨子也发现了这种动物的哪些部位可以做成美食……

desc_en: Entire sagas have been woven about the martial valor and tireless spirit of the legendary konung Haakon the Graybeard. Under his command, the dwarves managed, if only briefly, to conquer several Skadian cities.
desc_zh: 苍髯哈康大王作为传奇人物，他的英勇善战与刚毅不拔成为了一部又一部萨迦歌颂的主题。在他的领导之下，矮人一度短时攻下斯卡迪亚的若干城池。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手斧

desc_en: It must have come from the shores of distant Skadia. Some of the pieces contain peculiar, long-extinct insects.
desc_zh: 这种宝石很有可能来自遥远国度斯卡迪亚的沿海地区，有些琥珀还裹着早已灭绝的昆虫。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: A handful of fine, meticulously sifted wheat flour.
desc_zh: 一把细面，筛去了大多数杂质。

desc_en: Harpy feathers are sturdy enough to resemble armor, capable of chipping blades and deflecting poorly aimed shots.
desc_zh: 哈比的羽毛与一般禽类的羽毛不同，结实得出奇，而且韧性极佳。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Harpies have truly cast-iron stomachs that can digest pretty much anything. Their stomach acid in particular is a subject of research for many natural philosophers.
desc_zh: 哈比的胃真的像铁一样，基本什么都能消化。自然哲学家对于这类动物的胃酸尤其有兴趣。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Harpies have truly cast-iron stomachs that can digest pretty much anything. Their stomach acid in particular is a subject of research for many natural philosophers.
desc_zh: 哈比的胃真的像铁一样，基本什么都能消化。自然哲学家对于这类动物的胃酸尤其有兴趣。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: There aren't that many helmets or cuirasses which can survive a strike from a three-pronged hammerhead.
desc_zh: 没有多少胸甲和头盔扛得住这根三叉长柄锤。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: Do horses dream of fresh hay?
desc_zh: 不论什么马饲料，都离不开这个。

desc_en: Some Aldorian healers place special enchantments on their staves, much to the displeasure of village priests.
desc_zh: 奥尔多有些治疗师会给长杖附加特殊的魔法，乡下祭司很不喜欢这样。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: Originally, this ointment was used to treat scabies. Its potent wound-healing effects were discovered purely by accident.
desc_zh: 这个膏剂本来是治疥疮的，治伤的强力功效纯粹是偶然发现。

extra.en: If a selected body part is ~r~Injured~/~, the salve's effects are reduced by ~r~50%~/~.
extra.zh: 如果所选身体部位~r~受伤~/~，药膏的效果减弱~r~50%~/~。

desc_en: A solid choice when fighting on foot.
desc_zh: 非常适合徒步作战。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 盾牌

desc_en: A solid choice when fighting on foot. This particular shield bears King Etbert's crest.
desc_zh: 非常适合徒步作战。这一块盾牌刷了埃特伯特国王的盾徽。

desc_en: A solid choice when fighting on foot. This particular shield bears an insignia of some noble house.
desc_zh: 非常适合徒步作战。这一块盾牌刷了某个贵族的家徽。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 盾牌

desc_en: A frequent joke among the free companies is to hand one of these to a fresh recruit during drill, then stand back and enjoy the spectacle.
desc_zh: 佣兵团的人经常拿这个捉弄新来的，操练的的时候发给他们一把这样的斧头，然后就能站在一边看笑话了。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: Even though a strike from this club is unlikely to harm a well-armored opponent, it still has all the chances to briefly knock the wind out of them.
desc_zh: 如果对手防护精良，这根军棍难能伤到他，不过绝对可以打得他喘不过气来。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: Despite their small size, hedgehogs are brave, inquisitive little critters.
desc_zh: 刺猬个头虽小，但是勇敢又好奇。

extra.zh: 可以剖解。
刺猬

desc_en: Despite their small size, hedgehogs are brave, inquisitive little critters.
desc_zh: 刺猬个头虽小，但是勇敢又好奇。

extra.zh: 可以剖解。
刺猬

desc_en: The ornate pommel bears the crest of yet another noble house that did not survive the war.
desc_zh: 华丽的剑首刻着某个贵族的家徽，只是这个家族也覆灭于战乱之中。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手刀剑

desc_en: Hemp stalks can be woven into cheap, sturdy ropes. Of course, that's not the only use for this plant...
desc_zh: 麻的杆可以编成便宜、结实的绳子。当然了，这种植物的作用不止于此……

desc_en: Henbane excites the senses, but in large amounts, it's a deadly poison. In some places, it is even added to beer... to make the drinking merrier, so to speak.
desc_zh: 天仙子可以刺激感官，但大量使用可以致死。有些地方的人甚至喝啤酒都会加……说是喝起来更嗨。

extra.en: ~w~25%~/~ chance to cause ~lg~Battle Rage~/~.#The chance increases up to ~w~100%~/~ depending on Intoxication.
extra.zh: 有~w~25%~/~的几率令你~lg~战意激昂~/~。#这个几率受迷醉影响，最高可至~w~100%~/~

desc_en: Can be used to improve your standing with the ~bl~Grand Magistrate~/~ or sold away.
desc_zh: 可以卖掉，也可以用来增进你和~bl~城市联盟~/~的关系。

extra.en: A personally signed letter of gratitude from some Magistrate official.
extra.zh: 感谢信，有城联某位官员的亲笔签名。
引荐书[声誉%rep_amount%]

desc_en: herbs
desc_zh: 草本植物

desc_en: At first glance, it's just an ordinary severed finger. But only at first glance...
desc_zh: 乍看只是普普通通的断指，仔细看的话……

extra.en: Can be delivered to the contract giver for an additional ~y~reward~/~.
extra.zh: 交给派发契据的人，可以获得额外的~y~报酬~/~。

desc_en: The enigmatic Sages, who made the deepest thicket of the local forests their home, are one of the greatest Aldorian mysteries. Many believe it was them who'd been protecting the land from the worst of it - and now that their numbers have dwindled, everything comes crashing down.
desc_zh: 诸位慧老不可捉摸，隐居丛林最深的地方，奥尔多没有多少人像他们这般神秘高深。许多人认为国家之前之所以能维持相对稳定的局势，纯粹仰仗慧老，诸位老人如今一年少过一年，全国上下的时局便一塌糊涂了。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Even though it looks plain and unassuming, putting this wooden ring on your finger brings in the surge of incredible vigor.
desc_zh: 这个木头戒指虽然看着平平无奇，但戴上的瞬间能让你感受到活力不可思议的涌动。

desc_en: The reclusive Sages are long-time protectors of Aldor, yet very little is known about them. There seems to be a growing rumor that many of them have disappeared without a trace over the past few years.
desc_zh: 诸位慧老深入简出，常年守护奥尔多，大家对他们知之甚少。最近几年，据说多位慧老相继失踪，什么痕迹都没留下。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 长杖

desc_en: Inexplicably, the strips of bark still appear to be fresh, alive even... What power makes it possible?
desc_zh: 这些树皮不知道为什么至今依然新鲜，甚至还有生力……其中蕴涵了怎样的力量？

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 头盔

desc_en: A tree branch, darkened from age and covered with strange etchings - simply looking at it fills you with a sense of deep-seated anxiety.
desc_zh: 一根树枝，颜色因为年代久远而有些深沉，上面刻着奇怪的图纹。你只是看了一眼，内心深处就涌起了一阵焦虑。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: The forces from beyond the veil are fickle and vindictive. It's frighteningly easy to fall victim to them if you don't exercise the necessary caution.
desc_zh: “帷幕”后面的力量无法捉摸、睚眦必报。哪怕只是一时大意，都会为其所害。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 项链

desc_en: A pair of sturdy boots made out of cow leather. In times of war, this sort of footwear greatly grows in demand.
desc_zh: 生牛皮材质，结实，战乱年代需求最大。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: These staves, still bearing the mark of the Host, are the main proof of the clerical estate's divine patronage.
desc_zh: 这种长杖依然带有圣主的印迹，证明了教牧存在世间的神圣意义。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: To this very day, certain noble Firn lineages still preserve the tradition of instructing male heirs in the art of the sling.
desc_zh: 直到今天，山上的某些弗恩贵族家族还有教授男性继承人投石技艺的传统。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: Prone to superstition, Hilda believes the amulet her mother gave her long ago is the very thing that helped her survive on the island.
desc_zh: 迷信的希尔达认为自己那座岛上之所以能大难不死，完全是因为自己戴了这块护身符，这个东西母亲很早之前就送给她了。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 防御型 项链

desc_en: Hilda crafted this spear herself from the debris washed ashore after the shipwreck. Her hands remember every scratch and groove on the weathered shaft.
desc_zh: 捕鲸船遇险之后，希尔达用冲上海岸的东西做了这么一支矛。这件兵器用到现在，上面的沟沟壑壑，她都已经了然于胸。

desc_en: The Blades were a group of assassins operating in every major Aldorian city. They didn't last long though: betrayed by their client, most of them were found out, apprehended, and executed after a series of high-profile murders.
desc_zh: “尖刀会”刺客和杀手的足迹曾经遍及奥尔多的各大城市，只是存在时间不长——一系列引人注目的杀人事件之后，这个组织因遭客户出卖，多数成员身份败露、被捕、处以死刑。

desc_en: A sturdy garment that can take a beating, a reasonable choice for most contracts.
desc_zh: 这件衣服结实耐穿，禁得住摔打，大多数契据穿这个都应该不会有大问题。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Apparently, it was forged by a commoner with a dream of heroic feats.
desc_zh: 这把刀应该出自普通人之手，而且这人有一个英雄梦。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: Honey crepe eating contests are an old Aldwynn custom. Some even manage to die during them, raising the stakes and making these events all the more entertaining for the onlookers.
desc_zh: 奥尔德文有比赛吃蜂蜜薄饼的民俗，有的参赛选手甚至当场丧生，因而令比赛更加刺激，更受人关注。

desc_en: With the proper dosage, honey hyssop can quickly bring anyone back to health, unless the patient has already given up on themselves.
desc_zh: 除非患者自己已经放弃，否则只要用以适当剂量的蜜神香草，不论是谁都能恢复得大差不差。

extra.en: Grants the following effect for ~y~360~/~ turns:##Restoration replenishes ~lg~twice~/~ as much Health per tick
extra.zh: 可以产生以下效果，持续~y~360~/~个回合：##生命自动恢复每次恢复的生命数量~lg~翻倍~/~

desc_en: A centerpiece of any festive spread - the aroma alone is enough to sway even the pickiest of gourmands.
desc_zh: 只要过节，这个就是餐桌上的主角，单是这个香气就能把老饕馋得口水直流。

desc_en: It's both a delicious treat and a remedy.
desc_zh: 既能当甜食，也能当药品。

desc_en: It's both a delicious treat and a remedy.
desc_zh: 既能当甜食，也能当药品。

desc_en: Engraved on the blade is a phrase in Sentian Aldorian: "To Gill Korde, for the valor and courage demonstrated by him and his troops at the Battle of Arnem."
desc_zh: 斧刃上有一行铭文，是奥尔多文的森提亚方言：“赐吉尔·考德，旌其与部众于阿尔内姆一役所展之勇毅。”

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手斧

desc_en: It looks like one of the polehammers awarded by Duke Arno di Berro to captains of the Falcon Plume company for their display of heroism during the defense of the Northern Gates.
desc_zh: 鹰翎团英勇无畏，固守北门有功，迪·贝罗公爵赏了团中队长几把长柄锤，这一把看样子就是其中之一。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 双手锤棒

desc_en: A woolen hood with a playfully folded tip. These were once popular among Maen townsmen.
desc_zh: 羊毛兜帽，顶部随便折了一个尖。曼恩的城里人以前特别爱戴这种帽子。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: The practice of adding hops to beer emerged during the Radiant Wars: long campaigns required less perishable drinks.
desc_zh: 啤酒里边加蛇麻这种作法，出现于光辉战争期间——部队长途行军需要相对不容易变质的饮品。

desc_en: It remains unknown who first thought it would be a good idea to sample deathstinger secretions. Nevertheless, the fact remains: imbibing them briefly sharpens reflexes to an incredible degree. The eventual aftermath comes in the form of a severe headache and full-body cramps.
desc_zh: 这种物质由亡蜂分泌，至今仍然不知道最早是谁那么大的胆子吃了这种蜂蜜。胡蜂蜜确实有一定的功效，摄入这种物质可以令人的反应速度加快到不可思议的程度，不过功效散去之后，就会出现剧烈的头痛和全身痉挛。

extra.en: Grants the following effect for ~y~240~/~ turns:##~lg~+15%~/~ Accuracy#~lg~+15%~/~ Counter Chance#~lg~+15%~/~ Dodge Chance#~lg~+10%~/~ Crit Chance##Using it leads to an unpleasant ~r~Aftermath~/~.
extra.zh: 产生以下效果，存续~y~240~/~个回合：##准度~lg~+15%~/~#反击几率~lg~+15%~/~#闪躲几率~lg~+15%~/~#暴击几率~lg~+10%~/~##效果消失之后，会出现~r~戒断反应~/~。

desc_en: An old horseshoe, either misplaced by accident or used as a good luck charm.
desc_zh: 旧马蹄铁，要么是不小心掉了，要么就是被人用来招好运了。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Horsetail is well known as a powerful astringent. It shouldn't be abused, though - cattle that graze on horsetail often end up dead from poisoning.
desc_zh: 问荆消炎止血的功效显著，不过不能滥用，经常有黄牛因为吃了问荆被毒死。

desc_en: A hounskull visor may look peculiar, but it actually excels at deflecting blows to the face while also providing more breathing room.
desc_zh: 犬面头盔的面甲造型可能比较奇特，不过这种头盔可以避免很多伤害，而且呼吸相对畅通。

desc_en: Looks like it's time to sell this thing off.
desc_zh: 这东西看样子是时候卖掉了。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: A handy tool that can be used to carve a path through the thicket, chop some wood, or skin a dead animal.
desc_zh: 这件工具用处很多，可以开路，可以砍柴，也可以给动物剥皮。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: They taste best when cooked over a campfire with the fowl you personally procured.
desc_zh: 亲手打的野禽，大腿拆下来，营火上烤熟，味道最好。

desc_en: Crossbows are well-suited for hunting - their accuracy and stopping power leave little chance even to large animals.
desc_zh: 弩非常适合狩猎——准度可靠，杀伤力强，即便是大型野物，也难能脱身。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: It will send an arrow from one end of the glade to the other, but whether it hits the squirrel in the branches - that depends on your aim.
desc_zh: 拿着这种弓，站在树林里草地的一头，能把箭射到另外一头，至于能不能射中树上的松鼠，那就要看你的准头了。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: A long-established peasant weapon for hunting small game, demanding both training and a fair bit of dexterity.
desc_zh: 这个早就成了农民猎取小型野物的工具，只是需要日常练习，还需要手上灵活。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: A scourge of deer, wolves, and boars, this weapon was made for large game.
desc_zh: 这个东西专门用来捕杀大型动物，是鹿、狼、野猪的噩梦。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: Dwarven huscarls sleep in their clothes, keeping weapons and shields within arm's reach. Life in Fjall is unpredictable, and you never know when your master may require protection.
desc_zh: 矮人近卫平时和衣而睡，兵器和盾牌也要放在身旁。毕竟弗约的形势变幻莫测，他们需要保护主人，时时刻刻都要警惕。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 盾牌

desc_en: #Weber!##I have to inform you that the supplies I receive here in Osbrook leave much to be desired. I'm a patrician from a well-respected Brynn family, and I can no longer tolerate such a dismissive attitude to my person. The wine here is disgusting, I'm served gruel, and the local commoners don't respect their betters. In fact, they seem to barely understand who I am and what I do in their gods-forsaken village.##Therefore, I urge you to take swift measures, otherwise I'll have to report your misconduct to my higher-ups in Brynn. I'm well aware that there's some bad blood between you and Jeon, so I would hate to deepen that animosity even further. I expect to receive a crate of Mannshire fortified wine at the earliest possible date, or there'll be consequences.##Respectfully and with due displeasure,#Emissary Rickerd der Overbine
desc_zh: ##维博！##我告诉你，奥斯布鲁克这边的补给太寒酸了。我可是布林的名门贵族，他们把我当什么了？！我在这个地方，喝的是酸酒，吃的是稀饭，平民也一点礼数都没有。我看他们根本不知道我是什么来头，也不知道我是为什么来他们这个鸟不拉屎的地方。##鉴此，我促你尽快采取相应措施，否则我就将你玩忽职守之事上报布林。我知道你和耶昂不对付，也不是很想火上浇油。希望能尽早收到一箱曼郡加烈酒，没有按时送到的话，那就不好意思了。##此致，不悦，#里柯特·德·欧佛拜恩特使

extra.en: A letter by the emissary of Osbrook addressed to the Mannshire governor. It carries a heavy wax seal and looks awfully imposing.
extra.zh: 写信人：奥斯布鲁克特使，收信人：曼郡总督。封戳上面浇了厚厚一层蜡，看起来好像十分要紧。
作者：里柯德·德·欧佛拜恩
特使的信

desc_en: In Aldor, only a few things are known for certain about elephants: they have a fearsome temper, they're as big as a mountain, and their tusks can be sold for a high price.
desc_zh: 奥尔多人对于大象的了解并不多，只知道这种动物习性骇人，体型庞大如山，牙齿可以卖出高价。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_zh: 这类砍刀的式样效仿东方刀剑，外观奇特。近几年来，精灵族的各类东西在奥尔多都很流行，才出现了这么一种兵器。

desc_en: Entire wars have been fought in Fjall to claim such a sword - and the title that comes with it.
desc_zh: 弗约矮人之间连年的争斗，都是为了争夺这么一把剑和“亚尔”这个名号。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手刀剑

desc_en: Given sufficient materials, time, and patronage, dwarven craftsmen are still capable of producing true masterpieces.
desc_zh: 只要材料充足，时间充足，再有他人资助，矮人的工匠大师依然做得出真正的传世杰作。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: A cape made of the thinnest of silks. The material is incredibly durable: tearing even a single strip from it would require a significant effort.
desc_zh: 这件披风用的是世上最薄的绸缎，却又结实得令人不可思议。想撕烂这件衣服，一般人怕是很难做到。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 斗篷

desc_en: The only Jibean things about it are the name and the figs: created by a Brynn chef, the recipe is a blatant guess at what an Orient dish might look like.
desc_zh: 这道菜只有名字和无花果跟“吉贝”搭得上边，其实出自布林的某位大厨之手，纯粹诞生于他对东方菜品的臆断。

desc_en: Half the stories about distant Jibey one way or another mentions its legendary scimitars. Acquiring one in Aldor costs a fortune.
desc_zh: 关于遥远的吉贝，奥尔多流传着各种各样的传说，其中大概有一半都提到了远近闻名的吉贝弯刀，这种兵器在奥尔多价格不菲。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: A gold amulet, generously painted with azure and purple. Such colors are a rare sight in Aldor.
desc_zh: 金质护身符，漆色以蓝紫为主，这两种颜色在奥尔多非常罕见。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 项链

desc_en: A reminder of strenuous, yet rewarding days spent studying at the Academy, when the future looked bright and full of promise. So much has changed since then...
desc_zh: 学院的学习生活辛苦而又充实，那时的未来充满了光明和希望。可是后来，很多事情都变了一副模样……

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 手套

desc_en: A uniform of the Academy student, fashioned by Jonna from a man's mantle.
desc_zh: 这种斗篷学院学生人手一件，这一件是约娜拿了件男式的改出来的。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Used to be generously festooned with scalps and severed fingers, making things rather awkward with the Aldorian folk, forcing Jorgrim to hastily get rid of it all.
desc_zh: 这根腰带之前挂了很多头皮和手指，就因为这个，约戈里姆和奥尔多的人闹了很多不愉快，所以他只能赶紧把那些东西拆掉了。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 腰带

desc_en: The craftsmanship is undoubtedly dwarven, but the imagery has little to do with Fjall... Makes you wonder how exactly this pendant came into Jorgrim's possession.
desc_zh: 这个肯定是矮人的做工，只不过图案和弗约没太大关系……让人不禁好奇，这个东西是怎样到了约戈里姆的手上。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 攻击型 项链

desc_en: Some of its combat effectiveness was stripped away in favor of imposing aesthetics. Still, it's hard to deny that this armor makes quite an impression.
desc_zh: 这种盔甲为了外观，牺牲了一部分的实用性能，不过造型确实威武气派，这一点毋庸置疑。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 铠甲

desc_en: The flowers adorning its brow symbolize nobility, temperance, and purity of intention.
desc_zh: 这件轻盔顶部饰有白花，象征自制内敛和高风亮节。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 头盔

desc_en: It's embroidered with heraldic crests of a long dead noble house.
desc_zh: 斗篷上面绣了某个早已断绝的贵族的家徽。

desc_en: The main purpose of jousts is to show off, so no expense is too great when it comes to elaborate shield paintings. In fact, the last joust before the war was so exceedingly festive that it was more reminiscent of a carnival than a celebration of combat prowess.
desc_zh: 马上长枪比武的主要目的就是张扬和炫耀，所以比武的人为了装点这种盾牌，无论花多少钱都不会心疼。奥尔多内乱之前的那场马上长枪比武，声势浩大，现场沸反盈天，说是比武，莫不如说是狂欢节。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 中 盾牌

desc_en: If you ignore the lavish decorations, it's just a simple, hopelessly outdated topfhelm: the only thing it'll help you conquer it is the hearts of fair maidens.
desc_zh: 这顶桶盔装饰丰富，这是与普通桶盔的唯一区别，不过现在已经完全过时了——戴上它的话，除了美娇娘的芳心，其他什么都征服不了。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 头盔

desc_en: To make a kalkan, nomads weave reed stalks into a desired shape, then fasten it with a metal ring. The resulting shield is both lightweight and durable.
desc_zh: 游牧民族先用植物纤维将芦苇杆扎成致密结构，再用金属环固定苇杆，一块轻便又耐用的盾牌就做成了。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 盾牌

desc_en: A sword of newfangled design that has been growing in popularity among the mercenaries of the Grand Magistrate.
desc_zh: 这把剑造型入时，颇受城市联盟的雇佣兵青睐。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: A kettle helmet is essentially a hat, albeit made of metal. Even an amateurish village blacksmith can be tasked with crafting one.
desc_zh: 这种头盔本质上就是一顶金属帽子，连乡里普通的铁匠都能打。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 头盔

desc_en: The late King Etbert meticulously fostered a reputation as a patron and connoisseur of the fine arts: his court teemed with poets, artists, and sculptors praising their benefactor to high heaven.
desc_zh: 先王埃特伯特喜文好艺，素以慷慨赞助墨客艺人而为人所乐道——宫中上下，诗家、画家、雕刻工匠随处可见，无不尽其所能，以各自的形式向上天赞颂他们的赞助之人。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: The debate about whether Aldorian kipfels are actual bagels or mere bagel-likes hasn't stopped since their first appearance on the market.
desc_zh: 自打市面上有人卖奥式基夫利开始，就一直有人为“奥式基夫利到底算不算贝果”这个问题而争个不停，到现在也没争出谁对谁错。

desc_en: Too dull to cut anything but cheese.
desc_zh: 不怎么锋利，可是还能切奶酪。

desc_en: Although this shield offers reliable cover to the entire body, from feet to shoulders, you won't run far with it weighing you down.
desc_zh: 这种盾牌虽然可以充分遮挡肩部到脚的整个身体，但是十分笨重，不便移动。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 盾牌

desc_en: This bascinet's visor forms a solid barrier against blades and arrows. As a trade-off, it also greatly limits your vision.
desc_zh: 这个头盔的面甲可以很好地抵御劈砍和穿刺攻击，不过严重限制了穿戴者的视野。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 头盔

desc_en: Not very spacious, but at least it won't get in the way while running and fighting.
desc_zh: 装不了太多东西，不过起码动手、跑动的时候不会碍事。

extra.en: Can be used to store items.##Must be equipped before use.
extra.zh: 可以收纳物品。##装备之后才能使用。

desc_en: Making a single suit of noble plate armor demands multiple craftsmen and months of hard work.
desc_zh: 一件贵族板甲往往需要多名工匠好几个月才能造成。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 铠甲

desc_en: Such axes are well-suited for mounted combat. Aldorian knights often choose them over the rest of their arsenal when they ride into battle.
desc_zh: 这种斧子非常适合马上使用，奥尔多的骑士上战场常常随身带上一把。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: The art of engraving has reached amazing heights over the last half century: each of the belt's plates is inscribed with scenes of hunts and battles.
desc_zh: 近五十年来，纹刻工艺达到了令人称奇的高度——这条腰带每一段都刻了描绘打猎和战斗的图样。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: A single glance at this noble blade is all it takes to realize that only a select few are worthy to wield it.
desc_zh: 这把剑你只要看一眼，就知道只有极少数人有资格佩戴。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: In war, anything can go wrong: the mail around the neck and jaw serves to keep the head where it belongs, even after losing the helmet.
desc_zh: 战场上什么意外都有可能出现，脖子下巴加一圈链网，就算头盔掉了，脑袋也不至于搬家。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: Flails are considered to be a weapon of the low-born, but sometimes they are used by lords as well. Such "noble" flails are crafted with quality in mind.
desc_zh: 很多人都觉得连枷是下等人用的东西，不过有些贵族大人也会用连枷。这些“贵族”连枷的做工跟平常的连枷可谓天壤之别。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Knights are demanding customers, expecting both excellent combat performance and elegant appearance from their weapon - hence the elaborate shaping of the head and handle.
desc_zh: 骑士要求多，兵器既要用起来趁手，又要形制雅观，所以这把锤才有了这样的锤头和锤柄。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: The satin-lined cuffs are merely another way to parade one's impeccable taste in armor.
desc_zh: 这种沙漏手甲内衬是缎料，这种手甲主要用途是表现自身的地位和挑选武备的好品味。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 手套

desc_en: Invented by an unknown Aldwynn smith, this design quickly caught the eye of the local knights.
desc_zh: 这种斧子由奥尔德文的某位铁匠发明，而后很快便受到了当地骑士的青睐。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: A chestpiece held in high esteem by Aldorian knights. It provides almost the same level of protection as full plate but costs less and looks fancier.
desc_zh: 奥尔多的骑士喜欢穿这种盔甲，因为它的防护效果几乎可以媲美全板甲，但是造价低，而且样式更好看。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 铠甲

desc_en: The shift in attitude towards this decidedly non-chivalrous weapon was driven by the rising number of treatises extolling the benefits and virtues of sparring with flails.
desc_zh: 从前，连枷是不合骑士精神的东西，上不了战场。如今，推崇这类兵器战斗价值的专著越来越多，大家的态度也就跟着有了变化。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: Perfectly suited for knocking the life out of your opponent with a single well-placed strike, once you've gotten them off-balance.
desc_zh: 只要对手脚下没站稳，瞄准了一锤甩过去，就能让他小命不保。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Aldorian knights are slow to accept novelty, but the numerous advantages of poleaxes can persuade even the most stubborn.
desc_zh: 奥尔多的骑士接受新鲜事物的速度很慢，不过枪斧优点众多，就算是橡木疙瘩也能认识到它的好。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: Polehammers have recently begun to rise in popularity as a weapon of choice for knightly jousts.
desc_zh: 最近几年，骑士开始时兴带长柄锤参加比武。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: Well-suited for fighters who want their every strike to leave the opponent in the dirt.
desc_zh: 如果希望每一下都能把对手砸倒在地，用这个最合适。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: Sometimes a knight needs to fight on foot. This shield is excellent for such scenarios.
desc_zh: 骑士有时需要下马作战，这个时候就非常适合用这种盾牌。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 盾牌

desc_en: This two-handed sword was created with pure functionality in mind: its strength lies in perfect simplicity and great balance.
desc_zh: 这种双手剑锻造的时候完全没有考虑外观，心思全都花在了功用上，所以简洁简约和良好的平衡性才是这种兵器的长处。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: This weapon is a world apart from the tool which originally inspired it - a humble pickaxe.
desc_zh: 这种兵器最早借鉴了普通的鹤嘴镐，现在与鹤嘴镐已是判若两然。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: In the Aldorian tradition, a sword is the only "knightly" weapon there is. Lately, however, the nobility has been demonstrating a growing appreciation for warhammers and maces.
desc_zh: 奥尔多的贵族从前认为只有刀剑才配得上骑士使用，然而许多贵族近年来渐渐看到了战锤和钉头锤的魅力。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Can break one's jaw just by trying to spell its name.
desc_zh: 光是念这件兵器的名字，你的嘴巴就有点吃不消了。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: It is said that in the very heart of the desert between Hazzun and Al-Qaza lies the Labyrinth, guarded by silent warriors. Whatever is kept within remains secret, for no one who entered it has ever returned alive and sane.
desc_zh: 迷宫据说位于沙海中央，介于哈尊和阿卡扎之间，有无声的战士镇守。隐匿其中的秘密至今无人知晓，因为进去的人要么根本没能回来，就算回来了，也神智失常，无一例外。

desc_en: Over the years, I've collected a number of pieces from all corners of our world: Aldorian morgensterns, Skadian bludgeons, elven bozdogans... Some of them are plain and unassuming. Others - mostly the ones from the East - are the work of art, a source of pride for those who crafted them.##A reader unfamiliar with the matters of warfare may wonder: what advantages can this humble weapon offer over a good old sword? Quite a few, actually.##First of all, a mace is a perfect choice for a warrior who isn't experienced in fencing. Maces are easy to learn, simple to handle and maintain, and require only two things - strength and dexterity.##Secondly, maces make short work of mail shirts and light armor. Heavy plates are noticeably trickier, but even when a mace strike fails to punch through metal, a lucky hit can still daze the opponent for a few precious seconds.##Thirdly, maces don't get stuck in crushed armor and shields, which can be rather handy in the thick of a fight...##Fourthly... On the other hand, I'd rather not tire the esteemed reader by getting too verbose. For a change of pace, let's have a closer look at the short history of blunt weaponry in general...
desc_zh: 这些年来，我在世界各地收集了不少兵器，比如说奥尔多的晨星、斯卡迪亚的锤棍、精灵的锤矛……有些其貌不扬，平平无奇，有些则不然，尤其是东方的那些兵器，简直堪称艺术。不论什么工匠，造出了这样的兵器，都值得自豪。##读者如果不了解排兵布阵、上场打仗，可能觉得这些简单的兵器哪里比得上一把好剑？其实，单手锤、棒不仅有长处，而且长处不少，且听我细细解释。##第一，士兵如果不擅刀法剑术，锤或者大头棒便是他的不二选择。这种兵器易于练习，易于操持，便于使用，只要肩臂灵巧、力气够大就行。##第二，这类兵器可以轻松破坏链甲衫和轻防具，虽然攻击重型板甲的效果较差，但运气好的话，也能打晕对手，为你争取几秒宝贵的时间。##第三，这类兵器砸穿盔甲或者盾牌之后，不易卡住，这一点攸关生死……##第四……这个话题我不希望长篇大论，免得尊贵的读者看得腻烦了，我们不妨换个角度，来仔细看一看钝兵器简短的历史……

extra.en: Idrich Jorg is a distinguished Aldwynn weapon and armor collector who spent a fortune on his passion. The eccentric codger has never been in a real battle but can still discuss armaments for hours on end.
extra.zh: 伊德里赫·约格是奥尔德文著名的兵器收藏家，为了这份爱好，下了不少本钱。这个怪老头没上过战场，但是聊起兵器能滔滔不绝地说几个小时。
作者：伊德里赫·约格

desc_en: The Great Despot, a ruler and a patron of Nistra, is well versed in the art of war. Every year he makes sure to carry out a military parade to demonstrate the might of the Nistrian army to common people - I was fortunate enough to attend one of these events. In my entire life, I'd never witnessed a celebration this unifying. Can you imagine Aldorian nobles fraternizing with poor townsmen during festivities? Nonsense, right? In Nistra, however, it's a usual occurrence.##( . . . )##The parade opened with a procession of cataphracts - the remnants of the ancient times when the Nistrian Empire stretched far to the east. The horses moved at a steady pace, heavy hooves striking the cobblestones. The riders' armor resembled a carapace of an exotic beast - fashioned from countless shiny scales, it dazzled in the sun. In their hands they carried hefty flanged maces, decorated with gilded ornaments.##( . . . )##Allegedly, it's almost impossible to hold your ground against a cataphract charge. Their wedge formations shatter enemy lines like a battering ram, overpowering even the most experienced pikemen. Those who escape death by trampling rarely live to tell the tale - a couple mace swings is all it takes to send even a heavily-armored knight to his forefathers. Dazed by a sudden onslaught of the heavy cavalry, the infantry becomes almost entirely helpless...
desc_zh: 大方主是尼斯特拉的统治者和恩主，久经沙场，通晓兵法，每年都会举行一次阅兵，向平民展现尼斯特拉的军力，我曾经有幸观看过一次。实话实说，我这辈子都没见过这么团结人心的庆典。奥尔多的贵族和下里巴人称兄道弟，这种场景你敢想象？根本是异想天开，对不对？可是，这种事情在尼斯特拉确实是家常便饭。##（ . . . ）##阅兵开场先走出来的是一队全甲骑兵，这种形制源自古时的尼斯特拉帝国军队——帝国当时的疆域直抵东方。战马步伐从容，马蹄踏在卵石路面，震天动地。骑兵身上的铠胄形似某种异兽，片片鳞甲熠熠夺目，沉手的页锤镀了各色饰纹。##（ . . . ）##全甲骑兵冲锋，据说几乎无人能当，他们的楔形军阵会像攻城槌一样，撞破敌人的战线，无论对方枪兵战场经验多么丰富，都无力招架。即便侥幸躲过铁蹄，也鲜有人能够活着逃出战场。只需挥舞几次钉头锤，就算敌人是重甲骑士，也能把他们送去见圣主。至于步兵，一旦被重装骑兵撞晕，就完全丧失了还手之力……

extra.en: This collection of letters by an Aldorian merchant, who only by chance settled in Nistra, is written with a mix of genuine wonder and fascination. Nearly half the tome is filled with lengthy descriptions of the yearly military parade held in the capital of Nistra by its ruler, the Great Despot.
extra.zh: 这些文字的作者是奥尔多的一个商贩，他住到尼斯特拉纯属阴差阳错。本书字里行间充满了惊奇和赞叹，详实记录了当地风土民俗，将近一半的文字都在记述尼斯特拉首脑大方主每年国都阅兵的盛况。

desc_en: ...You know how our knights are, all too eager to dress head to toe in plate armor, so it comes as no surprise that Nistrians are obsessed with maces - around these parts, they treat it as a noble weapon just like we do with our swords. If only you could see the local weapon shops for yourself: It's hard to imagine such a variety of bludgeons anywhere else in the world. Some of the war hammers they sell are so peculiar that I can barely understand how they are supposed to be wielded in combat.##One time, I witnessed a weaponsmith showcasing his wares to a customer. There was a straw dummy in the yard for this very purpose - and judging by its sorry state, the demonstrations were held rather often... The smith dressed the dummy up in a full set of armor, an Aldorian one by the way, took a war hammer, and swung at it... by the Host, I'd never seen a strike this devastating!##It made a huge dent in the plate, and the hammer head got stuck so deep in the mangled metal and straw that the smith had to use a considerable amount of force to pull it free. Let's just say I wouldn't want to be on the receiving end of such a weapon...
desc_zh: ……大家知道我们的骑士，都是恨不得从头到脚都是板甲，所以尼斯特拉人偏好钉头锤也是意料之中。锤、棒于那边的人而言，就像刀剑于我们而言一样高尚。你们要是能亲眼看到当地的兵器集市就好了！很难想象还有哪个地方的单手锤、棒能有那么多花样。他们卖的某些战锤式样十分奇特，我都想象不到那些兵器实战的具体用法。##我见过一个铁匠为了给顾客展示自己锻打的兵器，捶打院里的稻草人——看那稻草人的样子，想必铁匠经常给客人演示。铁匠先给假人套上一身盔甲，奥尔多式的盔甲，然后拎起战锤就抡了过去……圣主啊，从没见过破坏力如此之大的攻击。##锤子在板甲上砸出一个大坑，结结实实地卡在了里面，铁匠费了九牛二五之力才把它拔了出来。要是我的话，绝对不可能像那个假人那样，站在原地硬挨那么一下……

extra.en: The continuation of notes written by an Aldorian merchant who spent at least a dozen years of his life in Nistra. He fervently and in great detail documented Nistrian traditions, paying special attention to the local nobility and their customs.
extra.zh: 这本书出自一个奥尔多商贩之手，此人在尼斯特拉住了至少十年。本文相当部分的笔墨都在描写尼斯特拉的风土人情，着重记述了当地贵族与他们的生活习惯。

extra.en: "Customs and Traditions of Nistra: Part Two"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Maces abilities:~/~##~lg~Knock Out~/~#~y~Concussion~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《尼斯特拉风土考二》##~gr~可以学习若干单手锤棒招式：~/~##~lg~狠锤~/~#~y~当头一锤~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。
作者：丹布里人乌纳

desc_en: Soldiers of the Maen garrison hold a deep appreciation for simplicity, light weight, and convenience. This crossbow combines all three qualities in its design.
desc_zh: 曼恩的驻兵非常推崇简约和轻便，所以这把弩才有了这样的设计。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: The majority of the Cowls, the fanatical followers of Neer, are former peasants, so it comes as no surprise that their favorite weapon is a heavy flail.
desc_zh: 风帽——也就是尼尔狂热的信众——多数都是农民出身，用的兵器绝大多数都是沉甸甸的连枷，也是情理之中的事情。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: Most of the time, the weather in Maen is rather chilly, so local mages have a preference for thick, heavy mantles. Why risk catching a cold if you can avoid it?
desc_zh: 曼恩的气候除了少数几个月份，常年寒凉，当地法师因此喜穿厚而重的法袍。既然有保暖的办法，又何必去冒感染风寒的风险？

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: For years, the Maen Academy was the crucible that forged battlemages in service of the crown. Predictably, it fell on hard times after the King's death and the rise of the Gray Army.
desc_zh: 多年以来，曼恩学院负责为国王培养战地法师。如今国王驾崩，灰军抬头，学院的日子就不好过了，也是意料之中。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: Kasper Stern, a legendary sorcerer and mentor at the Maen Academy, lived about a century ago and was an exceptionally versatile individual. Conrad II Ironhand held the mage in such high esteem that he entrusted him with leading a part of the royal army - an unprecedented decision!
desc_zh: 大约一百年前，曼恩学院有一教师，名作卡斯珀·斯滕，既长于咒法，又深谙军法与治政之道，鲜有人出其右，逝后成为传奇法师。“铁手”康拉德二世彼时对其欣赏有加，命其执掌先王麾下一部，开历史之先河！

stats.type_text: 独一无二 长杖

desc_en: The leather was specially treated to protect against fire, electricity, and other harmful elements that may be summoned by a resisting sorcerer.
desc_zh: 皮革经过了特殊处理，耐热、耐电，还可以抵御法师可能动用的其他元素。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: The life of a magehunter is full of uncertainty. However, with a gambeson like this, managing that uncertainty becomes so much easier.
desc_zh: 法师猎手的生活充满了变数。不过，有了这样的软铠之后，再应付那些变数就容易多了。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: A regular quilted gambeson, painted with the blues and whites of the Magistrate. It's often worn by village militias and light infantry.
desc_zh: 普普通通的绗麻夹棉软铠，染了城市联盟的蓝白颜色，一般是发给乡下的民兵和轻步兵穿。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: A solid choice when fighting on foot. This particular shield bears the colors of the Grand Magistrate.
desc_zh: 非常适合徒步作战。这一块盾牌刷了城市联盟的盾徽。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 盾牌

desc_en: A mail shirt with a blue and white tabard - a standard chestpiece of the Magistrate's garrisons.
desc_zh: 链甲上衣配了蓝白色搭肩外衫，这是城市联盟戍军的标配。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 铠甲

desc_en: The steps taken in these felt boots surpass even the number of stars in the sky.
desc_zh: 这双毡靴迈过的步子，比天上的星星还多。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: A manner of robe that is typically the sole possession of wandering dervishes such as Mahir. It offers reliable protection from both the scorching sun of Jacinth as well as the bone-chilling cold of its desert nights.
desc_zh: 玛息尔这种云游四方的苦行修士，除了这么一件袍子，身上一般别无他物。这种衣服既能遮挡红锆灼热的日光，也能抵御沙漠夜间彻骨的寒意。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Such footwear is cheap to maintain and can withstand a glancing blow to the legs - what else can a warrior wish for?
desc_zh: 这样的靴子保养起来不费钱，还能抵挡刮擦。战士要是能有这样的防具，还用奢求什么？

stats.type_text: 普通 中 靴子

desc_en: Additional neck protection is never redundant. Still, it pays not to get overly confident while wearing something as light as a cervellier.
desc_zh: 颈部添加一些防护总不会多余，不过这么轻便的内盔也不能过分指望能有多么可靠的保护。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 头盔

desc_en: Mail coifs are ubiquitous - they don't cost much, are lightweight, and provide adequate protection against slashing strikes.
desc_zh: 链甲头套随处可见，这种东西造价不贵，又轻便，而且可以有效抵御劈砍。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: Sensible handwear for anyone who values their fingers.
desc_zh: 如果爱惜自己的手指，建议戴这个。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 手套

desc_en: Such mantles have been a common garb of Aldorian battlemages ever since the Radiant Wars - the long range of maaf bows would make short work of anyone wearing light clothes.
desc_zh: 光辉战争之后，奥尔多的战地法师多数便穿上了这种法袍——玛弗人弓长箭远，轻衫薄衣等于送死。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 铠甲

desc_en: It seems like someone tried to improvise a battle axe of sorts. Not the worst result, all things considered.
desc_zh: 看样子有人是想自己造一把战斧。各种因素都考虑进来，做成这样也还算不赖。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: A shepherd's ol' reliable, perfectly adequate for driving stray wolves away from the flock.
desc_zh: 羊倌随身常带这种东西，非常适合驱赶离群的狼。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: An indispensable tool for pinning down fugitives and wild beasts, it can often be seen in the hands of bounty hunters.
desc_zh: 赏金猎人手里经常出现这种兵器，不论是抓逃跑的敌人还是野兽，都离不开它。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: The vineyards of Mannshire have barely started producing after being ravaged by war, so finding good wine is no easy task. This bottle is clearly old stock.
desc_zh: 曼郡的葡萄园被战火毁了，基本都还没恢复生产，现在难能找到好酒，这一瓶显然是陈酿。

extra.zh: 可以导致轻度~r~醉酒~/~。

extra.zh: 干透了之后，完全可以串项链上。

desc_en: The outer rim is decorated with an elegant pattern - a technique typical of Maen jewelers.
desc_zh: 戒指外环刻了某种精美的图案，曼恩的首饰匠人非常爱用这种工艺。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 戒指

desc_en: Somewhat reminiscent of the bands exchanged between newly-weds in Maen - or at least that had been the custom when people there were still getting married.
desc_zh: 有点像曼恩以前新婚夫妇交换的戒指，反正那边人以前愿意结婚的时候，有这样的习俗。

stats.type_text: 普通 勇士型 戒指

desc_en: Northerners can go for weeks without a single crumb of bread, but they start to wither after three days without mead.
desc_zh: 北方人一口面包不吃也能撑两个星期，可要是没有蜂蜜酒，连三天都熬不过去。

extra.zh: 可以导致轻度~r~醉酒~/~。

desc_en: Bits of meat and vegetables, roasted to a crisp over an open fire.
desc_zh: 几块肉，几片菜，明火烤到外皮酥脆。

desc_en: It's not that hard to make meatballs. The accompanying sauce, on the other hand...
desc_zh: 肉丸子做起来倒是不难，但这个酱可就没那么简单了……

desc_en: Over the last few decades, Aldorians have attained incredible mastery in forging heavy plate armor. Axes like this are simply an attempt at evening the odds.
desc_zh: 近几十年来，奥尔多人重型板甲的锻造工艺取得了长足的发展，这种斧头的诞生完全是为了应对这种板甲。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: A thin belt complete with a few metal buckles. It's still more of a fashion accessory than a functional piece of armor though.
desc_zh: 一条细带子，加了几个金属圆盘，与其说是防具，不如说是装饰。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: A crossbow fitted with a more sophisticated cranequin than usual, allowing for a noticeably smoother reloading process.
desc_zh: 这种弩的齿轮机构远比常规的复杂，装填相较其他手弩方便了很多。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: A breastplate worn by lonely mercenaries - it's relatively light, covers the vital spots, and doesn't cost all that much.
desc_zh: 单独行动的雇佣兵会穿这种胸甲，毕竟分量比较轻，可以保护重要部位，而且价格也没那么高。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 铠甲

desc_en: Light, durable, sits well in hand, and can most certainly put an arrogant knight in his place.
desc_zh: 轻便、耐用、趁手，可以把傲慢的骑士打得心服口服。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: Halberds were originally a mercenary weapon, so their widespread use among the Grand Magistrate's soldiers is hardly surprising - at least half of them hail from free companies.
desc_zh: 戟原本是雇佣兵用的东西，因此城市联盟的军队广泛使用也是意料之中的事情——城联军的人有一半之前都是自由佣兵团的成员。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: The life of a mercenary is too short and violent for dull outfits.
desc_zh: 雇佣兵人生短暂而又多舛，如果穿的戴的也朴素一辈子，那就太悲凉了。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: The longer mercenaries stay alive, the better they're paid - and the better they're paid, the longer they stay alive...
desc_zh: 雇佣兵活的时间越长，能拿到的赏钱就越多。能拿到的赏钱越多，那他们活的时间就越长……

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 铠甲

desc_en: As mercenaries like to jest, the longer the sword, the shorter the opposition.
desc_zh: 雇佣兵经常开玩笑说：“剑越长，敌人越矮。”

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: Among the Magistrate mercenaries, polehammers are almost as widespread as halberds.
desc_zh: 城联雇佣兵对于长柄锤的青睐，基本不亚于他们对戟的热爱。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: Not all free companies are sent to the front - some are contracted to protect supply convoys and undertake other auxiliary duties.
desc_zh: 并不是所有佣兵团都会派往前线，有些受雇是负责护卫辎重，或者承担后勤之类的辅助任务。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: About a third of someone' contract reward went toward the paints and hiring an artist. Well, we only live once.
desc_zh: 某个人领契据攒下来的赏金，估计三分之一都花在了漆料和请漆匠上。嗐，谁叫人只能活一回呢？

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 盾牌

desc_en: A heavy warhammer is one of the few weapons that can give an infantryman a fighting chance against a dismounted knight.
desc_zh: 有些时候，只有手持重型战锤的步兵，才能抵御落马骑士的进攻。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Every self-respecting merchant has a similar dagger. It can add more weight to your words when dealing with disgruntled clients - unless they come in numbers.
desc_zh: 但凡是个正经的生意人，身上都会带这么一把匕首。客人难缠的时候，这个特别好用。如果对方人多势众，那就另当别论了……

stats.type_text: 普通 匕首

desc_en: A well-to-do city merchant can be easily recognized by their attire. Such flashiness worked a bit too well in Maen - anyone dressed in a fancy garb was among the first to face the gallows.
desc_zh: 城里生活优渥的生意人看穿着就能认出来。不过曼恩的生意人不是这样，因为衣装华丽的早都被绞死了。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Might be wise to send that message sooner rather than later: pigeons don't fare well in such conditions.
desc_zh: 信鸽该放出去就放出去，这样闷着，过不了多久就会闷死。

extra.en: Can be released to send a message to Verren, allowing to move the Caravan to a selected location.
extra.zh: 放飞可以给维伦送信，让他把车队带到所选位置。

desc_en: Every now and then, the clergy and nobility consider outlawing this weapon - with a billhook in hand even a greenhorn can stand his ground against the heavy cavalry.
desc_zh: 教会和贵族有时候会呼吁全面禁用这种兵器——就算是什么都不会的新兵蛋子，有了长柄柴刀，也应付得了重装骑兵。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: Peasants call these clubs "snails" - the curled head adds weight to every blow.
desc_zh: 农民管这种棍子叫“蜗牛棍”，因为棍头卷了进去，打人更有分量。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Will slice through a brigand's gambeson or a beast's hide - and for the militia, it's all that's needed.
desc_zh: 能划开土匪的夹棉软甲，也能划开野物的皮，对民兵来说，这样就足够了。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: Village militias are called upon only as a last resort. And when the going gets dire, even a farming tool can become a weapon.
desc_zh: 只有到了迫不得已的时候，村庄才会召集民兵。什么东西到了他们手里，都能变成兵器。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Gather a group of peasants, provide them with a handful of longaxes and a clever sergeant, and even a better-equipped opponent might find itself stumped on how to deal with the resulting force.
desc_zh: 找几个农民，发几把长斧头，再安排个队长，对手就算装备好，见了也得直挠头。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: Add a bunch of cheaply-made spikes, and suddenly a simple mace becomes far more deadly and menacing.
desc_zh: 普普通通的钉头锤，加了几个廉价的尖，立马就比原来看着吓人多了，杀伤力也大了很多。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: A home-made axe on a long pole - this weapon sees frequent use in the hands of the Gray Army.
desc_zh: 自制的兵器——木棍头上绑了一把斧子，灰色军团经常用这种东西。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: Looks like it used to be a common hammer until some smith reinforced it with additional metal and put it on a longer shaft.
desc_zh: 看样子本来只是普通的锤子，后来不知道哪个工匠给它加了块铁，又接了一根长杆。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: When defending one's home, no weapon is too humble.
desc_zh: 保卫家园的时候，再简单的兵器也派得上用场。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: It doesn't take much time to learn how to use a spear efficiently. For this very reason, it became almost synonymous with peasant militias.
desc_zh: 长矛学起来不难，费不了多少工夫，民兵都喜欢用这个兵器。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: Peasants are seldom accustomed to close combat, so outfitting them with slings is a sound strategy - though usually overlooked by noble lords.
desc_zh: 农民很少有人能习惯近身战斗，用投石杖是个合理的办法，可惜他们的领主很少会想到这一点。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: Among the peasantry, millers are considered nobility of a sort. In terms of affluence, some can even rival merchants.
desc_zh: 在乡下人眼里，磨坊主就已经算得上贵族了。论家产，有些商人都比不过他们。

desc_en: Helps you get ~lg~sober~/~ faster.##Reduces the duration of ~lg~Bad Trip~/~ by ~lg~5-10~/~ turns.
desc_zh: 可以帮你更快恢复~lg~清醒~/~。##~lg~心神不宁~/~效果的存续时间缩短~lg~5-10~/~回合。

extra.en: Mindwort is a potent sedative, helpful in the recovery from major shocks.
extra.zh: 金丝桃镇定效果很好，可以帮助严重休克的病人恢复。

desc_en: A bold response to lackluster rations and persistent rockeater infestations - this is also the only known recipe for rendering the creatures' flesh safe for consumption.
desc_zh: 井下口粮紧张，又常年食岩虫肆虐，才出现了这种极端的做法，而且食岩虫的肉也只有这样做，才能安心食用。

desc_en: A bold response to lackluster rations and persistent rockeater infestations - this is also the only known recipe for rendering the creatures' flesh safe for consumption.
desc_zh: 井下口粮紧张，又常年食岩虫肆虐，才出现了这种极端的做法，而且食岩虫的肉也只有这样做，才能安心食用。

desc_en: The idea of strapping a round metal chestplate to a gambeson has its roots in Nistra, but the benefits it provides quickly became apparent to Aldorian armorsmiths as well.
desc_zh: 软铠前面绑一块金属的护心板，最早只有尼斯特拉人这么干，只是奥尔多的甲匠后来很快也意识到了这个办法的好处。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Knightly etiquette dictates that a mercy blow to an incapacitated opponent can only be delivered with this dagger.
desc_zh: 骑士做事有骑士的做法，对手无力还击之后，骑士要想结果他们，只能用这种匕首。

stats.type_text: 普通 匕首

desc_en: Eating this doesn't seem like a good idea.
desc_zh: 都这样了，别吃了。

desc_en: Such notes are kept by the abbots of many Aldorian monasteries, written in Axonian in accordance with old church traditions.
desc_zh: 奥尔多许多修院的院志均由院长保管，并且依照教会从前的传统，以亚克逊文记述。

extra.en: This item can be of use to someone...
extra.zh: 这个东西有人用得着……

desc_en: Aldorian monks' staves are blessed by the Host themself to help the faithful endure the hardships of daily toil and distant travels.
desc_zh: 奥尔多修士的长杖据说得到了圣主的加持，可以帮助信徒忍受每日的辛苦和长途跋涉的奔波。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: Can be delivered to the contract giver for an additional ~y~reward~/~.
desc_zh: 交给派发契据的人，可以获得额外的~y~报酬~/~。

extra.en: Huge and pointed - just like in old vampire tales.
extra.zh: 大而尖，俨然如以前吸血鬼故事描述的一般。

desc_en: It shimmers like a glint of moonlight.
desc_zh: 闪光仿佛月亮的点点辉光。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: A trophy quick to find a buyer, be it an apothecary or just some townsman looking for something to mount above his fireplace.
desc_zh: 驼鹿的角在炼金和制药领域应用广泛，药剂师一般都愿意收购。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Useful for creating powerful remedies as well as delightful stews.
desc_zh: 可以调配功效强大的药剂，也可以做出可口的炖菜。

desc_en: Useful for creating powerful remedies as well as delightful stews.
desc_zh: 可以调配功效强大的药剂，也可以做出可口的炖菜。

desc_en: Killing enemies grants ~lg~+/*Hand_Efficiency*/%~/~ Hands Efficiency and ~lg~/*Ability_Cost*/%~/~ Abilities Energy Cost for ~w~3~/~ turns, and also reduces the cooldowns of this ability tree and all ~w~Attack~/~ skills by ~lg~2~/~ turns.##The effect stacks up to ~w~2~/~ times.##The bonuses to Hands Efficiency and Abilities Energy Cost depend on the number of learned ~w~Weaponry~/~ abilities.
desc_zh: 击杀敌人会令~w~3~/~个回合之内主、副手效果~lg~+/*Hand_Efficiency*/%~/~、能力精力消耗~lg~/*Ability_Cost*/%~/~，还会令同一能力树技能与所有~w~攻击~/~技能的剩余冷却时间缩短~lg~2~/~个回合。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~2~/~层。##主、副手效果和能力精力消耗的加成大小取决于习得了几项~w~兵器~/~能力。

desc_en: A peculiarly shaped mushroom with a distinctive sponge-like cap.
desc_zh: 这种菇伞盖凹凸多孔，外观特别，容易辨认。

desc_en: A peculiarly shaped mushroom with a distinctive sponge-like cap.
desc_zh: 这种菇伞盖凹凸多孔，外观特别，容易辨认。

desc_zh: 这种菇伞盖凹凸多孔，外观特别，容易辨认。

desc_zh: 这种菇伞盖凹凸多孔，外观特别，容易辨认。

desc_en: A hit or two, and this morgenstern will be the last star your enemy will ever see.
desc_zh: 只需要一锤，最多两锤，你的敌人就看不到第二天早上的星星了。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: The ominous appearance of morions makes them the favorite stone of warlocks and everyone who delves into the occult and other things otherworldly.
desc_zh: 烟晶观感阴森，容易令人产生不祥之感，因此备受术士青睐。除此之外，热衷玄奥离奇之事的人也喜欢这种石头。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Gold, silver, morion... Looks like someone wanted to have a piece of jewelry for every occasion.
desc_zh: 金配银，再配烟晶……看样子有人是想有枚百搭的戒指，不论什么场合都可以戴着见人。

desc_en: Would be much more preferable if it was filled to the brim with foamy ale...
desc_zh: 要是倒上冒着泡沫的麦芽啤酒，就再好不过了！

desc_en: Would be much more preferable if it was filled to the brim with foamy ale...
desc_zh: 要是倒上冒着泡沫的麦芽啤酒，就再好不过了！

desc_en: A single mushroom salad is unlikely to sate your hunger, but at least the taste is sublime.
desc_zh: 只靠一份蘑菇沙拉肯定饱不了肚子，不过起码这个味道是妙极了。

desc_en: A serving of robust mushroom soup. Smells like the forest.
desc_zh: 蘑菇汤香喷喷，闻着有树林的气味。

desc_en: The shell is shut tight: the mollusk inside is still alive.
desc_zh: 贝壳闭得很紧，这一只还没死。

desc_en: The shell is shut tight: the mollusk inside is still alive.
desc_zh: 贝壳闭得很紧，这一只还没死。

desc_zh: 贝壳闭得很紧，这一只还没死。

desc_en: Mussel chowder can be found on the tables of both the poor and the rich. The only difference is that the poor have to catch the mussels themselves.
desc_zh: 贻贝巧达这东西穷人富人家的餐桌上都能见到，只是穷人要想熬贻贝巧达，得自己去捞贻贝。

desc_en: Mussel chowder can be found on the tables of both the poor and the rich. The only difference is that the poor have to catch the mussels themselves.
desc_zh: 贻贝巧达这东西穷人富人家的餐桌上都能见到，只是穷人要想熬贻贝巧达，得自己去捞贻贝。

desc_en: Staring for too long into the mirror-polished buckle summons a creeping sensation of falling into the abyss.
desc_zh: 这根腰带的扣头磨得像镜子一样，你要是一直盯着它看，会产生坠入深渊的感觉。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: They're covered with peculiar symbols in accordance with an ancient, half-forgotten technique.
desc_zh: 这幅手套背面饰有繁复的符号，用了某种几乎已被世人遗忘的古老工艺。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 手套

desc_en: Can't do without nails these days.
desc_zh: 这年头离了钉子根本没法生活。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Can be delivered to the contract giver for an additional ~y~reward~/~.
desc_zh: 交给派发契据的人，可以获得额外的~y~报酬~/~。

extra.en: Any attempts to unfurl it are met with a dry, unpleasant creak.
extra.zh: 不论谁想把这个东西展开，它都会发出嘶哑的尖叫。

desc_en: The trade fleet of Brynn is small but well equipped - each sailor is required to always carry a hatchet in case of a pirate attack.
desc_zh: 布林的商船队规模不大，但船上的防卫措施全面——-所有海员人手一把这种斧子，可以抵御海盗的袭击。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: Necromancers aren't bereft of a sense of humor, albeit theirs comes with a morbid twist: most of them find joy in desecrating graves of the clergy, using harvested skulls as a decoration for their staves.
desc_zh: 死灵法师也懂幽默，只是与常人有所不同——据说他们许多人热衷亵渎祭司的坟墓，还会用死者的头骨装点自己的法杖。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 长杖

desc_en: Can be delivered to the contract giver for an additional ~y~reward~/~.
desc_zh: 交给派发契据的人，可以获得额外的~y~报酬~/~。

extra.en: Sometimes, the path to forbidden knowledge ends early and abruptly.
extra.zh: 通向禁忌知识的道路有时候会戛然终止。

desc_en: For all its prickly nature, nettle leaves and stems are used both as food and in medicine.
desc_zh: 荨麻尽管蜇人，但是茎叶都可以食用，也可以入药。

desc_zh: 产生以下效果，存续~y~1200~/~回合：##视野加成~lg~+10%~/~#经验收益~lg~+25%~/~#失手几率~lg~-10%~/~#饥饿抗性~lg~+75%~/~#疲劳抗性~lg~+50%~/~#情境神智变化~lg~+0.1%~/~##效果消失之后，会出现~r~戒断反应~/~。

extra.en: Another achievement of elven alchemy. Brynn students in particular are fond of its hunger-numbing and memory-boosting effects - a perfect combination for a night of cramming.
extra.zh: 尼卡夫是精灵族在炼金领域取得的又一项成就。布林的学生尤其喜欢这个东西——又能消除饥饿感，又能增强记忆，完全是考前刷夜的不二选择。

desc_en: It didn't take long for Fjall dwarves to adopt Skadian bardiches. And thanks to their mercenaring varangs, this weapon shape became known to Nistrians as well.
desc_zh: 弗约的矮人没过多久就接受了斯卡迪亚的月牙斧，而后又通过他们那些瓦郎戈佣兵，将这种兵器传入了尼斯特拉。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: The Zeineshes of Nistra are among the most skilled mounted archers on the entire Continent, rivaled only by the nomads of the Ohirian barrens and Jarimad.
desc_zh: 整个大陆，论骑射，只有奥息尔荒原和亚里迈德的游牧民能与尼斯特拉的切涅什人相提并论。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: A typical weapon of Zeinesh mountain brigands. During times of conflict, they descend to the flatlands, offering to fight for the highest bidder.
desc_zh: 切涅什的山匪惯用这种武器。战乱年代，他们会来到平原赚钱，谁价钱开得高，就给谁卖命。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Nistra is a fascinating land of many intertwined cultures. Nistrian nobles, who still stay true to the ancient traditions of Axonia, also eagerly embrace the customs of Pjesht highlanders - such as a preference for this style of cloak, for example.
desc_zh: 尼斯特拉这片土地魅力无穷，多种文化交织相融。尼斯特拉的贵族虽然依旧遵守亚克逊古老的传统，但也愿意接受高地民族普耶什特的民俗，例如披着这种款式的斗篷。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 斗篷

desc_en: Constant wars with Aldor left a deep mark on Nistrian warfare. Naturally, they've become quite successful at combating heavily armored troops.
desc_zh: 尼斯特拉与奥尔多战争不断，他们的作战理念因此也深深受到了奥尔多军队的影响。经过长期的演变与调整，他们已经成功找到了应对方法，可以对付敌军士兵广泛穿戴的板甲。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: Even to this day, Nistrian smiths continue producing certain types of antique weaponry, although they use steel instead of iron now.
desc_zh: 直至今日，尼斯特拉的铁匠还会锻造一些形制古老的兵器，不过材料已经从铁改成了钢。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: To the Great Despot it is a matter of prestige to be perceived as a successor to the great Axonian Empire and its rulers. This is why so many Nistrian armor and weaponsmiths continue to dutifully replicate centuries-old designs.
desc_zh: 大方主希望外界将尼斯特拉视为亚克逊帝国与帝国历代国王的继承者，他认为此事关乎国家威望。正是这个原因，尼斯特拉的兵甲工匠至今依然勤恳效仿古代匠人的工艺。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 盾牌

desc_en: Some nobles wouldn't mind bartering away one of their smaller, less prosperous fiefs in exchange for a similar chestpiece.
desc_zh: 有些贵族要是能弄到类似这样的盔甲，哪怕拿出一小块不太兴旺的封地来换都没有问题。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 铠甲

desc_en: No armor can resist a blow dealt with such a monstrously heavy axeblade.
desc_zh: 这把斧子头部奇重无比，一斧子劈下去，什么样的盔甲都抵挡不住。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: A fashionable Aldwynn style, marked by unmistakable Nistrian motifs, likely adopted from passing merchants.
desc_zh: 奥尔德文现在时兴这种款式，上面的纹样明显受了尼斯特拉的影响，有可能是借鉴了境内过往外邦商人的穿着。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: With the exception of Aldwynn weaponsmiths, there aren't that many craftsmen in Aldor who can produce a mace of similar quality.
desc_zh: 奥尔多能打出这种钉头锤的兵器匠，一般都住在奥尔德文……

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: As the centuries-old tradition of knightly ransom becomes a thing of the past, aristocratic weapons grow increasingly more deadly, aiming to kill the opponent right on the spot.
desc_zh: 俘虏敌方骑士的传统存续了几百年之久，只是如今已不复存在，贵族的兵器也因而日益凶狠，只求当场毙敌。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: Two-handed flails may have originated on tournament grounds, but it's a rare occurrence to see a noble lord using one as he goes to war.
desc_zh: 双手连枷最初可能是源自比武大会，只是很少见到贵族领主带着这种兵器作战。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: It could have easily belonged to either a small-time baron or a duke - basically the kind of person who doesn't skimp on expanding their arsenal.
desc_zh: 这把剑本来的主人很有可能是个小地方的男爵，不然就是个公爵，因为这种人扩充军库最舍得花钱。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: The red velvet fittings are here to remind everyone who the lord of the land is.
desc_zh: 这双脚甲之所以有红丝绒的修饰，目的是提醒大家谁才是这个地方的领主。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 靴子

desc_en: Horsemen of the Ohirian barrens usually prefer adargas over kalkans: a light leather shield is much more convenient when fighting from horseback.
desc_zh: 奥息尔荒原马背上的民族不爱穹顶圆盾，青睐阿达加盾。人在马上，轻巧的皮盾在战斗时用起来更加方便。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 盾牌

desc_en: Tying coins to a belt is an Ohirian custom, each of them commemorating an important event in the wearer's life: surviving a battle, becoming a parent, losing a loved one...
desc_zh: 奥息尔人有腰带上挂钱币的习俗，生活遇到一件重要的事情，就挂一枚作为纪念，比如战场大难不死、长子或者长女降生、痛失亲人……

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: The edge requires surprisingly little maintenance. If the rumors are true, the tribes of the Yellow Steppe achieve this by treating their swords with some special solution.
desc_zh: 这把马刀非常神奇，几乎不需要保养。黄色草原的游牧部落据说会用特殊的溶液浸泡兵器。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: A weapon frequently carried by the nomads of the Ohirian barrens - every tribesman is given one after surviving his first battle.
desc_zh: 奥息尔荒原的游牧民经常带着这种兵器。第一次上战场的，但凡能活着回来，都会获得这么一份礼物。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: For many, the first clash with Jarimad mounted archers is also the last: deadly on foot, they are even deadlier from the saddle.
desc_zh: 很多人只有机会跟亚里迈德的弓骑兵交手一次，这些射手马下就是索命的好手，上了马更是箭箭夺命。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: The Ohirian barrens offer nothing but sand and rocks, yet the tribes who dwell there make do with little else.
desc_zh: 奥息尔荒原除了砂石一无所有，然而这里的部族也生存了下来。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: The dwarves of the Norrheim clan have to deal with the most dangerous beasts the North can offer on a daily basis, so their warriors' garments are frequently imbued with protective enchantments.
desc_zh: 诺尔海姆部落的矮人天天都要和北方最凶猛的野兽打交道，所以这些战士的衣服常常附有防护魔法。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: If a piece of armor is decorated with wild animals' horns, furs, and bones, then it most likely belonged to a member of the Norrheim clan, where a person's merit is based exclusively on their hunting prowess.
desc_zh: 盔甲上面若是缀有兽皮、兽角或者兽骨，那么很多可能出自诺尔海姆的部族之手。对于他们而言，个体的地位完全取决于胆量与狩猎的能力。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: A traditional weapon of Fjall clans, first adopted by the guards protecting the Northern Borderlands and then - by the rest of the kingdom.
desc_zh: 这是弗约各个部族常用的传统兵器，先是传到了戍守北疆的卫兵手上，后来传到了王国各地。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: In the North, there still persists a barbaric tradition of decorating belts with various so-called "trophies".
desc_zh: 北方现在还有一种野蛮的传统，要给腰带挂上各种呃……“战利品”。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: Skirmishing, plundering, murdering - nothing is impossible with this blade!
desc_zh: 有了这把剑，打家劫舍，杀人越货，没有干不了的事情。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: They are waterproof, don't get stuck in mud, and are easy to clean from blood stains.
desc_zh: 这种鞋不会湿，不会沾泥，不会沾血。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: Dwarves don't hold much respect for bows. They are usually handed out to youngsters who aren't experienced enough to fight on the frontline.
desc_zh: 矮人觉得弓箭不是正经兵器，所以打仗的时候，只会发给前线没什么经验的年轻人。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: The dwarves of Fjall rarely use spears in combat, deeming them a hunting weapon, unworthy of the battlefield.
desc_zh: 弗约的矮人认为长杆刃器是猎具，拿不上战场的台面，战斗时很少使用。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: The path to becoming a mage invariably starts with pain and injuries. A few layers of tightly wrapped cloth can slightly reduce the price of initial failures.
desc_zh: 所有法师入门之初，都绕不开伤痛。虽然只是两条布带紧紧缠在手上，但施法失误的时候，也算聊胜于无了。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 手套

desc_en: Not particularly durable, but it serves its purpose well enough.
desc_zh: 撑不了太长时间，不过起码可以发挥盾牌的作用。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 盾牌

name_en: Occasionally you may find unidentified items with ~y~unknown~/~ properties.##To learn them, you will need to use an ~y~Identification Scroll~/~.
name_zh: 你有时会得到属性~y~不明~/~的未鉴定物品。##你要使用~y~鉴定卷轴~/~，才能了解物品的属性。

desc_en: Long ago, Brynn was a gathering spot for a secret cult of sanguimancers, coveting the secrets of vampirism. It's unknown whether they were successful with their experiments, but they surely met their demise as it befits vampires - with wooden stakes deep in their chests.
desc_zh: 很久以前，有个研习血魔法的地下教派经常在布林聚集，希望获得吸血的能力。尽管不知道这些人的实验最终成功没有，但他们的下场和吸血鬼相同——全都是胸口插进了木桩。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 斗篷

desc_en: Gnarled and crooked. Dark magic and old age are quite an unsightly mix.
desc_zh: 骨节突出，形状扭曲，黑暗魔法搭配衰老，结果令人难以直视。

extra.en: Can be delivered to the contract giver for an additional ~y~reward~/~.
extra.zh: 交给派发契据的人，可以获得额外的~y~报酬~/~。

desc_en: An otherwise incomprehensible Axonian text containing what is clearly a long list of names and birth dates.
desc_zh: 上面写的是亚克逊文，看不懂是什么意思，只能看出是一大串人名和出生日期。

extra.en: This item can be of use to someone...
extra.zh: 这个东西有人用得着……

desc_en: A ragged shirt littered with stitches, patches, and oily spots.
desc_zh: 破破烂烂，到处都是补丁、油污和缝补的线脚。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: A relatively affordable piece of plate armor, worn by landless knights, mercenaries, and everyone else who isn't rolling in gold at the moment.
desc_zh: 这种板甲盔价格相对低廉，没有封地的骑士、雇佣兵之类手头不宽裕的人，都可以选择穿它。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 铠甲

desc_en: Battered, antiquated, and possibly passed down from someone's great-grandfather.
desc_zh: 看这个破旧样子，有可能是谁的太爷爷传下来的。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 靴子

desc_en: Has layers and is more than it appears.
desc_zh: 一层又一层，没有看起来这么简单。

desc_en: Has layers and is more than it appears.
desc_zh: 一层又一层，没有看起来这么简单。

desc_en: Thanks to its domed shape, a bascinet can reliably redirect incoming strikes, preventing them from doing significant harm.
desc_zh: 这种头盔没有明显的棱角，往往可以避开正面冲击，从而免受巨大的伤害。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 头盔

desc_en: Some people spitefully suggest that, contrary to their name, sentinets weren't invented in Sentia but were brought there from the Bronze Isles. The truth is, no one knows for sure anymore.
desc_zh: 有些人说森提亚盔名不副实，根本就不是森提亚人发明的，而是青铜群岛的舶来品。其实现在谁也不知道到底源自哪里，这样说的那些人只是心怀歹意。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 头盔

desc_en: Thanks to these pridefully displayed amulets, one can easily spot an oracle on the streets of Hazzun.
desc_zh: 这种护身符形制招摇，在哈尊的街上很容易就能认出他们的先知。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 项链

desc_en: Lifting an axe this giant is a strenuous task on its own, yet orcs somehow manage to fight with one of them in each hand.
desc_zh: 这把斧子要是掉在地上，一般人捡起来都费劲，奥克一只手就能舞得风生水起。

desc_en: Orc zealots are capable of cleaving a grown man in two with a single swing of their battlesickles.
desc_zh: 奥克的狂热分子如果手上有这么一把战镰，一刀就能把一个成年人砍成两段。

desc_en: A trophy sword reforged beyond recognition - the dullness of orc blades tends to be offset by the sheer force behind each strike.
desc_zh: 这件战利品经过重铸，已经完全看不出原来的样式，尽管并非特别锋利，但在力大无比的奥克手中，每一刀依然可以见血见肉。

desc_en: Even though such cleavers can inflict grievous wounds, they are too heavy and unwieldy for human hands.
desc_zh: 这种大刀常常可以造成重伤，不过因为刀身太重，并不适合人类使用。

desc_en: A favorite weapon of orc warriors. They use these scimitars for everything, be it training, fighting, or executing their prisoners.
desc_zh: 奥克战士最喜欢用这种弯刀，用它训练，带它上战场，用它处决俘虏。

desc_en: A staff used by orc shamans to perform their blood rituals.
desc_zh: 奥克萨满会在血祭的时候用这种法杖。

desc_en: It looks exactly as orcish weapons are supposed to: crude and intimidating.
desc_zh: 这根锤子一看就是奥克的兵器——粗陋而又令人生畏。

desc_en: Back in the day, these flails were a symbol of the exceptional strength and impeccable training demonstrated by the marshals of the Triune Hand Order.
desc_zh: 这种连枷当年象征了三手会元帅惊人的气力以及无与伦比的武艺。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 双手锤棒

desc_en: The gilded acanthus ornaments are a staple of Hazzun jewelry. This technique was invented in ancient times and has seen very little change after being rediscovered by modern craftsmen.
desc_zh: 哈尊的首饰经常有镀金的茛苕纹样。这种工艺发明于古代，现代工匠采用之后，就基本没怎么变过。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 手套

desc_en: Exquisite carvings, smooth curves... Everything about this crossbow betrays its elven origins.
desc_zh: 雕纹精细，线条平滑……这把弩一眼就能看出来是精灵族的产物。

desc_en: Jarimad nomads fight on foot only when there's no other option, but when they do, they rely on these axes - the design proved its usefulness through many battles against the heavy maaf infantry.
desc_zh: 亚里迈德的游牧民族认为徒步战斗是下下之策，他们只有被逼无奈之时才会抽出类似的长斧、下马作战。他们曾与玛弗的重装步多次交手，这种兵器发挥了巨大的作用。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: Elven quivers are distinguished by their high capacity and a special shape adapted for mounted archery.
desc_zh: 精灵族的箭筒容量很大，而且形状特别，专为骑射设计。

extra.en: Can be used to store arrows.##Fits ~lg~4~/~ stacks.
extra.zh: 可以收纳弓箭。##能装~lg~4~/~把弓箭。

desc_en: Elven shields are reliable and don't weigh the arm down. The alloy they are made of is exotic to Aldor.
desc_zh: 精灵盾牌结实耐用，而且佩戴轻松。这些盾牌用的据说是奥尔多采不到的某种合金。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 盾牌

desc_en: At the end of the day, few things can beat fine elven craftsmanship: it clearly took a lot of skill to create a staff this magnificent.
desc_zh: 无论抬杠的人怎么说，精灵族制作精细的东西确实有一手。这根法杖雕饰华美，显然出自大师之手。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 长杖

desc_en: Forged in the fabled land of Shanguo, this shield had traveled for thousands of miles before finding its way to Aldor - it's nigh impossible to imagine the circumstances of its journey.
desc_zh: 这块盾牌产自神秘的单国，万里飘摇流入了奥尔多，几乎无法想象这块盾牌途中经历过怎样的事情。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 盾牌

desc_en: The eagle carved into this agraffe's gilded surface is regarded in Aldor as an embodiment of freedom and chivalry.
desc_zh: 夹扣表面镀金，刻了一只雕，这种动物在奥尔多象征自由和高尚。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: A generously gilded helmet you'd be expected to wear while leading parades in celebration of ceaseless victories.
desc_zh: 这顶头盔镀金花了不少本钱，盔主应该是方队领队，每逢军队捷报频传、举行庆功大典的时候配戴。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 中 头盔

desc_en: A prize from the Aldwynn Tournament of 407, claimed by Sir Tibalt der Wald, who impressed the King himself by hitting five moving targets squarely in the center in just one minute.
desc_zh: 这是奥尔德文407年比武大会的奖品。提巴尔特·德·瓦尔杜爵士一分钟之内连中五个移动靶心，令国王大为赞赏。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: Local noblemen have an ancient tradition of exchanging daggers. As a rule, it's done by plunging them into each other's back.
desc_zh: 本地贵族交换匕首有个古老的传统，也就是必须从对方背后插进去。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 匕首

desc_en: A wandering horseman is a common Hieronite symbol of the posthumous Path toward the Host.
desc_zh: 圣会经常用“徐行的骑马人”象征生后前往圣主之所在的路。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: It's clear as day that the master smith, who meticulously crafted this weapon, put his heart and soul into it. The lord ordering it must have had money to spare.
desc_zh: 锻造这把钉头锤的肯定是能工巧匠，而且花了不少心血，订制这把兵器的领主显然也是有不少闲钱。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手锤棒

desc_en: At some point, it likely belonged to a Sentian patrician with a keen interest in the weapon traditions of the Bronze Isles.
desc_zh: 这件兵器当年有可能属于森提亚的某个贵族，此人显然对青铜群岛的武器工艺颇有钻研。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 长杆刃器

desc_en: Pairs well with any mantle, making it perfect for mages who care about fashion.
desc_zh: 可以搭配所有法袍，法师如果热衷时尚，这个绝对是不二之选。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: Formerly owned by some tax collector - who else would have the means for such extravagance?
desc_zh: 本来属于收税官，还有什么人用得起这么奢侈的东西？

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: The blade is inscribed with words of dedication to one Idrich Jorg of Aldwynn.
desc_zh: 剑身刻了一行字，说是献给奥尔德文的某个伊德里赫·约格。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 双手刀剑

desc_en: Gazing at one's own reflection for hours at a time is a common Hieronite practice. A diligent enough monk can use it to push past the limits of their consciousness, thus drawing nearer to the Truth.
desc_zh: 圣会修行常常需要对镜凝望数小时，僧侣若是勤于修行，就有机会借此超脱自我，接近至理。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: A customary weapon of the Royal Armorbreakers - a renowned guard unit currently employed in the service of the Council.
desc_zh: 这是破甲御卫的常配兵器，这个卫队声名赫赫，目前为王廷军效力。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 双手锤棒

desc_en: The gilded guard is decorated with intricate eastern ornaments - this weapon is a true work of art.
desc_zh: 护手盘镀金，还有精致繁复的东方装饰，真是一件艺术品。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手刀剑

desc_en: A sallet painted in black with a line of prayer meticulously inscribed on its rim - supposedly, it should provide additional protection against stray arrows and sudden strikes.
desc_zh: 这顶轻盔通体黑色，盔沿密密麻麻写了一圈祷文——这串文字据说可以保护盔主，不受流箭和意外攻击伤害。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 头盔

desc_en: To the nobility, the sling is more a plaything than a true weapon, fit only for occasional displays of skill at a tournament.
desc_zh: 对于贵族而言，投石索更像玩具，而非真正的兵器，只适合比武大会上炫耀武艺。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: The stamp of the Guild makes it safe to assume that this voulge was intended for some high-ranking Magistrate commander.
desc_zh: 这根弗日上面有公会的标记，想必原本肯定是给城市联盟某位高级军官造的。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 双手斧

desc_en: The sentiment that maces are a weapon of the peasantry is long obsolete. Adorned with gold and horsehair, this warhammer demonstrates it better than anything.
desc_zh: 早就没有人以为钉头锤是农民用的兵器了，这把镀金马鬃战锤就是最好的例证。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手锤棒

desc_en: A lone hunter and the monarch of the nightly canopy.
desc_zh: 喜好孤身狩猎，是夜间树冠之上的女王。

extra.zh: 羽毛可以拔掉。
猫头鹰

desc_en: A lone hunter and the monarch of the nightly canopy.
desc_zh: 喜好孤身狩猎，是夜间树冠之上的女王。

extra.zh: 羽毛可以拔掉。
猫头鹰

desc_en: When properly sharpened, the broad edges of the "ox tongue" spearhead bite into flesh, leaving gruesome, slow-to-heal wounds.
desc_zh: 这种兵器矛头宽扁，形似牛舌，磨砺之后，可以轻松刺入皮下，造成骇人的创口，需要很长时间才能愈合。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: It'll make you sweat like a pig, but safety is above all.
desc_zh: 戴上这种头套，满头大汗是很正常的事情，不过总比丢了命好。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: It's suitable for a night out, a duel, or both at the same time. You'll look appropriate either way.
desc_zh: 晚上出门可以穿，对决的时候可以穿，晚上出门对决的时候也可以穿，怎么穿都不会错。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: An attire that would be the main source of pride for any show-off from the slums.
desc_zh: 对于贫民窟里爱显摆的人来说，这是最拿得出手的一身。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: This sinister amulet is older than a century or two.
desc_zh: 这个吊坠阴森狰狞，至少有一两百年的历史了。

desc_en: When thrown, deals ~g~6 Poison Damage~/~ and with ~sy~120%~/~ chance ~r~Confuses~/~ or ~sy~Staggers~/~ the target.##Сreates a ~g~spore cloud~/~ with similar effects on the target's tile, which persists for ~y~4-6~/~ turns.
desc_zh: 投掷出去可以造成~g~6点中毒伤害~/~，还有~sy~120%~/~的几率令目标~r~混乱~/~或~sy~失衡~/~。##会在目标所在方格产生一团~g~孢子尘雾~/~，存续~y~4-6~/~个回合，产生类似的效果。

extra.en: The pale puffball is highly toxic - some accounts tell of a hired assassin fulfilling a contract by generously dispersing its spores throughout the victim's bedroom.
extra.zh: 白马勃有剧毒，据某案卷记载，此前有杀手在目标卧室播撒白马勃孢子，以此手法取人性命。

desc_en: Seventh of Hoarfrost##I walk amid the ruins of a nameless city. The earth is scored with fissures - I have to find my way around them again and again. They are glutted with bones, mingled with living flesh: it quakes and breathes. On the horizon stands a colossal tower. It climbs so high that its crown is lost in the clouds. I am heading toward it. I do not know why, but I must ascend it, to the very top.###Twelfth of Ice##Several robed figures whirl in a dance. I try to count them, but in vain: they spin so swiftly they blur into one. At last they stop, and I see their robes are dark with blood, soaked deep into the cloth. I wake.###Third of Streams##An old cathedral on the seashore. Far off, a flare of lightning - the storm is closing in. The wind is so strong I must brace against it with all my might, just to keep standing. The gusts grow more savage: the cathedral's stained-glass windows begin to shatter. I cower from the shards raining down from every side. The ringing of glass swells and swells, until at last it becomes so deafening that I jolt awake.###Twenty-Sixth of Bloom##A cowled figure leads me through dark halls. From it pours a radiance so bright I dare not lift my eyes, for fear of being blinded. We stop before a stone door. I know where we are... the Theosopher's Refuge!##The figure extends a hand and points to the door.#"The tablet," it proclaims, and the hollow echo takes up its thunderous voice.#"The tablet, the tablet, the tablet..." answer the moss-grown walls.##It is there - the answer to all my yearnings. At last I know what must be done.
desc_zh: 霜月初七##我走在无名之城的废墟，地上裂缝纵横，我不得不一次又一次绕开。裂隙之中白骨森森，其间有鲜红的活肉搏动、呼吸。远处立着一座大楼，楼顶摩云，高不可攀。我朝着它走去，冥冥之中，我隐约感觉自己必须爬上那楼，登上楼顶。##冰月十二##几个穿了袍子的人正飞快地旋转起舞。我想数清他们有几人，可他们转得实在太快，身影化成了一团。他们最后停了下来，我才看到一身身长袍被血浸成了暗红。我突然醒了过来。##溪月初三##海边有一座古老的座堂。远处电闪雷鸣，风暴压了过来。狂风呼啸，我尽了全力，才勉强站住，不至于被吹倒。风势越来越猛，座堂的花窗一扇接一扇地碎了。我猫着身体，躲避四处落下的玻璃。碎裂的声音越来越大，最后震耳欲聋，把我惊醒。##华月廿六##有个戴了兜帽的身影引我穿过昏暗的厅堂，浑身发着耀眼的光，晃得我不敢抬头，恐怕双眼刺伤。我们停在了一扇石门前。我知道这是什么地方……是通神修士寝地！##那个身影伸出手，指了指石门。#“石板。”那声音恢弘如雷，激起阵阵回响。“石板……石板……石板……”青苔斑驳的石墙一遍又一遍回应。##我苦苦追寻的答案终于找到了，终于知道该怎么办了。
