desc_en: Dear friend!##We may not know each other, but considering that you opened this tome, I'll take a wild guess and assume that you're intent on learning the ancient art of pyromancy... The art I've been mastering my entire life.##I'd rather not disclose my name. All you need to know is that I hold a high position among fire mages, and the only thing forcing me to play cloak and dagger is that our Circle is very particular about whom it shares the knowledge with.##Yet despite all the restrictions set upon me, I always yearned to not only bear power over the flame but, akin to the gods of the old, to enlighten the world - so hearken to me, as there is no one else who will share this knowledge with you...###( . . . )##As you may now realize, there is nothing complicated about visualizing the flames and then summoning them into existence with the sheer force of your mind, despite what my arrogant brethren may claim. When the time comes, they'll pay for all the injustices they've subjected me to, for dragging my good name through the mud.##Keep practicing, never stop learning, stay spirited, and remember - fire always attracts fire...
desc_zh: 朋友：##我们或许互不相识，只是你既然翻开了这本大部头，想必也是有意学习古老的炎系咒法……这门咒法我也是毕生修习才算学成。##本人是身居高位的炎术法师，无奈法会不准轻易将法识外传，名字不提也罢。只消记住，我不是无名之辈。##虽有禁令，但我还是希望仿效古代众神，启示世界。听好了，除我之外，估计再没有其他人会告诉你这些东西……##（ . . . ）##尽管我的同门扬言炎系咒法并非常人可学，但是如你所见，只需意念就完全可以唤出火焰。诸位同门如今对我冷眼旁观，大加污蔑，假以时日，他们一定会为此付出代价。##千万勤加修习，毕竟学海无涯，还要记住一件事情——火火相生……

desc_en: ...Either way, that's enough of me listing my accomplishments. If you're holding this treatise, then you are most likely a man of science as well, already closely familiar with my research. Let's not waste any time.##( . . . )##...The aforementioned experiments demonstrate that almost all matter in existence contains a certain amount of intangible, volatile substance called phlogiston. And when matter is exposed to fire, it provokes a complex alchemical reaction that results in the release of phlogiston, which further fuels the flames. For instance, wood is nothing but a mix of ashes and phlogiston, metal is a combination of phlogiston and calx, and stone doesn't contain any phlogiston at all, preventing it from burning. Living creatures consist of blood and phlogiston, the latter is actually present in large quantities - that's why fire is so harmful to both men and beast. But there is a silver lining: if we weren't imbued with phlogiston, it would probably be impossible for us to perform pyromancy.##( . . . )##...As for practical applications, they're aplenty. After countless experiments, I've discovered a way of using the released phlogiston to empower magic flames. In fact, my discovery was so spectacular that my hapless neighbors ended up calling the city guard on me, claiming that I was trying to burn the city to the ground. But in all fairness, what else can you expect from illiterate simpletons?##( . . . )##All the formulas are listed below along with step by step instructions. Still, I implore you, if you decide to repeat my experiments, then by the Host, exercise extreme caution!..
desc_zh: ……我的成就列举这么多应该就够了。你既然翻开了这么书，说明应该也相信科学，而且已经非常熟悉我的研究，我们就直奔主题吧。##（ . . . ）##……前述实验表明，世间所有物质内部均大量存在“燃素”这一属性活泼的无形元素。物质遇火会诱发某种复杂的炼金反应，进而导致燃素释出，从而产生火焰。木材就是由木灰和燃素组成，金属是燃素与石灰的混合物，石头则不含燃素。活体生物由血液和燃素构成，而且燃素含量很大，所以火能对所有生物造成极大的伤害。不过，倘若生物没有这一特质，我们也就不可能施展炎系咒法了。##（ . . . ）##……至于实际的应用意义，我发现可以利用释放出来的燃素催生魔法火焰。这项发现极为成功，我那些愚昧的邻居竟然叫来了城里的守卫，说怀疑我准备烧了整座城市。他们有这种想法我也能理解，毕竟都是没文化的草包。##（ . . . ）##我把所有相关的配方和各个步骤的指导都列在下面了。不过，如果真的想尝试我的实验，千万要格外小心……

extra.en: "The Mystery of Fire Essence, Also Known as Phlogiston to Pundits"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Pyromancy abilities:~/~##~lg~Melting Ray~/~#~lg~Incineration~/~#~y~From Blaze to Furnace~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.

extra.en: This tome is filled to the brim with complex alchemy formulas. An educated pyromancer can learn a great deal from it.
extra.zh: 这本巨著写满了复杂的炼金公式，炎系法术或许需要修炼到一定的程度，才能从这本书里学到很多东西。
作者：曼恩人涅尔曼

desc_en: ...They surrounded me, and, for a brief moment, I feared that I was to share the fate of the poor sod whose charred remains we had stumbled upon at the crossroad. However, they seemed friendly enough, even if the sight of their eerie masks unnerved me greatly.##( . . . )##Once we were done with our dinner, the priest - I could only assume he was a priest - gestured for us to leave the tent. Weighed down by the heavy meal, we reluctantly followed him outside. To our astonishment, we were met by the sight of a huge crowd, even though just a couple hours ago there were hardly more than a few dozen elves in the entire camp. The pitch-black darkness of the night was no match to the blinding light of hundreds of flames. The moon, as if terrified of the competition, hid behind the sudden clouds. The priest marched onwards, confidently pushing people aside and creating a path for us to follow...##( . . . )##The song came to a halt, leaving us in thick, oppressive silence. For a few minutes we just stood there, exchanging confused looks, when suddenly, huge gouts of fire erupted out of thin air and engulfed the people sitting in the middle of the circle. The crowd roared, then burst into wild dance, utterly enraptured. The burning dervishes remained in their place as if nothing had happened - I believe I even spotted a faint smile on one of their faces. Terrified, we attempted to flee, vainly trying to get through the rows of spinning nomads as they drew closer and closer...
desc_zh: ……他们把我团团围住，我一开始吓得要死，心想完了，也跟十字路口的那个小子一样，要被他们烧成焦炭了。可他们看着好像没什么恶意，只是戴的那些古怪的面具还是让我特别紧张。##（ . . . ）##我们吃完东西，那个祭司——不知道他是什么身份，感觉像是个祭司——招了招手，示意我们出去。我们带着一肚子食物，不情愿地走出帐篷，结果竟然看到外面有一大群精灵族——几个小时之前，整个营地精灵族也才几十个。成千上百簇火焰一片通明，驱散了夜晚的黑暗，月亮似乎也甘拜下风，突然拉来几片云躲了起来。祭司不由分说，大步向前，在人群里给我们推出了一条路……##（ . . . ）##歌声戛然而止，空气静得让人难以呼吸。我们面面相觑，就那么惶恐地站了好几分钟。突然之间，巨大的火车凭空窜出，吞噬了圆圈中央坐着的人。人群先是欢呼，而后开始恣肆地手舞足蹈。圆圈中央的苦行修士噼啪作响，可是他们一动不动，我看到甚至看到有张脸上露出了笑容。我们大惊失色，四下逃窜，却被旋转舞蹈的游牧民渐渐围了起来，包围圈越来越小……

desc_en: Everyone is familiar with an old Aldorian saying: "as long as Aldor has at least a dozen longbows, no one will take our freedom". There's actually truth to it: history has many examples of formidable foes, whose steady, conquering stride was broken and eventually turned into a shameful retreat by Aldorian armies.##This was well-demonstrated during the latest Radiant War, when after a series of defeats our commanders lured the elven army into a trap and, even if just for a short while, occupied some of the enemy's border cities.##I find our nobility's disregard for bows inexcusable. Rather than encouraging peasants to continue improving their skill and teach archery to their children, many shortsighted lords mock the tradition, treating the bow as a pathetic weapon wielded by artless louts. Some even place a ban on it, trying to protect their hunting grounds. Doing so is a dire mistake. I suppose these esteemed lords need to be reminded that before the Miracle of the Silver Pass, their armies, which consisted mostly of cavalry, had been suffering one humiliating defeat after another from the elven troops. That is until Aldorian longbowmen joined the fray in earnest.##Therefore, every full-grown man who lives on my land and knows how to use a bow is relieved from paying the army tax. He and his priceless skill are already valuable on their own. If he has kids, I personally make sure that every boy older than seven is taught archery by his father, learning proper aiming techniques and how to shoot right on target. There's quite a few exercises that can help with grasping the basics...
desc_zh: 奥尔多有句老话，大家都知道，“只要奥尔多不缺长弓，任谁也夺不去我们的自由。”这句话并非空话，奥尔多历史上，多次强敌大举进犯，最后均被奥尔多军击退，落荒而逃。##奥尔多的部队保家卫国，战果最为显赫的莫过于光辉战争——奥尔多军各部将领屡次佯败后退，最终将精灵军引入圈套，并且短期占领了他们的部分边塞城市。##我实在无法理解奥尔多的贵族为何如此蔑视弓箭，非但不鼓励乡民精进弓法，不教自己的后代引弓搭箭，反而认为这种兵器是乡野村夫耍弄的玩意，真是令人扼腕。有的为了保护自己的猎场，甚至明令禁止领内习弓射箭，实乃因小失大。奥尔多各地军队原本均以骑兵为主，对阵精灵族，屡战屡败。白银关奇胜，奥尔多的长弓兵真正登上战场，局面才有了转机，各位尊贵的大人想必已将此事抛诸脑后。##有鉴于此，在下领内所有成年男子，但凡了解如何用弓，即可免于军税，毕竟此等男丁知晓弓法，已是可贵。家中如有七岁以上男童，我会确保有成年男子授其拉弓射箭之术。父亲传授基本知识之时，通常可以利用以下技巧和诀窍……

作者：尼达尔·德·佛特

desc_en: ...Any member of the Forest Watch should never forget that their one and only true advantage is the element of surprise. Knowing the terrain is half the battle, as it provides opportunities to catch the enemy off guard and engage in combat on your own terms. The first arrow is the most important one, especially if it hits the target.##When possible, avoid detection by constantly changing your position and shooting from the farthest possible distance - this tactic is bound to sow confusion and hesitation, granting you enough precious moments to adjust your aim and finish the job. Trust me, few things are more terrifying than a constant barrage of arrows coming seemingly out of nowhere in the middle of the woods...##Of course, it's just basic advice, and every situation comes with its own caveats. As you can imagine, brigands or poachers are much easier to lure into an ambush than orc scouts, and you'll definitely need a backup plan when dealing with dire beasts that occasionally emerge from the deep woods after years of slumber...
desc_zh: 护林卫所有人都应该明白，“出其不意，攻其不备”是他们唯一的优势。人在战场，熟悉地形方位比什么都重要。毕竟只有了解周边环境，才能抓住敌人的破绽，戳中其软肋。第一支箭往往最为重要，如果能够命中目标，对于战局的意义就更不言而喻了。##条件允许的时候，尽量不要长时间停在某个位置，而且射箭尽量与目标保持距离，越远越好。这种策略必然能令敌人迟疑、慌乱，为己方争取宝贵的时间瞄准、射箭。身处密林之间，什么都没有凭空飞来的箭雨令人胆寒……##当然，这只是一些基础的建议，实际情况自然各有各的差异。倘若对方是盗猎的人，自然要比奥克斥候更容易引入埋伏圈；如果面对的是沉眠多年、新近苏醒的怪物，那肯定需要预先设计好备选的行动方案……

extra.en: The relic forests of Aldor are teeming with dangers - the bands of militia patrolling the deepest, least explored areas are known as the Forest Watch. The part of the Watch that had been protecting His Majesty's personal hunting grounds was eventually reformed into the famous Royal Rangers.
extra.zh: 奥尔多的孑遗森林危机四伏，王国为了巡查这种树林最为人迹罕至的深处，成立了民兵组织“护林卫”，部分成员负责守护陛下的王家林苑，后来经过改制，便成了赫赫有名的王苑守卫。

desc_en: Not so white anymore.
desc_zh: 颜色完全变了。

desc_en: A wooden shield reinforced with a few strips of metal. A common armament of the Aldorian infantry.
desc_zh: 这种盾牌多了加固的金属部件，在奥尔多步兵队伍十分常见。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 盾牌

desc_en: A sword from King Etbert's personal armory. Clearly not his favorite, otherwise it would have followed the monarch into his tomb.
desc_zh: 这把剑原本属于埃特伯特国王，国王征战南北，统一奥尔多的时候，配的很有可能就是它。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手刀剑

desc_en: Whether due to age, infirmity, or fear, some of the realm's kings steered clear of the tournament grounds, leaving the task of upholding their honor to carefully chosen and trained knights - the royal champions
desc_zh: 奥尔多各代国王有些或是因为年迈，或是因为体弱，或是因为胆怯，不会亲自走进比武大会的场地，而是把维护王室荣耀的任务交给精心挑选、训练的骑士——也就是“御前斗士”。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 腰带

desc_en: A royal huntmaster is defined by three duties: the king should have plenty of game to pursue, he must never return from the hunt empty-handed, and he shall always remain safe and sound while doing so.
desc_zh: 出色的王家虞官必须满足三个条件：一、国王每次出猎必须有野物可追；二、国王每次决不能空手而归；三、虞官自己每次都能安然返回。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: The right to hunt in His Majesty's preserves was among the chief privileges of the Royal Rangers. Some even adorned their hats with writs bearing the highest permission.
desc_zh: 王苑守卫能在陛下的猎场打猎，这是他们的一大特权。有的守卫甚至会把国王的特许文书缝在自己的帽子上。

desc_en: The main task of the Royal Rangers was to patrol the hunting grounds of His Majesty. Their gambesons were sewn by the best craftsmen the realm had to offer.
desc_zh: 王苑守卫当年主要负责巡查陛下的林苑，他们的软铠均出自奥尔多手艺最好的匠人之手。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: This gem is worth a fortune, valued by enchanters for its unique magical properties.
desc_zh: 这种宝石价值连城，而且魔法属性特别，备受附魔师珍爱。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: The ability of rubies to withstand violent energies makes them particularly attractive to sorcerers who favor dangerous and unpredictable schools of magic, such as pyromancy.
desc_zh: 部分法师热衷修习炎系咒法之类难以捉摸的危险法系，红宝石刚好能够抵御猛烈魔能的冲击，因而备受此类人士所爱。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: Mage bracers are usually made of silver or gold and are encrusted with all kinds of gems - the resonance created by putting precious metals and stones together is capable of empowering magic spells.
desc_zh: 法师护臂用的金属一般不是金就是银，然后镶嵌各种宝石——贵重的金属与宝石放在一起会产生共振，从而增强咒法的效力。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 手套

desc_en: The ruby shines the prettiest under the direct sunlight.
desc_zh: 这颗红宝石在阳光直射下的光泽最好看。

stats.type_text: 普通 攻击型 项链

desc_en: A distinguishing accessory of a noble or wealthy elf.
desc_zh: 腰带的主人应该是某个贵族或者有钱的精灵。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: People of Fjall hold a belief that a properly crafted runic charm can bring success in any endeavor.
desc_zh: 弗约人认为不论做什么事情，只要戴一条做工可以的符文护符，就能顺顺利利。

stats.type_text: 普通 防御型 项链

desc_en: Shackles so rusty that you shouldn't have any trouble removing them with your bare hands.
desc_zh: 已经锈透了，摘下来应该不难。

desc_en: A sword that has seen better days. It looks like it's about to crumble to dust.
desc_zh: 这把剑过去可不是这样，现在好像马上就要碎成锈渣一样。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: There are two kinds of halberdiers: those who favor thrusting and those who favor slashing. But in case you want to do both, this is a weapon for you.
desc_zh: 用戟的一般是两类人，一类人喜欢突刺，一类人喜欢劈砍，适合不知道自己喜欢突刺还是劈砍的人。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: High-quality grain is treasured in times of war and famine.
desc_zh: 一袋上好的粮食，战乱年代闹饥荒的时候，比什么都金贵。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Healers grind saiga horns into powder to treat headaches and fever... The results leave much to be desired.
desc_zh: 治疗师给人治头疼、发热会用到高鼻羚羊角磨出来的粉……不过效果一般般。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Sallets aren't uncommon among Aldorian soldiers. An open version is comfortable to wear, compromising neither your vision nor the ability to take deep breaths.
desc_zh: 奥尔多的士兵喜欢轻盔，敞面轻盔戴着舒服，既不影响视线，也不妨碍大口喘气。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 头盔

desc_zh: 这个东西加了盐之后，部分功效可以保留很长时间，所以经常出现在北疆戍边士兵的口粮里。

desc_en: It is widely believed that consuming a gulon's liver can greatly extend one's lifespan.
desc_zh: 民间普遍认为谷隆肝延年益寿。

desc_en: For better or for worse, it's a thing that exists.
desc_zh: 随你喜欢不喜欢，就是有人会用盐腌这个东西。

desc_zh: 对于弗约的矮人而言，这个是美味。

desc_en: The deserts of Ahjat are harsh, fickle, and teeming with dangers. Fortunately, the Sand Guard, tasked with escorting caravans, knows exactly how to handle them - whether it's raiding nomadic bands or something even worse...
desc_zh: 艾哈雅特沙漠变幻莫测，危机四伏。幸而有沙野卫兵护送商队，应对沿途出没的游牧劫匪或者更骇人的威胁。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: Sapphires' receptiveness to magic has long drawn the attention of sorcerers. There's a whole heap of scholarly works on the subject gathering dust in the Academy archives.
desc_zh: 海蓝宝石容易受到魔法影响，法师对这类宝石的关注因而由来已久。相关的学术研究多如牛毛，学院的档案室堆了很多相关的文献，都积了厚厚的尘土。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_zh: 附近有魔力源的时候，这个东西就会发出轻轻的鸣响。

stats.type_text: 普通 法师型 项链

desc_en: Maaf military leaders - sardars - enjoy great power even when not actively leading the armies. In the years between wars, most of them hoard so much wealth that they become almost reluctant to return to the battlefield...
desc_zh: 玛弗军中的长官，也就是“萨达尔”，即便在战场之外也是掌握大权。多数萨达尔都会趁着和平时期大肆敛财，甚至因贪恋财宝而不愿重返战场……

stats.type_text: 独一无二 中 靴子

desc_en: A portion of well-salted minced meat stuffed into a thoroughly cleaned animal intestine.
desc_zh: 肉搅碎了，用盐腌好，往洗净的肠衣里一灌就成了。

desc_en: Scaled armor was at its peak during the latest war with Nistra, from where it was borrowed by Aldorian knights to begin with.
desc_zh: 鳞甲的最盛时期是奥尔多与尼斯特拉上一次开战之时，这种盔甲最初也是奥尔多骑士从尼斯特拉带来的舶来品。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 铠甲

desc_en: These were obviously inspired by the Nistrian military tradition - scaled armor is still a common sight around those parts.
desc_zh: 这种靴子明显是受了尼斯特拉军传统的启发，那边至今依然常见鳞甲这种防具。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 靴子

desc_en: This halberd's name comes from its vague resemblance to a scorpion's tail and the ability to deliver equally painful "stings".
desc_zh: 这杆钩镰名副其实——枪头与蝎螯有几分相似，而且能造成的伤痛丝毫不亚于蝎螯。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: Brought out when a scouting mission calls for a probing strike.
desc_zh: 侦察行动如果需要试探性进攻，这种兵器就可以拿出来了。

desc_en: The Sentians have always been known for their ability to add a touch of refinement to even the most simple and mundane items.
desc_zh: 再简单无奇的东西，交给森提亚人，都能变得不太一样。他们这种能力远近闻名。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: "As vexing as a Sentian slinger" - a saying dating back to the wars of Aldor's unification, still in use in the kingdom's western reaches.
desc_zh: “烦人得像森提亚的投石手”，这个说法源自奥尔多统一战争时期，至今仍在王国西部边境流传。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: It's a common practice for such polearms to be adorned with vibrant scraps of cloth, helping soldiers distinguish friend from foe as they head into the fray.
desc_zh: 这种长武器经常绑有颜色鲜艳的布条，以便混战之中辨认友方。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: This small, easy to carry hatchet comes into play when a sword just doesn't cut it anymore.
desc_zh: 这把斧子不是很大，易于挥舞，剑砍不动的时候，它就可以出场了。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: Sergeants and veteran mercenaries sport this type of armor while they're saving up for something more substantial.
desc_zh: 有些军官和久经沙场的雇佣兵为了攒钱置办一身好盔甲，就会先用这样的盔甲将就着。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 铠甲

desc_en: A well-made sword, forged from good steel and completely bereft of any trifling decorations.
desc_zh: 这把剑用的是上等好钢，工艺精湛，什么不必要的修饰都没有。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: Poleaxes started to gain popularity in Aldor not long before the war, as the need to combat the increasing use of heavy armor had been becoming more and more apparent.
desc_zh: 奥尔多开始流行这种兵器也不过是战前没多久的事情，因为当时穿重甲的人越来越多，对付这种防具需要枪斧。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: Not the most light or comfortable footwear, but, as the saying goes, victory trumps everything.
desc_zh: 不怎么轻便，穿着也不怎么舒服，不过有句话说得好，“胜利胜过一切”。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 靴子

desc_en: A weapon often used by sergeants of the Magistrate. Such blades aren't cheap but definitely worth it.
desc_zh: 这种剑一般是城市联盟的军官佩戴，造价不菲，但是物有所值。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: A set of shackles with a short chain. The bracelets dig viciously into the skin, hindering arm movements and making it difficult to even lift a spoon to one's mouth.
desc_zh: 镣铐中间有一截短链子，铐环很小，很容易磨破皮肤，非常妨碍手臂活动。戴着这个东西，连把勺子抬到嘴边都不容易。

extra.zh: 工具

desc_en: A peculiar pagan artifact: the ram skull can sense even the slightest presence of magic, responding to it with vibrations.
desc_zh: 这件多神教的长杖十分古怪，只要周围存在魔力，杖头的公羊头骨就会振动。

desc_en: Countless Nistrian commanders, standard-bearers, and mages were left forever in Aldorian soil during the Nistrian Wars. The archers responsible could expect little mercy in return.
desc_zh: 尼斯特拉无数的指挥官、旗手和法师葬身利箭之下，战死沙场，永远留在了奥尔多。因此，奥尔多的弓手一旦被俘，多数都不得善终。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: Decent iron, tanned leather - too bad the blade itself is missing.
desc_zh: 铁是好铁，皮子是好皮子，只可惜剑没了。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: The waters around the Bronze Isles are teeming with mollusks. Sea storms, which are frequent this time of year, often end up bringing them to the shores of Aldor as well.
desc_zh: 青铜群岛周围水域这种贝壳很多。每年到了这个时候，海上暴风暴雨频发，这种海贝就会漂到奥尔多海边。

extra.zh: 体内可能有珍珠。

desc_en: It's a well-known fact that the Brotherhood of Truth's Eternal Sun favors the pursuit of Knowledge over prayers and martial training. And yet, it doesn't affect the Brotherhood knights' combat readiness in the slightest: if anything, their study of the world's secrets fills them with incredible zeal on the battlefield.
desc_zh: 众所周知，相较祷告与习武，真理永恒之日兄弟会更为热衷求知。话虽如此，他们的骑士毫不畏惧战斗，随时可以上场作战。他们正是因为不懈研习世界的奥秘，才能够在战场上展现出非凡的激情。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 盾牌

desc_en: If there's something our commanders should learn from Nistrians, it's how to employ the shield wall tactics with the same efficacy. Our army mostly relies on heavy cavalry and archers. The Nistrian army, on the other hand, is built around heavy infantrymen equipped with tower shields. They are usually deployed in square formations, so that their shields protect not only the first row but also the archers standing behind them. This makes the Nistrian army almost impervious to a disorganized enemy - covered by shields and nearby comrades, their soldiers can safely deliver strikes without endangering themselves or worrying about getting flanked.##Fjall dwarves in particular can only bite their axe handles in frustration, powerless against these orderly lines, bristling with steel. And once you factor in the masterful support of their light cavalry and horse archers, which deliver lightning fast attacks at enemy flanks, it becomes abundantly clear why Nistrians rarely return home without a victory.##Aldorian commanders usually attempt to weaken Nistrians with sustained longbow volleys, then send in a cavalry wedge to break their formations. Unfortunately, this brash maneuver is very risky and often leads to large casualties or even defeat. That's why I suggest abandoning needless pride and actually learning from our sworn enemy's success...
desc_zh: 对于我们的将领而言，盾墙战术是尼斯特拉人最值得学习的地方，有助于我们了解如何部署盾墙才能达到同样的效果。奥尔多的军队主要依赖重装骑兵与弓兵，尼斯特拉军队的核心则是巨盾的重装步兵。这一兵种多为方队阵型，他们的盾牌因此可以保护站在首排的步兵以及第二排的弓兵。面对这样的军队，散兵游勇基本无计可施，而这些士兵可以从盾后安全发动攻击，且不会有性命之虞，也不用担心敌人包抄。##就算是弗约的矮人，遇到这般整齐的矛盾战线也只能气得直啃斧把。加之尼斯特拉的轻装骑兵和弓骑兵骁勇善战，能够针对敌军侧翼发动闪电奇袭，这种阵型可对敌军造成极大的伤害。鉴此，尼斯特拉军队如此行军作战，不胜反倒不合常理。##奥尔多的将领应对尼斯特拉人的这种阵型，常常先派弓兵持续远射，削弱对方阵线，而后派出骑兵冲突对方方队。这种战术虽然气势汹汹，但是风险很大，时常造成己方大量伤亡乃至败北。综上，我建议摒弃自大与傲慢，切实研究我们宿敌的制胜法宝……

extra.en: "Nistrian Warfare, its History, and its Distinction From the Warfare of Aldor"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Shield abilities:~/~##~lg~Raise Shield~/~#~lg~Breakthrough~/~#~y~Moment of Retribution~/~#~y~Embodiment of Resilience~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《尼斯特拉战争、战争史以及尼斯特拉与奥尔多战争辨异》##~gr~可以学习若干盾技：~/~##~lg~举盾~/~#~lg~突围~/~#~y~以牙还牙~/~#~y~顽抗~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。

extra.en: War always changes, and so do armies. Though one thing remains constant throughout centuries - a shield wall, something that Nistrians mastered better than anyone else.
extra.zh: 战争年年不同，军队也代代更迭，只有一样东西千百年来未曾改变——盾墙，各国军队要数尼斯特拉军最明白这个道理。
作者：延斯·达伦

desc_en: ...Alchemical powders and poisons, whether they are applied to a dagger or a concealed blade, are prohibited. Curses, enchantments, or any other magic are prohibited.##If a combatant prefers to use a shield or a buckler instead of a dagger, the following rules apply:##Spikes and blades are allowed.#Striking with a shield is allowed, be it with a shield's boss, edge, or flat.#Shield strikes are allowed to be delivered to any part of the body including the head and the neck. If a duel is conducted to the first blood, a wound caused by a shield strike doesn't stop the duel.#The first blood condition only applies to sword and dagger wounds, unless the shield strike itself renders the opponent incapacitated.#Bucklers larger than one and a half feet in diameter or shields wider than two feet are prohibited. A set of exclusive rules is applied to two-handed, full-sized dueling shields. Such shields can only be used in a duel with the consent of both combatants.#If a combatant manages to knock their opponent down with a shield bash, the opponent is allowed to get back on their feet and continue to fight. The duel concludes upon the second knockdown or if the opponent fails to recover after the first fall...
desc_zh: ……匕首和隐蔽的刃器不得涂抹或浸泡炼金粉剂和毒药，禁止使用诅咒、附魔或其他任意形式的魔法。##如果决斗之人不用匕首，而是选择盾牌或拳盾，那么他需要遵守以下规则：##盾上可以表面带刺或边缘开刃。#可以使用盾牌的中央突起、边缘或盾面击打对手。#盾牌可以击打头颈在内的任意身体部位。#“见血即终止”的规则仅适用于刀剑或匕首造成的创口，除非盾击令对手丧失行动能力，否则任何盾伤均不会导致决斗终止。#拳盾半径不得大于一又二分之一尺，其他盾牌宽不得超过两尺。与人等高的双持决斗盾牌规则与常规盾牌不同：1.需经决斗双方同意，方可使用；#2.如果一人被盾牌撞倒，可以站起继续战斗；3.如果对手首次击倒未能站起或被击倒两次，则决斗结束……

extra.en: Formal duels weren't all that popular in Aldor even before the civil war, but now the practice is almost abandoned. Occasional dueling bucklers on some citizens' belts and dusty dueling codexes in their closets are the only few things remaining of this irrevocably forgotten fad.
extra.zh: 奥尔多内战之前就已经不怎么流行正式的决斗了，现在更是基本上完全看不到了。这项风俗已经被人遗忘，只是偶尔还有人会在腰间别一块决斗拳盾，或者衣柜放着一本积了灰尘的决斗书典。

extra.en: "The Iron Dueling Codex"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Shield abilities:~/~##~lg~Shield Bash~/~#~y~Last Bastion~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《决斗书典》##~gr~可以学习若干盾技：~/~##~lg~盾击~/~#~y~鱼死网破~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。
作者：艾尔瓦罗·维尼加斯

desc_en: A bulky cargo of sturdy building materials, enough to repair several worn-down structures.
desc_zh: 扎扎实实的一批建筑材料，足够修几个破败的东西。

extra.en: This item is required for completing your ~y~contract~/~.
extra.zh: 要有这件东西，才能拿到~y~契据~/~约定的奖赏。

desc_en: The crates are packed tight with candles, relics, and other pious necessities.
desc_zh: 箱子里边满满的都是蜡烛、圣髑和信徒、圣会用的其他东西。

extra.en: This item is required for completing your ~y~contract~/~.
extra.zh: 要有这件东西，才能拿到~y~契据~/~约定的奖赏。

desc_en: An assortment of tools for every craft a small village might need.
desc_zh: 各种工具，什么行当的都有，小村子需要的都有。

extra.en: This item is required for completing your ~y~contract~/~.
extra.zh: 要有这件东西，才能拿到~y~契据~/~约定的奖赏。

desc_en: A shishpar is a flanged mace used by soldiers of Jibey and the Maaf Empire. It particularly excels at punching through scaled armor, which is quite popular in those lands.
desc_zh: 吉贝和玛弗帝国的士兵多穿鳞甲，为了对付这种防具，便诞生了悉什帕这种页锤。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: A makeshift blade wrapped in a piece of cloth. A common weapon of urchins and vagabonds.
desc_zh: 简易的刀具，裹了几层布，很多街头流浪的人都有。

stats.type_text: 普通 匕首

desc_en: Best not to dig too greedily and too deep.
desc_zh: 挖什么东西都不能太贪心，不能挖得太深。

extra.en: Allows you to do some digging.
extra.zh: 可以挖东西。
工具

desc_en: Sickles are generally wielded by women and children - during the harvesting season, they are tasked with cleaning up patches of grain that were missed during scything.
desc_zh: 短把镰刀基本上是小孩和女人用——收割的时候，长把大镰刀割完之后，他们就会拿着这种镰刀再去收割漏割的庄稼。

desc_en: The brutal killing power of this crossbow gave birth to rumors that even soldiers hiding behind mantlets aren't safe from the bolts launched with it.
desc_zh: 这种弩的威力巨大，就算对手躲在移动防护墙后面，据说也难能毫发无伤。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: A squad of competent engineers can determine the outcome of an entire siege. Therefore, it pays to keep them well-protected and properly armed: tunnel skirmishes beneath the walls are a common occurrence.
desc_zh: 一队得力的攻城兵可以决定整场围城战的结果，因此有必要确保他们防护完备，武装得当，毕竟城墙下的地道战对他们而言是家常便饭。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: Amethyst is also known as the savant's stone - pendants and necklaces encrusted with this gem are often worn by people who have a keen interest in various sciences.
desc_zh: 紫水晶也被人称作“智者之石”，热衷各类学科的人士经常佩戴嵌有紫水晶的吊坠和项链。

stats.type_text: 普通 防御型 项链

desc_en: A ring encrusted with an amethyst is a well-known talisman for maintaining mental clarity.
desc_zh: 戒指镶了紫水晶，就可以保持心境澄澈。

stats.type_text: 普通 勇士型 戒指

desc_en: When purchasing jewelry, mages prioritize craftsmanship and a correct balance between gems and metals, both of which are vital if one hopes to utilize the materials' mystical properties.
desc_zh: 法师挑选首饰，主要在意工艺优劣，还有宝石与金属是否相合。要想充分利用材质的神秘学属性，就必须确保这两个方面万无一失。

stats.type_text: 普通 防御型 项链

desc_en: It's believed that every aquamarine carries a heavenly blessing, so they are often used for rings and necklaces.
desc_zh: 很多人都觉得海蓝宝石获得了上天保佑，经常用它们装饰戒指和项链。

stats.type_text: 普通 勇士型 戒指

desc_en: A simple silver clasp suitable for a cloak or a doublet - a mandatory accessory of any affluent townsman.
desc_zh: 简简单单的银饰扣，一般别在斗篷或者马甲上，城里只要家境还不错的，衣服都会别这种东西。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: The nobility once held a belief that silver could neutralize many poisons. By the time reality proved them woefully wrong, these cups had already found their way into the cupboards of many respectable Aldorian families.
desc_zh: 从前的贵族认为银杯能够中和绝大多数毒素，后来事实证明他们大错特错，可是这些杯子那时已经走进了奥尔多许多名门望族的橱柜。

extra.zh: 里边盛了水。

desc_en: Elven mud is a drink of the nobility and the wealthy. This vessel is yet another way to casually flaunt one's wealth, clearly showing that its owner is no stranger to foreign delicacies.
desc_zh: 喝精灵泥水的人非富即贵，这种饮品是他们显露身家的又一手段，让人明白即便是异域珍馐，他们也能如数家珍。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: The Emir of Jibey buys the loyalty of Ohirian warlords with gold, silk, and amulets not unlike this one - doing so is much cheaper than sending in the army to reestablish his rule over the region.
desc_zh: 吉贝的埃米尔收买奥息尔军阀，靠的就是金子、绸缎和这样的吊坠，这种做法代价远远小于出军征伐。

stats.type_text: 普通 防御型 项链

desc_en: In iatrochemistry, emeralds are thought to be the quintessence of life force - which is why they are worn day and night by those obsessed with longevity.
desc_zh: 医化学家认为祖母绿是生力精华，痴迷延年益寿的人白天黑夜都会戴着这种宝石。

desc_en: Jewelry connoisseurs might wrinkle their noses at mixing gold and silver, but hardly anyone else shares the objection.
desc_zh: 首饰鉴赏家或许会嫌弃金配银，不过其他人大多数没有这种顾虑。

stats.type_text: 普通 混合型 戒指

desc_en: Jade isn't as popular in Aldor as it is in the East, but the jewelry made with it is still pretty easy to find.
desc_zh: 玉石在奥尔多不像东方那么流行，不过玉石首饰算不上稀罕物件。

stats.type_text: 普通 勇士型 戒指

desc_en: According to local beliefs, silver offers protection against the evil eye and diseases.
desc_zh: 当地人认为，银器可以驱邪治病。

stats.type_text: 普通 勇士型 戒指

desc_en: A frozen spark of the setting sun, now on your finger.
desc_zh: 夕阳冰封的余晖落在了你的手指上。

stats.type_text: 普通 勇士型 戒指

desc_en: Jewelers consider the union of silver and sapphires to be one of the most refined and harmonious.
desc_zh: 对于首饰匠人而言，银器和蓝宝石是最考究而又和谐的一种组合。

stats.type_text: 普通 勇士型 戒指

desc_en: Directing your prayers toward an image of a saint tends to yield significantly better results, making prayer amulets a desirable accessory.
desc_zh: 祷告的时候，面前摆上圣像，效果一般会好很多，所以大家都喜欢随身带一块祷告护符。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Topaz and silver form an exquisite combination, priced precisely to appeal to the wives of respectable merchants.
desc_zh: 黄玉配银器，精致又雅观，价格定得恰到好处，正好适合财力中等的生意人的老婆。

stats.type_text: 普通 勇士型 戒指

desc_en: The marvelous healing properties of silverleaf have been documented since antiquity. To the sorrow of many, centuries of unchecked foraging have pushed it to the brink of extinction.
desc_zh: 银叶草药效神奇，自古就有记载，只可惜千百年来滥采滥摘，这种植物如今已濒临灭种。

extra.en: Grants the following effect for ~y~360~/~ turns:##Replenishes ~lg~1%~/~ Max Health
extra.zh: 可以产生以下效果，持续~y~360~/~个回合：##立刻恢复生命上限~lg~1%~/~的生命

desc_en: A traditional Hazzun pastry, served at every elven tea table.
desc_zh: 哈尊的传统面点，每个精灵家庭喝茶的时候都会有这个。

desc_en: A traditional Hazzun pastry, served at every elven tea table.
desc_zh: 哈尊的传统面点，每个精灵家庭喝茶的时候都会有这个。

desc_en: Skadian bardiches are a weapon of status. Only the greatest warriors - the champions and the retinue of Skadian princes - are allowed to carry them.
desc_zh: 斯卡迪亚的月牙斧并非人人皆可用，只有极其优秀的战士——斯卡迪亚大公的扈从和比武勇士——才能配持。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: A bludgeon is a surprisingly deadly piece of gear. If anyone knows their maces, it's Skadians.
desc_zh: 锤棍的攻击效果非常好，谁都没有斯卡迪亚人熟悉这种兵器。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: These axes don't see much use in Aldor, but in Skadia they are ubiquitous. If the axeblade ever gets too chipped to use, you can always switch your grip and strike with the hammerhead.
desc_zh: 这种斧子在奥尔多不是很常见，但斯卡迪亚到处都是。这个兵器顶端一头是斧，一头是锤，所以斧子卷刃严重的时候，还可以用锤头。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: Generations of conflicts with Fjall dwarves and Jarimad nomads left an indelible mark of their culture on Skadian armor and weaponry.
desc_zh: 斯卡迪亚人与弗约矮人和亚里迈德的游牧民世代为敌，战端频发，他们盔甲和兵器的形制也因而打上了不可磨灭的烙印。

desc_en: A shield bearing the crest of the Elder Prince, likely brought to Aldor by a mercenary who once served in the Prince's retinue.
desc_zh: 这块盾牌饰有老大公的盾徽。可能是某个雇佣兵带过来的，而且这个雇佣兵以前应该是大公的随从。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 盾牌

desc_en: This weapon can often be seen in the hands of Skadian horsemen. They weren't the ones who first started using it though: Skadians borrowed the design from the Poleds, a tribe inhabiting the shores of the Icy Sea.
desc_zh: 斯卡迪亚的骑兵手里经常能看到索夫尼亚，可是这种兵器并非斯卡迪亚人发明，而是他们从毗邻冰海的波列部落引入的。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: Distant Skadia is notable for its powerful spellcasters, known as volkhvs. There must be quite a story to this staff.
desc_zh: 斯卡迪亚距离奥尔多很远，那里的法师——也就是“沃赫夫”——十分强大，这根长杖到了这里，肯定费了不少周折……

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: Skadians borrowed the practice of reinforcing mail armor with iron plates from Jarimad warriors. Such chestpieces are more than capable of protecting the cavalry from stray arrows and spear thrusts.
desc_zh: 斯卡迪亚人从亚里迈德的战士那里学会了用铁板加固链甲的工艺。骑兵穿上这样的盔甲，完全足以抵御流箭和长杆刃器的攻击。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 铠甲

desc_en: There's a dwarven belief that an attire blessed by Skarhogg shamans can fortify strength and resolve of any warrior who puts it on.
desc_zh: 矮人认为衣服只要经过斯卡霍格的萨满祝福，穿上之后，力量和毅力就都会变得更强。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: A key to every door.
desc_zh: 什么门都打得开。

extra.zh: 可以打开任意锁具。

desc_en: Skirmishers are expected to carry a considerable amount of arrows and gear, so they give more thought than most to their choice of belts and bandoleers.
desc_zh: 散兵需要随身带大量箭枝和工具，所以他们比大多数人更在意自己的腰带和腰包。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: A favorite shield of the Nistrian light cavalry - its curved form protects a good portion of the rider's back from arrows.
desc_zh: 尼斯特拉的轻装骑兵最喜欢带这种盾牌——-盾面呈弧形，可以比较好地保护腰背，防止后方射来的箭矢。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 盾牌

desc_en: Whittling the enemy down with agile maneuvering and constant arrow barrages from a safe distance is the preferred tactic of the Nistrian light infantry.
desc_zh: 尼斯特拉轻步兵喜好机动作战，同时与敌人保持安全的距离，凭借连绵不绝的箭雨攻势不断削减敌方的兵力。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: Attrition through small engagements is certainly one way to tip the decisive battle in your favor.
desc_zh: 不断以零星的小规模交锋消耗敌人，确实也有可能改变决定性战役的局面。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: Skonfert is famous for its furnaces and masterful smiths. In times of great conflict, it was there that victories were forged.
desc_zh: 斯孔弗特炼场广博，手艺精湛的铁匠众多，因此而闻名。每逢大战，胜利往往就在那个地方铸就。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: Surprisingly well preserved.
desc_zh: 保存得极为完好。

desc_en: "Sky-readers" was the name given by King Etbert's soldiers to the elven oracles who fought on the Jacinth's side during the Radiant Wars. Many attribute the Aldorian army's defeat to their involvement, for how can one defeat an enemy who sees the outcome of every battle in advance?
desc_zh: 光辉战争期间，埃特伯特国王麾下的士兵称呼红锆军内的精灵卜兵为“星监”。现在很多人认为奥尔多军最终战败，原因就在这些卜兵身上，毕竟敌人若是每次都不战而先知战果，那么怎么可能打得赢？

stats.type_text: 独一无二 长杖

desc_en: Rests securely against the body, even when stuffed to the brim with stones.
desc_zh: 就算装满了石头，也能安稳地带在身上。

desc_en: This casket used to hold some noble lady's earrings and pendants. Now it's just a fancy curio, forgotten by time.
desc_zh: 这个匣子本来装了某个贵族小姐或者太太的珠宝首饰，如今已被时间遗忘，变成了花哨的古董。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Upon landing, creates a slowly spreading smoke cloud.##The smoke has ~w~50%~/~ chance to cause ~r~Coughing~/~ and applies the following effects:##~r~-20%~/~ Accuracy#~r~+20%~/~ Fumble Chance#Reduces Vision to ~r~1~/~ tile
desc_zh: 投掷落地之后，会从所在方格缓慢放出烟雾。##烟气有~w~50%~/~的几率造成~r~咳嗽~/~及以下效果：##准度~r~-20%~/~#失手几率~r~+20%~/~#视野减少~r~1~/~格

extra.en: A simple metal shell stuffed with a mixture of dry grass, oil, tar, and tinder, used by peasants to smoke wild beasts out of their dens.
extra.zh: 金属壳简简单单，里面填的是引火料、油、焦油和干草，农民经常用这东西对付缩在窝里的野兽。

desc_en: There are stories about a village where hams are cooked over steam. Some local customs never fail to perplex.
desc_zh: 据说有个村里喜欢把火腿蒸着吃。有些地方习俗真的是让人百思不得其解。

desc_en: ...I knew that backstabber wouldn't make it easy for me, but this... this I didn't expect even from him. To be sent to the breeding grounds of the disease for a misdeed I never committed? I can't believe this is happening. I beseech the Host day and night that I succeed at bringing that villain's sins to light. Yesterday I tried to explain to Brother Venn how viciously I was slandered, but he didn't believe me...##( . . . )##...I can't bear seeing their deformed faces anymore. The stench, the foul smell of decaying flesh... It permeates everything: my clothes, the wood of my bed, these very pages, me... I check my skin every day. How long do I have before the first symptoms manifest? Do I only have a couple years before I join them: hunched, decrepit, forced to observe the slow decay of my own body? No, no, no... I'd rather die...
desc_zh: ……我知道那个小人肯定会找我麻烦，只是没想到他竟然干出这种……事情，给我扣了一项乌有之罪，让我来到了这个地方，真是令人发指。我日夜向圣主祈祷，希望自己有朝一日能够揭发那个恶人的罪行。昨天，我向维恩教友解释，说自己被人诬陷，但他不以为然……##（……）##……我实在不愿再看到这一张张狰狞的面孔。这种气味，腐烂肉体的这种恶臭……无处不在——我的衣服上，我的床上，还有这些纸上，还有我身上。我每天都会留意自己的皮肤，我再过几年真的就要变成他们那样了吗？驼着背，老态龙钟，只能等着身体慢慢朽败？天呐，不要啊……那我不如直接死了算了……

extra.en: An old diary ruined by moisture. It reeks with decay.
extra.zh: 本子已经泡得不成样子，散发着腐烂的气味。
作者：佚名

desc_en: A masterfully crafted piece of equipment - such quivers often outlast their owners.
desc_zh: 这种箭筒做工优良，寿命常常比主人长。

extra.en: Can be used to store bolts.##Fits ~lg~3~/~ stacks.
extra.zh: 可以收纳弩箭。##能装~lg~3~/~把弩箭。

desc_en: The sooner you start, the better your chances of mastering the bow - which is why in Aldorian villages training begins in early childhood.
desc_zh: 这样的弓，用得越早，越有可能驾驭，所以奥尔多乡下练弓都是从娃娃抓起。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: A crossbow used by both sides of the conflict - it's equally popular with the soldiers of the Council and the mercenaries of the Magistrate.
desc_zh: 这种弩随处可见，不论是王廷的士兵，还是城联的雇佣兵，都喜欢用。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: Rapid advancements in steel forging are slowly but steadily driving down the cost of plate armor - enough that wealthier foot soldiers can now afford individual pieces.
desc_zh: 锻钢工艺快速进步，让这类防具的价格慢慢稳定地降了下来。现在，即便是手头比较宽裕的步兵也买得起板甲散件了。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 铠甲

stats.type_text: 普通 匕首

desc_zh: 有些酒馆不许客人戴这种手套进门，必须放在门口，毕竟里边往往衬了不少金属板。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 手套

desc_en: It takes a truly impressive amount of strength and stamina to handle this axe efficiently.
desc_zh: 只有极其强大的勇士才能把这种阔斧用得得心应手。

desc_en: As the boastful proverb goes, as long as Aldor has at least a dozen longbows, it'll remain unconquered.
desc_zh: 奥尔多只要不缺长弓，任谁也攻不下来。

desc_en: One of King Etbert's decrees demanded all mages to join the army in the event of war, which handily provided him with lots of additional troops during his Radiant campaigns. These army-issued mantles aren't much to look at, but the craftsmanship is perfectly serviceable.
desc_zh: 埃特伯特国王生前有令，要求战时所有法师必须入伍，他光辉战争期间因而额外募集了大量士兵。部队配发的这些法袍虽然看着不怎么样，但是做工绝对够用。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: Such poleaxes are forged by the Council weaponsmiths with less metal than usual, allowing for cheaper production.
desc_zh: 这种兵器产自王廷的铁匠，用的材料比较少，造价也就比较便宜。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_zh: 就算敌人的防具顶得住钝击，这根长柄钉头锤的尖端也能精准刺入其颈部。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_zh: 王廷围城，打了布林个措手不及，守军很快就发现后方留存的箭撑不了多久，便迅速制造了大量投石杖，在军中广泛配发。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: The kind of sponge used by city barbers to soothe terrified clients before pulling a bad tooth.
desc_zh: 大城市的剃工给客人拔牙的时候，如果客人非常恐慌，就会用这种海绵安抚对方的情绪。

desc_en: The magic sigils carved into the leather are useful for swiftly redirecting the flow of magical energies in the chaos of combat.
desc_zh: 皮面雕了魔法符印，可在混战之中迅速改变魔能流动的方向。

desc_en: The Faceless are the Palace Guard of the Great Jacinth and are considered the best warriors in all the Elven Kingdoms. Among other feats, they distinguished themselves on the frontlines of the Radiant Wars by repelling the advance of King Etbert's army.
desc_zh: 无面作为大红锆的御前卫队，其武力之高，各个精灵王国之内无出其右。无面卫队骁勇善战，功绩赫赫，曾于光辉战争期间坚守前阵，瓦解了埃特伯特国王的进攻。

desc_en: With no shortage of practical uses, spearmint makes a fine addition to any tincture.

desc_en: ...From my experience, many bounty hunters, especially the ones who are still wet behind the ears, fall into two extremes.##The first extreme is to hunt with such needless cruelty as if there's extra pay in it. Some folks enjoy beating their quarry half to death after already catching them. One can count their blessings if the poor bastard doesn't go belly up during the return trip, or if the client is able to recognize anything in the mutilated mess. It's simply the worst way to go about things.##The second extreme is to avoid harming the quarry entirely, going out of your way to not leave a single bruise. Trust me, no one will hold you accountable for such trivialities, and it's much better to return with a dead man's head than to pussyfoot around and get nothing - that's just how this trade works.##The most reliable way to capture your bounty alive is to hit them on the leg with a sharp spear. Just make sure the wound is properly treated before you hogtie them - otherwise there's a chance they'll bleed out or die of fever before you claim the reward...
desc_zh: ……根据我的个人经历，赏金猎人，尤其是经验贫乏的赏金猎人，往往存在两种极端。##一种极端，执行任务的时候下手毒辣，好像越残忍，赏金越好似的。这些人抓到目标，还要把对方打得半死，而且乐在其中。至于目标半路上会不会嗝屁，或者客户能不能认出来目标血肉模糊的脸，那就全看这些赏金猎人的造化了。这样干活，十有八九会把名声搞砸了。##另外一个极端，不动目标一根汗毛，唯恐目标受伤。我跟你说，那些小伤，客户根本不会跟你计较，与其小心翼翼，磨磨蹭蹭，结果一无所获，倒不如交给客户一颗死人头。要想活捉离群之马，最靠谱的办法就是用长枪把目标的腿刺伤。##不过千万注意，要先给目标包扎好伤口，再把手脚捆在一起。否则，你还没拿到赏金，这人可能就已经出血出死了，要么就是发烧烧死了……

extra.en: "Bounty Hunting: Tricks of the Trade Detailed by an Experienced Trapper Across Twenty Chapters"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Spears abilities:~/~##~lg~Nail Down~/~#~lg~Impaling Lunge~/~#~y~Precise Hits~/~#~y~No Retreat~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《赏金老手二十章详谈成功秘诀》##~gr~可以学习若干长杆刃器招式：~/~##~lg~尖矛~/~#~lg~突刺~/~#~y~精准一击~/~#~y~绝不后退~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。

extra.en: It goes without saying that bounty hunting isn't the most respectable of trades but still a rather lucrative one, so there are always folks looking to learn its tricks.
extra.zh: 赏金猎人这个行当，毋庸置疑，不是什么正经职业，但钱赚得可不少，所以经常有人想进这一行。
作者：“神鬼难逃”卡恩

desc_en: ...When it comes to strategy and tactics, royalist commanders are utterly stuck in their ways: just like a century ago, the Council army continues to primarily rely on heavy cavalry. Their infantry consists mostly of poorly-trained peasant levies, which take to their heels the moment they lose sight of their lord's banner.##Therefore, in order to properly deal with our sworn enemy, it's most advisable to focus on the reforms that will help us specifically counter the Council army's composition. If the enemy relies on cavalry, it's only reasonable to triple our efforts at training pikemen and crossbowmen, making them a backbone of our army.##It's worth mentioning the practice introduced by Commander Damian of the renowned Albatross brigade: by using a formation reminiscent of the antique phalanx, he achieved a decisive victory against Duke der Narn in the battle of the Chilly Ford. Regardless of what anyone might think, the future of warfare is pikemen. I've been saying this for at least a decade, and I'm saying it now as well...
desc_zh: ……保王派的将领战略观念和战术思维相当僵化狭隘——王廷军一百年前作战主要依赖重装骑兵，现在依然如此。步兵基本都是训练无素的农家壮丁，一眼看不见领主的旗子，就会临阵脱逃。因此，为了妥善应对最大的敌人，强烈建议重点推进相关改革措施，切实调整王廷军的兵种构成。##既然敌人依赖骑兵，那么我们就应该大力加强枪兵与弩兵的训练，不能只翻一倍，还要再加一倍，要让他们变成军队的主力。我在这里介绍一下信天翁旅指挥官达米安采用的作战办法。冷河战役期间，他仿效古代方阵，大破那恩王，取得关键胜利。##无论他人如何争辩，枪兵一定是未来战争的主力。这个道理，我已经说了至少十年，现在依旧还是这个观点……

extra.en: "An Essay on the Necessity of a Military Reform, Backed by Compelling Evidence and Indisputable Arguments. Part One"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Spears abilities:~/~##~lg~Determination~/~#~lg~Pikeman Stance~/~#~y~Wounding Spearhead~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《实论铁证谈军事改革的必要性》（卷一）##~gr~可以学习若干长杆刃器招式：~/~##~lg~寸土必争~/~#~lg~枪兵站姿~/~#~y~枪锐矛利~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。

extra.en: The ongoing strife gave commanders on every side of the conflict lots of food for thought, but it's the strategists of the Magistrate who are the most determined to make their new ideas a reality.
extra.zh: 大乱让各方将领受到极大的触动和启发，然而只有城联军的谋士锐意革新。
作者：贝瑞隆·佛·马尔

desc_en: ...No matter how unfair his fate might be, no matter how many hardships and sorrows befall him, a true knight has to always remain steadfast. Even when facing certain death, he must stay courageous and unrelenting. These virtues are best exemplified by the life story of Sir Winfred, whose heroic deeds are well documented, ready to serve as an inspiration for any young page.##( . . . )##Leading with a dastardly ambush, the orcs laid waste to his entire retinue, ending the lives of many noble warriors in one fell swoop. In the ensuing chaos, Sir Winfred lost his mount but proceeded to fight on foot. One of the orcs stood tall and mighty even among his vile brethren: with a cleave of his giant axe he shattered the valiant knight's shield, then knocked the sword out of his hand. Death seemed inevitable, but Sir Winfred prevailed - in a bout of great luck he spotted a knightly spear lying in the grass nearby...##The savage lunged at him, ready to finish the distracted knight with a single blow, but Sir Winfred proved to be more nimble than his opponent. A lightning-fast thrust buried the spear in the foe's throat, and when a couple more orcs charged at him to avenge their fallen champion, they met the same fate. It's hard to overstate the importance of resourcefulness and discipline - had Sir Winfred given up, this battle would have certainly been his last...
desc_zh: ……无论命运多么残酷，无论经受了多少苦难和悲伤，真正的骑士都应当安然若素。即便死亡就在眼前，也必须不屈不挠、勇敢无畏。温弗雷德爵士的一生充分彰显了骑士的这些美德——他的英雄事迹记载详实，任何年轻的扈从读了都会备受鼓舞。##（ . . . ）##温弗雷德爵士的手下人遭遇奥克阴险的埋伏，全军覆没。混战之中，爵士的马被奥克砍翻，他只得徒步战斗。一个奥克身形尤其彪悍，力大无比，大斧一挥，劈开了骑士的盾牌，而后又撞飞了他的剑。爵士似乎在劫难逃，就在这时，却看到旁边的草地上躺着一支骑士长矛……##凶蛮的奥克看到对手分神，便猛扑了过来，准备一斧结果了他，谁知爵士机敏更胜一筹，以迅雷不及掩耳之势，将长矛深深地插进了对手喉咙。几个奥克冲将过来，要为他们牺牲的勇士报仇，最终却落得同样的下场。由此可见，应变能力与严格训练至关重要，倘若温弗雷德爵士直接放弃，这场战役注定将成为他的最后一战……

extra.en: "The Book of Sword and Honor: a Guidance to a Page"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Spears abilities:~/~##~lg~Regroup~/~#~y~One at a Time!~/~#~y~Stay Back!~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《刀剑与荣耀：扈从指南》##~gr~可以学习若干长杆刃器招式：~/~##~lg~应变~/~#~y~逐个击破~/~#~y~不要过来！~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。

extra.en: This book was written with the intention of providing knights with all the advice they might need as well as setting inexperienced youth on the righteous path.
extra.zh: 作者写这本书主要是希望向骑士提供他们所需的各类建议，同时也让初出茅庐的年轻人找到正确的方向。

desc_zh: 织咒法师眼中的世界与其他人截然不同，因为他们的意识经过训练，能够察觉魔能流的扰动和变化。

desc_en: Most mages have to contend with merely reciting the few surviving spells, possessing little to no understanding of the force powering them. But not everyone is satisfied with this state of things: the half-secretive Circle of Spellweavers aims to resurrect the lost art of creating new spells - their efforts are yet to bear fruit.
desc_zh: 大多数法师只需要学会唱诵为数不多流传下来的法咒，几乎全然不了解是什么力量令法咒产生效果。不过，并非所有人都止步于此——秘密组织织咒法会希望复兴“创作法咒”这一遗失的技艺，只是他们目前为止还没有取得任何成绩。

desc_en: Unlike a common pitchfork, a spetum has its prongs pointed at different directions, which makes them much more suitable for catching enemy blades.

desc_en: During her pilgrimage to Mount Foros, Saint Theona's procession was ambushed by bandits. By the grace of the Host, the Hieronites fought them off - after which Theona performed a miracle, healing the dying and wounded with nothing more than a single sprig of spider vine.
desc_zh: 圣徒缇欧娜去佛洛斯山朝圣途中，随行之人遭土匪打劫，幸赖圣主眷顾，队内圣门之徒击退了劫匪。缇欧娜而后施展奇观，一众人等，无论伤情轻重，即便是将死之人，也都救治妥当。问她用了什么？只一根蜘蛛蔓而已。

desc_en: ...As I already mentioned before, the most important secret to impeccable fencing is proper edge alignment. With enough training it's fairly simple to deliver deadly wounds with a flick of a wrist. At the same time, sword strikes should usually engage the entire body. A strike performed with shoulder and hip rotation is more than capable of slicing through the opponent's defenses, chopping off a limb, or simply sending their head flying.##The skill of applying power to swings is especially vital when dealing with well-armored foes. It's worth mentioning that it's impossible to slice directly through mail and plate armor, unless we are talking about orcs. Strength has to be paired with accuracy to cut at the least protected parts and gaps. Aim for the throat, face, armpits, groin, hands. Even a shallow wound to those areas can cause a massive bleeding and weaken your enemy.##To cut through gambeson or tough hide, you have to keep your sword in perfect condition. Remember to timely sharpen it, clean the blade from dirt and caked blood, and, most importantly, oil it at least every few days. Flaxseed oil is the cheapest and the most readily available one, but if you have money to spare, consider using clove oil. In the next chapter we'll also explore a large selection of alchemical pastes which have recently appeared on the market...
desc_zh: ……如前文所说，刀法剑术最关键的是刃面的方向。训练如若充分，只需运动手腕就能造成致命创伤。话虽如此，刀剑多数的动作都需要整个身体参与。出击的时候，肩膀和胯部相应转动，才能攻破敌人的防御，砍断对方的手足或者直接令其脑袋搬家。##如果对方装甲精良，那么挥舞刀剑时如何用力就成了关乎生死的问题。只要不是奥克，就不可能直接劈开链甲和板甲，就要运用足够的力量和准度攻击盔甲的间隙或者相对薄弱的部位，例如颈部、面部、腋下、胯下和手掌。这些位置即便只是浅创，也能造成大量失血，从而导致对方虚弱。##如果希望穿透软铠或硬质皮甲，则需要保持刀剑清洁锋利。记得定时磨砺，清理刃面的尘土和板结的血块，最重要的是，每隔几天就要给刀剑上一次油。亚麻籽油最便宜，而且最容易买到，有余钱的话，推荐丁香油。下面一章，我将详细介绍市面最近出现的各类炼金膏剂……

desc_en: An excerpt from the chapter seven titled "Pressing the offense as a path to defense":##( . . . )##What does a seasoned veteran of a dozen battles may have in common with a hot-headed youngster who barely learned the basics of fencing? Why will neither of them survive a run-in with an experienced duelist?##The answer lies in predictability: frontline experience and fighting in a tight formation don't really prepare you to one-on-one combat. When it comes to duels, relying on a steady rhythm of attacking and blocking in hopes that your opponent makes a mistake is a foolish endeavor, and any swordsman worth their salt will easily figure out your tactics and use them against you. I'm referring, of course, to the so-called hidden strikes - counters that simultaneously displace an opponent's weapon just as he attacks.##It's an advanced technique that requires you to read your enemy's intentions: after all, hidden strikes must be performed as soon as an opponent prepares to deliver his attack. If you're not quick enough, you'll be lucky to have your hidden strike becoming a simple parry. Worst case scenario - you'll lose your head.##Fortunately, this skill can be mastered with enough practice and persistence - and then, I assure you, this investment will pay off not only in duels but also on the fields of battle...
desc_zh: 第七章“以攻为守”节选：##（ . . . ）##假设有两个人，一个是久经沙场的老兵，上过十几次战场，一个是基本不懂刀剑的暴脾气年轻人，二者会有什么相同之处？为什么他们与决斗老手动手都有可能丧命？##因为二者的行为容易捉摸，老兵的经验仅限于熟悉前线作战和配合阵型战斗。决斗的时候，高明的人不会仅仅依靠稳定不变的攻守节奏，等待对手露出破绽。这种低级战术很容易被真正的剑士看穿，进而授其以柄。对，我要说的技巧就是所谓的“攻守一体”——通过反击拨开对手的兵器，同时形成攻击。##这种技巧难度较大，需要预判对手的意图，毕竟你要与对手同时出手，判明其攻击意图以后，立刻挡避与攻击。如果动作不够快，你这一下就会变成单纯的招架，最惨的后果是你有可能丢掉脑袋。##不过，只要勤学苦练，多加练习，这项技巧就能掌握。届时，汗水与辛苦不仅能够让你在决斗时占得上风，在战场上也能拥有一技之长……

desc_en: ...The guards' charred remains are still strewn under the drizzling rain. I've been observing him for hours. It's becoming clear that he isn't planning to leave the house. Well then...##It would be too risky to try and sneak into the building - I can see an occasional shadow moving behind the half-opened shutters, he is ready for guests. Either way, I wouldn't be able to do much within the cramped interior of the house other than burn down along with it. I wonder if I can lure him outside before the rain dies out...##I headed to the nearest inn where I demanded a bucket of icy water. To the innkeeper's shock, I immediately poured it over myself. Not catching fire is half the victory when hunting pyromancers!##I had to act fast - freezing to the bone and succumbing to fever wasn't a part of the plan. After returning to the house, I began cautiously approaching the main entrance. Suddenly, I heard a sound of a mournful song, or a prayer of sorts, coming from inside... There was a magic spark, a roar of rising flames - I barely had enough time for a desperate dodge. Trying to ignore my smoldering doublet, I rushed towards the mage. There were only a few yards between me and the target - one final push, and I was on the doorstep...##I bet the sorcerer didn't expect to see me up close. I wasted no time on pleasantries: upon reaching him with one giant leap, I grabbed the bastard by the throat and let my trusty blade do the talking. He let out a terrible wheeze and started shaking in agony before finally going limp, collapsing with a heavy thud.##I picked up some rag lying nearby and wiped his black blood off my sword...
desc_zh: ……外面下着毛毛雨，卫兵烧焦的尸体还横七竖八躺在那里。已经守了几个小时，看来他没有出来的意思，既然这样……##直接溜进去太危险了，我看屋里有个人影走来走去，他应该做好了家里来客人的准备。房子里面那么小，无论他是不是有所准备，我都没法施展什么计策，除非与它一同化为灰烬。我是不是可以趁着雨还没停，把他引出来……##我跑到附近的酒馆，要了一桶冰水，接过水桶就把冰水浇在了自己头上，把酒馆老板吓了一跳。抓炎术法师，只要自己身上不能着火，就等于有了一半的胜算！##我哆哆嗦嗦跑了回去，得趁自己还没发烧，赶紧把他引出来。我蹑手蹑脚走到房子门口，突然听到屋里传出一个哀怨的声音，不知道是在唱歌还是在祷诵……那声音还未落下，就看到火花凭空出现，而后听到火焰飞出的“轰隆”巨响。所幸我反应迅速，在火球接触马甲的瞬间闪到了一边，不然就变成焦尸了。我全然顾不上“嘶嘶”冒烟的衣服，直接奔向了那个法师……目标仅有几码之遥，我一个箭步冲到了门口……##那法师想必没有料到我会跑到这么近的地方。我没跟他费什么寒暄的口舌，一大步窜到这混蛋身旁，揽过脖子，直接一剑跟他表明了来意。他痛叫一声，摇摇晃晃，“噗通”一声倒了下去。##我拿起旁边一块布，擦掉了剑上的黑血……

desc_zh: 三手会的圣堂武士研习圣主，既遵守骑士纪律，又修炼魔法，都只是为了最终获得超凡神通。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: The legendary templar Theobrand was born and raised in a poor shepherd's family. A master of the sling since childhood, he kept up the practice even after joining the Order.
desc_zh: 传奇的圣堂武士提欧布兰德出身贫寒的牧民家庭，自幼擅长使用投石兵器，进入教团之后也没有荒废这项技能。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: Forged by great weaponsmiths in times immemorial, this blade still carries the blessing of the Host.
desc_zh: 这把剑由古时的传奇兵匠铸成，至今依然拥有圣主的加持。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手刀剑

desc_en: A risky weapon for those who are confident in their skill.
desc_zh: 这件兵器，即便熟悉，用起来也十分危险。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Thrushes have a beautiful singing voice - alas, they are more prized for their tasty, nourishing meat.
desc_zh: 知更鸟的歌喉婉转，可惜这种鸟类的肉营养可口，人们更关注它们的食用价值。

extra.zh: 羽毛可以拔掉。
知更鸟

desc_en: Thrushes have a beautiful singing voice - alas, they are more prized for their tasty, nourishing meat.
desc_zh: 知更鸟的歌喉婉转，可惜这种鸟类的肉营养可口，人们更关注它们的食用价值。

extra.zh: 羽毛可以拔掉。
知更鸟

desc_en: Aromatic spices, medicinal brews, herbal oils - thyme has a place in all of them.
desc_zh: 百里香用途多，可以当香料，也可以熬药汤，也能作药油。

desc_en: The trick is not to tighten the bindings too much. Numb hands are of little use in a fight.
desc_zh: 关键在于绑得松紧适中。动手的时候，要是手勒木了，就不好了。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 手套

desc_en: The tit is seen as a symbol of luck, so no harm comes to these birds without good reason - they are hunted only by those stricken with poverty or starvation.
desc_zh: 山雀被人视为好运的象征，所以除非穷极了、饿极了，一般没人会抓。

extra.zh: 羽毛可以拔掉。
山雀

desc_en: The tit is seen as a symbol of luck, so no harm comes to these birds without good reason - they are hunted only by those stricken with poverty or starvation.
desc_zh: 山雀被人视为好运的象征，所以除非穷极了、饿极了，一般没人会抓。

extra.zh: 羽毛可以拔掉。
山雀

desc_en: Some madmen claim it to be a berry.
desc_zh: 有些疯子说这个是莓果。

desc_en: Some madmen claim it to be a berry.
desc_zh: 有些疯子说这个是莓果。

desc_en: Topaz is a well-known good luck charm that is mostly used in inexpensive jewelry.
desc_zh: 大家都知道黄玉能招好运，这种宝石多数用于制作廉价首饰。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Topazes can be relatively cheap - pieces of equipment encrusted with them are commonly purchased by mages of modest income.
desc_zh: 黄玉比较廉价，有些法师收入不多，就常常青睐镶了这种宝石的首饰。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: Topfhelms have been out of fashion for quite a while. Nowadays they are worn almost exclusively by gray-haired, irredeemably nostalgic veterans.
desc_zh: 桶盔早就不时兴了，现在还戴这种头盔的，基本都是满头花白的老兵，张口闭口就是“当年如何如何”。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 头盔

desc_en: Can be equipped and ignited.##~ly~Illuminates~/~ the surroundings within ~w~9~/~ tiles.#Remaining within a lit area removes the penalties of darkness.
desc_zh: 可以拿在手上、点燃。##能够~ly~照亮~/~周围~w~9~/~个方格。#如果站在照亮的区域，视野范围不会受黑暗影响。

extra.en: Blazes with heat and radiant light.
extra.zh: 火光炽烈，热浪逼人。

desc_en: Can be equipped and ignited.##~ly~Illuminates~/~ the surroundings within ~w~9~/~ tiles.#Remaining within a lit area removes the penalties of darkness.
desc_zh: 可以拿在手上、点燃。##能够~ly~照亮~/~周围~w~9~/~个方格。#如果站在照亮的区域，视野范围不会受黑暗影响。

extra.en: Blazes with heat and radiant light.
extra.zh: 火光炽烈，热浪逼人。

desc_en: Restores ~lg~6~/~ Durability to any cloth armor.
desc_zh: 可以令任意布防具恢复~lg~6~/~点耐久。

extra.en: All that remains of a once-functional gambeson.
extra.zh: 本来是件好好的软铠，现在只拆下来了这么一块。

desc_en: The growing prevalence of archers and crossbowmen keeps driving shields to become taller, thicker, and heavier.
desc_zh: 弓兵弩兵愈发常见，盾牌便不得不做得越来越高，越来越厚，越来越重。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 盾牌

desc_en: Fancy enough for when you're going out into the world to prove your mettle.
desc_zh: 不论出去闯荡还是彰显你的胆量，穿这双鞋都不会丢人。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: It's significantly easier to learn how to use a crossbow than a bow, but there's no avoiding practice either way.
desc_zh: 弩学起来比弓容易多了，不过一样需要勤加练习。

stats.type_text: 普通 弩 远程兵器

desc_en: A simple wooden bow that is remarkably tricky to land a shot with.
desc_zh: 简易木弓，准头很难练。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: Can be used to store items, with dedicated compartments for traps, tools, and a hunting net.##Must be equipped before use.
desc_zh: 可以收纳物品，有专门放捕兽夹、工具和捕兽网的地方。##装备之后才能使用。

extra.en: A backpack laden with traps may be a heavy burden, but chasing down your quarry yourself is even more tiresome.
extra.zh: 包里多装几个捕兽夹，见到猎物就不用到处乱追了。

desc_en: It'll keep the rain away, help you stay warm in cold weather, and conceal you in the dark.
desc_zh: 可以防雨，可以御寒，在暗处的时候，还能掩藏你的身影。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 斗篷

desc_en: Shoes like these are cheap and wear well, the qualities which attract all kinds of vagabonds. Just make sure to keep them free of holes.
desc_zh: 这种鞋子又便宜，又好穿，各种流浪汉都觉得好，只是时不时需要补一补。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 靴子

desc_en: Any journey feels easier with a staff in hand.
desc_zh: 出门带着手杖，去哪儿都轻松一些。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: A scarcely decorated staff of the Forest folk. It can be used to empower a simple spell.
desc_zh: 森林部落的长杖，装饰朴实，可以催动简单的咒法。

desc_en: Some say this organ is the source of trolls' incredible resilience.
desc_zh: 有的人说巨魔之所以生命力顽强，原因就在这里。

desc_en: Both the soldiers of the Northern Borderlands and the dwarves they are getting in constant skirmishes with have a morbid penchant for collecting fingers of slain foes and wearing them as necklaces.
desc_zh: 北疆的士兵以及他们经常面对的矮人都有一个病态的喜好——杀了敌人之后，剁下对方的手指，穿成项链戴在胸前。

stats.type_text: 普通 攻击型 项链

desc_en: The ancient Axonian practice of cooking with truffles was revived only in recent times - yet its appeal has been growing steadily ever since.
desc_zh: 古亚克逊人会用松露入菜，这种做法到了近些年才重现世间，不过出现之后便是愈发流行。

desc_en: The ancient Axonian practice of cooking with truffles was revived only in recent times - yet its appeal has been growing steadily ever since.
desc_zh: 古亚克逊人会用松露入菜，这种做法到了近些年才重现世间，不过出现之后便是愈发流行。

desc_en: Adored by Sentian aristocrats, this method of preparing meat inspired many of them to keep a personal kennel of truffle hounds.
desc_zh: 森提亚的贵族当年尤其热衷这种肉菜，所以现在很多人都会自己囤一些松露。

desc_en: Adored by Sentian aristocrats, this method of preparing meat inspired many of them to keep a personal kennel of truffle hounds.
desc_zh: 森提亚的贵族当年尤其热衷这种肉菜，所以现在很多人都会自己囤一些松露。

desc_en: Much of the turquoise is mined in the mountains of Jibey, from where it reaches Aldor through the trade routes of the House of the Azure Thread.
desc_zh: 这种绿松石大多数采自吉贝山区，而后由碧罗商会的车队运至奥尔多。

extra.zh: 这个东西有些生意人可能会感兴趣。

desc_en: Can be delivered to the contract giver for an additional ~y~reward~/~.
desc_zh: 交给派发契据的人，可以获得额外的~y~报酬~/~。

extra.en: The withered skin hangs from the bones in ragged strips.
extra.zh: 干枯的皮肤虽然还连着骨头，但也已是摇摇欲坠。

desc_en: This mysterious armor looks both surprisingly modern and incredibly ancient...
desc_zh: 这副盔甲非常神秘，看起来非常现代，但又似乎是古代的制式……

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 铠甲

desc_en: The absolute mystery of this helmet's origins deepens with its engraved interior, which calls to mind elven craftsmanship - though, given the overall design, such a claim makes very little sense.
desc_zh: 这顶盔的来路非常神秘，内壁的铭文更加让人捉摸不透。有人想到了精灵的工艺，可是看它整体的设计，完全不像精灵的制品。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 重型 头盔

desc_en: Doesn't make you look any more trustworthy, to put it bluntly.
desc_zh: 坦白说，套上这个的话，应该不会有多少人会觉得你可靠。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: The nauseating stink of a rotting maw and clotted blood still lingers about them.
desc_zh: 依然存在血块，同时散发着腐烂口腔的恶臭。

extra.en: Can be delivered to the contract giver for an additional ~y~reward~/~.
extra.zh: 交给派发契据的人，可以获得额外的~y~报酬~/~。

desc_en: This staff saturates the surrounding air with a heavy stench of stale blood.
desc_zh: 这根法杖拿到哪里，哪里的空气就会充斥着血液浓重的腐腥。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 长杖

desc_en: Seemingly cumbersome, this steel staff is actually quite light. It's also an excellent conduit for magic.
desc_zh: 这个长杖看起来很沉，其实非常轻巧，而且传导魔能的效果很好。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: The backbone of the Magistrate's army, the Vanguard, is formed by mercenaries. A decent pay, plentiful drinks, and honorary swords make for a surefire way to earn the loyalty of the dogs of war.
desc_zh: 城市联盟的军队主力都是雇佣兵。只要钱给到位，酒管够，剑有面子，这些挣卖命钱的家伙就肯定忠心耿耿。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: Left behind by the Ancestors, the Vaults conceal boundless riches and unspeakable horrors alike. Only the most capable warriors have the courage to explore their forsaken halls.
desc_zh: 先祖留下了一座座地墟，里面藏着无尽的财宝，也有言语无法形容的骇人之物，只有最骁勇的战士才敢深入墟里荒废的厅堂。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手斧

desc_en: The ease of maintenance and lethal power of flails make them a staple choice among the Vehement, particularly in battles against the undead.
desc_zh: 连枷保养便利，杀伤力强，奋武因而人手一把，对付僵尸的时候尤其经常使用。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: The Vehement are militant Hieronites who took up arms to fight against all manner of ghouls, warlocks, and unholy monstrosities.
desc_zh: 圣会部分门徒习武好战，统称“奋武”，为了对抗各色食尸鬼、术士与邪恶之物，均已操起了各自的兵器。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: When it comes to the Vehement, their members hail from all walks of life - there are peasants, fanatical pilgrims, knights errant, and even battlemages.
desc_zh: 圣门奋武出身各异，三教九流均有，有的是农民，有的是狂热的朝圣信徒，有的是流浪骑士，甚至还有战地法师。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 铠甲

desc_en: The initiation into the Vehement is incomplete without a sacred vow: to stand always with the Hieron and the common folk, doing all in one's power to purge the evils of this world
desc_zh: 成为奋武之前，必须郑重起誓：“我时刻效忠圣会与百姓，尽自己全力荡涤世间的邪恶。”

stats.type_text: 普通 中 铠甲

desc_en: Quite a few mages are drawn to the Vehement ranks, seeking to apply their knowledge and skills for the benefit of the common folk.
desc_zh: 不少法师希望运用自己的所学和能力造福平民百姓，便加入了奋武的行列。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

name_zh: 韦尔米尔的刺绣卡夫坦
desc_en: A well-made caftan, now battered and worn out, a distant echo of the life left behind.
desc_zh: 这件卡夫坦做工精良，不过已经破旧不堪，只能隐约看出主人从前的优渥。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: This ring used to belong to Velmir's brother. Now it serves as a silent reminder of the path he chose for himself.
desc_zh: 这枚戒指原本属于韦尔米尔他哥哥，如今戴在了韦尔米尔手上，静静地让他时刻铭记自己选择的人生之路。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 通用型 戒指

desc_en: For a long while, there existed an unspoken rule in Aldor that only those born into nobility can wear red velvet. However, during the last few decades, Brynn merchants have been showing increasingly less respect towards this custom.
desc_zh: 长久以来，奥尔多都有一条不成文的规定——只有出身贵族，才能穿戴红丝绒，只是布林的生意人最近几十年好像已经不怎么讲究这个了。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 斗篷

desc_en: It's set with an incredibly large morion that seems to be shifting its color every now and then... Or is it merely a trick of the light?
desc_zh: 镶了一颗奇大无比的烟晶石，好像时不时还会变色……只是光的原因吗？

desc_en: In knowledgeable hands, this staff can turn even the weakest poison into a deadly one.
desc_zh: 如果这根长杖到了经验丰富的毒师手里，效力再弱的毒物都能变成夺人性命的毒药。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杖

desc_en: I did. Thanks for reminding me. It should be right here... Yes, here you go. Don't lose it. It will come in handy once we get to Brynn.
desc_zh: 噢，你不说我都忘了。应该就在这里……嗯，给。别丢了，我们到了布林，这个就能派上用场了。

extra.en: Upon parting with this ring, Verren was, as always, stingy on details. It might come in handy at some point... But how?
extra.zh: 维伦给你这枚戒指的时候，也没告诉你多少东西。这首饰后面什么时候说不定能派上用场……能派上什么用场呢？

desc_en: Built to persevere - even cleaving it apart would take more than a single strike.
desc_zh: 做工扎实，就算直接一刀砍下去，都很难会断。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 腰带

desc_en: Armed with such a bow, an experienced archer can single-handedly stall the advance of a full squad of light infantry.
desc_zh: 有经验的弓箭手配上这样的弓，一个人就能轻松拦住一小队轻装步兵。

stats.type_text: 普通 弓 远程兵器

desc_en: Properly outfitting a commoner for war typically requires a collective effort, sometimes involving the entire extended family.
desc_zh: 平头百姓要想攒齐一身打仗的装备，常常需要倾尽一家之力，有时候甚至需要整个大家族帮衬。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 铠甲

desc_en: The presence of a dagger on one's belt is what sets apart an experienced warrior from a greenhorn: it gives you an indisputable edge the moment the fight moves to the ground.
desc_zh: 想知道一个战士有没有经验，就看他腰带上有没有匕首。两个人地上扭打的时候，腰上别了匕首，就必然会占据上风。

stats.type_text: 普通 匕首

desc_en: Only a seasoned fighter can handle a two-headed flail without embarrassing themselves.
desc_zh: 只有经验丰富的战士，用两头的连枷才不会出丑。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: Noticeably sturdier than standard soldier gloves - proof that their owner has lasted long enough to amass some decent coin.
desc_zh: 比普通的军用手套明显结实了不少，说明手套主人命够长，攒了不少金币。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 手套

desc_en: An obvious choice for any infantryman: a combination of common boots' practicality and some fairly decent protection.
desc_zh: 既像日常的靴子一样实用，还能提供保护，显然是步兵的不二选择。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 靴子

desc_en: It's hard to imagine armor which would protect from a direct hit with this axe.
desc_zh: 实在不知道什么样的防具能顶得住这种长斧。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: The two-handed flail is hardly the most widespread weapon. The reason is simple: few soldiers possess the strength, skill, and finesse to master it.
desc_zh: 双手连枷向来不甚受人青睐，毕竟没有多少人具备驾驭它的力气、经验和技巧。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: A reliable weapon which doesn't require much skill or maintenance, an easy choice for many common soldiers.
desc_zh: 简单可靠，不需要太多技巧，也不用专意保养，非常适合普通的士兵使用。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手锤棒

desc_en: An axe capable of cleaving open both the laminar armor of maaf riders and the breastplates of Nistrian cataphracts.
desc_zh: 不论玛弗骑兵的片甲还是尼斯特拉全甲骑兵的前胸甲，这种枪斧都能轻而易举劈成两半。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: The convenience and versatility of these polehammers garner them praise from the veteran soldiers of both the Council and the Magistrate.
desc_zh: 这种长柄锤操持方便，用法多样，因而备受王廷军与城联军的老兵推崇。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: The mace head is shaped in such a way that it's equally effective against both lightly and heavily armored opponents.
desc_zh: 这个钉头锤顶部造型独到，无论是敌人身着重甲还是轻甲，都能对其造成伤害。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: As one prominent Aldorian commander used to say, wars are waged by knights but are won with spears. Spears like this one.
desc_zh: 正如奥尔多的某位杰出将领所言，打仗开场要靠骑士，不过制胜就要靠这样的长矛了。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: A soldier adept with the sling can be every bit as lethal as a seasoned archer or crossbowman.
desc_zh: 士兵如果能熟练运用投石杖，那么杀敌的能力完全可以媲美久经沙场的弓弩射手。

stats.type_text: 普通 投石兵器 远程兵器

desc_en: This sword has witnessed many a front line and survived plenty of close battles.
desc_zh: 这把剑见证了许多悲壮的前线故事，经历了不少短兵相接的战役。

stats.type_text: 普通 单手刀剑

desc_en: Sometimes the simplest solution is the best one - this maul is a testament to it.
desc_zh: 这根大锤完美诠释了“最简单的设计有时候才是最好的设计”这个道理。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手锤棒

desc_en: In the chaotic months following the uprising, the Magistrate struggled to contain the surge of crime that swept over Brynn. The tide turned with the rise of vigilantes - well-armed volunteers who eventually bolstered the ranks of the reformed city guard.
desc_zh: 起义爆发之后，几个月里一片混乱，城联疲于应对席卷布林全城的犯罪浪潮。义勇出现之后，局势得以扭转——这些志愿者武装精良，最终加入了重组之后的城市卫队，壮大了卫队的力量。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 斗篷

desc_en: The bite of a viper is deadly, though it strikes only when disturbed.
desc_zh: 一旦被蝮蛇咬了，就必死无疑。不过，它只有被惊扰了，才会攻击。

extra.zh: 可以剖解。
蝮蛇

desc_en: The bite of a viper is deadly, though it strikes only when disturbed.
desc_zh: 一旦被蝮蛇咬了，就必死无疑。不过，它只有被惊扰了，才会攻击。

extra.zh: 可以剖解。
蝮蛇

desc_en: Visored barbutes are in no way inferior to sallets and bascinets. Choosing one over another is a matter of preference.
desc_zh: 面甲巴布特盔丝毫不比轻盔和中头盔逊色，具体选择哪种头盔主要取决于个人喜好。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 头盔

desc_en: High-born or not, some knights don't have a single coin to their name. Affording first-rate armor is out of the question, so is wearing a common soldier's kettle helmet. And that's where cervelliers come into play.
desc_zh: 骑士之中，不论出身贵贱，总是会有一些人身无分文。他们穿不起像样的盔甲，也不屑于戴平常士兵的圆顶锅盔，这种时候就会选择内盔。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 头盔

desc_en: One of the heaviest helmets out there, it can protect your head and neck from just about anything - not to mention how formidable it looks.
desc_zh: 这种头盔很沉，这种分量的世间少有。头盔外形霸气，几乎可以抵挡任何形式的攻击，充分保护头颈。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 头盔

desc_en: Its glory years are long behind it. In this day and age, Aldorian armorsmiths are capable of forging much more efficient designs. And even though the visor adds an extra layer of protection, the whole thing is still outrageously outdated.
desc_zh: 这种头盔是很久很久以前的防具，奥尔多的盔匠今时今日锻造的形制比这种好了很多。虽然加了面甲，多了一层防护，但整个头盔依然是老得不能再老的古董了。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 头盔

desc_en: Fear makes the wolf bigger than he is, and it's hard to see a damn thing in one of these sallets - as a result, they are often worn by soldiers fighting on the front line.
desc_zh: 人面对野狼时，恐慌会令其内心夸大野兽的体型，不过戴上轻盔之后，你基本上就看不见什么东西了，所以，阵型前排的士兵一般会戴这种头盔。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 头盔

desc_en: Complete with a full visor, sentinets offer protection on par with the more widespread sallets and barbutes. In some aspects, they even surpass them.
desc_zh: 森提亚盔带上完整的面甲，防护性能就能媲美更加常见的夏雷尔和巴布特，有些方面甚至更强。

stats.type_text: 普通 重型 头盔

desc_en: When asked about its recipe, alchemists prefer to maintain a cryptic silence.
desc_zh: 每当人们问起这个东西的配方，炼金术师往往都只会保持神秘的沉默。

desc_en: When asked about its recipe, alchemists prefer to maintain a cryptic silence.
desc_zh: 每当人们问起这个东西的配方，炼金术师往往都只会保持神秘的沉默。

desc_en: Noble Marrs, Zeineshes, and Chervenians take pride in adorning their clothing with traditional folk patterns, seizing every opportunity to assert their culture in blatant defiance of the ruling Ksifit minority.
desc_zh: 玛斯族、切涅什族和车尔文族的贵族乐于在衣物纹绣传统的民族图案，抓住一切机会表现本族文化，公然对抗统治阶级的少数民族柯西菲特人。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 轻型 腰带

desc_en: Maces are held in great regard in Skadia, where even high-born military commanders don't scoff at using them on the battlefield - although this particular weapon looks somewhat ceremonial in nature.
desc_zh: 斯卡迪亚人十分崇尚钉头锤，即便是出身高贵的将领也不会鄙视这类兵器，不过这一根看起来是礼兵器，形制的意义大于实用价值。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 单手锤棒

desc_en: A predecessor to halberds, a voulge is still occasionally used by guards and some militias.
desc_zh: 弗日虽然是戟的前身，但守卫和某些民兵还在使用。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手斧

desc_en: Thickly woven and fitted with a quilted mantelet - the only source of comfort a wandering mage can truly rely on.
desc_zh: 织法厚密，还有一条夹棉的披肩，这件斗篷常常是行者法师唯一的真朋友。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 斗篷

desc_en: These cowls are usually pulled over one's eyes: many commoners believe that a mage's gaze brings woes and misfortune, so why not ease their fears?
desc_zh: 很多平民百姓认为法师的目光会带来灾祸和厄运，法师通常会戴这种兜帽遮掩双眼，免得惹人恐慌。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 头盔

desc_en: There are mages who make a living by wandering the world, offering their services to anyone willing to pay. Most of them suffer a miserable fate: some die after taking on a contract they can't handle, some join brigand gangs, while others fall victim to the mob, which is quick to act upon its prejudice.
desc_zh: 有些法师云游四方，谁愿意出钱请他们帮忙，他们就替谁办事，以此谋生。这种行者法师最终的境地多数都不是很好——有的接自己搞不定的契据，死了；有的成了土匪；有的则因为偏见，死在了暴民手中。

stats.type_text: 普通 轻型 铠甲

desc_en: There isn't a single agricultural tool which hasn't been repurposed for military use.
desc_zh: 只要是个农具，就都能改出军用版本。

stats.type_text: 普通 长杆刃器

desc_en: A step above the kettle helmet, tougher and more resistant to both melee and ranged weaponry.
desc_zh: 比圆顶锅盔好上一档，更结实，抵御远近兵器的效果更好。

stats.type_text: 普通 中 头盔

desc_en: A weapon of uncertain times - a humble scythe blade, fastened to a wooden handle.
desc_zh: 普通的镰刀绑了木柄，适合时局动荡的年代。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: It's sharp to such a degree that a strong enough strike will easily separate your opponent's head from their body.
desc_zh: 十分锋利，只要力量够大，一刀就能砍下敌人的首级。

stats.type_text: 普通 双手刀剑

desc_en: Hand imagery is considered a powerful ward in Aldor, capable of protecting its user from misfortune, sickness, and curses.
desc_zh: 奥多尔的人认为手掌的图案能够辟邪，可以防止佩戴之人遭受厄运、不幸和诅咒或罹患疾病。

stats.type_text: 独一无二 防御型 项链

desc_en: ...All those pampered clerks and merchants, who never leave the city walls, know nothing about warfare apart from what they read in chivalric romances. Such buffoons tend to assume that battles are won with the skill and valor of a few individual soldiers, the so-called heroes.##This line of thinking is complete rubbish. Yes, personal skill will undoubtedly save your hide if you get into a tavern brawl or decide to duel for the honor of your dame, no argument here. But the moment two war parties clash on the battlefield, the importance of it falls off. A battle is no place for dueling rules, fancy swordplay, or codes of honor.##A month of drills under an experienced commander is all it takes for a mob of yesterday's peasants to hold their ground against bandits, who may be more competent individually, yet incapable of forming a line. Battles aren't won with superior numbers or better equipment but rather with good plans and the ability to execute them.##Understanding when to attack, when to turtle up, and when to press the advantage, preventing the enemy from regrouping and gathering their wits - this is what truly separates a sloppy duelist or a yesterdays' thug from a real soldier.
desc_zh: ……娇生惯养的文员和生意人对于战争的了解，全部源于宣扬骑士精神的传奇故事。这些蠢货以为胜负归根结底取决于少数士兵——即所谓的英雄——的战斗能力和胆魄。##这种考虑想法纯粹是胡扯。如果是在酒馆斗殴或为了心爱的姑娘与人对决，毫无疑问，你的战斗能力越强，胜算就越大。然而，两军交战之时，个体对于胜负的这种影响就小多了，因为战役讲的不是对决的规则，也不是荣辱道德。##即便是一群农民，经过良将一个月的操练，也能抵挡土匪的攻击。后者虽然各自的战斗能力胜过农民，但是未经训练，无法形成有效的战线。作战取胜依赖的并非人数优势或兵甲优势，而是良好的作战规划和执行能力。##正儿八经的士兵懂得何时进攻、何时固守、何时乘胜追击，不给敌人丝毫集结或喘息的机会，这些才是他们与懒散的对决手或恶徒真正的区别。

extra.en: "History of the Trollslayers, Their Victories and Defeats, Witnessed First-Hand"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Warfare abilities:~/~##~lg~Seize the Initiative~/~#~lg~War Cry~/~#~y~Opportune Moment~/~#~y~Setup~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《亲眼见证：“巨魔杀手”的历史、胜利与败北》##~gr~可以学习若干搏斗能力：~/~##~lg~掌握主动~/~#~lg~战吼~/~#~y~把握时机~/~#~y~准备就绪~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。

extra.en: A memoirs by a retired sergeant of the Trollslayers, a legendary free company which, in spite of its own name, has never encountered a single troll.
extra.zh: 回忆录的作者是传奇自由佣兵团的退伍军官。佣兵团尽管名叫“巨魔杀手”，但是其实并未见过巨魔。
作者：黑脸·拉尔斯

desc_en: ( . . . )##- In order to keep peace, the ruler shall never forget about war.##- A poorly trained soldier can cause just as much harm on a battlefield as enemy spies and saboteurs outside of it.##- If there's a possibility of forcing your choice of the battlefield upon the enemy, it shall be pursued by all means.##- Exploit every available opening. The ends justify the means.##- Know your opponent. Even the bravest and the most skillful knight will perish if he charges blindly into a pikemen line.##- Battles can often be won before they even begin. Make use of skirmishing to avoid a decisive battle, break the enemy's morale, sow uncertainty among their soldiers. A good fight is never clean.##- Numerical superiority is not always an advantage. Without proper guidance it might crumble upon itself. In the right circumstances, a single soldier can defeat a dozen foes, especially if they approach him one by one...
desc_zh: （……）##-兵者，国之大事，存亡之重，不可不时念也。##-治军乱者，交和则溃，其害甚于间。##-虚实者，善用则益于胜矣。##-不知彼，虽勇骑骁士，唐突亦枪陈之鬼耳。##-制胜之法不在战，散兵能解要役，敌饱能饥之，佚能劳之，安能间之，诡道者，兵之利也。##-兵非贵益多也，武进则一可当十……

extra.en: "The Art of Strategy"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Warfare abilities:~/~##~lg~Offensive Tactic~/~#~lg~Defensive Tactic~/~#~y~Right on Target~/~#~y~Intimidation~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《兵法》##~gr~可以学习若干搏斗能力：~/~##~lg~攻击战术~/~#~lg~防御战术~/~#~y~正中目标~/~#~y~震慑~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。

extra.en: The most popular edition of "The Art of Strategy", its authorship is credited to at least a dozen different military commanders, scholars, and government officials.
extra.zh: 这是《兵法》流传最广的版本，各界认为本书著者至少包含多名军队将领、文士和政府官员等十数人。
作者：佚名

desc_en: ...Other than horse archers and the ever-present threat of ambushes, the Maaf Empire has prepared yet another nasty surprise for us. Akin to venomous beasts, which crawl into the tents of careless soldiers, maaf assassins prey on oblivious commanders.##The locals call these knaves the Shadows, the name reflecting their dastardly nature perfectly. And, just like their namesakes, they're never too far behind from our high-ranking military officials and garrison leaders, all while remaining completely unnoticeable.##The Shadows strike only upon gathering full information about their mark's routine. Unlike common spies and assassins, who are fond of poisons and crossbows, the maaf Shadows always get close and personal.##More often than not, they disguise themselves as commoners or merchants in order to attack in the middle of a busy street. Once they get close to their victim, they kill it with a single well-placed strike and then disappear in the resulting commotion. The only defense against such tactics is a sizable escort and the utmost vigilance.##Even if discovered in time, the Shadows remain extremely dangerous. They charge towards their target, attempting to carve their way through the guards and quickly disposing of the unwary in a whirlwind of steel and magic. Even when mortally wounded, they sometimes still manage to reach their mark and, upon finishing it off, proceed sowing death among the remaining retinue...
desc_zh: ……玛弗帝国不仅有擅长骑射的骑兵和神出鬼没的游击部队，还有一群我们难以提防的刺客。玛弗的刺客专门刺杀疏于防备的将领，有如毒虫钻入营帐毒杀疏于防备的士兵一般。##当地人称其为“鬼影”，这个称呼充分体现了其行径之奸险。他们会像影子一样，时刻跟在目标——军队大将或兵营的指挥官身边。##鬼影不会轻易行动，只有完全掌握目标的日常行动才会出手。寻常的间谍和刺客偏好下毒或弩弓，然而玛弗的刺客往往近身行刺。##鬼影为了能够在繁忙的街道行刺，通常会扮成平民或商贩的模样。他们首先会看准攻击部位，接近目标，一击毙命，然后消失在骚乱的人群之中。防范这种刺杀，只有加强防卫部署，时刻保持高度警惕。##鬼影即便被当场发现，依然极度危险。他们会突破卫兵的拦截，冲向目标，趁着慌乱了结对方。就算身受重伤，他们有时也能接近猎物，将其杀害之后，还会攻击猎物身边的其他人……

extra.en: "Shadows of Ahjat. A Reminder to the Commanders in Service of His Majesty"##~gr~Allows you to learn the following Warfare abilities:~/~##~lg~Against the Odds~/~#~lg~Finisher~/~#~y~Tactical Advantage~/~##Reading this book grants some ~y~Experience~/~.
extra.zh: 《艾哈雅特鬼影：军中将领的梦魇》##~gr~可以学习若干搏斗能力：~/~##~lg~力挽狂澜~/~#~lg~最后一击~/~#~y~战术优势~/~##阅读本书可以获得一定的~y~经验~/~。

extra.en: This text was written during the latest war between Aldor and the Maaf Empire, an unsuccessful attempt at keeping military governors and commanders safe.
extra.zh: 本书著于奥尔多与玛弗帝国最近一次开战期间，然而并未增强军队长官和将领的安全防范意识。
作者：司务长加鲁斯

desc_en: ...Despite what many Aldorians tend to believe, the unbridled nature of dwarves and their remarkable resilience on the battlefield don't really stem from their love for mushroom infusions and mead (even though there's a grain of truth to that).##Many humans are openly wary of having any dealings with dwarves, and only the most avaricious merchants are willing to undertake a journey to Fjall. Upon returning from the seaside settlements of the Norrheim clan, they usually start with a bunch of tales about sea leviathans before eventually bringing up peculiar dwarven customs.##All dwarves, be it whalers or berserkers, live by a simple principle - "all or nothing". Freedom or death, wealth or ruin, glory or dishonor... Their distaste for compromises comes with mother's milk: combined with a cult of weaponry and warfare, it makes Fjall rather troublesome for its more civilized neighbors.##When dwarves loot and raid, they do it with unquenchable greed. When they protect their homes - it's bestial fury. This primal savagery unsettles even seasoned veterans, and only a well organized line of defense can stand up against the dwarven onslaught.##Fully aware of the aforementioned fact, dwarves prefer to attack only when they know their victim can't offer much resistance. For example, when a neighboring country is weakened by war and can no longer afford the necessary number of patrols...
desc_zh: ……很多奥尔多人常常认为，矮人之所以桀骜不驯，他们在战场上之所以如此顽强，是因为他们热衷蘑菇药汤和蜂蜜酒，然而事实并非尽然如此。##许多人类都会尽量避免与矮人接触，只有爱财如命的商人愿意去弗约走一趟。这些人每次从海边的诺尔海姆部落回来，都会跟大家讲起巨型海怪的故事，最后往往都会说到矮人古怪的风土。##所有矮人，无论是捕鲸人还是狂战士，人生信条都很简单——“决不妥协”，要么自由，要么死亡，要么繁华，要么破灭，要么无比荣耀，要么身败名裂……矮人从小就明白绝不妥协的道理，加之精通兵器与战斗，令弗约周边的地区头痛不已。##矮人入侵掠夺的时候，气势汹汹，如脱缰野马；保护家园的时候，杀气腾腾，似猛虎一般。他们狂野凶残，即便是久经沙场的老手也无法坦然面对，只有部署精到的防线才能抵挡矮人猛烈的侵袭。##矮人非常明白自己的长处和短板，从不打无胜算之仗，只有在对方几无还手之力的时候，例如邻国战后百业凋敝，无力调遣足够的人马巡查疆土，只有这种时候，矮人才会发动进攻……
