desc_en: Delivers a strike with ~r~-66%~/~ Weapon Damage to themselves or an ally, granting ~lg~"Battle Rage"~/~ to both for ~w~6~/~ turns (~w~12~/~ turns if striking themselves):##~lg~+10%~/~ Weapon Damage#~lg~+7.5%~/~ Crit Chance#~lg~+20%~/~ Crit Efficiency
desc_zh: 击打自己或友方一次，本次击打兵器伤害~r~-66%~/~，令双方获得~w~6~/~回合的~lg~“激昂”~/~（如果击打自己，那么存续~w~12~/~个回合））：##兵器伤害~lg~+10%~/~#暴击几率~lg~+7.5%~/~#暴击效果~lg~+20%~/~

desc_en: Makes a huge amount of ~w~noise~/~. Reanimates all slain Restless within ~w~30~/~ tiles, replenishing them ~lg~50%~/~ Max Health and ~bl~50%~/~ Max Energy, as well as granting ~lg~-10%~/~ Fumble Chance, ~lg~+5%~/~ Crit Chance, and ~lg~+10%~/~ Accuracy for ~w~9~/~ turns.##The reanimated Undead's Armor Durability is set to ~w~0%~/~, and all their abilities are put on a ~w~50%~/~ cooldown.##Spotting an enemy puts the skill on cooldown.#Each degree of ~r~Injury~/~ reduces the skill's cooldown by ~lg~25%~/~.
desc_zh: 产生巨大~w~声响~/~，复活方圆~w~30~/~格之内所有被杀的不死生灵，令他们立刻恢复生命上限~lg~50%~/~的生命和精力上限~bl~50%~/~的精力，还令他们~w~9~/~个回合之内失手几率~lg~-10%~/~、暴击几率~lg~+5%~/~、准度~lg~+10%~/~。##复活的不死生灵防具耐久变为~w~0%~/~，而且所有能力当前冷却时间缩短~w~50%~/~。##发现敌人会令这个技能进入冷却。#这个技能的冷却时间可以缩短，缩短幅度为~lg~25%~/~乘以一个倍数，这个倍数等于目标所有~r~伤情~/~的和（1处轻伤=1，1处中度受伤=2，1处重伤=3）。

desc_en: Applies three adjacent targets with ~r~/*CTA*/%~/~ Counter Chance until the next turn (the effect doesn't stack), then deals ~w~/*Damage*/ Crushing Damage~/~ to them with ~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~ Accuracy, ~w~/*FMB_Hit*/%~/~ Fumble Chance, ~w~/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~ Armor Penetration, ~w~/*CRT_Hit*/%~/~ Crit Chance, and ~w~/*Immob_Chance*/%~/~ Immobilization Chance. Then allows the character to ~w~reposition~/~ to an adjacent tile.##The damage dealt depends on the equipped ~w~boots'~/~ Protection.##Hitting a target applies it with ~r~+/*FMB*/%~/~ Fumble Chance, ~r~/*CRT*/%~/~ Crit Chance, and ~r~/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~ Weapon Damage for ~w~3~/~ turns.##The effect stacks up to ~w~2~/~ times.##With ~w~/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~Staggers~/~ the target if it remains adjacent after receiving a hit.
desc_zh: 令目标下一回合之前反击几率~r~/*CTA*/%~/~，（这个效果不能叠加）然后对三个邻近方格造成~w~/*Damage*/点钝击伤害~/~，本次伤害准度为~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~、失手几率为~w~/*FMB_Hit*/%~/~、护甲穿透为~w~/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~、暴击几率为~w~/*CRT_Hit*/%~/~、限制移动几率为~w~/*Immob_Chance*/%~/~，然后可以~w~调整位置~/~，移到邻近方格。##伤害的数值取决于所穿~w~足部护具~/~的防护。##命中目标会令其~w~3~/~个回合之内失手几率~r~+/*FMB*/%~/~、暴击几率~r~/*CRT*/%~/~、兵器伤害~r~/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~。##这组效果可以叠加，最多~w~2~/~层。##如果本次击打命中目标，而且运用这个技能之后，目标还在邻近方格，那么有~w~/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~的几率令其~w~失衡~/~。

desc_en: Reanimates a slain Undead, replenishing it ~lg~66%~/~ Max Health and ~bl~66%~/~ Max Energy.##The reanimated Undead's Armor Durability is set to ~w~0%~/~, and all their abilities are put on a ~w~50%~/~ cooldown.
desc_zh: 令一个被杀的不死生灵复活，令其恢复生命上限~lg~66%~/~的生命和精力上限~bl~66%~/~的精力。##复活的不死生灵护甲耐久变为~w~0%~/~，且所有能力冷却时间缩短~w~50%~/~。

desc_en: Deals ~ur~/*Unholy_Damage*/ Unholy Damage~/~.##Replenishes Health for the amount of damage dealt. If Health is at ~r~100%~/~, increases its maximum amount for ~w~9~/~ turns instead.
desc_zh: 造成~ur~/*Unholy_Damage*/ 点邪术伤害~/~。##立刻恢复一定量的生命，恢复量等于本次所造成伤害的数值。如果生命目前为~r~100%~/~，那么本次咒法则会令生命上限在后续~w~9~/~个回合之内提高。

desc_en: ~w~Jumps~/~ to the targeted tile.##This skill can't be used if one of the paws is ~r~Severely Injured~/~.
desc_zh: ~w~扑~/~向目标方格。##只要有一只掌~r~重伤~/~，这个技能就无法运用。

desc_en: Takes a shot with ~lg~+2~/~ Range.##Each tile of distance to the target grants the shot ~lg~+/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~ Weapon Damage, ~lg~+/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~ Armor Penetration, and ~lg~+/*Bodypart_Damage*/%~/~ Bodypart Damage.##If equipped with a ~w~sling~/~, each tile of distance to the target also grants the shot ~lg~+/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~ Accuracy.##If the target isn't ~w~hostile~/~, ~lg~doubles~/~ all distance-related bonuses and, upon hitting the target, with ~w~/*Confuse_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~Confuses~/~ it for ~w~10~/~ turns.
desc_zh: 射出一箭或投射一次，这一下射程~lg~+2~/~。##目标与你的距离会令这一下兵器伤害、护甲穿透和肢体伤害获得加成，加成数值分别等于~lg~/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~、~lg~/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~与~lg~/*Bodypart_Damage*/%~/~和距离的乘积。##如果装备了~w~投石兵器~/~，那么目标与你的距离会令这一下准度提高，具体增幅等于~lg~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~和距离的乘积。##如果目标目前没有~w~敌意~/~，那么上述与距离有关的增益全部~lg~翻倍~/~，另外如果命中目标，还有~w~/*Confuse_Chance*/%~/~的几率令其~w~混乱~/~~w~10~/~个回合。

desc_en: Makes a huge amount of ~w~noise~/~.##Spotting an enemy puts this skill on a ~w~7~/~ turn cooldown.
desc_zh: 造成巨大~w~声响~/~。##发现敌人会令这个技能当前冷却时间增加~w~7~/~个回合。

desc_en: Delivers a strike to a ~w~3х2~/~ tile area with ~r~-200%~/~ Knockback Chance as well as ~lg~+/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~ Weapon Damage and ~lg~+/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~ Armor Penetration for each degree of ~r~Injury~/~ affecting the targets within the skill's area of effect.##This strike can't ~w~knock~/~ back its targets.##Hitting a target applies it with ~r~-5%~/~ Bleed Resistance for ~w~6~/~ turns for each enemy within the skill's area of effect.##The effect stacks up to ~w~6~/~ times.##If the strike kills at least one target, delivers it again to the same area (but no more than once).
desc_zh: 向一个~w~3x2~/~格大小的区域击打一次，本次击打击退几率~r~-200%~/~，兵器伤害和护甲穿透获得增益，增益数值分别等于~lg~/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~和~lg~/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~乘以一个倍数，这个倍数等于这个技能效果范围内目标~r~伤情~/~的和（1处轻伤=1，1处中度受伤=2，1处重伤=3）。##本次击打不会~w~击退~/~目标。##这个技能的效果范围之内每有一个敌人，那么命中目标就会令其~w~6~/~个回合之内出血抗性~r~-5%~/~。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~6~/~层。##如果这次击打击杀目标，那么再次对同一范围运用这个技能（只能重复一次）。

desc_en: A nexus of pure Aether energy, delicate and volatile.
desc_zh: 汇聚了纯粹的以太能量，易碎而且不稳定。

desc_en: A nexus of pure Aether energy, delicate and volatile.
desc_zh: 汇聚了纯粹的以太能量，易碎而且不稳定。

desc_en: Delivers a strike with ~lg~+25%~/~ Damage and ~lg~+100%~/~ Energy Drain. Burns the target's Energy for the amount of damage dealt and replenishes the same amount of Energy to the summoner.
desc_zh: 击打一次，伤害~lg~+25%~/~、精力吸取~lg~+100%~/~。令目标损耗精力，损耗数量等于所造成伤害的数值，同时令召唤者恢复等量的精力。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~r~"Mark of the Feast"~/~ for ~w~3~/~ turns:##~r~-26%~/~ Bleed Resistance#~r~-13%~/~ Dodge Chance#Grants all received strikes ~lg~+9%~/~ Life Drain.##Receiving a ~r~Bleeding~/~ prolongs the effect's duration by ~r~1~/~ turn.
desc_zh: 令目标获得存续~w~3~/~回合的~r~“在劫难逃”~/~：##出血抗性~r~-26%~/~#闪躲几率~r~-13%~/~#令受到的所有击打生命吸取~lg~+9%~/~##每获得一处~r~出血~/~，上述效果的存续时间就延长~r~1~/~回合。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Massacre"~/~ for ~w~10~/~ turns:##~lg~+5%~/~ Armor Penetration#~lg~+12%~/~ Bodypart Damage#~lg~+7%~/~ Bleed Chance#~lg~+3%~/~ Crit Chance##Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~IV~/~).##Basic axe strikes prolong the effect's duration by ~lg~1~/~ turn (up to ~w~10~/~) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn).##Only one ~w~Stance~/~ effect can be active at a time.
desc_zh: 触发~w~10~/~个回合的~lg~“大开杀戒”~/~：##护甲穿透~lg~+5%~/~#肢体伤害~lg~+12%~/~#出血几率~lg~+7%~/~#暴击几率~lg~+3%~/~##运用同一能力树的技能会令这个效果叠加1层（最多叠到~w~四~/~层）##单手斧普通击打会令这个效果存续时间延长~lg~1~/~个回合（最多~w~10~/~个回合），但是会令效果层数减少（每回合最多一次）。##~lg~站姿~/~效果无法多个同时生效。

desc_en: Shoots a fiery ray towards the targeted tile, dealing ~o~/*Fire_Damage_Ray*/ Fire Damage~/~ to all targets in its path and with ~w~/*Chance*/%~/~ chance ~o~Igniting~/~ them for ~w~3-4~/~ turns.##The ray explodes in the targeted tile, ~o~Igniting~/~ it and dealing ~o~/*Fire_Damage_Explosion*/ Fire Damage~/~ to a ~w~3x3~/~ tile area.##The explosion's damage increases by ~lg~20%~/~ for each enemy the ray passes through.
desc_zh: 向所选方格射出一道火焰，对其过的所有目标造成~o~/*Fire_Damage_Ray*/点灼烧伤害~/~，并有~w~/*Chance*/%~/~的几率将他们~o~点燃~/~，燃烧持续~w~3-4~/~个回合。##火焰落入所选方格后爆炸，将方格~o~点燃~/~，同时对~w~3x3~/~方格大小的区域造成~o~/*Fire_Damage_Explosion*/点灼烧伤害~/~。##爆炸有可能获得~o~伤害~/~增益，以~lg~20%~/~为基数，火焰穿过1个目标，爆炸伤害增加20%*1；穿过2个目标，伤害增加20%*2，以此类推。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~r~/*CTA*/%~/~ Counter Chance until the next turn (the effect doesn't stack), then deals ~w~/*Damage*/ Crushing Damage~/~ with ~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~ Accuracy, ~w~/*FMB*/%~/~ Fumble Chance, ~w~/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~ Armor Penetration, ~w~/*CRT*/%~/~ Crit Chance, ~w~/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~ Stagger Chance, and ~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ Knockback Chance.##The damage dealt depends on the equipped ~w~boots'~/~ Protection.##Hitting the target applies it with ~r~/*Block_Power*/%~/~ Max Block Power, ~r~/*Stun_Resistance*/%~/~ Control Resistance, ~r~/*Knockback_Resistance*/%~/~ Move Resistance, and ~r~/*Crit_Avoid*/%~/~ Crit Avoidance for ~w~4~/~ turns.##The effect stacks up to ~w~2~/~ times.
desc_zh: 令目标下一回合之前的反击几率~r~/*CTA*/%~/~，（这个效果不能叠加）然后造成~w~/*Damage*/点钝击伤害~/~，本次伤害准度为~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~、失手几率~w~/*FMB*/%~/~、护甲穿透~w~/*Armor_Piercing*/~/~、暴击几率为~w~/*CRT*/%~/~、破衡几率为~w~/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~、击退几率~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~。##伤害的数值取决于所穿~w~足部护具~/~的防护。##命中目标会令其~w~4~/~个回合之内格挡力量上限~r~/*Block_Power*/%~/~、控制抗性~r~/*Stun_Resistance*/%~/~、位移抗性~r~/*Knockback_Resistance*/%~/~、暴击避免~r~/*Crit_Avoid*/%~/~。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~2~/~层。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Mighty Swing"~/~ for ~w~1~/~ turn:##~lg~+40%~/~ Weapon Damage#~lg~+40%~/~ Stagger Chance#~lg~+20%~/~ Stun Chance#~lg~+40%~/~ Bodypart Damage#~lg~+40%~/~ Armor Damage#~r~-200%~/~ Counter Chance

Killing enemies grants ~lg~+/*Hand_Efficiency*/%~/~ Hands Efficiency and ~lg~/*Ability_Cost*/%~/~ Abilities Energy Cost for ~w~3~/~ turns, and also reduces the cooldowns of this ability tree and all ~w~Attack~/~ skills by ~lg~2~/~ turns.##The effect stacks up to ~w~2~/~ times.##The bonuses to Hands Efficiency and Abilities Energy Cost depend on the number of learned ~w~Weaponry~/~ abilities.
desc_zh: 击杀敌人会令~w~3~/~个回合之内主、副手效果~lg~+/*Hand_Efficiency*/%~/~、能力精力消耗~lg~/*Ability_Cost*/%~/~，还会令同一能力树技能与所有~w~攻击~/~技能的剩余冷却时间缩短~lg~2~/~个回合。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~2~/~层。##主、副手效果和能力精力消耗的加成大小取决于习得了几项~w~兵器~/~能力。

desc_en: ~lg~Doubles~/~ the duration of ~lg~"Rapid Restoration"~/~ on an ally and instantly refreshes one of their cooldowns.##Reduces the cooldown of ~w~"Summon the Hive"~/~ by ~lg~3~/~ turns.
desc_zh: 随机令一个友方的一项技能立刻结束冷却，同时令其~lg~“迅速恢复”~/~的存续时间~lg~延长一倍~/~。##令~w~“唤巢”~/~的冷却时间缩短~lg~3~/~个回合。

desc_en: Performs a ~w~charge~/~ towards the target and delivers a strike with ~lg~+66%~/~ Crit Efficiency, ~lg~+66%~/~ Daze Chance, and ~lg~+66%~/~ Armor Penetration##This skill can be used only while affected by ~lg~"Murk"~/~.
desc_zh: 向目标~w~突进~/~一次，并击打一次，本次击打暴击效果~lg~+66%~/~、击晕几率~lg~+66%~/~、护甲穿透~lg~+66%~/~。##这项技能只有~lg~“幽隐”~/~状态下可以运用。

desc_en: ~w~Teleports~/~ to the targeted tile.##Grants ~lg~+18%~/~ Dodge Chance for ~w~3~/~ turns and reduces all cooldowns by ~lg~3~/~ turns.##This skill can't be used while affected by ~w~Immobilization~/~ or ~r~"Net"~/~.
desc_zh: ~w~瞬间移动~/~至目标方格。##令自身接下来~w~3~/~回合之内闪躲几率~lg~+18%~/~，令当前所有剩余冷却时间缩短~lg~3~/~回合。##~w~移动受限~/~或~r~“束手束脚”~/~期间，这项技能无法运用。

desc_en: Performs a ~w~charge~/~ towards the target and delivers a strike to its most damaged body part with ~lg~+/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~ Stagger Chance, ~lg~+/*Bodypart_Damage*/%~/~ Bodypart Damage, and ~lg~+/*Bleeding_Chance*/%~/~ Bleed Chance.##If the strike doesn't cause an ~r~Injury~/~, reduces the skill's cooldown by ~lg~4~/~ turns.
desc_zh: 向目标~w~突进~/~一次，向其状态最差的身体部位击打一次，本次击打破衡几率~lg~+/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~、肢体伤害~lg~+/*Bodypart_Damage*/%~/~、出血几率~lg~+/*Bleeding_Chance*/%~/~。##如果击打没有令目标~r~受伤~/~，则令这项技能的冷却时间缩短~w~4~/~回合。

desc_en: Delivers a strike to one of the target's legs with ~lg~+/*CRT*/%~/~ Crit Chance.##If the target is adjacent, grants the strike ~lg~+/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~ Weapon Damage and ~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ Knockback Chance.##If the target is ~w~1~/~ tile away, grants the strike ~lg~+/*Bodypart_Damage*/%~/~ Bodypart Damage and ~lg~+/*Immob_Chance*/%~/~ Immobilization Chance.
desc_zh: 击打一次目标的一条腿，本次击打暴击几率~lg~+/*CRT*/%~/~。##如果目标位于邻近方格，那么本次击打兵器伤害~lg~+/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~、击退几率~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~。##如果目标与你相距~w~1~/~个方格，那么本次击打肢体伤害~lg~+/*Bodypart_Damage*/%~/~、限制移动几率~lg~+/*Immob_Chance*/%~/~。

desc_en: ~w~Repositions~/~ to a tile with a fleshy corpse and devours it, replenishing ~lg~50%~/~ Max Health and ~bl~50%~/~ Max Energy, as well as transforming into a stronger ~w~Ghoul~/~.##Instead of transforming, ~w~Large Ghouls~/~ are granted one of the following effects for ~w~30~/~ turns:##~lg~"Rapid Restoration"~/~#~lg~"Sturdiness"~/~ #~lg~"Battle Rage"~/~
desc_zh: ~w~调整位置~/~，移到有肉尸的方格，吃下肉尸，立刻恢复生命上限~lg~50%~/~的生命和精力上限~bl~50%~/~的精力，变成更为强大的~w~食尸鬼~/~。#~w~大食尸鬼~/~不会变身，而是获得以下一个效果，存续~w~30~/~个回合：##~lg~迅速恢复~/~#~lg~矫健~/~#~lg~激昂~/~

desc_en: Loses ~r~3%~/~ Max Health per turn while there's both an enemy and an ally within Vision. If the Martyr is Alarmed, and there are no enemies within Vision, the Health loss is ~r~tripled~/~.##Upon death, grants ~lg~"Blood Oath"~/~ to a random ally within Vision for ~w~99~/~ turns:##~lg~+33%~/~ Life Drain#~lg~+33%~/~ Healing Efficiency#~lg~-33%~/~ Abilities Energy Cost
desc_zh: 只要视野之内同时存在敌方和友方，每回合就损失生命上限~r~3%~/~的生命。如果殉教信徒处于“警觉”状态，而且视野之内没有敌方，那么生命损失速度加快~r~两倍~/~。##死亡时，令视野之内的随机一个友方获得存续~w~99~/~回合的~lg~“血誓”~/~：##生命吸取~lg~+33%~/~#治疗效果~lg~+33%~/~#能力精力消耗~lg~-33%~/~

desc_en: Darkness ~lg~doesn't apply~/~ penalties to Vision, and attacks against targets within it ~lg~don't receive~/~ the penalties to Accuracy and Fumble Chance.
desc_zh: ~w~黑暗~/~~lg~不会~/~影响属性，攻击暗处的敌人时，准度和失手几率也~lg~不会~/~因此而受到影响。

desc_en: Remaining on the same tile grants ~lg~-3%~/~ Cooldowns Duration, ~lg~+3%~/~ Weapon Damage, and ~lg~+3%~/~ Counter Chance for ~w~4~/~ turns.##The effect stacks up to ~w~3~/~ times.##Moving to other tiles removes the effect (except when moving with ~w~Maneuvers~/~).
desc_zh: 原地不动会令~w~4~/~个回合之内冷却时间~lg~-3%~/~、兵器伤害~lg~+3%~/~、反击几率~lg~+3%~/~。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~3~/~层。##移到其他方格会令这组效果消失。（~w~机动技能~/~移动除外）

desc_en: When used on an ally, replenishes ~lg~6%~/~ Max Health to them, prolongs the duration of every positive effect on them by ~lg~3~/~ turns, and also removes a random negative effect.##When used on an enemy, deals ~g~/*Poison_Damage*/ Poison~/~ and ~ur~/*Unholy_Damage*/ Unholy Damage~/~, prolongs the duration of all negative effects on them by ~r~3~/~ turns, and reduces the duration of all positive effects by ~r~1~/~ turn.
desc_zh: ##对友方发动时：令其立刻恢复生命上限~lg~6%~/~的生命、所有正面效果存续时间延长~lg~3~/~个回合，同时随机消除一个负面效果。##对敌方运用时：造成~g~/*Poison_Damage*/点中毒伤害~/~和~ur~/*Unholy_Damage*/点邪术伤害~/~，令其所有负面效果存续时间延长~r~3~/~个回合、所有正面效果缩短~r~1~/~个回合。

desc_en: Grants ~lg~"Oath of Guidance"~/~ to an ally for ~w~9~/~ turns:##~lg~+6%~/~ Accuracy for each miss#~lg~-6%~/~ Fumble Chance for each fumble#~lg~+6%~/~ Dodge Chance for each received strike or shot#~lg~-6%~/~ Damage Taken for each tile of distance to the closest enemy##All bonuses stack up to ~w~6~/~ times.
desc_zh: 令一个友方获得~lg~“导引誓言”~/~，持续~w~9~/~个回合：##每有一次没有命中，准度~lg~+6%~/~；每失手一次，失手几率~lg~-6%~/~；每被击打或射击/投射命中一次，闪躲几率~lg~+6%~/~；与最近敌人的距离每多一个方格，所受伤害就~lg~-6%~/~。##上述所有加成最多叠加~w~6~/~层。

desc_en: Grants ~lg~"Oath of Protection"~/~ to an ally for ~w~3~/~ turns:##Transfers ~w~100%~/~ of the received damage to the caster.#Receiving damage reduces all of the caster's cooldowns by ~lg~1~/~ turn.
desc_zh: 令一个友方获得~w~3~/~个回合的~lg~“护佑誓言”~/~：##自身所受伤害的~w~100%~/~转给施法者。#施法者受到伤害时，自身所有冷却时间缩短~lg~1~/~个回合。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Oath of Retribution"~/~ for ~w~3~/~ turns:##Reflects ~w~33%~/~ of the damage received from strikes and shots as ~ur~Unholy Damage~/~ with ~w~20%~/~ Armor Penetration.
desc_zh: 触发~lg~“惩戒誓言”~/~，持续~w~3~/~个回合：##将所受击打伤害和射击/投射伤害的~w~33%~/~以~ur~邪术伤害~/~的形式还给攻击者，本次反伤有~w~20%~/~的护甲穿透。

desc_en: Activates ~w~5~/~ stacks of ~lg~"Offensive Tactic"~/~ for ~w~6~/~ turns (~w~+1~/~ turn for each enemy within Vision):##~lg~+2%~/~ Crit Chance#~lg~+3%~/~ Accuracy#~lg~-3%~/~ Fumble Chance#~lg~-3%~/~ Skills Energy Cost#~lg~-3%~/~ Cooldowns Duration##Basic strikes, shots, and using ~w~Attack~/~ skills reduce the number of stacks (no more than once per turn).##Killing enemies increases the number of stacks by ~lg~2~/~ (up to ~w~VI~/~).##While affected by ~lg~"Offensive Tactic"~/~, using ~w~"Defensive Tactic"~/~ doesn't take a turn.##Only one ~lg~"Tactic"~/~ can be active at a time.
desc_zh: 触发~w~5~/~层~lg~“攻击战术”~/~，持续~w~6~/~个回合（视野范围之内每有一个敌人，存续时间便~w~+1~/~）：##暴击几率~lg~+2%~/~#准度~lg~+3%~/~#失手几率~lg~-3%~/~#技能精力消耗~lg~-3%~/~#能力冷却时间~lg~-3%~/~##普通击打、射击或者运用~w~攻击~/~技能会令这个状态的层数减少（每回合最多一次）。##击杀敌人会令这个状态叠加~lg~2~/~层（最多叠到~w~六~/~层）。##~lg~“攻击战术”~/~生效期间，运用~w~“防御战术”~/~不消耗回合。##两种~lg~“战术”~/~无法同时生效。

desc_en: Grants ~lg~+5%~/~ Weapon Damage, ~lg~+5%~/~ Immobilization Chance, and ~lg~+3%~/~ Crit Chance if there is only one adjacent enemy.##~lg~Doubles~/~ the bonuses if the adjacent tiles are empty.
desc_zh: 邻近方格只有一个敌人时，令兵器伤害~lg~+5%~/~、限制移动几率~lg~+5%~/~、暴击几率~lg~+3%~/~。##如果邻近方格没有敌人，那么上述增益~lg~翻倍~/~。

desc_en: Transfers ~w~66%~/~ of the damage received by the Tentacle Arm to the summoner.#Transfers ~w~33%~/~ of the damage received by the summoner to the Tentacle Arm.##Destroying a Tentacle Arm reduces the summoner's Max Health by ~r~9%~/~ and permanently applies them with ~r~+33%~/~ Damage Taken.##Killing the Anmarrak also destroys the Tentacle Arm.
desc_zh: 触手所受伤害的~w~66%~/~会转移给本体。#本体所受伤害的~w~33%~/~会转移给触手。##一支触手坏死之后，本体的生命上限会降低~r~9%~/~，而且所受伤害永久~r~+33%~/~。##击杀安玛拉会令其触手坏死。

desc_en: Performs a ~w~charge~/~ towards the target and delivers a strike with ~lg~+/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~ Weapon Damage and ~lg~+/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~ Armor Penetration.##If the target takes damage, applies it with ~r~-/*Bleed_Debuff*/%~/~ Bleed Resistance and ~r~+/*Damage_Debuff*/%~/~ Damage Taken for ~w~4~/~ turns.##The effect doesn't stack.
desc_zh: 向目标~w~突进~/~一次，击打一次，本次击打兵器伤害~lg~+/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~、护甲穿透~lg~+/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~。##如果目标受到伤害，则令其~w~4~/~回合之内的出血抗性~r~-/*Bleed_Debuff*/%~/~、所受伤害~r~+/*Damage_Debuff*/%~/~。##这个效果不能叠加。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~r~-/*Stun_Debuff*/%~/~ Control Resistance for ~w~3~/~ turns (the effect doesn't stack).##Then delivers a strike with ~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ Knockback Chance.##If the strike ~w~knocks~/~ the target back, ~w~repositions~/~ to the emptied tile and delivers an additional strike with ~lg~+/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~ Daze Chance.##If the first strike doesn't ~w~knock~/~ the target back, reduces the skill's cooldown by ~lg~3~/~ turns.
desc_zh: 令目标~w~3~/~个回合之内控制抗性~r~-/*Stun_Debuff*/%~/~。（这个效果不能叠加）##然后击打一次，本次击打击退几率~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~。##如果本次击打将目标~w~击退~/~，那么~w~调整位置~/~，移到目标此前所在方格，然后再次击打，本次击打击晕几率~lg~+/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~。##如果第一次击打没有~w~击退~/~目标，那么这个技能的剩余冷却时间缩短~lg~3~/~个回合。

desc_en: Grants ~lg~+3%~/~ Dodge Chance, ~lg~+1%~/~ Crit Chance, ~lg~-5%~/~ Abilities Cooldown to every Feral Dog within Vision.
desc_zh: 令视野内每一匹野狗闪躲几率~lg~+5%~/~、暴击几率~lg~+3%~/~、能力冷却时间~lg~-5%~/~。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Painful Stabs"~/~ for ~w~10~/~ turns:##~lg~+4%~/~ Crit Chance#~lg~+10%~/~ Crit Efficiency#~lg~+5%~/~ Weapon Damage#~lg~+12%~/~ Bleed Chance##Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~IV~/~).##Basic dagger strikes prolong the effect's duration by ~lg~1~/~ turn (up to ~w~10~/~) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn).##Only one ~w~Stance~/~ effect can be active at a time.
desc_zh: 触发~w~10~/~个回合的~lg~“辣手利刃”~/~：##暴击几率~lg~+4%~/~#暴击效果~lg~+10%~/~#兵器伤害~lg~+5%~/~#出血几率~lg~+12%~/~##运用同一能力树的技能会令这个效果叠加1层（最多叠到~w~四~/~层）。##匕首普通击打会令这个效果存续时间延长~lg~1~/~个回合（最多~w~10~/~个回合），但是会令效果层数减少（每回合最多一次）。##~lg~站姿~/~效果无法多个同时生效。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Parry"~/~ for ~w~3~/~ turns:##~lg~+/*PRR*/%~/~ Block Chance#~lg~+/*Block_Power*/%~/~ Max Block Power#~lg~+/*CTA*/%~/~ Counter Chance##~lg~Fully~/~ replenishes Block Power.##While affected by ~lg~"Parry"~/~, each blocked strike reduces the skill's cooldown by ~lg~2~/~ turns and grants ~lg~+10%~/~ Block Power Recovery for ~w~3~/~ turns, and each counter grants ~lg~+2%~/~ Crit Chance for ~w~5~/~ turns.##The effect stacks up to ~w~4~/~ times.
desc_zh: 触发~w~3~/~个回合的~lg~“招架”~/~：##格挡几率~lg~+/*PRR*/%~/~#格挡力量上限~lg~+/*Block_Power*/%~/~#反击几率~lg~+/*CTA*/%~/~##格挡力量立刻~w~完全~/~恢复。##~lg~“招架”~/~生效期间，每成功格挡一次击打，这个技能的冷却时间便缩短~lg~2~/~个回合，~w~3~/~个回合之内格挡力量恢复便~lg~+10%~/~。每次反击会令~w~5~/~个回合之内暴击几率~lg~+2%~/~。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~4~/~层。

desc_en: Delivers a strike to all adjacent tiles with ~lg~+/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~ Stagger Chance and ~lg~+/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~ Daze Chance.##Then allows the character to ~w~reposition~/~ to an adjacent tile.##Grants ~lg~-10%~/~ Backfire Chance, ~lg~-10%~/~ Abilities Energy Cost, and ~lg~-10%~/~ Fumble Chance for ~w~5~/~ turns for each enemy hit by the strike.##The effect stacks up to ~w~3~/~ times.
desc_zh: 击打一次所有邻近方格，本次击打破衡几率~lg~+/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~、击晕几率~lg~+/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~。##然后~w~调整位置~/~，移到邻近方格。##本次击打每命中一个敌人，那么~w~5~/~个回合之内失误几率和能力精力消耗便~lg~-10%~/~、失手几率~lg~-10%~/~。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~3~/~层。

desc_en: Delivers a strike with ~lg~+50%~/~ Bodypart Damage, ~lg~+25%~/~ Crit Chance, and ~lg~+50%~/~ Bleed Chance.##A successful hit to the head applies the target with ~r~"Blindness"~/~ for ~w~2~/~ turns if it deals at least ~r~5%~/~ of its Max Health as damage.
desc_zh: 击打一次，本次击打肢体伤害~lg~+50%~/~、暴击几率~lg~+25%~/~、出血几率~lg~+50%~/~。##如果本次击打命中目标~w~头部~/~而且没有失手，同时所造成伤害不少于目标生命上限的~r~5%~/~，那么令目标~r~“盲目”~/~~w~2~/~回合。

desc_en: Destroys the chosen ~w~runic boulder~/~ and with ~w~/*Chance*/%~/~ chance applies all targets adjacent to it with ~w~Petrification~/~ for ~w~2~/~ turns (~w~+2~/~ turns for each stack of ~lg~"Runic Empowerment"~/~ over ~w~I~/~).##When a ~w~Petrified~/~ target receives damage, additionally deals ~w~/*Pure_Damage*/~/~ ~w~Pure Damage~/~ to it and worsens the Condition of its body parts by ~r~3%~/~ (no more than once per turn).##Each ~w~Petrified~/~ enemy within Vision grants ~lg~+20%~/~ Geomantic Power.
desc_zh: 摧毁所选~w~符文巨石~/~，同时有~w~/*Chance*/%~/~的几率令与其邻近的所有目标~w~石化~/~~w~2~/~个回合（~lg~符文强化~/~层数每比~w~1~/~层多1，便延长~w~2~/~个回合）。##~w~石化~/~的敌人受到伤害时，对其额外造成 ~w~/*Pure_Damage*/~/~点~w~纯粹伤害~/~，身体部位状态恶化~r~3%~/~（每回合最多一次）。##视野之内每有一个石化的敌人，地术法力便~lg~+20%~/~。

desc_en: Summons a ~w~Phantasm~/~ on the targeted tile, which persists for ~w~8~/~ turns.##Each turn, the ~w~Phantasm~/~ deals ~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/ Arcane Damage~/~ to a random adjacent enemy with ~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~ Accuracy, ~w~/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~ Armor Penetration, ~w~/*CRT*/%~/~ Crit Chance, and ~w~/*CRTD*/%~/~ Crit Efficiency.##The offensive capabilities and Max Health of the ~w~Phantasm~/~ change dynamically depending on the caster's stats, decreasing with distance from the caster.#The ~w~Phantasm~/~ can move within ~w~2~/~ tiles of its summoning or ~w~teleportation~/~ spot, is immune to all effects (except ~r~"Stasis"~/~ and ~r~"Wormhole"~/~), and replenishes Health upon taking ~p~Arcane Damage~/~.##The ~w~Phantasm~/~ has access to the following abilities: ~w~"Arcane Tether"~/~, which ~w~pulls~/~ enemies in, ~w~"Mana Siphon"~/~, which steals Energy, and ~w~"Consonance"~/~, which prolongs its summoning duration.##~w~Teleporting~/~ the ~w~Phantasm~/~ instantly refreshes all its cooldowns.
desc_zh: 在目标方格召唤一个~w~幻影~/~，存续~w~8~/~个回合。##~w~幻影~/~每个回合随机对一个邻近的敌人造成~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/点秘术伤害~/~，准度为~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~，护甲穿透~w~/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~，暴击几率~w~/*CRT*/%~/~，暴击效果~w~/*CRTD*/%~/~。##~w~幻影~/~的攻击能力和耐久上限会动态变化，取决于施法者自身的数值，而且距离施法者越远，就越低。#~w~幻影~/~可以在召唤位置或~w~瞬间移动~/~位置周围~w~2~/~个方格的范围之内移动，免疫所有效果（~r~“静滞”~/~和~r~“虫洞”~/~除外），而且受到~p~秘术伤害~/~就会立刻恢复耐久。##~w~幻影~/~具备以下能力：~w~秘能束缚~/~，将敌人~w~吸引~/~到距离自己更近的位置；~w~魔能虹吸~/~，吸取目标精力；还有~w~谐和~/~，延长幻影自身的存续时间。##~w~幻影~/~~w~瞬间移动~/~会令自身所有冷却时间立刻结束。

desc_en: Marks a large area within ~w~3~/~ tiles. Next turn releases a swarm of spectral bats, dealing ~ur~/*Unholy_Damage*/ Unholy Damage~/~ to all targets within it and applying them with ~r~"Curse of Decay"~/~ for ~w~9~/~ turns.
desc_zh: 标记方圆~w~3~/~格之内的一大片区域。下一回合向这片区域释放一群幻影蝙蝠，对标记区域内所有目标造成~ur~/*Unholy_Damage*/ 点邪术伤害~/~，并令这些目标获得存续~w~9~/~回合的~r~“衰弱诅咒”~/~。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Pikeman Stance"~/~ for ~w~10~/~ turns:##~lg~+5%~/~ Accuracy#~lg~+5%~/~ Bleed Chance#~lg~+15%~/~ Knockback Chance#~lg~+8%~/~ Immobilization Chance##Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~IV~/~).##Remaining on the same tile prolongs the effect's duration by ~lg~1~/~ turn (up to ~w~10~/~), and basic spear strikes reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn).##Only one ~w~Stance~/~ effect can be active at a time.
desc_zh: 触发~w~10~/~个回合的~lg~“枪兵站姿”~/~：##准度~lg~+5%~/~#出血几率~lg~+5%~/~#击退几率~lg~+15%~/~#限制移动几率~lg~+8%~/~##运用同一能力树的技能会令这个效果叠加一层（最多叠到~w~四~/~层）。##原地不动会令这个效果存续时间延长~lg~1~/~个回合（最多~w~10~/~个回合），长杆刃器普通击打会令效果层数减少（每回合最多一次）。##~lg~站姿~/~效果无法多个同时生效。

desc_en: Shoots a spike, dealing ~w~/*Piercing_Damage*/ Piercing~/~ and ~g~/*Poison_Damage*/ Poison Damage~/~ with ~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~ Accuracy.##A successful, damaging hit applies the affected body part with ~r~-10%~/~ Protection for ~w~10~/~ turns.##The effect stacks up to ~w~5~/~ times.
desc_zh: 射出一根毒刺，造成~w~/*Piercing_Damage*/点穿刺伤害~/~和~g~/*Poison_Damage*/点中毒伤害~/~，本次攻击的准度为~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~。##如果成功命中，而且造成伤害，那么命中的身体部位~w~10~/~个回合之内防护~r~-10%~/~。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~5~/~层。

desc_en: Grants spear strikes against targets affected by ~w~Immobilization~/~ or ~r~"Net"~/~ ~lg~+10%~/~ Armor Penetration and ~lg~+15%~/~ Bodypart Damage.
desc_zh: 如果目标~w~移动受限~/~或~r~动弹不得~/~，而且使用长杆刃器击打这个目标，那么这类击打的护甲穿透~lg~+10%~/~、肢体伤害~lg~+15%~/~。

desc_en: Deals ~cg~/*Caustic_Damage*/ Caustic Damage~/~ with ~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~ Accuracy and ~w~/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~ Armor Penetration.##If the target takes damage, with ~w~/*Debuff_Chance*/%~/~ chance applies it with ~r~"Acid Bath"~/~ for ~w~3~/~ turns.
desc_zh: 造成~cg~/*Caustic_Damage*/点腐蚀伤害~/~，本次攻击准度为~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~、护甲穿透为~w~/*Armor_Piercing*/%~/~。##如果目标受到伤害，就有~w~/*Debuff_Chance*/%~/~的几率对目标造成~w~3~/~个回合的~r~“酸浴”~/~。

desc_en: Marks a ~w~7~/~ tile line. Next turn deals ~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/ Arcane~/~, ~ly~/*Sacred_Damage*/ Sacred~/~, and ~ur~/*Unholy_Damage*/ Unholy Damage~/~ with ~w~80%~/~ Armor Penetration, ~lg~+125%~/~ Knockback Chance, and ~lg~+100%~/~ Stun Chance to all targets within the area.
desc_zh: 标记一个~w~7~/~格长的路径。下一回合向这个路径上的所有目标造成~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/点秘术伤害~/~、~ly~/*Sacred_Damage*/点神圣伤害~/~和~ur~/*Unholy_Damage*/ 点邪术~/~伤害，护甲穿透效果为~w~80%~/~，击退几率~lg~+125%~/~，硬直几率~lg~+100%~/~。

desc_en: Secret Cults
desc_zh: 秘密教派

desc_en: Delivers two basic strikes.##Each successful hit reduces all cooldowns by ~lg~1~/~ turn and also grants ~lg~+3%~/~ Crit Chance for ~w~5~/~ turns for each ally within Vision.##The effect stacks up to ~w~5~/~ times.
desc_zh: 发动两次普通击打。##视野之内每有一个友方，每次完全命中就会令所有冷却时间缩短~lg~1~/~个回合，同时令~w~5~/~个回合内的暴击几率~lg~+3%~/~。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~5~/~层。

desc_en: Each Spiderling within ~w~12~/~ tiles grants ~r~+33%~/~ Cooldown Duration to ~w~"Egg Clutch"~/~, and also ~lg~+4%~/~ Crit Chance and ~lg~+4%~/~ Life Drain to the Broodmother.
desc_zh: 周围~w~12~/~ 个方格之内，每有一个小蜘蛛，便令 ~w~“产卵”~/~的冷却时间~r~+33%~/~，也会令蛛母暴击几率~lg~+4%~/~、生命吸取~lg~+4%~/~。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Raise Shield"~/~ for ~w~3~/~ turns:##~lg~+/*Block_Chance*/%~/~ Block Chance#~lg~+/*Block_Power*/%~/~ Max Block Power#~lg~+/*Crit_Avoid*/%~/~ Crit Avoidance#~r~-200%~/~ Dodge Chance##The bonus to Block Chance depends on the equipped ~w~shield's~/~ Block Chance.##If equipped with a ~w~light shield~/~, replenishes ~lg~/*Block_Restore*/%~/~ Max Block Power, grants the effect ~lg~+/*CTA*/%~/~ Counter Chance, and ~lg~doesn't penalize~/~ Dodge Chance.##If equipped with a ~w~heavy shield~/~, grants the effect ~lg~+33%~/~ Energy Restoration.
desc_zh: 触发~w~3~/~个回合的~lg~“举盾”~/~：##格挡几率~lg~+/*Block_Chance*/%~/~#格挡力量上限~lg~+/*Block_Power*/%~/~#暴击避免~lg~+/*Crit_Avoid*/%~/~#闪躲几率~r~-200%~/~##格挡几率的增益与所用~w~盾牌~/~的格挡几率相关。##如果所用盾牌为~w~轻盾~/~，那么立刻恢复格挡力量上限~lg~/*Block_Restore*/%~/~的格挡力量，并令这个效果反击几率~lg~+/*CTA*/%~/~，而且~lg~移除~/~盾牌对闪躲几率的影响。##如果所用盾牌为~w~重盾~/~，则令这个效果增加“精力自动恢复~lg~+33%~/~”这一项。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Rampage"~/~ for ~w~10~/~ turns:##~lg~-10%~/~ Skills Energy Cost#~lg~+4%~/~ Crit Chance#~lg~+15%~/~ Bleed Chance#~lg~-3%~/~ Fumble Chance#Every ~w~third~/~ strike deals additional damage equal to ~r~15%~/~ of the target's Max Health (but no more than ~w~/*Max_HP_Limit*/~/~).##Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~IV~/~).##Basic two-handed axe strikes prolong the effect's duration by ~lg~1~/~ turn (up to ~w~10~/~) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn).##Only one ~w~Stance~/~ effect can be active at a time.
desc_zh: 触发~w~10~/~个回合的~lg~“运斤成风”~/~：##技能精力消耗~lg~-10%~/~#暴击几率~lg~+4%~/~#出血几率~lg~+15%~/~#失手几率~lg~-3%~/~#以三次击打为周期，每个周期的第三次击打会额外造成伤害，额外的伤害等于目标生命上限的~r~15%~/~（但不会超过~w~/*Max_HP_Limit*/~/~）##运用同一能力树的技能会令这个效果额外叠加一层（最多叠到~w~四~/~层）。##双手斧普通击打会令这个效果的存续时间延长~lg~1~/~个回合（最多~w~10~/~个回合），但会令效果的层数减少（每回合最多一次）。##~lg~站姿~/~效果无法多个同时生效。

desc_en: Grants ~lg~+25%~/~ Dodge Chance for ~w~3~/~ turns and performs a ~w~Charge~/~ towards the targeted tile.
desc_zh: 令自身~w~3~/~回合内的闪躲几率~lg~+25%~/~，然后向目标方格~w~突进~/~一次。

desc_en: A man's misery is a rat's good fortune: never before has fresh carrion been so plentiful.
desc_zh: 人受难，老鼠开心，毕竟从来没有过这么多腐肉。

desc_en: Each turn restores ~lg~5%~/~ Armor Durability.##Each ~w~percent~/~ of Armor Durability grants ~lg~+0.5%~/~ Magic and Nature Resistance.
desc_zh: 每回合恢复~lg~5%~/~的护甲耐久。##~w~每个百分点~/~的护甲耐久会令魔法抗性和自然抗性~lg~+0.5%~/~。

desc_en: ~w~Repositions~/~ to an adjacent tile, replenishes ~w~/*Block_Power*/%~/~ Max Block Power, and reduces the cooldowns of the ability tree's other skills by ~lg~1~/~ turn for each visible enemy within ~w~3~/~ tiles.##Activates ~lg~"Regroup"~/~ for ~w~10~/~ turns:##~lg~+5%~/~ Block Chance#~lg~+5%~/~ Max Block Power#~lg~+15%~/~ Block Power Recovery#~lg~+5%~/~ Counter Chance##Grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~IV~/~) for each reduced cooldown.
desc_zh: ~w~调整位置~/~，移到邻近方格，方圆~w~3~/~格之内每有一个敌人在视野之内，就立刻恢复格挡力量上限~w~/*Block_Power*/%~/~的格挡力量，同一能力树其他技能的剩余冷却时间就缩短~lg~1~/~个回合。##触发~w~10~/~个回合的~lg~“应变”~/~：##格挡几率~lg~+5%~/~#格挡力量上限~lg~+5%~/~#格挡力量恢复~lg~+15%~/~#反击几率~lg~+5%~/~##这组效果触发之前，同一能力树每有一个技能的冷却时间缩短，这组效果就叠加1层（最多叠到~w~四~/~层）。

desc_en: Replenishes ~lg~5%~/~ Max Health to an ally and grants them ~lg~"Rapid Restoration"~/~ for ~w~5~/~ turns.##Reduces all cooldowns by ~lg~2~/~ turns for the Rockeater Worker and all allies within Vision.
desc_zh: 立刻令一个友方恢复生命上限~lg~5%~/~的生命，同时令其获得~w~5~/~个回合的~lg~“恢复迅速”~/~。##令自己和视野之内的所有友方所有冷却时间缩短~lg~2~/~个回合。

desc_en: Delivers a strike with ~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ Knockback Chance and ~lg~+/*Bodypart_Damage*/%~/~ Bodypart Damage for each ~r~Bleeding~/~ affecting the target and each missing ~r~20%~/~ of its Health.##With ~w~/*Bleeding_Chance*/%~/~ chance causes the target's ~r~Injured~/~ body parts to start ~r~Bleeding~/~.##Then replenishes ~bl~/*MP_Restore*/%~/~ Max Energy for each ~r~Bleeding~/~ and degree of ~r~Injury~/~ affecting the target.
desc_zh: 击打一次，目标每有一处~r~出血~/~或生命每少~r~20%~/~，本次击打的击退几率就~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~、肢体伤害就~lg~+/*Bodypart_Damage*/%~/~。##目标每一处~r~受伤~/~的身体部位都有~w~/*Bleeding_Chance*/%~/~的几率因为本次击打而~r~出血~/~。##然后，目标每有一处~r~出血~/~，就立刻恢复精力上限~bl~/*MP_Restore*/%~/~的精力。如果目标身上~r~有伤~/~，也会立刻恢复精力，恢复的比例等于~bl~/*MP_Restore*/%~/~乘以一个倍数，这个倍数是目标所有~r~伤情~/~的和（1处轻伤=1，1处中度受伤=2，1处重伤=3）。

desc_en: Delivers a strike with ~lg~+/*Bodypart_Damage*/%~/~ Bodypart Damage and ~lg~+/*Bleeding_Chance*/%~/~ Bleed Chance.
desc_zh: 击打一次，本次击打肢体伤害~lg~+/*Bodypart_Damage*/%~/~、出血几率~lg~+/*Bleeding_Chance*/%~/~。

desc_en: Applies an ally with ~r~"Gift Rescinded"~/~ for ~w~9~/~ turns:##~r~-33%~/~ Life Drain#Upon death, leaves ~w~2-3~/~ ~w~Blood Puddles~/~ on random adjacent tiles, which persist for ~w~6~/~ turns.##When the effect expires, the target dies, instantly refreshing the caster's cooldowns and replenishing ~lg~33%~/~ Max Health and ~bl~33%~/~ Max Energy to them.
desc_zh: 令一个友方获得存续~w~9~/~个回合的~r~“恩赐剥夺”~/~：##生命吸取~r~-33%~/~#死亡时会随机在邻近方格产生~w~2-3~/~滩存续~w~6~/~个回合的~w~沸血~/~。##效果结束时，目标死亡，令施法者所有冷却立即结束，同时立刻恢复生命上限和精力上限~lg~33%~/~的生命和精力。

desc_en: Deals ~o~/*Fire_Damage*/ Fire Damage~/~ to all adjacent tiles, ~o~Igniting~/~ the empty ones.##With ~w~/*Chance*/%~/~ chance ~o~Ignites~/~ all affected targets for ~w~2-3~/~ turns and applies them with ~r~/*Fire_Resistance*/%~/~ Fire Resistance for ~w~10~/~ turns.##Grants ~lg~+15%~/~ Pyromantic Power for ~w~4~/~ turns for each affected enemy.
desc_zh: 对邻近的所有方格造成~o~/*Fire_Damage*/点灼烧伤害~/~，~o~点燃~/~没有物体和生灵的方格。。##有~w~/*Chance*/%~/~的几率~o~点燃~/~所有受到影响的目标，燃烧持续~w~2-3~/~个回合，令他们~w~10~/~个回合之内灼烧抗性~r~/*Fire_Resistance*/%~/~。##每有一个敌人受到影响，炎术法力下面~w~4~/~个回合便提升~lg~15%~/~。

desc_en: Marks a ~w~3x3~/~ tile area. Next turn throws a huge rock, dealing ~w~/*Crushing_Damage*/ Crushing Damage~/~ to all targets within it.##Each tile of distance to a target increases the skill's damage by ~lg~10%~/~.
desc_zh: 标记一个~w~3格x3格~/~的区域，下一回合投掷一块巨石，对标记区域内所有目标造成~w~/*Crushing_Damage*/点钝击伤害~/~。##这个技能可以获得伤害增益，以~lg~10%~/~为基数，巨魔与目标距离1个方格，则伤害增加~lg~10%~/~*1，距离2个方格，则增加~lg~10%~/~*2，以此类推。

desc_en: Each turn, ~w~runic boulders~/~ burn ~bl~2%~/~ Max Energy of all enemies adjacent to them for each stack of ~lg~"Runic Empowerment"~/~, replenishing the same amount of Energy to the character, and prolong all their active cooldowns by ~r~1~/~ turn.##The effect doesn't stack.
desc_zh: 每叠加了1层~lg~符文强化~/~，~w~符文巨石~/~每个回合就令邻近的所有敌人损耗精力上限~bl~2%~/~的精力，同时令施法者立刻恢复同等数量的精力，还会令敌人当前所有所剩冷却时间延长~r~1~/~个回合。##这个效果不能叠加。

desc_en: Summoning a ~w~runic boulder~/~ grants ~lg~+7.5%~/~ Energy Restoration for ~w~5~/~ turns and reduces the ability tree's cooldowns by ~lg~1~/~ turn for each stack of ~lg~"Runic Empowerment"~/~.
desc_zh: 每有一层~lg~符文强化~/~，召唤一块~w~符文巨石~/~便令自身~w~5~/~个回合之内精力自动恢复~lg~+7.5%~/~，同时令同系法咒当前的剩余冷却时间缩短~lg~1~/~个回合。

desc_en: Destroying a ~w~runic boulder~/~ to use the ability tree's spells deals ~p~Arcane Damage~/~ to all targets adjacent to it.#The damage dealt is equal to ~bl~3%~/~ of the current Energy, increasing by ~lg~100%~/~ for each stack of ~lg~"Runic Empowerment"~/~ above ~w~I~/~.
desc_zh: 如果通过摧毁~w~符文巨石~/~催动同系法咒，那么会对邻近巨石的所有目标造成~p~秘术伤害~/~。#所造成的伤害数值等于当前精力的~bl~3%~/~，当前叠加的~lg~符文强化~/~层数每比~w~1~/~多1层，这个数值就提高~lg~100%~/~。

desc_en: Applies enemies with ~r~-5%~/~ Physical Resistance, ~r~-5%~/~ Move Resistance, and ~r~-5%~/~ Control Resistance for each ~w~runic boulder~/~ adjacent to them.
desc_zh: 敌人每与一块~w~符文巨石~/~邻近，物理抗性、位移抗性、控制抗性便分别~r~-5%~/~。

desc_en: Grants ~lg~-5%~/~ Damage Taken and ~lg~-5%~/~ Backfire Damage Change for each adjacent ~w~runic boulder~/~##Grants ~w~boulders~/~ ~lg~-25%~/~ Damage Taken.##Reduces the sustain cost of adjacent ~w~boulders~/~ to ~w~1~/~ Energy per turn.
desc_zh: 每有一块~w~符文巨石~/~与施法者邻近，施法者所受伤害便~lg~-5%~/~，失误伤害变化便~lg~-5%~/~。##~w~巨石~/~所受伤害~lg~-25%~/~##每回合维持邻近~w~巨石~/~所消耗的精力减为~w~1~/~点。

desc_en: While affected by ~lg~"Stone Armor"~/~, remaining on the same tile grants ~lg~-5%~/~ Cooldowns Duration, ~lg~+8%~/~ Crit Avoidance, and ~lg~+10%~/~ Energy Restoration for ~w~5~/~ turns.##The effect stacks up to ~w~3~/~ times.
desc_zh: ~lg~石甲~/~状态下，原地不动可令自身~w~5~/~个回合之内冷却时间~lg~-5%~/~、暴击避免~lg~+8%~/~、精力自动恢复~lg~+10%~/~。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~3~/~层。

desc_en: Allows the character to simultaneously summon ~w~4~/~ ~w~runic boulders~/~.##If a ~w~boulder~/~ is within ~w~2~/~ tiles of the character, its destruction by enemies no longer ~w~Confuses~/~ or deals ~p~Arcane Damage~/~.
desc_zh: 令你可以同时召唤~w~4~/~块~w~符文巨石~/~。##如果~w~巨石~/~与你的距离不超过~w~2~/~格，那么敌人将它摧毁不会造成~w~混乱~/~，也不会造成~p~秘术伤害~/~。

desc_en: Summons a ~w~runic boulder~/~ on the targeted tile, dealing ~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/ Arcane Damage~/~ to every enemy adjacent to it and with ~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~knocking~/~ them back.##Each ~w~boulder~/~ grants the caster ~w~1~/~ stack of ~lg~"Runic Empowerment"~/~:##~lg~+5%~/~ Magic Power#~lg~+10%~/~ Geomantic Power#~lg~-10%~/~ Abilities Energy Cost#~r~/*MP_turn*/~/~ Energy Replenishment##Only ~w~3~/~ ~w~boulders~/~ can be summoned simultaneously.##~w~Boulders~/~ fall apart when they leave the caster's Vision or if the caster runs out of Energy.##When a ~w~boulder~/~ is destroyed by enemies, ~w~Confuses~/~ the caster for ~w~4-6~/~ turns and deals ~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/ Arcane Damage~/~ to them.
desc_zh: 在所选方格召唤一块~w~符文巨石~/~，对邻近方格的所有敌人造成~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/点秘术伤害~/~，并有~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~的几率~w~击退~/~敌人。##视野之内每有一块符文巨石，施法者便获得1层~lg~符文强化~/~：##法力~lg~+5%~/~#地术法力~lg~+10%~/~#能力精力消耗~lg~-10%~/~#精力恢复~r~/*MP_turn*/~/~##最多可以同时召唤~w~3~/~块巨石。##如果~w~巨石~/~脱离施法者的视野，或施法者精力耗尽，那么~w~巨石~/~崩塌。##敌方摧毁~w~巨石~/~时，施法者~w~混乱~/~~w~4-6~/~个回合，同时受到~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/点秘术伤害~/~。

desc_en: Destroys the chosen ~w~runic boulder~/~, dealing ~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/ Arcane~/~ and ~w~/*Blunt_Damage*/ Crushing Damage~/~ to all targets in a ~w~5x5~/~ tile area. ##With ~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~knocks~/~ the affected targets back and with ~w~/*Stun_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~Stuns~/~ them.##Replenishes ~bl~5%~/~ Max Energy for each enemy within the spell's area of effect.
desc_zh: 摧毁所选~w~符文巨石~/~，对~w~5x5~/~格范围内的所有目标造成~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/点秘术伤害~/~和~w~/*Blunt_Damage*/点钝击伤害~/~。##有~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~的几率~w~击退~/~，有~w~/*Stun_Chance*/%~/~的几率造成~w~硬直~/~。##法咒的效果范围内每有一个敌人，便立刻恢复精力上限~bl~5%~/~的精力。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~r~"Sacrificial Blood"~/~, which remains active until the caster's death.##Using spells against a target with this effect grants ~lg~+6%~/~ Magic Power and ~lg~+6%~/~ Healing Efficiency (both effects stack up to ~w~6~/~ times), replenishes ~bl~6%~/~ Max Energy, and reduces all cooldowns by ~lg~1~/~ turn.
desc_zh: 令目标获得~r~“血祭”~/~，只要施法者不死，这个效果就持续有效。##如果目标受到这个效果影响，那么对其催动法咒会令自身法力~lg~+6%~/~、治疗效果~lg~+6%~/~（这两个效果均可叠加，最多~w~6~/~层），并立刻恢复精力上限~bl~6%~/~的精力，同时所有冷却时间缩短~lg~1~/~个回合。

desc_en: Deals ~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/ Arcane Damage~/~ to a ~w~5x5~/~ tile area (except the central tile) and with ~w~/*Debuff_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~Staggers~/~ or ~w~Immobilizes~/~ all affected targets.##With ~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~knocks~/~ back the targets adjacent to the area's center and ~w~pulls~/~ the targets that are ~w~1~/~ tile away from it.##The spell doesn't harm the caster, aside from ~p~Arcane Damage~/~.
desc_zh: 对一个~w~5x5~/~格的范围（不含中央方格）造成~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/点秘术伤害~/~，有~w~/*Debuff_Chance*/%~/~的几率令所有受到影响的目标~w~失衡~/~或~w~移动受限~/~。##有~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~的几率~w~击退~/~邻近区域中心的目标，同时~w~吸引~/~与中心相距~w~1~/~个方格的目标。##这个法咒除了造成~p~秘术伤害~/~之外，不会对施法者造成其他影响。

desc_en: Removes all physical and magical effects from the chosen target and every target adjacent to it.##Destroys all summoned magical or elemental entities within the spell's area of effect (~w~runes~/~, ~o~fires~/~, ~ur~unholy blood~/~, ~g~acid~/~, ~o~magma~/~, etc).##Replenishes ~lg~/*HP*/%~/~ Max Health and ~bl~/*Regen_MP*/%~/~ Max Energy for each removed effect or destroyed entity.##~lg~Doubles~/~ the bonuses for each positive effect removed from the caster.##Applies all Undead targets within the spell's area of effect with ~r~+33%~/~ Damage Taken for ~w~10~/~ turns.
desc_zh: 祛除所选目标及与其邻近的所有目标的物理效果与魔法效果。##摧毁这个法咒效果范围之内召唤的所有魔法实体和元素实体（例如~w~符印~/~、~o~火焰~/~、~ur~邪血~/~、~g~酸液~/~和~o~岩浆~/~）。##每祛除一项效果或移除一个实体，施法者便立刻恢复生命上限~lg~/*HP*/%~/~的生命和精力上限~bl~/*Regen_MP*/%~/~的精力。##如果对自己催动，每祛除一项正面效果，增益~lg~翻倍~/~。##令法咒效果范围之内的幽魂和不死生灵~w~10~/~个回合之内所受伤害~r~+33%~/~。

desc_en: Reduces Backfire Damage by ~lg~40%~/~ and activates ~lg~Seal of Finesse~/~ for ~w~10~/~ turns:##~lg~-3%~/~ Backfire Chance#~lg~-3%~/~ Fumble Chance#~lg~-3%~/~ Backfire Damage Change#~lg~-3%~/~ Cooldowns Duration##Remaining on the same tile grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~V~/~).##Moving to other tiles reduces the number of stacks. Removes the effect when moving with ~w~I~/~ stack.
desc_zh: ~w~10~/~个回合之内失误伤害减少~lg~40%~/~，并且触发~lg~精纯法印~/~：##失误几率~lg~-3%~/~#失手几率~lg~-3%~/~#失误伤害变化~lg~-3%~/~#冷却时间~lg~-3%~/~##原地不动会会令这个效果叠加~lg~1~/~层（最多~lg~五~/~层）。##移到其他方格会令效果层数减少。层数为~w~1~/~时，移到其他方格会令这个效果消失。

desc_en: Creates ~w~3~/~ random ~w~places of power~/~ within ~w~2~/~ tiles, which persist for ~w~20~/~ turns.##When the caster moves to a ~w~place of power~/~ activates ~lg~"Place of Power"~/~ for ~w~3~/~ turns:##~lg~+7%~/~ Magic Power#~lg~-4%~/~ Spells Energy Cost#~lg~+3%~/~ Miracle Chance#~lg~+10%~/~ Energy Restoration##Remaining on a ~w~place of power~/~ grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~IV~/~) and prolongs its duration by ~lg~1~/~ turn.##Using spells reduces the number of stacks.##When the caster moves to a ~w~place of power~/~ for the first time, reduces all spells' cooldowns by ~lg~2~/~ turns.##~w~Places of power~/~ prevent the creation of ~w~sigils~/~ on the same tile.
desc_zh: 施法者在方圆~w~2~/~个方格之内随机揭示~w~3~/~处~w~法源~/~，法源存续~w~20~/~回合。##施法者如果移到~w~法源~/~方格，就会获得效果~lg~“法源”~/~，存续~w~3~/~个回合：##法力~lg~+7%~/~#法咒精力消耗~lg~-4%~/~#奇观几率~lg~+3%~/~#精力自动恢复~lg~+10%~/~##停在~w~法源~/~方格会令这个效果叠加~lg~1~/~层（最多叠到~w~四~/~层），同时令其存续时间延长~lg~1~/~个回合。##催动法咒会令层数减少。##施法者第一次进入~w~法源~/~时，令所有法咒当前剩余的冷却时间减少~lg~2~/~个回合。##~w~法源~/~可以防止同一方格出现~w~魔印~/~。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~Seal of Power~/~ for ~w~5~/~ turns:##~lg~+15%~/~ Magic Power#~p~+/*Arcane_DMG_Default*/ Arcane Damage~/~ to strikes and shots#~lg~+10%~/~ Bonus Range##Using spells transforms the effect into a ~lg~"Seal"~/~ of the corresponding School and prolongs its duration by ~lg~3~/~ turns (up to ~w~9~/~).##~o~Pyromancy:~/~ ~lg~+15%~/~ Pyromantic Power, ~o~+/*Fire_DMG*/ Fire Damage~/~ to strikes and shots, ~lg~+3%~/~ Miracle Chance, and ~lg~+3%~/~ Crit Chance.#~bl~Electromancy:~/~ ~lg~+15%~/~ Electromantic Power, ~ly~+/*Shock_DMG*/ Shock Damage~/~ to strikes and shots, ~lg~-4%~/~ Backfire Chance, and ~lg~-4%~/~ Fumble Chance.#~y~Geomancy:~/~ ~lg~+15%~/~ Geomantic Power, ~lg~-10%~/~ Damage Taken, ~lg~+10%~/~ Damage Reflection, and ~lg~-5%~/~ Backfire Damage Change.#~p~Arcanistics:~/~ ~lg~+15%~/~ Arcanistic Power, ~p~+/*Arcane_DMG*/ Arcane Damage~/~ to strikes and shots, and ~lg~-7%~/~ Abilities Energy Cost.##Using the ability tree's spells transforms the effect back into ~lg~"Seal of Power"~/~.
desc_zh: 触发~lg~增强法印~/~，持续~w~5~/~回合：##法力~lg~+15%~/~#击打和射击获得~p~/*Arcane_DMG_Default*/~/~点~p~秘术伤害~/~#距离加成~lg~+10%~/~##催动咒法能力树的法咒会令~lg~“增强法印”~/~变成相应法系的法印，并且令其存续时间延长~lg~3~/~个回合（最多~w~9~/~个回合）。##~o~炎系法印：~/~炎术法力~lg~+15%~/~，击打和射击获得~o~/*Fire_DMG*/~/~点~o~灼烧伤害~/~，奇观几率~lg~+3%~/~，暴击几率~lg~+3%~/~#~bl~电系法印：~/~电术法力~lg~+15%~/~，击打和射击获得~ly~+/*Shock_DMG*/~/~点~ly~电击~/~伤害，失误几率~lg~-4%~/~，失手几率~lg~-4%~/~#~y~地系法印：~/~地术法力~lg~+15%~/~，所受伤害~lg~-10%~/~，反伤~lg~+10%~/~，失误伤害变化~lg~-5%~/~#~p~秘系法印：~/~击打和射击获得~p~/*Arcane_DMG*/~/~点~p~秘术伤害~/~，秘术法力~lg~+15%~/~，能力精力消耗~lg~-7%~/~。##催动本系法咒会令法印变回~lg~增强法印~/~本印。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~lg~"Seal of Reflection"~/~ for ~w~8~/~ turns:##~lg~+30%~/~ Magic Resistance#~lg~+25%~/~ Nature Resistance#~lg~+10%~/~ Physical Resistance#~lg~+33%~/~ Damage Reflection##~w~Redirects~/~ all received aimed spells towards a random target within ~w~8~/~ tiles, if there is one.
desc_zh: 令目标获得存续~w~8~/~个回合的~lg~“反动法印”~/~：##魔法抗性~lg~+30%~/~#自然抗性~lg~+25%~/~#物理抗性~lg~+10%~/~#反伤~lg~+33%~/~##针对目标催动的所有指向性法咒均会随机~w~转向~/~~w~8~/~个方格之内的其他目标（前提是这个范围内存在其他目标）。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~lg~"Seal of Shackles"~/~ for ~w~6~/~ turns:##~r~-50%~/~ Energy Restoration#~r~+100%~/~ Abilities Energy Cost#~r~+100%~/~ Cooldowns Duration#~r~+25%~/~ Fumble Chance#~r~+25%~/~ Backfire Chance#Using abilities deals ~p~Arcane Damage~/~ equal to ~bl~/*DMG*/%~/~ of the Energy spent.
desc_zh: 令目标获得存续~w~6~/~个回合的~lg~“禁锢法印”~/~：##精力自动恢复~r~-50%~/~#能力精力消耗~r~+100%~/~#冷却时间~r~+100%~/~#失手几率~r~+25%~/~#失误几率~r~+25%~/~#运用能力会对自身造成~p~秘术伤害~/~，数值等于能力所耗精力的~bl~/*DMG*/%~/~。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~r~/*EVS*/%~/~ Dodge Chance and ~r~/*PRR*/%~/~ Block Chance until the next turn (the effect doesn't stack) and delivers a strike or shot to its least protected body part with ~lg~+/*HC*/%~/~ Accuracy and ~lg~/*FMB*/%~/~ Fumble Chance.##If the target takes damage, activates ~lg~"Seized Initiative"~/~ for ~w~2~/~ turns:##~lg~+5%~/~ Accuracy#~lg~-5%~/~ Fumble Chance#~lg~-10%~/~ Cooldowns Duration#~lg~-10%~/~ Skills Energy Cost##Also applies the target with ~r~"Initiative Loss"~/~ for ~w~2~/~ turns, which penalizes the same stats.##Damaging strikes and shots prolong the duration of both effects by ~lg~1~/~ turn.##~r~"Initiative Loss"~/~ can only be active on one target at a time.##Grants the skill ~lg~+1~/~ Range (if equipped with a ~w~spear~/~) or sets its Range to that of the weapon (if equipped with a ~w~ranged weapon~/~).
desc_zh: 令目标下一回合之前的闪躲几率~r~/*EVS*/%~/~、格挡几率~r~/*PRR*/%~/~，（这个效果不能叠加）然后向其防护最少的身体部位击打、射箭或抛投一次，本次击打准度~lg~+/*HC*/%~/~、失手几率~lg~/*FMB*/%~/~。##如果目标受到伤害，那么触发~w~2~/~回合的~lg~“占据主动”~/~：##准度~lg~+5%~/~#失手几率~lg~-5%~/~#冷却时间~lg~-10%~/~#技能精力消耗~lg~-10%~/~##也会令目标获得~w~2~/~回合的~r~“错失主动”~/~，这一效果会影响目标的上述属性。##如果击打、射击造成伤害，就会令上述两组状态的效果存续时间延长~lg~1~/~回合。##每次只能有一个目标带有~r~“错失主动”~/~的状态。##如果所用兵器为~w~长杆刃器~/~，令这一个技能距离~lg~+1~/~；如果所用兵器为~w~远程兵器~/~，将这个技能的距离加给所用兵器。

desc_en: Deals ~w~/*Blunt_Damage*/ Crushing Damage~/~ with ~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~ Accuracy, ~w~/*CRT*/%~/~ Crit Chance, ~w~/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~ Daze Chance, and ~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ Knockback Chance.##Replenishes ~lg~/*Block_Restore*/%~/~ Max Block Power.##If equipped with a ~w~light shield~/~, grants the skill ~lg~-25%~/~ Cooldown Duration.##If equipped with a ~w~heavy shield~/~, replenishes Block Power for ~w~30%~/~ of the damage dealt.
desc_zh: 造成~w~/*Blunt_Damage*/点钝击伤害~/~，本次伤害准度为~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~、暴击几率为~w~/*CRT*/%~/~、击晕几率为~w~/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~、击退几率为~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~。##立刻恢复格挡力量上限~lg~/*Block_Restore*/%~/~的格挡力量。##如果所用盾牌为~w~轻盾~/~，那么令这个技能的冷却时间~lg~-25%~/~。##如果所用盾牌为~w~重盾~/~，那么立刻恢复一定数量的格挡力量，恢复幅度等于本次击打所造成伤害的~w~30%~/~。

desc_en: Marks a large area within ~w~3~/~ tiles. Next turn delivers ~w~/*Crushing_Damage*/ Crushing Damage~/~ with ~w~150%~/~ Knockback Chance to all targets within it.##Each tile of distance to a target increases the skill's damage by ~lg~10%~/~.
desc_zh: 标记方圆~w~3~/~格之内的一大片区域，下一回合击对这个区域内所有目标造成~w~/*Crushing_Damage*/点钝击伤害~/~，并有~w~150%~/~的几率击退目标。##这个技能可以获得伤害增益，以~lg~10%~/~为基数，巨魔与目标距离1个方格，则伤害增加~lg~10%~/~*1，距离2个方格，则增加~lg~10%~/~*2，以此类推。

desc_en: Deals ~ly~/*Shock_Damage*/ Shock Damage~/~ to all ~ly~Resonating~/~ targets within Vision and with ~w~/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~Dazes~/~ them.##The spell's damage increases by ~lg~25%~/~ for each ~ly~Resonating~/~ target within Vision.##If ~ly~Resonating~/~ targets are adjacent to each other, the spell deals ~lg~double~/~ damage to them.
desc_zh: 对视野之内所有~ly~“谐振”~/~状态的目标造成~ly~/*Shock_Damage*/点电击伤害~/~，而且有~w~/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~的几率把他们~w~击晕~/~。##视野内每有一个~ly~“谐振”~/~的目标，这个伤害便增加~lg~25%~/~。##如果~ly~“谐振”~/~状态的目标彼此邻近，那么这次法咒的伤害~lg~翻倍~/~。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~r~"Sic!"~/~ for ~w~15~/~ turns:##Grants all attacks received from Dogs ~lg~+50%~/~ Damage.#Dogs won't ~w~flee~/~ while the target with this effect is within their Vision.
desc_zh: 令目标获得~r~“给我上！”~/~的效果，存续~w~15~/~回合。##如果这个目标在狗的视野之内，那么狗对其造成的伤害~lg~+50%~/~。

desc_en: Surprisingly well preserved.
desc_zh: 保存得极为完好。

desc_en: Applies an Undead ally with ~r~"Soul Sacrifice"~/~ until the next turn.##When the effect expires, the target explodes, dealing ~ur~Unholy Damage~/~ equal to its remaining Health (but no more than ~w~20%~/~ of its maximum amount) to all adjacent tiles.##The spell can be used only on targets with less than ~r~20%~/~ Health.
desc_zh: 对一个友方不死生灵催动~r~“魂祭”~/~，效果存续1回合。##效果结束时，目标爆炸，对所有邻近方格造成~ur~邪术伤害~/~，伤害数值等于其爆炸前所剩生命（伤害数值不超过其生命上限的~w~20%~/~）。##咒法目标仅限生命少于~r~20%~/~的不死生灵。

desc_en: Delivers a strike. Successfuly hitting the target activates ~lg~"Spectral Haunting"~/~ until the next turn:##Grants all received strikes and shots ~r~+20%~/~ Fumble Chance and ~r~-10%~/~ Accuracy.##Receiving damage removes the effect.##When the effect expires, the Wraith disappears for ~w~2-4~/~ turns, then materializes on a tile adjacent to an enemy and delivers a strike to them.##Hitting the target increases the Wraith's Max Health by ~lg~20%~/~ and permanently grants it ~lg~+3%~/~ Crit Chance.
desc_zh: 击打一次。如果成功命中目标，那么催动~lg~“阴魂不散”~/~，效果存续到下个回合开始。受到伤害会移除其效果。##令所受的所有击打、射击失手几率~r~+20%~/~、准度~r~-10%~/~。##受到伤害会移除这个效果。##效果结束时，幽魂消失~w~2-4~/~回合，然后在与敌方邻近的方格再次现身，并对其击打一次。##如果此次击打命中目标，那么令幽魂的生命上限提高~lg~20%~/~，并令其暴击几率永久~lg~+3%~/~。

desc_en: ~w~Jumps~/~ to the targeted tile. Instantly refreshes the cooldown of ~w~"Egg Clutch"~/~.
desc_zh: ~w~扑~/~向目标方格。~w~“产卵”~/~的冷却立刻结束。

desc_en: Marks a tile (~w~2~/~ different tiles or the same tile ~w~twice~/~ if equipped with a ~w~bow~/~ or ~w~sling~/~). ##Then takes a shot at them with ~r~/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~ Weapon Damage and ~lg~+/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~ Daze Chance.##Applies damaged targets with ~r~/*PRR*/%~/~ Block Chance and ~r~+/*FMB*/%~/~ Fumble Chance for ~w~5~/~ turns.##If the same target wasn't marked twice, ~lg~doubles~/~ the applied penalties' duration.##If equipped with a ~w~crossbow~/~, instantly reloads it and ~lg~doubles~/~ the applied penalties.
desc_zh: 标记一个方格（如果装备了~w~弓~/~或者~w~投石兵器~/~，那么可以标记~w~2~/~个方格或者同一方格标记~w~两次~/~）。##然后向标记的方格射出一箭或投射一次，这一下兵器伤害~r~/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~、击晕几率~lg~+/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~。##令受到伤害的目标~w~5~/~个回合之内格挡几率~r~/*PRR*/%~/~、失手几率~r~+/*FMB*/%~/~。##如果一个目标没有被标记两次，那么上述减益效果的存续时间~lg~翻倍~/~。##如果当前装备了~w~弩~/~，那么立刻填箭，同时令上述减益效果~lg~翻倍~/~。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~r~"Stasis"~/~ for ~w~3~/~ turns:##~lg~+200%~/~ Move Resistance#~lg~-50%~/~ Damage Taken#Immunity to all damage types except ~p~Arcane~/~.#Immunity to all effects except ~r~"Wormhole"~/~.#~r~Can't perform any actions~/~.#Prevents ~w~death~/~.#~w~Freezes~/~ all cooldowns and the duration of active effects.##When the effect expires or is removed, deals ~w~/*Total_Damage*/%~/~ of the ~p~Arcane Damage~/~ the target received over the course of ~r~"Stasis"~/~ to a ~w~3x3~/~ tile area, and with ~w~/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~Dazes~/~ all affected targets.##~w~Teleporting~/~ a target affected by ~r~"Stasis"~/~ removes the effect and ~w~doubles~/~ the chance to ~w~Daze~/~.##The spell can't be used on giant targets.
desc_zh: 对目标施加存续~w~3~/~个回合的~r~“静滞”~/~：##位移抗性~lg~+200%~/~#所受伤害~lg~-50%~/~#免疫~p~秘术伤害~/~以外的各类伤害。#免疫~r~“虫洞”~/~以外的所有效果。#~r~不能采取任何行动~/~。#防止~w~死亡~/~。#~w~冻结~/~当前所有冷却时间和生效效果的存续时间。##这个效果结束或移除时，对一片~w~3x3~/~格的范围造成~p~秘术伤害~/~，数值等于目标在~r~“静滞”~/~生效期间所受~p~秘术伤害~/~的~w~/*Total_Damage*/%~/~；同时还有~w~/*Daze_Chance*/%~/~的几率~w~击晕~/~所有受影响的目标。##~r~静滞~/~的目标如果~w~瞬间移动~/~，就会移除自身的这个效果，同时~w~眩晕~/~的几率~w~翻倍~/~。##这个法咒不能用于大型目标。

desc_en: Applies all ~ly~Resonating~/~ targets within Vision with ~r~"Static Field"~/~ for ~w~6~/~ turns, creating a ~w~3х3~/~ tile area around each of them.##Remaining in the spell's area of effect:##Deals ~ly~/*Shock_Damage*/ Shock Damage~/~#Applies with ~r~-4%~/~ Shock Resistance for ~w~10~/~ turns (the effect stacks up to ~w~5~/~ times).#Has ~w~/*Immob_Chance*/%~/~ chance to cause ~w~Immobilization~/~.##~r~"Static Field"~/~ doesn't affect the caster and deals ~lg~double~/~ damage to ~w~Immobilized~/~ targets.
desc_zh: 令视野之内所有~ly~“谐振”~/~的目标获得~w~6~/~个回合的~r~“静态场”~/~效果，在每个目标周围~w~3х3~/~格的范围内分别产生一个效果区域。##只要停在这个法咒的效果范围内，就会：##受到~ly~/*Shock_Damage*/点电击伤害~/~#~w~10~/~个回合之内电击抗性~r~-4%~/~（这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~5~/~层）#有~w~/*Immob_Chance*/%~/~的几率移动受限。##~r~静态场~/~不影响施法者，而且对~w~移动受限~/~的目标伤害~lg~翻倍~/~。

extra.zh: 静态场

desc_en: When enemies move to adjacent tiles, applies them with ~r~-10%~/~ Physical Resistance and ~r~-10%~/~ Crit Avoidance for ~w~4~/~ turns.##The effect stacks up to ~w~2~/~ times.##Grants spear strikes against adjacent targets ~lg~+30%~/~ Knockback Chance.
desc_zh: 敌人移到与你邻近的方格时，令其~w~4~/~个回合之内物理抗性~r~-10%~/~、暴击避免~r~-10%~/~。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~2~/~层。##长杆刃器击打邻近目标的击退几率~lg~+30%~/~。

desc_en: Steals ~r~6%~/~ Max Health and ~bl~6%~/~ Max Energy from an Undead ally, transferring them to the caster.##Activates ~lg~"Stolen Essence"~/~ for ~w~30~/~ turns:##~lg~+13%~/~ Magic Power#~lg~-9%~/~ Spells Energy Cost#~lg~-9%~/~ Cooldowns Duration#~lg~-9%~/~ Damage Taken#Using spells replenishes Health for ~w~9%~/~ of the Energy spent.##The repeated use of this spell grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~III~/~) and refreshes its duration.
desc_zh: 摄取一个友方不死生灵生命上限~r~6%~/~的生命和精力上限~bl~6%~/~的精力，将生命与精力转给施法者。##触发~lg~“摄魄”~/~，效果存续~w~30~/~回合：##法力~lg~+13%~/~#法咒精力消耗~lg~-9%~/~#剩余冷却时间~lg~-9%~/~#所受伤害~lg~-9%~/~#催动~w~法咒~/~会立刻恢复一定量的生命，恢复幅度等于所耗精力的~w~9%~/~。##反复催动这道法咒会令效果叠加（最多~w~三~/~层），并重置效果的存续时间。

desc_en: Performs a ~w~charge~/~ towards the target and delivers a strike to all adjacent tiles with ~lg~+/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~ Weapon Damage and ~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ Knockback Chance.##Reduces the ability tree's cooldowns and cooldowns of all spells by ~lg~2~/~ turns for each enemy ~w~knocked~/~ back by the strike.
desc_zh: 向目标~w~突进~/~一次，击打一次所有邻近方格，本次击打兵器伤害~lg~+/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~、击退几率~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~。##本次击打每~w~击退~/~一个敌人，同一能力树技能与所有法咒当前的剩余冷却时间便缩短~lg~2~/~回合。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Stone Armor"~/~ for ~w~4~/~ turns (~w~+4~/~ turns for each stack of ~lg~"Runic Empowerment"~/~):##~lg~+15%~/~ Physical Resistance#~lg~+20%~/~ Nature Resistance#~lg~+15%~/~ Magic Resistance#~lg~+20%~/~ Bleed Resistance#~lg~+20%~/~ Move Resistance#~lg~+20%~/~ Control Resistance##Summoning ~w~runic boulders~/~ prolongs the effect's duration by ~lg~2~/~ turns.##When the effect expires or is activated again, the armor explodes, dealing ~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/ Arcane~/~ and ~w~/*Blunt_Damage*/ Crushing Damage~/~ to all adjacent targets, and with ~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~Knocking~/~ them back.##The explosion's damage increases by ~lg~100%~/~ for each strike or shot received over the course of the effect (but no more than ~w~/*Max_DMG*/~/~).
desc_zh: 发动~lg~石甲~/~，存续~w~4~/~个回合（每有一层~lg~符文强化~/~，便延长~w~4~/~个回合）：##物理抗性~lg~+15%~/~#自然抗性~lg~+20%~/~#魔法抗性~lg~+15%~/~#出血抗性~lg~+20%~/~#位移抗性~lg~+20%~/~#控制抗性~lg~+20%~/~##效果结束或再次发动时，石甲爆炸，对邻近的所有目标造成 ~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/奥秘伤害~/~和 ~w~/*Blunt_Damage*/点钝击伤害~/~，并有~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~的几率造成~w~击退~/~。##爆炸的伤害有可能提升，提升倍数等于效果期间所受到的击打和射击次数之和（不过~w~/*Max_DMG*/~/~封顶）。#召唤~w~符文巨石~/~会令本效果存续时间延长~w~2~/~个回合。

desc_en: Destroys the chosen ~w~runic boulder~/~, dealing ~w~/*Piercing_Damage*/ Piercing~/~ and ~w~/*Blunt_Damage*/ Crushing Damage~/~ to all tiles adjacent to it, and with ~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~knocks~/~ the affected targets back.##Then, if the adjacent tiles are empty, summons ~w~stone spikes~/~ on them, which persist for ~w~8~/~ turns.##The ~w~spikes'~/~ Durability depends on the caster's Max Energy.
desc_zh: 摧毁所选~w~符文巨石~/~，对与其邻近的所有方格造成~w~/*Piercing_Damage*/点穿刺伤害~/~和~w~/*Blunt_Damage*/点钝击伤害~/~，并有~w~/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~的几率~w~击退~/~受到影响的目标。##然后，如果有邻近方格上没有目标，那么召唤~w~石刺~/~，存续~w~8~/~个回合。##~w~石刺~/~的耐久取决于施法者的精力上限。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Striker Stance"~/~ for ~w~10~/~ turns:##~lg~+3%~/~ Crit Chance#~lg~+10%~/~ Knockback Chance#~lg~+10%~/~ Armor Penetration#~lg~+15%~/~ Stagger Chance#Grants ~lg~+100%~/~ Daze Chance to every ~w~third~/~ strike.##Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~IV~/~).##Basic two-handed mace strikes prolong the effect's duration by ~lg~1~/~ turn (up to ~w~10~/~) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn).##Only one ~w~Stance~/~ effect can be active at a time.##If affected by ~lg~"Mighty Swing"~/~, using the skill delivers a strike to a random adjacent enemy.
desc_zh: 触发~w~10~/~个回合的~lg~“大杀四方”~/~：##暴击几率~lg~+3%~/~#击退几率~lg~+10%~/~#护甲穿透~lg~+10%~/~#破衡几率~lg~+15%~/~##以三次击打为周期，每个周期~w~第三次~/~击打击晕几率~lg~+100%~/~。##运用同一能力树的技能会令这个效果叠加一层（最多叠到~w~四~/~层）。##双手锤、棒普通击打会令效果的存续时间延长~lg~1~/~个回合（最多~w~10~/~个回合），但也会令效果的层数减少（每回合最多一次）。##~lg~站姿~/~效果无法多个同时生效。##~lg~“无坚不摧”~/~生效期间，运用这个技能会随机击打一个邻近敌人。

desc_en: Delivers a strike with ~r~-50%~/~ Weapon Damage and ~lg~+/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~ Stagger Chance.##Reduces all cooldowns by ~lg~2~/~ turns.##A successful, damaging hit puts all of the target's abilities on a ~r~2~/~ turn cooldown.##If equipped with a ~w~spear~/~, grants the skill ~lg~+1~/~ Range.
desc_zh: 击打一次，本次击打兵器伤害~r~-50%~/~、破衡几率~lg~+/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~。##令所有能力的剩余冷却时间缩短~lg~2~/~回合。##如果目标被成功命中并受到伤害，那么其所有能力当前剩余的冷却时间增加~r~2~/~回合。##如果所用兵器为~w~长杆刃器~/~，那么这个技能的距离~lg~+1~/~。

desc_en: Summons a ~w~Blood Golem~/~ on the targeted tile.##Only ~w~3~/~ ~w~Blood Golems~/~ can be summoned simultaneously.
desc_zh: 在目标方格召唤一个~w~赤血魔像~/~。##最多可以同时存在~w~3~/~个~w~魔像~/~。

desc_en: Summons a ~w~Bloodgorger Worm~/~ on the targeted tile.

desc_zh: 在目标方格召唤一只~w~啐血蠕虫~/~。

desc_en: Summons three ~w~Rockeaters~/~ within ~w~2-4~/~ tiles of the target.##The ~w~Rockeaters'~/~ strength depends on the location's ~w~danger~/~.##Spotting an enemy puts this skill on a ~w~5~/~ turn cooldown.
desc_zh: 在目标周围~w~2-4~/~格的范围之内召唤三只~w~食岩虫~/~。##这些~w~食岩虫~/~的战力取决于当前地点的~w~危险程度~/~。##虫王看到敌人会令这个技能进入~w~5~/~个回合的冷却。

desc_en: The ~w~right statue~/~ summons a ~w~Restless~/~ next to one of the corpse piles.
desc_zh: ~w~右侧雕像~/~在一堆尸体旁边召唤一个~w~僵尸~/~。

desc_en: Summons a ~w~Thrall~/~ on the targeted tile.##Only ~w~3~/~ ~w~Thralls~/~ can be summoned simultaneously.
desc_zh: 在目标方格召唤一个~w~役奴~/~。##最多可以同时存在~w~3~/~个~w~役奴~/~。

desc_en: Loses ~r~3%~/~ Max Health and summons a ~w~Leech Worm~/~ on the targeted tile.
desc_zh: 损失生命上限~r~3%~/~的生命，在目标方格召唤一条~w~吸血蠕虫~/~。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Suppression"~/~ for ~w~12~/~ turns (~w~15~/~ turns if equipped with a ~w~crossbow~/~):##~lg~+5%~/~ Immobilization Chance#~lg~+10%~/~ Knockback Chance#~lg~+10%~/~ Bleed Chance#~lg~-5%~/~ Cooldowns Duration#~lg~-5%~/~ Skills Energy Cost##Using the ability tree's skills (except ~w~"Taking Aim"~/~) grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~IV~/~).##If equipped with a ~w~sling~/~, using the ability tree's skills increases the number of stacks by ~lg~2~/~.##Basic shots prolong the effect's duration by ~lg~1~/~ turn (up to ~w~15~/~) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn).##Only one ~w~Stance~/~ effect can be active at a time.
desc_zh: 触发~w~12~/~个回合（如果装备了~w~弩~/~，就是~w~15~/~个回合）的~lg~“压制”~/~：##限制移动几率~lg~+5%~/~#击退几率~lg~+10%~/~#出血几率~lg~+10%~/~#能力冷却时间~lg~-5%~/~#技能精力消耗~lg~-5%~/~##运用同一能力树的技能（~w~瞄准~/~除外）会令这个效果叠加1层。（最多~w~五~/~层）##如果装备了~w~投石兵器~/~，那么运用同一能力树的技能会令这个效果额外叠加~lg~2~/~层。##普通射击会令这个效果存续时间延长~lg~1~/~个回合（最多~w~12~/~个回合），但是会令效果层数减少（每回合最多一次）。##~lg~站姿~/~效果无法多个同时生效。

desc_en: Grants all received strikes and shots ~r~+50%~/~ Fumble Chance.##Each missing ~r~percent~/~ of Health increases the penalty by ~r~+0.2%~/~ and also grants the Rat Swarm ~r~-1%~/~ Damage.
desc_zh: 令自身受到的所有击打、射击失手几率~r~+50%~/~。##每~r~少~/~一个百分点的生命，上述两项减益就增加~r~+0.2%~/~，并令鼠群的伤害~r~-1%~/~。

desc_en: Grants all received strikes and shots ~r~+50%~/~ Fumble Chance.##Each missing ~r~percent~/~ of Health increases the penalty by ~r~+0.2%~/~ and also grants the Bat Swarm ~r~-1%~/~ Damage.
desc_zh: 令自身受到的所有击打、射击失手几率~r~+50%~/~。##每~r~少~/~一个百分点的生命，上述两项减益就增加~r~+0.2%~/~，并令蝙蝠的伤害~r~-1%~/~。

desc_en: Performs a ~w~charge~/~ towards the targeted tile. Grants ~lg~+25%~/~ Dodge Chance for ~w~3~/~ turns.##This skill can be used only while affected by ~lg~"Exaltation"~/~.
desc_zh: 向目标方格~w~突进~/~一次，令自身~w~3~/~个回合之内闪躲几率~lg~+25%~/~。##这个技能只有~lg~“腾空”~/~状态可以发动。

desc_en: Delivers a strike with ~lg~+0.5%~/~ Weapon Damage for each ~w~percent~/~ of the target's Pain and with ~lg~+1%~/~ Bodypart Damage for each missing ~r~percent~/~ of its Health.##Reduces the skill's cooldown by ~lg~1~/~ turn for each ~r~Bleeding~/~ or degree of ~r~Injury~/~ affecting the target.
desc_zh: 击打一次，目标每有一个百分点的疼痛，本次击打兵器伤害就~lg~+0.5%~/~；目标的生命每缺失一个~w~百分点~/~，本次击打的肢体伤害就~lg~+1%~/~。##目标每带有一处~r~出血~/~或一处~r~伤情~/~，这个技能当前剩余的冷却时间就缩短~lg~1~/~个回合。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Taking Aim"~/~ for ~w~1~/~ turn:##~lg~+/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~ Accuracy#~lg~+/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~ Weapon Damage#~lg~+10%~/~ Range##Each enemy within ~w~4~/~ tiles additionally grants to the effect:##~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ Knockback Chance#~lg~+/*Immob_Chance*/%~/~ Immobilization Chance#~lg~+/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~ Stagger Chance##The bonus to Accuracy depends on the number of learned ~w~Ranged Weapons~/~ abilities.##The effect is removed if not equipped with a ~w~ranged weapon~/~.
desc_zh: 触发~w~1~/~个回合的~lg~“瞄准”~/~：##准度~lg~+/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~#兵器伤害~lg~+/*Weapon_Damage*/%~/~#距离~lg~+10%~/~##方圆~w~4~/~个方格之内每有一个敌人，那么这个效果就另外获得以下增益：##击退几率~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~#限制移动几率~lg~+/*Immob_Chance*/%~/~#破衡几率~lg~+/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~##准度的增益取决于习得了几项~w~远程兵器~/~能力。##如果没有装备~w~远程兵器~/~，就移除“瞄准”的效果。

desc_en: Delivers a strike with ~lg~+150%~/~ Bodypart Damage, ~lg~+80%~/~ Bleed Chance, and ~lg~+25%~/~ Life Drain.##If the strike worsens an ~r~Injury~/~ or causes a new one, replenishes ~lg~25%~/~ Max Health. If the strike causes ~r~Bleeding~/~, replenishes ~lg~10%~/~ Max Health.
desc_zh: 击打一次，本次击打肢体伤害~lg~+150%~/~、出血几率~lg~+80%~/~、生命吸取~lg~+25%~/~。##如果本次击打令目标~r~受伤~/~或令其现有伤情恶化，则立刻恢复自身生命上限~lg~25%~/~的生命。如果本次击打造成~r~出血~/~，那么立刻恢复自身生命上限~lg~10%~/~的生命。

desc_en: Deals ~ly~/*Shock_Damage*/ Shock Damage~/~ to the target and two random enemies within Vision, prioritizing the ones affected by ~r~"Resonance"~/~.##Removes ~r~"Resonance"~/~ from the affected targets and with ~w~/*Stun_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~Stuns~/~ them.##Each turn of removed ~r~"Resonance"~/~ increases the damage and the Stun Chance by ~lg~5%~/~.##If the spell ~w~Stuns~/~ the target, summons an additional lightning against a random enemy within Vision.##Instantly kills the target if the spell puts its Health below ~r~/*HP_Limit*/%~/~ (but no more than ~w~/*Max_HP_Limit*/~/~).
desc_zh: 对视野之内一个目标和随机两个敌人造成~ly~/*Shock_Damage*/点电击伤害~/~，优先伤害~r~“谐振”~/~状态的敌人.##移除目标的~r~“谐振”~/~状态，有~w~/*Stun_Chance*/%~/~的几率令目标~w~硬直~/~。#~r~“谐振”~/~移除时每剩一个回合，这一道法咒造成的伤害和硬直几率便增加~lg~5%~/~。##如果这个法咒造成~w~硬直~/~，那么额外召唤一道闪电，随机攻击视野内的一个敌人。##如果敌人当前生命少于生命上限的~r~/*HP_Limit*/%~/~（且不多于~w~/*Max_HP_Limit*/~/~点），那么立刻将其击杀。

desc_en: Summons a ~w~Tentacle Arm~/~ on the targeted tile and activates ~lg~"Shared Flesh"~/~ for an indefinite number of turns:##~lg~-99%~/~ Damage Taken#~lg~+200%~/~ Move Resistance#~lg~+66%~/~ Control Resistance#~lg~+66%~/~ Healing Efficiency#~r~Can't move to other tiles or deliver strikes~/~.
desc_zh: 在目标方格召唤一条~w~触手~/~，触发效果~lg~“共肉”~/~，存续无限回合：##所受伤害~lg~-99%~/~#位移抗性~lg~+200%~/~#控制抗性~lg~+66%~/~#治疗效果~lg~+66%~/~#~r~不能击打，也不能移至其他方格~/~

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Thirst for Battle"~/~ for ~w~8~/~ turns.##Each missing ~r~percent~/~ of Health grants:##~lg~+0.4%~/~ Weapon Damage#~lg~+0.2%~/~ Crit Chance#~lg~+0.5%~/~ Crit Efficiency#~lg~+0.25%~/~ Life Drain#~lg~+0.4%~/~ Energy Drain##The effect's power changes dynamically depending on the current Health.##Critical strikes and shots prolong the effect's duration by ~lg~1~/~ turn (up to ~w~8~/~).##The first strike received on the same turn as using the skill is guaranteed to trigger a counter.
desc_zh: 触发~w~8~/~个回合的~lg~“奋力一搏”~/~。##生命每少一个~r~百分点~/~，那么：##兵器伤害就~lg~+0.4%~/~#暴击几率就~lg~+0.2%~/~#暴击效果就~lg~+0.5%~/~#生命吸取就~lg~+0.25%~/~#精力吸取就~lg~+0.4%~/~##这组效果的强度会随当前生命的变化动态变动。##击打和射击的暴击会令这组效果的存续时间延长~lg~1~/~个回合（最多~w~8~/~个回合）。##运用这一个技能的回合期间，第一次遭受的击打一定会触发反击。

desc_zh: 对目标造成~w~/*Piercing_Damage*/点穿刺伤害~/~、~g~/*Poison_Damage*/点中毒伤害~/~和~ur~/*Unholy_Damage*/ 点邪术伤害~/~，护甲穿透~lg~+33%~/~、出血几率~lg~+66%~/~、限制移动几率~lg~+66%~/~、生命吸取~lg~+66%~/~。##这个技能无法反击。

desc_zh: 造成~w~/*Blunt_Damage*/点钝击伤害~/~、~g~/*Poison_Damage*/点中毒伤害~/~和~ur~/*Unholy_Damage*/ 点邪术伤害~/~，护甲穿透~lg~+33%~/~，有~w~99%~/~的几率将目标~w~拉近~/~~w~4~/~格。##这个技能无法反击。

desc_zh: 可以拿在手上、点燃。##能够~ly~照亮~/~周围~w~9~/~个方格。#如果站在照亮的区域，视野范围不会受黑暗影响。

desc_en: Replenishes ~lg~13%~/~ Max Health to the target and grants it ~w~1~/~ stack of ~lg~"Unholy Blessing"~/~ for ~w~13~/~ turns:##~lg~+6%~/~ Life Drain#~lg~+6%~/~ Energy Drain#~lg~-6%~/~ Damage Taken##The repeated application of the effect grants an extra stack of it (up to ~w~III~/~) and refreshes its duration.
desc_zh: 令目标恢复生命上限~lg~13%~/~的生命，令其接下来~w~13~/~回合获得一层~lg~“邪术庇佑”~/~：##生命吸取~lg~+6%~/~#精力吸取~lg~+6%~/~#所受伤害~lg~-6%~/~##反复施加这个效果会令其叠加（最多~w~三~/~层），同时会令其存续时间重置。

desc_en: If a target affected by ~r~"Enough for Everyone"~/~ dies, replenishes ~lg~/*HP*/%~/~ Max Health and ~bl~/*Regen_MP*/%~/~ Max Energy, then delivers a free dual strike to a random adjacent enemy and applies it with the same effect (but no more than once per turn).
desc_zh: 如果~r~“人人有份”~/~影响的目标死亡，那么立刻恢复生命上限~lg~/*HP*/%~/~的生命和精力上限~bl~/*Regen_MP*/%~/~的精力，然后双手随机击打一个邻近目标，令其获得相同的效果，本次击打不消耗回合（每回合最多1次）。

desc_en: Delivers a strike to three adjacent tiles with ~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ Knockback Chance and ~lg~+/*Armor_Damage*/%~/~ Armor Damage.##Grants ~lg~-10%~/~ Skills Energy Cost for ~w~3~/~ turns for each target that is ~w~knocked~/~ back by the strike.##The effect stacks up to ~w~3~/~ times.##If affected by ~lg~"Mighty Swing"~/~, and the strike ~w~knocked~/~ the target back, puts its abilities on a ~r~2~/~ turn cooldown.
desc_zh: 击打一次三个邻近方格，本次击打击退几率~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~、护甲破坏~lg~+/*Armor_Damage*/%~/~。##本次击打每~w~击退~/~一个目标，就令~w~3~/~个回合之内技能精力消耗~lg~-10%~/~。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~3~/~层。##~lg~“无坚不摧”~/~生效期间，如果击打~w~击退~/~目标，就令目标所有能力冷却时间延长~r~2~/~个回合。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Unwavering Stance"~/~ for ~w~10~/~ turns:##~lg~+10%~/~ Magic Resistance#~lg~+10%~/~ Nature Resistance#~lg~+5%~/~ Counter Chance#~lg~+10%~/~ Block Chance#~lg~+10%~/~ Max Block Power#~lg~+10%~/~ Block Power Recovery#Grants ~lg~+100%~/~ Knockback Chance to every ~w~third~/~ strike.##Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~IV~/~).##Basic staff strikes prolong the effect's duration by ~lg~1~/~ turn (up to ~w~10~/~) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn).##Only one ~w~Stance~/~ effect can be active at a time.
desc_zh: 触发~w~10~/~个回合的~lg~“不动不摇”~/~：##魔法抗性~lg~+10%~/~#自然抗性~lg~+10%~/~#反击几率~lg~+5%~/~#格挡几率~lg~+10%~/~#格挡力量上限~lg~+10%~/~#格挡力量恢复~lg~+10%~/~#以三次击打为周期，每个周期的~w~第三次~/~击打击退几率~lg~+100%~/~。##运用同一能力树的技能会令这个效果叠加1层（最多叠到~w~四~/~层）##长杖普通击打会令这个效果存续时间延长~lg~1~/~个回合（最多~w~10~/~个回合），但是会令效果层数减少（每个回合最多一次）。##~lg~站姿~/~效果无法多个同时生效。

desc_en: ~w~Repositions~/~ to an adjacent tile, lowers the equipped ~w~helmet's~/~ visor, and activates ~lg~"Unyielding Defense"~/~ for ~w~8~/~ turns:##~lg~+6%~/~ to all body parts' Protection (no less than ~lg~+1~/~)#~lg~+4%~/~ Fortitude#~lg~+4%~/~ Block Power Recovery#~lg~+4%~/~ Block Chance or ~lg~+4%~/~ Dodge Chance (the priority is given to the highest Stat)##Each received strike or shot grants an extra stack of the effect (up to ~w~V~/~).
desc_zh: ~w~调整位置~/~，移到邻近方格。如果戴了头盔，那么放下~w~头盔~/~的面甲，触发~w~8~/~个回合的~lg~“岿然不动”~/~：##每个身体部位的防护~lg~+6%~/~（不少于~lg~+1~/~）#坚忍~lg~+4%~/~#格挡力量恢复~lg~+4%~/~#格挡几率~lg~+4%~/~或闪躲几率~lg~+4%~/~（角色哪一项数值高，哪一项获得增益）##每次受到击打或射击，这个效果就叠加1层（最多叠到~w~五~/~层）。

desc_en: Delivers a strike with ~r~-9%~/~ Accuracy, ~lg~+33%~/~ Bleed Chance, and ~lg~+33%~/~ Immobilization Chance.##If the target takes damage, applies it with ~r~-6%~/~ Bleed Resistance, ~r~-6%~/~ Move Resistance, and ~r~-6%~/~ Control Resistance for ~w~9~/~ turns.##The effect stacks up to ~w~3~/~ times.
desc_zh: 击打一次，本次击打准度~r~-9%~/~、出血几率~lg~+33%~/~、限制移动几率~lg~+33%~/~。##如果目标受到伤害，那么令其~w~9~/~个回合之内出血抗性、位移抗性和控制抗性分别~r~-6%~/~。##这个效果可以叠加，最多~w~3~/~层。

desc_en: Consecutive damaging strikes against the same target grant ~lg~+15%~/~ Life Drain and ~lg~+7.5%~/~ Armor Penetration for ~w~6~/~ turns.
desc_zh: 后续每一次击打只要对同一目标造成伤害，就令自身~w~6~/~回合内的生命吸取~lg~+15%~/~、护甲穿透~lg~+7.5%~/~。

desc_en: Makes a large amount of ~w~noise~/~. With ~w~/*Disable_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~Confuses~/~ all enemies within ~w~9~/~ tiles for ~w~6~/~ turns or ~w~Dazes~/~ them for ~w~2-3~/~ turns.##The chances to ~w~Confuse~/~ and ~w~Daze~/~ depend on the target's ~w~Will to Fight~/~.##Activates ~lg~"Battle Rage"~/~ for ~w~6~/~ turns (~w~+2~/~ turns for each enemy ~w~Confused~/~ or ~w~Dazed~/~ by the skill, up to ~w~20~/~):##~lg~+10%~/~ Weapon Damage#~lg~+5%~/~ Crit Chance#~lg~+20%~/~ Crit Efficiency
desc_zh: 产生巨大~w~声响~/~。有~w~/*Disable_Chance*/%~/~的几率令方圆~w~9~/~格之内的所有敌人~w~混乱~/~~w~6~/~个回合，或令他们~w~眩晕~/~~w~2-3~/~个回合。##~w~混乱~/~和~w~眩晕~/~的几率取决于目标的~w~战斗意愿~/~。##触发~w~6~/~个回合（每有一个敌人因为这个技能而~w~混乱~/~或~w~眩晕~/~，存续时间就~w~+2~/~，最多~w~20~/~个回合）的~lg~“激昂”~/~：##兵器伤害~lg~+10%~/~#暴击几率~lg~+5%~/~#暴击效果~lg~+20%~/~

desc_en: Study various tactics and combat moves to emerge victorious from any battle.##~y~Main focus:~/~#~w~Support~/~, ~w~Survivability~/~, ~w~Weakening Effects~/~
desc_zh: 研习战斗取胜所需的各种战术和格斗招式。##~y~能力要义：~/~#~w~辅助~/~、~w~生存~/~、~w~造成减益~/~

extra.zh: 战斗与角色

desc_en: Spits a ball of webbing, dealing ~cg~/*Caustic_Damage*/ Caustic~/~ and ~g~/*Poison_Damage*/ Poison Damage~/~ with ~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~ Accuracy.##Hitting the target applies it with ~r~"Web"~/~ for ~w~6-8~/~ turns:##~r~+30%~/~ Fumble Chance#~r~-25%~/~ Dodge Chance#~r~-50%~/~ Block Chance#~r~-50%~/~ Counter Chance#~r~+30%~/~ Backfire Chance##The effect can't be applied to tiny and giant targets.
desc_zh: 吐出一张网，造成~cg~/*Caustic_Damage*/点腐蚀伤害~/~和~g~/*Poison_Damage*/点中毒伤害~/~，准度为~w~/*Hit_Chance*/%~/~。##如果这个技能命中目标，那么令其~r~“束手束脚”~/~~w~6-8~/~回合：##失手几率~r~+30%~/~#闪躲几率~r~-25%~/~#失误几率~r~+30%~/~#格挡几率~r~-50%~/~#反击几率~r~-50%~/~。##体型很小或巨大的目标不会受这个效果影响。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~r~/*CTA*/%~/~ Counter Chance until the next turn, delivers a dual strike with ~lg~+/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~ Stagger Chance, and with ~w~/*Move_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~swaps~/~ places with the target.##Then proceeds delivering strikes with the same effects to random adjacent enemies (prioritizing new ones) until one of them is struck twice.##If this skill kills a target, allows the character to repeat the strike ~w~2~/~ more times without restrictions.
desc_zh: 令目标下一回合之前反击几率~r~/*CTA*/%~/~，双手接连击打一次，这两次击打破衡几率~lg~+/*Stagger_Chance*/%~/~，同时有~w~/*Move_Chance*/%~/~的几率与目标~w~对调~/~位置。##然后继续随机击打一个邻近的敌人（优先没有受到这个技能击打的目标），效果相同，直至有一个目标第二次受到这个技能攻击。##如果这个技能击杀目标，那么双手可以再接连击打~w~2~/~次，不受限制。

desc_en: Delivers a strike to three adjacent tiles with ~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ Knockback Chance.
desc_zh: 向三个邻近方格击打一次，本次击打击退几率~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~。

desc_en: Delivers a strike to three adjacent tiles with ~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~ Knockback Chance.
desc_zh: 向三个邻近方格击打一次，本次击打击退几率~lg~+/*Knockback_Chance*/%~/~。

desc_en: Removes all negative physical and mental effects. Activates ~lg~"Vigor"~/~ for ~w~60~/~ turns.##Activates ~lg~"Will to Survive"~/~ for ~w~15~/~ turns:##~lg~+/*Fortitude*/%~/~ Fortitude#~w~Temporary~/~ immunity to ~r~Injuries~/~ and negative states (caused by ~r~Fatigue~/~, ~r~Pain~/~, low ~w~Morale~/~, etc).#~lg~-5%~/~ Damage Taken for each fully or temporarily removed effect, ~r~Injury~/~, or state (up to ~lg~-25%~/~).##Replenishes ~lg~/*HP*/%~/~ Max Health.
desc_zh: 移除所有负面的物理效果和精神效果。触发~w~60~/~个回合的~lg~“精神焕发”~/~。##触发~w~15~/~个回合的~lg~求生欲~/~：##~lg~+/*Fortitude*/%~/~坚忍#~w~暂时~/~免疫~r~受伤~/~以及~r~疲劳~/~、~r~疼痛~/~、低~w~神智~/~等造成的负面状态。#每移除1个效果、~r~伤势~/~或状态，不论彻底移除还是暂时移除，所受伤害便~lg~-5%~/~（最多~lg~-25%~/~）。##立刻恢复生命上限~lg~/*HP*/%~/~的生命。

desc_en: Receiving damage replenishes the same amount of Health to all allies within Vision.
desc_zh: 受到伤害时，令视野内所有友方立刻恢复一定量的生命，数值等于本次所受到的伤害。

desc_en: Grants ~lg~+6%~/~ Max Health and ~lg~+6%~/~ Weapon Damage for each type of Proselyte within Vision.##Hitting an enemy applies them with ~r~+3%~/~ Damage Taken for ~w~6~/~ turns for each type of Proselyte within Vision.
desc_zh: 视野之内每有一类变节信徒，生命上限和兵器伤害就分别~lg~+6%~/~。##视野之内每有一类变节信徒，命中敌方就会令其~w~6~/~回合之内所受伤害~r~+3%~/~。

desc_en: Destroys a flesh-covered corpse and summons ~w~Leech Worms~/~ on the tiles adjacent to it. The number of ~w~Worms~/~ depends on the corpse's size.##Permanently grants ~lg~+9%~/~ Max Health, ~lg~+6%~/~ Bleed Chance, and ~lg~+6%~/~ Crit Chance to all previously summoned ~w~Leech Worms~/~.
desc_zh: 毁掉一具肉尸，在与其邻近的方格召唤~w~吸血蠕虫~/~。~w~蠕虫~/~的数量取决于尸体体型。##令此前召唤的所有~w~吸血蠕虫~/~生命上限~lg~+9%~/~、出血几率~lg~+6%~/~、暴击几率~lg~+6%~/~。

desc_en: Destroys a flesh-covered corpse and summons ~w~Leech Worms~/~ on the tiles adjacent to it. The number of ~w~Worms~/~ depends on the corpse's size.##Permanently grants ~lg~+9%~/~ Max Health, ~lg~+6%~/~ Bleed Chance, and ~lg~+6%~/~ Crit Chance to all previously summoned ~w~Leech Worms~/~.
desc_zh: 毁掉一具肉尸，在与其邻近的方格召唤~w~吸血蠕虫~/~。~w~蠕虫~/~的数量取决于尸体体型。##令此前召唤的所有~w~吸血蠕虫~/~生命上限~lg~+9%~/~、出血几率~lg~+6%~/~、暴击几率~lg~+6%~/~。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~r~"Wormhole"~/~ for ~w~3~/~ turns and marks its tile.##When the effect expires or is removed, ~w~teleports~/~ the target to the marked tile, dealing ~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/ Arcane Damage~/~.##If the marked tile is occupied, ~w~teleports~/~ the target to the closest empty tile, dealing additional ~p~/*Arcane_Damage_Add*/ Arcane Damage~/~ and with ~w~/*Stun_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~Stunning~/~ it.##While ~r~"Wormhole"~/~ is active, the spell doesn't go on cooldown and can be used again without spending Energy to remove the effect from the target.##The spell can't be used on giant or stationary targets and doesn't harm the caster.
desc_zh: 对目标施加存续~w~3~/~个回合的~r~“虫洞”~/~，同时标记其所在方格。##这个效果结束或移除时，令目标~w~瞬间移动~/~到标记方格，对其造成~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/点秘术伤害~/~。##如果标记方格存在其他生灵或物体，那么令目标~w~瞬间移动~/~到距离标记方格最近的空方格，并且额外对其造成~p~/*Arcane_Damage_Add*/点秘术伤害~/~，还有~w~/*Stun_Chance*/%~/~的几率令其~w~硬直~/~。##~r~“虫洞”~/~生效期间，这个法咒不会进入冷却，而且如果再次催动的目的是移除目标的这个效果，那么本次催动不会消耗精力。##这个法咒不能用于大型目标和固定目标，不会伤害施法者。

desc_en: Applies the target with ~r~"Wormhole"~/~ for ~w~3~/~ turns and marks its tile.##When the effect expires or is removed, ~w~teleports~/~ the target to the marked tile, dealing ~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/ Arcane Damage~/~.##If the marked tile is occupied, ~w~teleports~/~ the target to the closest empty tile, dealing additional ~p~/*Arcane_Damage_Add*/ Arcane Damage~/~ and with ~w~/*Stun_Chance*/%~/~ chance ~w~Stunning~/~ it.##While ~r~"Wormhole"~/~ is active, the spell doesn't go on cooldown and can be used again without spending Energy to remove the effect from the target.##The spell can't be used on giant or stationary targets and doesn't harm the caster.
desc_zh: 对目标施加存续~w~3~/~个回合的~r~“虫洞”~/~，同时标记其所在方格。##这个效果结束或移除时，令目标~w~瞬间移动~/~到标记方格，对其造成~p~/*Arcane_Damage*/点秘术伤害~/~。##如果标记方格存在其他生灵或物体，那么令目标~w~瞬间移动~/~到距离标记方格最近的空方格，并且额外对其造成~p~/*Arcane_Damage_Add*/点秘术伤害~/~，还有~w~/*Stun_Chance*/%~/~的几率令其~w~硬直~/~。##~r~“虫洞”~/~生效期间，这个法咒不会进入冷却，而且如果再次催动的目的是移除目标的这个效果，那么本次催动不会消耗精力。##这个法咒不能用于大型目标和固定目标，不会伤害施法者。

desc_en: Activates ~lg~"Praise the Court!"~/~ for ~w~9~/~ turns:##~r~Can't move to other tiles or deliver strikes~/~.#~w~Daze~/~, ~w~Stun~/~, and ~w~Stagger~/~ prolong the effect's duration by ~r~1~/~ turn.##When the effect expires, the Supplicant transforms into a ~w~Thrall~/~ and grants ~lg~"Blood Oath"~/~ to all Proselytes within Vision for ~w~9~/~ turns:##~lg~+33%~/~ Life Drain#~lg~+33%~/~ Healing Efficiency#~lg~-33%~/~ Abilities Energy Cost
desc_zh: 触发效果~lg~“赞颂圣宫！”~/~，持续~w~9~/~个回合：##~r~不能移动，也不能击打~/~。#~w~眩晕~/~、~w~硬直~/~或~w~失衡~/~会令这个效果延长~r~1~/~个回合。##效果结束时，祈愿信徒变为~w~役奴~/~，同时令视野之内所有~w~变节信徒~/~获得存续~w~9~/~个回合的~lg~“血誓”~/~：##生命吸取~lg~+33%~/~#治疗效果~lg~+33%~/~#能力精力消耗~lg~-33%~/~。

desc_en: Grants critical spear strikes ~lg~+20%~/~ Bodypart Damage.##Сritical spear strikes deal additional damage equal to ~w~10%~/~ of the target's Max Health (but no more than ~w~/*Max_DMG*/~/~).
desc_zh: 长杆刃器暴击肢体伤害~lg~+20%~/~。##长杆刃器暴击会额外造成伤害，额外的伤害数值等于目标生命上限的~w~10%~/~（但不会高于~w~/*Max_DMG*/~/~）。

desc_en: Summons a ~w~Wraith~/~ on the targeted tile. The ~w~Wraith's~/~ power depends on the number of ~lg~"Stolen Essence"~/~ stacks.
desc_zh: 在目标方格召唤一个~w~幽魂~/~。这个~w~幽魂~/~的战力取决于~lg~“摄魄”~/~的层数。
